2608.29059v1.title: Primordial black holes and induced gravitational waves from localized features in DBI inflation
2608.29059v1.abstract: We investigate primordial black hole formation in a Dirac-Born-Infeld inflationary framework in which the background dynamics are determined by explicit functional forms of the inflaton potential $V(\phi)$ and the warp factor $f(\phi)$. The background equations are solved numerically to obtain the evolution of the slow-roll parameters. We show that a localized feature in the potential, accompanied by a correlated structure in the warp factor, dynamically induces a transient suppression of the slow-roll parameter, leading to a short-lived non-attractor phase. This behavior generates an enhancement of the curvature power spectrum on small scales, while preserving consistency with CMB-scale observables. The Mukhanov-Sasaki equation is then solved numerically to compute the resulting power spectrum, which exhibits narrow and localized peaks in the PBH abundance across different mass ranges. We also evaluate the associated stochastic background of induced gravitational waves and find that the predicted signal can fall within the sensitivity bands of future pulsar timing arrays and space-based interferometers, depending on the scale of the inflationary feature. A parameter scan in the $(r,n_s)$ plane shows that the large-scale predictions remain consistent with current observational constraints.

classification.title_zh: DBI暴胀中局域特征产生的原初黑洞与诱导引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Dirac-Born-Infeld (DBI) 暴胀框架下研究原初黑洞的形成，其中背景动力学由暴胀子势 V(φ) 和翘曲因子 f(φ) 的显式函数形式决定。数值求解背景方程得到慢滚参数的演化。我们证明，势中的局域特征伴随翘曲因子中的相关结构，会动力学地诱发慢滚参数的瞬态压低，从而导致短命的非吸引子阶段。这种行为在小尺度上增强曲率功率谱，同时保持与 CMB 尺度可观测量的相容性。随后数值求解 Mukhanov-Sasaki 方程计算所得功率谱，结果显示在不同质量范围内 PBH 丰度出现窄而局域的峰。我们还评估了相关的诱导引力波随机背景，发现预测信号可以落入未来脉冲星计时阵列和空间干涉仪的灵敏度带内，具体取决于暴胀特征所处的尺度。在 (r, n_s) 平面上的参数扫描表明，大尺度预言与当前观测约束一致。
classification.one_liner: 在 DBI 暴胀中引入局域的势与翘曲因子结构，可增强小尺度曲率功率谱并产生原初黑洞与可被未来探测器观测的诱导引力波。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学暴胀与原初黑洞/引力波方向，与用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、超流超导等支线不相关；仅因涉及引力波和黑洞现象而与经典引力/广义相对论支线有微弱关联。

2608.30573v1.title: NS-UNO: Neutron Star EoS Inference from an Unconstrained Number of Observations
2608.30573v1.abstract: Future multimessenger observations of neutron stars (NS) are expected to substantially increase both the number and precision of astrophysical constraints on the equation of state (EoS) of dense matter. This motivates inference frameworks capable of accommodating a variable, non fixed number of observations while preserving the posterior information associated with each measurement. In this work, we introduce NS-UNO, a Neural Posterior Estimation framework for NS EoS inference designed to accommodate an Unconstrained Number of Observations (UNO). NS-UNO combines a hierarchical DeepSets model with a conditional normalising flow, enabling a single trained model to perform inference from mass-radius observation sets of varying size, with each observation represented by a set of posterior samples. We demonstrate accurate and well calibrated posterior reconstructions using a model trained jointly on piecewise polytropic and non-parametric Gaussian process EoS ensembles. The reconstruction improves as observations probe a broader range of NS masses, while remaining robust to variations in the number and precision of the observations. The model also generalises to EoSs outside the families used during training. Finally, we qualitatively demonstrate the framework on current multimessenger constraints from NICER and GW170817. NS-UNO provides a flexible and scalable approach to NS EoS inference, naturally suited to the increasingly diverse observational datasets expected from next generation multimessenger astronomy.

classification.title_zh: NS-UNO: 基于不受观测数量限制的中子星状态方程推断
classification.abstract_zh: 未来中子星（NS）的多信使观测预计将大幅增加对致密物质状态方程（EoS）的天体物理约束的数量和精度。这促使推断框架能够容纳可变、非固定数量的观测，同时保留每次测量相关的后验信息。在这项工作中，我们介绍了NS-UNO，一种用于NS EoS推断的神经后验估计框架，旨在适应不受观测数量限制（UNO）的情况。NS-UNO将层次化DeepSets模型与条件归一化流相结合，使得一个训练好的模型能够对不同大小的质量-半径观测集进行推断，每个观测由一组后验样本表示。我们展示了使用联合训练的分段多方和参数化高斯过程EoS集成所获得的高精度且校准良好的后验重建。随着观测覆盖更广的中子星质量范围，重建效果得到改善，同时对观测数量和精度的变化保持鲁棒。该模型还能推广到训练中未使用的EoS族。最后，我们定性演示了该框架在来自NICER和GW170817的当前多信使约束上的应用。NS-UNO提供了一种灵活且可扩展的NS EoS推断方法，自然适用于下一代多信使天文学预期日益多样化的观测数据集。
classification.one_liner: 提出NS-UNO，一种基于神经后验估计的中子星状态方程推断框架，可处理任意数量的观测样本，并在多信使数据上验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力背景下中子星状态方程的推断方法，使用机器学习技术，但与全息或量子引力无关。

2507.06837v2.title: Examining the possibility of a thick crust in the compact stellar object HESS J1731-347
2507.06837v2.abstract: A relativistic mean-field model with a crossing term of isovector-scalar and isoscalar mesons, the Cracow crossing terms (CCT) model, has previously been shown to be capable of explaining the light and compact object HESS J1731-347 [11]. Here, the model is supplemented with a correct treatment of the phase transition. Applying the thermodynamically consistent Gibbs conditions shows that a mixed-phase system occurs in the core of the neutron star over a wide range of densities, extending up to the neutron star crust, leading to an intriguing stellar structure with a thick and massive crust.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 检查致密恒星天体 HESS J1731-347 中厚壳层的可能性
classification.abstract_zh: 先前已证明，带有同位旋-标量和同位旋-标量介子交叉项的相对论平均场模型，即克拉科夫交叉项（CCT）模型，能够解释轻而致密的天体 HESS J1731-347。在此，该模型补充了对相变的正确处理。应用热力学一致的吉布斯条件表明，在中子星核心处，混合相系统在一个很宽的密度范围内出现，一直延伸到中子星壳层，从而产生一种具有厚重壳层的有趣恒星结构。
classification.one_liner: 利用热力学一致的吉布斯条件，CCT模型中子星核心在宽密度范围出现混合相，导致厚重且大质量的壳层。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究非全息框架下的中子星状态方程与相变，仅涉及经典引力背景，与全息/量子引力主线无直接关联。

2512.13675v3.title: Matter-Mediated Entanglement in Classical Gravity: Suppression by Binding Potentials and Localization
2512.13675v3.abstract: Gravity-induced entanglement (GIE) is widely regarded as key evidence of nonclassical gravity. Recent work, however, argues that a classical gravitational background can generate entanglement through virtual matter propagation between separated masses. Here we show that this mechanism is negligible once realistic matter dynamics is taken into account. For bound or condensed matter, the binding potential converts the claimed long-range matter-mediated interaction into an exponentially short-ranged one, with an attenuation length of only a few picometers for representative binding energies-well below atomic dimensions and therefore negligible under experimentally relevant distances. For unbound matter, the channel remains negligible before significant wave-packet overlap, while after overlap the packets no longer represent two spatially separated subsystems. Thus the proposed classical matter-mediated mechanism does not challenge the usual interpretation of GIE as evidence for nonclassical gravity once physical localization and finite-time matter dynamics are treated consistently.

classification.title_zh: 经典引力中的物质介导纠缠：束缚势与定域化的抑制
classification.abstract_zh: 引力诱导纠缠（GIE）被广泛视为非经典引力的关键证据。然而，最近有工作认为经典引力背景可以通过分离质量之间的虚物质传播产生纠缠。这里我们表明，一旦考虑真实的物质动力学，这种机制是可以忽略的。对于束缚或凝聚态物质，束缚势将所谓的远程物质介导相互作用转化为指数级短程作用，对于代表性的束缚能，其衰减长度仅为几皮米——远小于原子尺度，因此在实验相关距离上可以忽略。对于非束缚物质，在显著的波包重叠之前该通道仍然可以忽略，而重叠之后波包不再代表两个空间上分离的子系统。因此，一旦物理定域化和有限时间物质动力学被一致地处理，所提出的经典物质介导机制并不会挑战通常将GIE解释为非经典引力的证据的做法。
classification.one_liner: 表明经典引力通过物质传播产生纠缠的机制在真实束缚物质中会被指数抑制，因此不能推翻引力诱导纠缠作为量子引力证据的解读。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文讨论了经典引力框架下物质介导纠缠的可行性，与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但与主要全息或凝聚态方向无直接交集。

2604.25569v3.title: Curvature-Assisted Dynamical Compactification in a Pre-Inflationary Higher-Dimensional Universe
2604.25569v3.abstract: We investigate a pre-inflationary dynamical compactification scenario in which a higher-dimensional expanding universe evolves into an effectively four-dimensional one through curvature-assisted modulus trapping. To obtain a calculable semiclassical realization, we consider a simple five-dimensional $S^1$ compactification in a time-dependent open FRW background. Bulk quantum fields generate both the late-time Casimir contribution that stabilizes the radion and the early-time Kaluza-Klein thermal contributions relevant for the cosmological evolution. We show that negative curvature can sustain tracker-like radion evolution, allowing the radion to be trapped in a compactified vacuum before a subsequent four-dimensional inflationary phase dilutes the curvature remnant. While our analysis is performed in a 5D toy model, it illustrates a broader mechanism by which dynamical compactification can arise in a pre-inflationary higher-dimensional cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 曲率辅助的暴涨前高维宇宙动力学紧致化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种暴涨前的动力学紧致化场景，其中高维膨胀宇宙通过曲率辅助的模场俘获演化为有效四维宇宙。为实现可计算的半经典实现，我们考虑了在时间依赖的开放FRW背景下的简单五维S^1紧致化。体量子场既产生稳定radion的晚期Casimir贡献，也产生与宇宙学演化相关的早期Kaluza-Klein热贡献。我们表明，负曲率可以维持类似跟踪解的radion演化，使radion在随后的四维暴涨阶段稀释曲率残余之前被俘获在紧致真空中。虽然分析是在5D玩具模型中进行的，但它展示了一种更广泛的机制，即动力学紧致化可以在暴涨前的高维宇宙学中出现。
classification.one_liner: 提出曲率辅助的动力学紧致化机制，展示5D玩具模型中radion如何通过负曲率和量子效应被俘获。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于高维宇宙学紧致化，与用户的全息超流、QNM、凝聚态等核心重点标签交集很少，仅与经典引力/广义相对论支线有边缘关联。

2504.02462v3.title: Gravitational Wave with Domain Wall Dominance
2504.02462v3.abstract: Domain walls (DWs) can be produced when a discrete symmetry is spontaneously broken, and long-lived DWs can dominate the energy density of the universe. In this work, we explore the possibility that a "domain wall dominant (DWD)" phase existed in the early universe and ended with DW decay. During the DWD phase, the universe undergoes a power-law accelerated expansion of the scale factor and exhibits temporal superhorizon evolution of the relevant frequency modes. We show that this can lead to distinct features imprinted on the stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background including the independence of its amplitude from the wall tension. Our findings provide a comprehensive framework for evaluating GW emission associated with DWD, leading to distinguishable long-lived DW-induced GWs from other cosmological sources, with significant implications for future GW observatories.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 畴壁主导时期的引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 当离散对称性自发破缺时会产生畴壁，长寿命的畴壁可以主导宇宙的能量密度。我们探讨了早期宇宙中存在“畴壁主导”阶段并以畴壁衰变结束的可能性。在畴壁主导阶段，宇宙经历尺度因子的幂律加速膨胀，并表现出相关频率模式的超视界时间演化。我们证明这会在随机引力波背景上留下独特印记，包括其振幅与壁张力无关。我们的发现为评估与畴壁主导相关的引力波发射提供了全面框架，使长寿命畴壁产生的引力波与其他宇宙学来源可区分，对未来引力波观测台具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 早期宇宙畴壁主导阶段会在随机引力波背景上留下独特印记，其振幅与壁张力无关，为未来引力波观测提供可区分的信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究畴壁主导时期的引力波，属于宇宙学与经典引力，与用户重点标签中的“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”相关，但不涉及全息或凝聚态方向。

2603.06995v2.title: Constraint Analysis and Quantization of Anomalous 2-D Thomas-Whitehead Gravity
2603.06995v2.abstract: The two-dimensional effective Polyakov action is often realized as the anomalous contributions of string theories and fermions coupled to gravity in two dimensions. However, as a result of the reparametrization invariance, one finds that the effective action produces vanishing Hamiltonians as constraints even in disparate gauges such as the dynamical light-cone and the Arnowitt-Deser-Misner (ADM) formalism of the metric. On the other hand, two-dimensional gravitational theories naturally arise as geometric actions on the coadjoint orbits of the Virasoro algebra. The Thomas-Whitehead gravity formalism extends the effective Polyakov action in such a way that the defining coadjoint element for the orbit becomes a dynamical field, viz. the diffeomorphism field. In this work, we examine the role the diffeomorphism field plays through the well-understood quantization of the two-dimensional anomalous contributions to gravity. This is first done in the dynamical light-cone and then with the ADM formalism of the metric. To examine a dynamical diffeomorphism field, the constraint analysis is then repeated in a Minkowski background, where the dynamics of the diffeomorphism field arise from the Thomas-Whitehead action. Adding dynamics to the diffeomorphism field appears to remove the vanishing Hamiltonians; however, expressing the diffeomorphism in terms of the P-tensor recovers the Hamiltonian constraint. One can compare this investigation to that of a gauge Wess-Zumino-Witten action where the gauge field has become dynamical through the inclusion of a Yang-Mills term.

classification.title_zh: 反常二维Thomas-Whitehead引力的约束分析与量子化
classification.abstract_zh: 二维有效Polyakov作用量通常表现为弦理论和费米子耦合二维引力的反常贡献。然而，由于重新参数化不变性，即使在动态光锥和度规的ADM形式等不同规范下，有效作用量也会产生消失的哈密顿量作为约束。另一方面，二维引力理论自然地作为Virasoro代数余伴随轨道上的几何作用量出现。Thomas-Whitehead引力形式扩展了有效Polyakov作用量，使得定义轨道的余伴随元素成为一个动力学场，即微分同胚场。本文通过充分理解的二维引力反常贡献的量子化，考察微分同胚场的作用。首先在动态光锥中完成，然后采用度规的ADM形式。为了研究动态微分同胚场，我们在闵可夫斯基背景下重复约束分析，其中微分同胚场的动力学源于Thomas-Whitehead作用量。给微分同胚场添加动力学似乎消除了消失的哈密顿量；然而，用P张量表示微分同胚场恢复了哈密顿约束。可以将此研究与规范Wess-Zumino-Witten作用量进行类比，其中规范场通过加入杨-米尔斯项而变得动力学。
classification.one_liner: 本文分析了二维Thomas-Whitehead引力中动态微分同胚场的约束结构，发现其动力学可消除消失哈密顿量但通过P张量恢复约束，并对比了WZW模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于二维反常引力的约束分析与量子化，而非全息原理、AdS/CFT或用户指定的凝聚态/QCD/热化等方向，仅与经典引力理论有一定关联。

2608.29295v1.title: Automated identification and subtraction of gravitational-wave glitches using boundary refinement
2608.29295v1.abstract: Transient noise artifacts, or glitches, in gravitational wave strain data elevate the false alarm rate of astrophysical searches and degrade parameter estimation when overlapping a signal. No method previously identified a glitch's time boundary: existing detection and classification tools flag and label glitches without resolving their extent, forcing subtraction to run over padded windows that cost time and erase signal beyond the glitch itself. We present three boundary identification methods, AMPS (Amplitude-based Multi-glitch Pulse Segmenter), FLARE (Fitness-based Localization And Refinement Extractor), and CRISP (connected-region identification via spectrogram power), paired with three subtraction techniques, adaptive spline fitting, wavelet shrinkage, and their combination, across five glitches from the GravitySpy database spanning Advanced LIGO's first three observing runs. AMPS sets a boundary from a robust amplitude threshold, FLARE from the best fitness of a segmented spline fit, and CRISP from spectrogram power. Injecting a chirp signal on four broadband glitches, the combined technique recovers 95 to 97 percent of the injected signal-to-noise ratio, against roughly 64 percent for wavelet shrinkage alone. CRISP gives the most uniform boundary width across glitches; AMPS and CRISP both identify a boundary in a fraction of a second, two to three orders of magnitude faster than FLARE. For the glitch overlapping GW170817, a low-frequency residual persists under the default boundary, a deliberate tradeoff against removing signal power. Scattered light glitches remain untested and are the primary direction for future work.

classification.title_zh: 使用边界细化自动识别和扣除引力波毛刺
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波应变数据中的瞬态噪声伪影（即毛刺）会提高天体物理搜索的误报率，并在与信号重叠时降低参数估计质量。目前没有方法能够识别毛刺的时间边界：现有的检测和分类工具仅标记毛刺而不解析其范围，迫使扣除程序在填充窗口上运行，这既耗费时间又抹除了毛刺本身之外的信号。我们提出了三种边界识别方法——AMPS（基于幅度的多毛刺脉冲分割器）、FLARE（基于适应度的定位与细化提取器）和CRISP（基于频谱图功率的连通区域识别），并配以三种扣除技术：自适应样条拟合、小波收缩及其组合。这些方法应用于来自GravitySpy数据库的五个毛刺，覆盖Advanced LIGO前三次观测运行。AMPS通过鲁棒幅度阈值确定边界，FLARE通过分段样条拟合的最佳适应度确定边界，CRISP通过频谱图功率确定边界。在四个宽带毛刺上注入啁啾信号，组合技术恢复了注入信噪比的95%至97%，而单独使用小波收缩仅恢复约64%。CRISP在不同毛刺间给出了最均匀的边界宽度；AMPS和CRISP都能在不到一秒内确定边界，比FLARE快两到三个数量级。对于与GW170817重叠的毛刺，在默认边界下残留低频余量，这是避免移除信号功率的刻意权衡。散落光毛刺尚未测试，是未来工作的主要方向。
classification.one_liner: 提出三种毛刺边界识别方法和三种扣除技术，以提高引力波观测中重叠信号的信噪比恢复。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于引力波数据中的噪声伪影识别与扣除，属于经典引力实验数据处理，不涉及全息或量子引力理论。

2609.00126v1.title: Quantum Complexity Dynamics for Disjoint Subsystems
2609.00126v1.abstract: Quantum complexity has emerged as a natural probe of chaos, thermalization, and the black hole interior on timescales long after local observables have equilibrated. However, its time evolution has been studied almost exclusively in subsystems confined to a single connected region. We show, using complementary tools from holography and random quantum circuits, that noncontiguous subsystems composed of multiple disjoint regions give rise to qualitatively new physics compared to the contiguous case. First, at finite temperature, a subsystem occupying less than half of the total system can carry high complexity at late times, even as the complexity of its larger complement remains low. This inversion of the usual hierarchy is intrinsically thermal: it vanishes in the infinite-temperature limit, which is the regime modeled by random quantum circuits. Second, if a subsystem's complexity equilibrates at an early time, then fragmenting it into $m$ disjoint components can further reduce this timescale by a factor of $m$, a phenomenon we exhibit in both holography and random quantum circuits. These results not only sharpen the correspondence between geometric and computational notions of complexity, but also motivate the search for novel complexity phenomena in quantum dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 不相交子系统的量子复杂性动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 量子复杂性已成为在局域可观测量达到平衡很久之后，探测混沌、热化以及黑洞内部的时间尺度上的自然探针。然而，其时间演化几乎仅在局限于单一连通区域的子系统中被研究。我们利用全息方法和随机量子电路的互补工具表明，由多个不相交区域组成的非连通子系统相比连通情形会引发定性的新物理。首先，在有限温度下，占据总系统不到一半的子系统在晚期可以携带高复杂性，即使其更大的补集的复杂性仍然较低。这种通常层级关系的反转本质上是热效应：它在无限温度极限下消失，而该极限正是随机量子电路所模拟的机制。其次，如果子系统的复杂性在早期达到平衡，那么将其分割为m个不相交分量可进一步将该时间尺度缩小因子m，这一现象在全息和随机量子电路中都有体现。这些结果不仅深化了复杂性之几何与计算概念间的对应，也激励人们在量子动力学中寻找新的复杂性现象。
classification.one_liner: 利用全息与随机量子电路，揭示不相交子系统的复杂性动力学出现新的热化与层级反转现象。
classification.relevance_reason: 用户重点标签主要针对全息凝聚态现象、相变、QNM等特定方向，而本文聚焦全息复杂性的一般动力学，不涉及这些具体模型或现象。

2609.00131v1.title: A 1/4-BPS chiral algebra in D1D5: from charge concentration to BPS chaos
2609.00131v1.abstract: The D1D5 CFT exhibits a charge concentration puzzle for BPS states, similar to, but simpler than, that of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. We consider the chiral algebra of 1/4-BPS operators in the D1D5 CFT arising from a supercharge cohomology, and the resulting rational correlators. Using crossing symmetry and this chiral algebra, we establish a non-perturbative proof of the existence of a family of 1/4-BPS states away from the charge concentration locus for general coupling and finite central charge. We further discuss possible implications for BPS chaos in the D1D5 CFT and compute a late-time BPS plateau at the orbifold point.

classification.title_zh: D1D5 中一个 1/4-BPS 手征代数：从电荷集中到 BPS 混沌
classification.abstract_zh: D1D5 CFT 在 BPS 态上表现出电荷集中疑难，该疑难类似于（但比 N=4 SYM 更简单）。我们考虑了 D1D5 CFT 中由超荷上同调产生的 1/4-BPS 算符的手征代数，以及由此得到的有理关联函数。利用交叉对称性和该手征代数，我们对于一般耦合和有限中心荷，非微扰地证明了在电荷集中点之外存在一族 1/4-BPS 态。我们进一步讨论了其对 D1D5 CFT 中 BPS 混沌的可能影响，并在 orbifold 点上计算了晚期 BPS 平台。
classification.one_liner: 在 D1D5 CFT 中利用 1/4-BPS 手征代数与交叉对称性，非微扰证明电荷集中点之外存在一族 BPS 态，并讨论 BPS 混沌及 orbifold 点晚期平台。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文关注 D1D5 CFT 中的 1/4-BPS 手征代数、电荷集中与 BPS 混沌，与用户重点标签（如全息超流超导、经典引力、冷原子/凝聚态实验等）无直接重合。

2609.00150v1.title: On the mass spectrum of Viel-dreibein gravity
2609.00150v1.abstract: We study the AdS-wave configurations of Viel-dreibein gravity, a three-dimensional theory of $N$ interacting spin-2 fields, as a pretext to characterize the mass spectrum of this multigravity theory. We manage to implement the known strategy of rewriting the system as a higher-derivative theory for a single dreibein, thereby deriving the precise $2N$th-order equation governing the dynamics of the AdS-wave profile in question. The second novelty we introduce is a factorization of such an equation as the product of $N$ Klein-Gordon operators, exploiting the recent representation of the roots of any $N$th-degree polynomial in terms of the increasingly celebrated $\mathscr{A}$-hypergeometric functions. Remarkably, this allows us to determine the mass spectrum of the full theory independently of the number of involved gravities, which is essential for an explicit construction of the AdS-wave solutions. This enables us to explore the parameter space of the theory and find all its critical points (not only the Breitenlohner-Freedman bounds) where a much wider range of degeneracies in the squared masses arises. At those points, the solutions allow a zoo of new logarithmic modes leading to several $\log^{\chi-1}$ asymptotic behaviors, with $\chi\le N$, a signature of the existence of allegedly dual logarithmic conformal field theories.

classification.title_zh: Viel-dreibein 引力的质谱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究Viel-dreibein引力的AdS波构型——这是一个由N个相互作用的自旋2场组成的三维理论——以此作为刻画这一多重量力理论质量谱的切入点。我们成功实现了将该系统重新写为单一dreibein的高阶导数理论的已知策略，从而导出了所讨论AdS波剖面所遵循的精确2N阶运动方程。我们引入的第二个新意是：利用最近关于任何N次多项式的根可以用日益著名的$\mathscr{A}$-超几何函数表示的结果，将该方程因式分解为N个Klein-Gordon算子的乘积。值得注意的是，这让我们能够独立于所涉及引力子数来确定整个理论的质量谱，这对于显式构造AdS波解至关重要。这使得我们得以探索该理论的参数空间，并找到其所有临界点（不仅仅是Breitenlohner-Freedman界），在这些点上质量二次方会出现远更广泛的简并性。在这些点，解允许大量新的对数模式，导致多种$\log^{\chi-1}$渐近行为（$\chi\le N$），这标志了推测存在对偶的对数共形场论。
classification.one_liner: 通过AdS波分析，将Viel-dreibein多重量力系统化为高阶导数方程并因式分解为N个Klein-Gordon算子，从而解析确定质量谱，并在临界点发现类似log CFT的对数新模式。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究三维多重引力的经典AdS波解与质量谱，与用户标注的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关，但未涉及全息凝聚态、QNM、涡旋等用户其他重点支线，因此相关度为中。

2609.00558v1.title: Iso-$\mu/T$ holographic entropy and its attractor for a strongly coupled quantum fluid
2609.00558v1.abstract: Numerical evidence has shown that a period of vanishing entropy production during far-from-equilibrium stages induces subsequent violations of the dominant energy condition in strongly coupled plasmas. This behavior also appears to hold for a Bjorken-expanding, hot and dense strongly coupled quantum fluid. In this context, it has been established that the chemical potential-to-temperature ratio ($\mu/T$) in the medium increases with higher initial charge density, $\rho_0$, and/or lower initial energy density, $\varepsilon_0$. Here, we present a numerical method to evolve Bjorken R-charged plasmas by varying $(\varepsilon_0,\rho_0)$ in order to generate a curve that preserves a constant $\mu/T$. This allows us to address the case in which all Bekenstein-Hawking entropy densities evolve towards configurations with the same $\mu/T$. This approach enables a more direct comparison with the $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM plasma case ($\mu/T=0$) and, consequently, provides clearer evidence of the correlation between entropy production and violations of the dominant energy condition. Moreover, this procedure offers a characterization (albeit numerical and partial) of the iso$-\mu/T$ entropy density hydrodynamic attractor for hot and dense strongly coupled quantum fluids.

classification.title_zh: 等$\mu/T$全息熵及其对强耦合量子流体的吸引子
classification.abstract_zh: 数值证据表明，在远离平衡阶段，一段消失的熵产生时期会诱发强耦合等离子体中主导能量条件的后续违反。这种行为似乎也适用于Bjorken膨胀的热而密的强耦合量子流体。在此背景下，已经确定介质中化学势-温度比($\mu/T$)随着初始电荷密度$\rho_0$的增大和/或初始能量密度$\varepsilon_0$的减小而增加。这里，我们提出一种数值方法，通过变化$(\varepsilon_0,\rho_0)$来演化Bjorken R电荷等离子体，从而生成保持恒定$\mu/T$的曲线。这使我们能够讨论所有Bekenstein-Hawking熵密度演化到具有相同$\mu/T$的构型的情况。这种方法能够与$\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM等离子体情况($\mu/T=0$)进行更直接的比较，从而为熵产生与主导能量条件违反之间的关联提供更清晰的证据。此外，这一过程为热而密的强耦合量子流体提供了iso$-\mu/T$熵密度流体动力学吸引子的表征（尽管是数值且局部的）。
classification.one_liner: 通过数值演化Bjorken R电荷等离子体生成等$\mu/T$曲线，研究熵产生与主导能量条件违反的关联，并刻画iso-$\mu/T$熵密度吸引子。
classification.relevance_reason: 该研究属于全息强耦合等离子体非平衡流体动力学，与用户重点关注的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁、相变、QNM等方向没有直接重叠，相关性较低。

2609.00942v1.title: Fuchsian Resonance and a Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary for Pole-Skipping
2609.00942v1.abstract: Pole-skipping occurs at special complex frequencies and momenta where the retarded Green function of a black-hole or black-brane background is not uniquely defined. The local near-horizon mechanism is well known: at resonance, a Frobenius recurrence matrix loses rank and the space of smooth horizon solutions enlarges. We address the global question of how two boundary-normalized solutions enter this resonant horizon solution space. For a general second-order scalar radial equation on a nonextremal background analytic near the horizon, the Frobenius recurrence at the resonant order yields a solvability condition. We prove that its vanishing is equivalent to singularity of the horizon recurrence matrix, absence of the logarithmic Frobenius term, and existence of two independent smooth horizon solutions. Away from resonance, the source zero is equivalent to horizon smoothness of the response-normalized solution, while the response zero is equivalent to horizon smoothness of the source-normalized solution. We then analyze the parameter-dependent simple pole of the nonresonant ingoing solution as resonance is approached. After removing this singularity, its resonant limit is proportional to the larger-root Frobenius solution, with proportionality factor given by the same solvability function. Continuing to the boundary shows that the same condition is equivalent to simultaneous vanishing of the two regularized boundary connection coefficients. This establishes a horizon-to-boundary dictionary between local Fuchsian resonance and the boundary source-response 0/0 structure of pole-skipping. Finally, different directions of approach can select different resonant solutions, with the selection governed by the first parameter variation of the same solvability function.

classification.title_zh: Fuchsian共振与极点跳跃的视界到边界词典
classification.abstract_zh: 极点跳跃发生在黑洞或黑膜背景的延迟格林函数在特殊复频率和动量处未被唯一定义的情况。局域近视界机制是已知的：在共振处，Frobenius递推矩阵失去秩，使得光滑视界解空间扩大。我们处理两个边界归一化解是如何进入这一共振视界解空间的全局问题。对一般非极端背景上的一般二阶标量径向方程，在共振阶处的Frobenius递推产生一个可解性条件。我们证明该条件的消失等价于视界递推矩阵的奇异性、对数Frobenius项的缺失以及两个独立光滑视界解的存在性。远离共振，源零点等价于响应归一化解的视界光滑性，而响应零点等价于源归一化解的视界光滑性。我们进一步分析依赖参数的共振逼近过程中非共振内行解的简单极点。移除该奇点后，其共振极限正比于大根Frobenius解，比例因子正是同一可解性函数。继续延拓到边界表明，同一条件等价于两个正则化边界连接系数的同时消失。这建立起局域Fuchsian共振与极点跳跃的边界源-响应0/0结构之间的视界到边界词典。最后，不同的趋近方向可以选择不同的共振解，这种选择由同一可解性函数的一阶参数变分所控制。
classification.one_liner: 严格证明极点跳跃的Fuchsian共振条件等价于边界连接系数的整体消失，建立了从视界Frobenius结构到边界Green函数零点/极点的完整词典。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究极点跳跃的数学对应，与准正则模式(QNM)的零点/极点结构相关，但未涉及用户重点标签中的具体物态或凝聚态全息模型，关联间接。

2609.01332v1.title: Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$ Einstein-Scalar Gravity
2609.01332v1.abstract: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its amplitude $\eps$ and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$. The linearized $\phim$ profile is an exact hypergeometric function, independent of the $\pp$ hair, whose horizon-regular branch always carries a source, so there is no spontaneous $\phim$ hair. Because the dual operator $\mathcal{O}_{-}$ is irrelevant ($\Delta=4$), the second-order response develops a logarithmically running condensate with a closed-form, scheme-independent slope $\tfrac{\sqrt{21}}{70}C_{s}^{2}$. The renormalized free energy is scheme dependent, but the geometric temperature shift $\delta T/T_{0}\approx-0.345\,\eps^{2}$ at fixed entropy is not. The full metric and $\pp$ back-reaction is obtained in closed form, diagonalizing into two P\"oschl-Teller problems with $\delta\pp=\tfrac{6}{\sqrt7}\,\delta H$. Three transport coefficients of the dual fluid remain exactly conformal to this order, while the sound speed, like the free energy, is scheme dependent.

classification.title_zh: AdS4 Einstein-Scalar 引力中平面黑洞上的微扰双标量毛发
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维 Einstein 引力耦合两个标量的系统中构造了双标量毛发的平面黑洞，其势函数源自 ABJM 一致性截断的 11 维超引力。从已知的单标量毛发黑洞膜出发，我们以振幅 ε 微扰地开启第二个标量 φ_m，并将耦合的 Einstein-标量系统解到 ε² 阶。线性化的 φ_m 轮廓是精确的超几何函数，与 π 毛发无关；其视界正则支总是附带源，因此不存在自发的 φ_m 毛发。由于对偶算符 O_- 是无关的 (Δ=4)，二阶响应会发展出对数跑动凝聚，其闭式、与方案无关的斜率为 √21/70 C_s²。重整化自由能是方案依赖的，但在固定熵下几何温度移动 δT/T₀ ≈ -0.345 ε² 不是。完整的度规和 π 反作用是闭式得到的，可对角化成两个 Pöschl-Teller 问题，且有 δπ = 6/√7 δH。对偶流体的三个输运系数在该阶仍精确共形，而声速与自由能一样是方案依赖的。
classification.one_liner: 在 ABJM 截断启发的 AdS4 Einstein-scalar 理论中，从单标量毛平面黑洞微扰开启第二个标量；线性支恒带源故无自发毛发，二阶效应给出对数跑动凝聚，同时揭示了自由能与声速的方案依赖性和温度移动的方案无关性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该工作基于 ABJM 截断构造 AdS4 平面黑洞的双标量微扰解，核心属于 AdS/CFT 字典与经典黑洞引力方向；与用户列出的全息超流、p 波、探针膜、相变与气泡等具体主线没有直接交叉，故列为中等相关。

2609.00423v1.title: Positive energy from timelike singularities
2609.00423v1.abstract: The energy of various asymptotically AdS and asymptotically flat solutions to the Einstein equations with time-translational invariance and a timelike singularity is computed, spaces with Kasner timelike singularities and black holes with negative masses among them. The definition used for gravitational energy is the on-shell Hamiltonian of the physical classical action proposed by Hawking and Horowitz thirty years ago and which agrees with the Abbott-Deser and ADM expressions. To deal with the singularity, a timelike regulating cut-off boundary surrounding the singularity compatible with a well-defined foliation in constant-time slices is introduced, so calculations are performed at a finite value of the regulating parameter, which is set to zero in the final expression for the energy. In all instances considered, the energy contribution from the singularity is finite and positive, its value depends on the geometry around the singularity and is such that the total gravitational energy is positive. Of the solutions reviewed, only the AdS soliton (which has no singularity) has negative gravitational energy relative to AdS space. The AdS and the Schwarzschild black holes with negative masses have respectively the same energies as AdS and Minkowski spaces.

classification.title_zh: 来自类时奇点的正能量
classification.abstract_zh: 计算了具有时间平移不变性和类时奇点的若干渐近AdS与渐近平直Einstein解的引力能量，其中包括具有Kasner类时奇点的时空和负质量黑洞。所使用的引力能量定义是Hawking与Horowitz三十年前提出的物理经典作用量的壳上Hamiltonian，它与Abbott-Deser及ADM表达式一致。为处理奇点，引入一个围绕奇点并与良定义等时切片叶状结构相容的类时正则化截断边界，计算在有限的截断参数值上进行，最终的能量表达式再令其趋于零。在所有考察的例子中，奇点对能量的贡献都有限且为正；其数值取决于奇点附近的几何，并使总引力能量为正。在回顾的解中，只有无奇点的AdS孤子具有相对于AdS空间的负引力能量。带负质量的AdS与Schwarzschild黑洞则分别与AdS空间和Minkowski空间具有相同的能量。
classification.one_liner: 采用Hawking-Horowitz壳上Hamiltonian计算含类时奇点的渐近AdS/平直时空的引力能量，发现奇点能量贡献有限且为正，负质量黑洞与相应真空同能量。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于纯经典引力计算，研究类时奇点和负质量黑洞的引力能量，与用户经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但不涉及全息字典、量子信息或用户的凝聚态/全息主线，总体参考意义中等。

2609.00664v1.title: Perturbations and stability of black holes with static scalar hair in general GLPV theories
2609.00664v1.abstract: We derive the background equations and complete odd- and even-parity quadratic actions for static, spherically symmetric black holes with radial scalar hair in general quartic-quintic Gleyzes-Langlois-Piazza-Vernizzi (GLPV) theories, including Horndeski. On regular, nondegenerate branches, the formulation applies across Killing horizons and yields local no-ghost conditions and radial and angular eikonal characteristics. Tensor modes in both parity sectors share the same squared radial speed. When the radial coordinate is timelike, generic antisymmetric mixing induces nonstandard large-multipole scaling for both even-parity angular branches. Requiring both branches to have finite, nonzero eikonal phase speeds selects the Horndeski-related compatibility condition between the quartic and quintic beyond-Horndeski functions. This condition aligns the covariant degeneracy directions and permits a local disformal map to Horndeski when regular and invertible. For a finite, nonzero scalar kinetic term at the horizon, every nontrivial branch of the exact quadratic GLPV black hole is locally unstable or has a degenerate tensor cone near a simple outer horizon. Apart from identified exceptions, this obstruction extends to general shift- and reflection-symmetric quadratic GLPV theories and the regular Horndeski-related branch of the quartic-quintic class. Finally, for scalar-Gauss-Bonnet black holes with a vanishing horizon scalar kinetic term, we construct analytic power-law quartic beyond-Horndeski deformations whose associated quintic function is fixed by the same condition. At sufficiently small coupling, all local no-ghost and high-frequency gradient-stability conditions hold throughout the exterior. For a linear Gauss-Bonnet coupling, we estimate an interior scale below which the background and stability expansions lose perturbative control; this does not imply a physical instability.

classification.title_zh: 一般GLPV理论中具有静态标量毛的黑洞的微扰与稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在一般的quartic-quintic GLPV理论（包括Horndeski）中推导了具有径向标量毛的静态球对称黑洞的背景方程和完整的奇、偶宇称二次作用量。在规则的、非退化分支上，该形式适用于越过Killing视界，并给出局部无鬼条件以及径向和角向eikonal特征。两个宇称部分的张量模式具有相同的平方径向速度。当径向坐标为类时，一般的反对称混合会导致偶宇称角向分支出现非标准的大多极标度。要求两个分支具有有限非零的eikonal相位速度，会选择quartic和quintic beyond-Horndeski函数之间的Horndeski相关兼容条件。该条件使协变退化方向对齐，并在规则且可逆时允许局部的disformal映射到Horndeski理论。对于视界处非零且有限的标量动能项，精确二次GLPV黑洞的每个非平凡分支在简单外视界附近局部不稳定或具有退化张量锥。除了已识别的例外，这一阻碍扩展到一般的移位和反射对称二次GLPV理论以及quartic-quintic类的正则Horndeski相关分支。最后，对于视界标量动能消失的标量-高斯-博内黑洞，我们构造了解析幂律quartic beyond-Horndeski形变，其关联的quintic函数由同一条件固定。在足够小的耦合下，所有局部无鬼和高频梯度稳定性条件在外域都成立。对于线性高斯-博内耦合，我们估计了一个内部尺度，低于该尺度背景和稳定性展开将失去微扰控制；这并不意味着物理不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 推导GLPV理论中静态标量毛黑洞的二次摄动作用量，证明其局部不稳定性/退化张量锥，并在标量-高斯-博内情形构建稳定形变。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论方向的修改引力与黑洞稳定性研究，与全息或其他凝聚态主线无直接关联。经典引力标签下相关，但对用户重点研究支线（如全息超流、畴壁、QNM等）相关性一般。

2609.00882v1.title: Reissner-Nordstrom in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin electromagnetic field
2609.00882v1.abstract: The magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom black hole embedded into the Bertotti-Robinson magnetic field is presented. Then it is used, as a seed, to generate, through the Harrison transformation of the Ersnt's equations, the Reissner-Nordstrom metric in the Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin magnetic field. Special cases generalising, the vacuum hairy type I Schwarzschild solution is discussed. The local equivalence between various forms of the Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson is shown by exhibiting the explicit diffeomorphism.

classification.title_zh: 在Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin电磁场中的Reissner-Nordstrom黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 将磁Reissner-Nordstrom黑洞嵌入Bertotti-Robinson磁场中。然后以此为种子，通过Ernst方程的Harrison变换，生成在Bertotti-Robinson-Bonnor-Melvin磁场中的Reissner-Nordstrom度规。讨论了真空带毛I型Schwarzschild解的推广特例。通过显式微分同胚展示了Schwarzschild-Bertotti-Robinson各种形式之间的局部等价性。
classification.one_liner: 构造嵌入BRBM电磁场的RN黑洞解，并展示相关度规等价性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的带电黑洞嵌入外部电磁背景的解构造与变换，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2609.01012v1.title: Charging higher-dimensional spacetimes with a generalized Kerr-Schild transformation
2609.01012v1.abstract: We explore the construction of higher-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) solutions from vacuum seeds by means of a generalized Kerr-Schild transformation along a geodesic null vector field $\mathbf{k}$. Assuming the vector potential $\mathbf{A}$ to be aligned with $\mathbf{k}$, and $\mathbf{k}$ to be a Weyl aligned null direction satisfying the ``optical constraint'', we arrive at three distinct branches of solutions. If $\mathbf{k}$ is expanding and twisting, then its shear must vanish -- this branch includes certain charged Taub-NUT metrics. If $\mathbf{k}$ is expanding and twistfree, one finds two subfamilies: Robinson-Trautman electrovac solutions with a non-null Maxwell field if the shear is zero, or shearing solutions with a null field. Finally, the case when $\mathbf{k}$ is non-expanding reduces to a subset of the known Kundt solutions. In all cases, the Chern-Simons term turns out to be identically zero on-shell. In passing, by relaxing the alignment assumption on $\mathbf{A}$, we also obtain a six-dimensional extension of a charged Taub-NUT metric for which the magnetic part of the field strength is a linear combination of two distinct K\"ahler 2-forms, as opposed to the previously known examples in more than four dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 用广义 Kerr-Schild 变换为高维时空充电
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了如何通过沿测地类光矢量场 k 的广义 Kerr-Schild 变换，从真空种子构建高维 Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) 解。假设矢量势 A 与 k 对齐，且 k 是满足“光学约束”的 Weyl 对齐类光方向，我们得到三个不同的解分支。若 k 是膨胀且扭曲的，则其剪切必须为零——该分支包括某些带荷 Taub-NUT 度量。若 k 是膨胀且无扭曲的，则有两个子族：剪切为零时对应具有非类光 Maxwell 场的 Robinson-Trautman 电真空解，或者具有类光场的剪切解。最后，当 k 不膨胀时，解约化为已知 Kundt 解的子集。在所有情形中，Chern-Simons 项在壳上恒为零。顺带地，通过放宽对 A 的对齐假设，我们还获得了六维带荷 Taub-NUT 度量的推广，其中场强的磁部分是两个不同 Kähler 2-形式的线性组合，这与先前多于四维的例子不同。
classification.one_liner: 利用广义 Kerr-Schild 变换系统性构造高维 Einstein-Maxwell(-Chern-Simons) 解，并给出带荷 Taub-NUT、Robinson-Trautman 等分支
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要涉及经典引力中的解析解构造，与全息/量子引力主线不直接相关，但属于用户标注的经典引力支线，具有一定参考价值。

2609.01193v1.title: Angular power spectrum of induced gravitational waves: breaking model and parameter degeneracies in PTA observations
2609.01193v1.abstract: Large primordial curvature and tensor perturbations on small scales can generate second-order tensor-scalar induced gravitational waves (TSIGWs) through scalar-scalar, tensor-scalar, and tensor-tensor source terms. TSIGWs are recognized as one of the principal contributors to the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) observations. We explore the energy density spectrum of second-order TSIGWs in the presence of non-Gaussian primordial curvature perturbations. Furthermore, we present the first calculation of the anisotropic angular power spectrum associated with second-order TSIGWs, which provides a promising tool to discriminate them from other SGWB sources.

classification.title_zh: 诱导引力波的角功率谱：打破PTA观测中的模型与参数简并
classification.abstract_zh: 小尺度上的大原初曲率和张量扰动可以通过标量-标量、张量-标量和张量-张量源项产生二阶张量-标量诱导引力波（TSIGWs）。TSIGW被认为是随机引力波背景（SGWB）观测的主要贡献者之一。我们研究了在存在非高斯原初曲率扰动的情况下二阶TSIGW的能量密度谱。此外，我们首次计算了与二阶TSIGW相关的各向异性角功率谱，这为将它们与其它SGWB源区分开提供了一种有前途的工具。
classification.one_liner: 通过计算诱导引力波的各向异性角功率谱，为PTA观测中区分不同随机引力波背景源提供新手段。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究宇宙学诱导引力波的角功率谱，属于经典引力与宇宙学交叉方向，与用户的重点研究领域（全息、量子引力、凝聚态全息等）无明显关联。

2609.01391v1.title: Scalar wave scattering by black holes embedded in dark matter halos
2609.01391v1.abstract: We study the scattering of massless scalar waves by static black holes embedded in dark matter halos. The halo is modelled by means of a Hernquist profile, for which the Einstein equations admit an exact solution. We analyse the scattering using null geodesics, the glory approximation, the partial wave expansion, and the complex angular momentum (CAM) method. The geometric analysis shows that the presence of the halo changes the light ring radius weakly but shifts the critical and glory impact parameters. The wave analysis shows that the characteristic black hole interference pattern is preserved, with halo compactness providing the leading correction and the halo scale radius playing a secondary role. For sufficiently compact halos, the environment also induces a sizeable gravitational redshift. Most of the displacement of the interference extrema can be reproduced by a vacuum Schwarzschild solution with an appropriately chosen $\omega M_{\rm BH}$. A non-vanishing residual, however, reveals a genuine halo contribution that cannot be absorbed into such an effective frequency shift. Finally, we perform the CAM reconstruction of the scattering cross section and find that only a few Regge poles are required to achieve high accuracy at large angles.

classification.title_zh: 暗物质晕内嵌黑洞的标量波散射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究嵌入暗物质晕中的静态黑洞对无质量标量波的散射。暗物质晕采用Hernquist轮廓建模，该轮廓允许爱因斯坦方程存在精确解。我们利用零测地线、光环近似、分波展开和复角动量（CAM）方法分析散射。几何分析表明，暗物质晕的存在对光环半径影响较弱，但会移动临界碰撞参数和光环碰撞参数。波动分析显示，特征性的黑洞干涉图样得以保持，其中暗物质晕的紧致性起主要修正作用，晕的标度半径起次要作用。对于足够紧致的晕，环境还会引起显著的引力红移。干涉极值的大部分位移可由适当选择 ωM_BH 的真空Schwarzschild解重现。然而，非零残差揭示了无法被这种有效频移吸收的真正晕贡献。最后，我们进行了散射截面的CAM重构，发现仅需少数Regge极点即可在大角度下实现高精度。
classification.one_liner: 利用零测地线、分波展开和复角动量方法研究暗物质晕中黑洞的标量波散射，发现干涉图样基本保持但存在由晕紧致性主导的环境修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究暗物质晕背景下黑洞的经典引力散射行为，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与用户重点标签中的该项直接对应。

2609.01480v1.title: Gravitational Waves from Reheating beyond Instantaneous Thermalization
2609.01480v1.abstract: We study gravitational-wave production during perturbative reheating without assuming instantaneous thermalization of the inflaton decay products. The injected energetic particles thermalize through an in-medium cascade of nearly collinear splittings subject to the Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal effect and are ultimately isotropized by elastic scatterings near the thermal scale. The non-thermal hard population present before complete thermalization produces an additional gravitational-wave component through hard-soft scatterings, with $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^{1/2}$ below the injection-scale turnover. The same isotropization erases the directional information underlying the vacuum $1/k$ bremsstrahlung soft pole, changing the deep-infrared spectrum from $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f$ to $\Omega_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^3$.

classification.title_zh: 超越瞬时热化的再加热阶段引力波产生
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在不对暴胀子衰变产物做瞬时热化假设的情况下，扰动性再加热过程中的引力波产生。注入的高能粒子通过受 Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal 效应制约的介质内近共线劈裂级联实现热化，并最终在热尺度附近通过弹性散射各向同性化。在完全热化之前存在的非热硬粒子群通过硬-软散射产生额外的引力波成分，在注入尺度转折以下满足 Ω_GW ∝ f^{1/2}。相同的各向同性化抹去了真空 1/k 轫致辐射软极点背后的方向性信息，使深红外谱从 Ω_GW ∝ f 变为 Ω_GW ∝ f^3。
classification.one_liner: 通过考虑暴胀子衰变产物未瞬时热化的扰动再加热过程，发现非热硬粒子群的硬-软散射会产生额外引力波成分，并使深红外谱指数由 f 变为 f^3。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究宇宙再加热时期的引力波产生，核心是粒子热化与散射物理，不涉及全息、量子引力或黑洞信息，仅在弱场引力波层面与经典引力相关，因此与用户主线相关性低。

2507.17313v2.title: Scattering Radiation Emitted Near a Black Hole Horizon
2507.17313v2.abstract: We study a family of outgoing electromagnetic radiation states prepared outside but arbitrarily close to the horizon of a Schwarzschild black hole, with frequencies that remain uniformly bounded in the local source frame. As the preparation point approaches the horizon, gravitational redshift drives this radiation toward zero Killing frequency and into a controlled soft regime at any fixed exterior scattering radius. The radiation considered here may be viewed as part of the Hawking radiation spectrum. After including transmission through the Schwarzschild potential, we obtain the leading soft response in a localized region of weak curvature and formulate an inclusive scattering probability that is infrared safe. Through the infrared triangle, this response is related to electromagnetic memory at future null infinity. The conditioned memory record probes angular projections of the zero-frequency component of the transmitted radiation, together with their correlations with the accompanying hard scattering outcome. It can therefore provide an additional asymptotic constraint and a partial fingerprint of the radiation source.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞视界附近发射的散射辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一族在Schwarzschild黑洞视界外侧任意近处制备的外向电磁辐射态，其在局域源参考系中频率保持一致有界。随着制备点靠近视界，引力红移使该辐射趋于零Killing频率，并在任意固定外部散射半径处进入可控软区。这里考虑的辐射可视为霍金辐射谱的一部分。在计及穿过Schwarzschild势垒的透射之后，我们得到了弱曲率局域区域中的领头软响应，并构造了一个红外安全的包含性散射概率。通过红外三角，该响应与未来类光无穷远处的电磁记忆相关联。受条件作用的记忆记录探测透射辐射的零频分量的角投影，及其与伴随硬散射结果的关联。因此，它可以提供额外的渐近约束和辐射源的部分指纹。
classification.one_liner: 研究黑洞视界附近电磁辐射的散射与记忆效应，通过红外三角将软响应与未来类光无穷远的电磁记忆关联，可提供辐射源的渐近探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于广义相对论中黑洞时空电磁辐射与记忆效应的研究，符合用户经典引力/广义相对论支线；与全息超导、QCD等分支无直接关联。

2603.21425v3.title: Holographic One-Point Function and Geodesics in SdS$_3$
2603.21425v3.abstract: Grinberg and Maldacena showed that heavy thermal one-point functions in AdS/CFT can encode complex geodesics reaching a black hole singularity. We study the de Sitter analogue in three-dimensional Schwarzschild--de Sitter space, restricting to the finite cyclic quotients $\mathrm{dS}_3/\mathbb Z_q$. We define a one-point function through a differentiate dictionary and show that an analogous result holds for the Bunch--Davies-prepared integral. Using the exact light field Green function, the bulk integral reduces exactly to a convergent one-dimensional transform, whose large-mass limit is controlled by the near-defect region and governed by a complex saddle. Its action reproduces a complex geodesic length from future infinity to the conical defect, whose real part is the renormalized boundary-to-horizon proper time and whose imaginary part is the horizon-to-defect distance. The imaginary part appears in the one-point coefficient normalized in the Lorentzian source basis; in the Euclidean basis the same saddle contributes only the real part, the two being related by a fixed connection factor.

classification.title_zh: SdS$_3$中的全息单点函数与测地线
classification.abstract_zh: Grinberg和Maldacena指出，AdS/CFT中重的热单点函数可以编码到达黑洞奇点的复测地线。我们在三维Schwarzschild--de Sitter空间中研究其de Sitter类似物，并限制在有限循环商空间$\mathrm{dS}_3/\mathbb Z_q$上。我们通过微分字典定义单点函数，并证明对于Bunch--Davies制备的积分有类似结果成立。利用精确的光场Green函数，体积分精确约化为一个收敛的一维变换，其大质量极限由近缺陷区域控制，并由一个复鞍点支配。其作用量再现了从未来无穷远到锥形缺陷的复测地线长度，其实部是重整化后的边界到视界固有时，虚部是视界到缺陷的距离。虚部出现在Lorentzian源基中归一化的单点系数中；在Euclidean基中，同一鞍点只贡献实部，两者通过一个固定的连接因子联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 在三维Schwarzschild-de Sitter空间中，建立了de Sitter全息单点函数与复测地线长度之间的对应，其大质量极限由近缺陷区的复鞍点控制。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文主要属于de Sitter全息与测地线对应，不在给定的用户重点标签范围内（如全息超流、QNM、相变等）。

2604.03003v2.title: Black Hole Interior Operators and Dilatation Symmetry in Planar Black Branes
2604.03003v2.abstract: Planar AdS black branes have a scaling symmetry that maps a brane solution at one temperature to a solution at another. It is natural to expect that boundary representations of bulk field modes should inherit this symmetry i.e. their correlators should transform covariantly under boundary dilatations. We derive a covariance condition that any boundary representation of interior modes in a planar AdS black brane should satisfy. We then show that Papadodimas-Raju mirror operators satisfy this condition. Thus the Papadodimas-Raju reconstruction of the bulk interior, although state-dependent, inherits the scaling symmetry of planar AdS black holes.

classification.title_zh: 平面 AdS 黑膜中的黑洞内部算子与标度对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 平面 AdS 黑膜具有一种标度对称性，可将某一温度下的膜解映射到另一温度下的解。自然地预期，体场模式的边界表示应继承该对称性，即它们的关联函数应在边界标度变换下协变地变换。我们推导出平面 AdS 黑膜中内部模式的任何边界表示都应满足的协变条件，然后证明 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算子满足该条件。因此，Papadodimas-Raju 对体内部的态依赖重构继承了平面 AdS 黑洞的标度对称性。
classification.one_liner: 通过推导内部模式的边界表示协变条件，证明 Papadodimas-Raju 镜像算子虽然具有态依赖性，但仍继承平面 AdS 黑膜的标度对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文关注 AdS/CFT 中黑膜内部算子边界表示的标度/膨胀对称性，属于全息体态重构与黑洞量子引力信息方向，但未涉及用户标注的凝聚态、相变或经典引力等具体研究支线。

2606.09346v3.title: Asymptotic Algebras and Holography of Information in CGHS Model
2606.09346v3.abstract: Holography of Information (HoI) and the island formula are two recent approaches to the black hole information loss paradox that yield different Page curves. The difference between the Page curves has been argued to be rooted in the algebra that each approach focuses on. In this paper, we study the candidate algebras for the CGHS model. Making the usual assumptions that are made in HoI literature, we establish HoI for the CGHS model coupled to a massless scalar by constructing the radiative phase space and asymptotic algebras at future null infinity. We prove that the quantum state of the right-moving modes can be recovered from an arbitrarily small neighbourhood of the right future null infinity. We then argue that island reconstruction is incompatible with exact commutativity of the left and right radiative algebras. We discuss the possible distinction between the HoI and island approaches for the CGHS model.

classification.title_zh: CGHS模型中的渐近代数与信息全息
classification.abstract_zh: 信息全息（HoI）和岛公式是近年来处理黑洞信息丢失悖论的两种方法，它们得到不同的Page曲线。有观点认为Page曲线的差异源于每种方法所关注的代数。本文研究CGHS模型的候选代数。采用HoI文献中的通常假设，通过在将来零无穷构造辐射相空间和渐近代数，我们建立了与无质量标量场耦合的CGHS模型的HoI。我们证明右行模的量子态可以从右将来零无穷的任意小邻域恢复。然后我们论证岛重建与左右辐射代数的完全交换性不相容。我们讨论HoI与岛方法在CGHS模型中可能的区别。
classification.one_liner: 该文在CGHS二维引力模型中建立信息全息，证明了右行模量子态可由右将来零无穷的任意小领域恢复，并指出岛重建与辐射代数交换性存在张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主题属于量子引力/黑洞信息，与给定的重点研究支线（如全息超流、凝聚态、QNM等）无直接交集。

2606.14834v2.title: Entropy Quantization and Quasi-normal Modes of Dyonic Kerr-Sen Black Holes
2606.14834v2.abstract: We explore the properties of inner and outer horizon thermodynamics of dyonic Kerr-Sen black hole (DKSBH). It is observed that the entropy (or area) product is universal, depending only on the angular momentum of the BH. We then proceed to study the dual conformal field theory~(CFT) in the Kerr/CFT correspondence using thermodynamic relations and compute the central charges from 2D CFT. The central charges are found to be universal with only angular momentum dependence. By comparing to Kerr-Newman BH, it is found that the essential difference is in the right-moving sector of the CFT. Interestingly, we can then explicitly produce the non-vanishing central charges related to its static solution, the dyonic dilaton BH, using the thermodynamic method. Moreover, from the CFT relations to multi-horizon thermodynamics, we find the analytical expression of the quasi-normal modes~(QNM) spectra in terms of BH parameters. This QNM computation supports the Bekenstein-Hod conjecture on the BH's entropy quantization.

classification.title_zh: 双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞的熵量子化与准正则模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞（DKSBH）的内外视界热力学性质。研究发现其熵（或面积）乘积是普适的，仅依赖于黑洞角动量。随后，利用热力学关系研究 Kerr/CFT 对应中的对偶共形场论（CFT），并从二维 CFT 计算中心荷，发现中心荷也是普适的，只依赖于角动量。通过与 Kerr-Newman 黑洞比较，发现本质差异位于 CFT 的右行扇区。有趣的是，热力学方法还能显式给出其静态解——双荷伸缩子黑洞——的非零中心荷。此外，从 CFT 关系到多视界热力学，我们得到以黑洞参数表示的准正则模（QNM）谱的解析表达式；该 QNM 计算支持 Bekenstein-Hod 关于黑洞熵量子化的猜想。
classification.one_liner: 对双荷 Kerr-Sen 黑洞，利用内外视界热力学和 Kerr/CFT 对应得到普适中心荷及解析准正则模谱，从而支持 Bekenstein-Hod 熵量子化猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文包含 QNM 谱的解析计算，可与 QNM 研究主线发生交集，但其核心为黑洞熵量子化/Kerr-CFT 热力学，不涉及全息凝聚态、探针膜或非线性演化，因此相关度为中等偏间接。

2608.08593v2.title: Conformally mapping HKLL to flat space
2608.08593v2.abstract: We study two conformal images of the HKLL reconstruction problem for a conformally coupled scalar on AdS$_3$. The first mapping is to a Dirichlet problem on one half of the Einstein static universe. A further conformal transformation maps this half-ESU problem to a massless scalar in a region of $(2+1)$-dimensional Minkowski space bounded by an uniformly accelerated circular Dirichlet mirror. However, the global HKLL problem, the resulting flat-space problem is not a generic local mirror problem with arbitrary boundary data. Rather, the mirror response data must belong to a restricted spectral class inherited from normalizable global AdS modes. We formulate and solve this restricted mirror problem intrinsically in flat space. In the process, we find an example of a valid smearing function which itself does not satisfy the equations of motion. We further consider AdS-Rindler wedge reconstruction. By conformal mapping to an appropriate coordinate system in flat space, we find a simple way to see the blow-up of the smearing function.

classification.title_zh: 将 HKLL 共形映射到平直时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 AdS3 中共形耦合标量的 HKLL 重建问题的两个共形像。第一个映射是爱因斯坦静态宇宙一半上的 Dirichlet 问题。进一步的共形变换将这个半-ESU 问题映射到一个由均匀加速的圆形 Dirichlet 镜面所界定的 (2+1) 维闵可夫斯基空间区域中的无质量标量问题。然而，对于全局 HKLL 问题，得到的平直空间问题并不是具有任意边界数据的一般局部镜面问题；相反，镜面响应数据必须属于从可归一化的全局 AdS 模式继承而来的受限谱类。我们在平直空间中内禀地构造并求解了这个受限镜面问题。在此过程中，我们找到了一个合法的 smearing 函数的例子，而该函数本身并不满足运动方程。我们进一步考虑了 AdS-Rindler 楔形重建：通过共形映射到平直空间中的适当坐标系，我们可以简洁地看到 smearing 函数的发散行为。
classification.one_liner: 通过共形映射研究 AdS3 上 HKLL 体态重建在爱因斯坦静态宇宙与平直空间中的像，并构造受限镜面问题的 smearing 函数。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于 AdS/CFT 字典中的 HKLL 体态重建基础研究，与所列全息超流、相变、QNM 或经典引力等具体支线无直接重叠，因此相关性较低。

2608.27627v2.title: The Late-time Ramp of the Double-Scaled SYK Model from the large-$n$ tail of Cactus Diagram
2608.27627v2.abstract: We derive the late-time ramp of the finite-temperature spectral form factor in the double-scaled SYK model directly from cactus diagrams, which is introduced as a multi-trace generalization of chord diagram in Ref \cite{Berkooz:2020fvm}. Although single-trace observables admit an exact chord-diagram description, multi-trace sums are obstructed by the chord-intersection weights $q_{IJ}$, which cannot be averaged independently to $q$. Our key idea is that the non-analytic contribution responsible for the ramp is controlled by the large-order tail of the Cactus-diagram expansion and is insensitive to finite changes in its low-order analytic terms. Decomposing the contribution with $n$-cross-trace-pairings Cactus diagram into two buds $B_n$ and a kernel $\mathcal K_n$, we determine their large-$n$ asymptotics with fixed $0\leq q<1$ and resum the resulting tail. For $\beta_L=\beta+it$ and $\beta_R=\beta-it$, we obtain \begin{equation*} Z_s^{\mathrm{sing}}(\beta+it,\beta-it) =s_p c_N \frac{|t|}{2\pi} \int_{E_{min}}^{E_{max}} e^{-2\beta E} dE+O(1), \qquad s_p=\begin{cases}2,&4\mid p,\\1,&4\nmid p.\end{cases} \end{equation*} This result reproduces the linear ramp predicted by random matrix theory, including its temperature dependence and symmetry factor, and agrees with the semiclassical predictions. It provides a direct microscopic origin of the ramp within the general $q$-deformed quantum algebra. While the plateau lies beyond the scope of the present analysis and calculation.

classification.title_zh: 双标度SYK模型晚期斜坡：来自仙人掌图的大n尾部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们直接从仙人掌图推导了双标度SYK模型中有限温度谱形因子的晚期斜坡，仙人掌图在文献[Berkooz:2020fvm]中被引入为弦图的多迹推广。尽管单迹观测量具有精确的弦图描述，多迹求和受到弦交叉权重q_{IJ}的阻碍，这些权重无法独立地平均为q。我们的关键思想是，产生斜坡的非解析贡献由仙人掌图展开的大阶尾部控制，并且对其低阶解析项的有限改变不敏感。我们将具有n次交叉迹配对的仙人掌图贡献分解为两个萌芽B_n和一个核K_n，确定了它们在固定0≤q<1下的大n渐近行为，并对所得尾部进行重求和。对于β_L=β+it和β_R=β-it，我们得到：Z_s^{sing}(β+it,β-it)=s_p c_N |t|/(2π) ∫_{E_min}^{E_max} e^{-2βE} dE + O(1)，其中s_p=2（若4整除p），1（其他情况）。这一结果再现了随机矩阵理论预言的线性斜坡，包括其温度依赖性和对称因子，并与半经典预言一致。它为一般q变形量子代数中斜坡的直接微观起源提供了依据。而平台则超出了本文分析和计算的范围。
classification.one_liner: 通过仙人掌图大阶尾部的重求和，直接从双标度SYK模型导出有限温度谱形因子的线性斜坡。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要处理双标度SYK模型与随机矩阵理论中的谱形因子斜坡问题，与用户关注的全息超流、相变、经典引力等支线的直接关联较弱；仅multi-trace技术与个别用户标签重叠。

2605.18286v2.title: Primary gravitational waves at high frequencies II: Emergence of the exponential cut-off in the power spectrum
2605.18286v2.abstract: [Abridged] In slow roll inflation, the power spectrum (PS) of primary gravitational waves (PGWs) generated from the quantum vacuum rises as $k^2$ over wave numbers $k$ which never leave the Hubble radius. In fact, over such small scales, the PS exhibits a similar behavior at any time after inflation. In a recent work, we had argued that the PS of PGWs has to be regularized to truncate the unphysical quadratic rise at large wave numbers. Assuming instantaneous transitions from inflation to the epochs of radiation and matter domination, we had shown that the regularized PS oscillates with a constant amplitude about a vanishing mean over small scales during these epochs. We had also smoothed the transition (actually, the `effective potential' governing the equation of motion of GWs) from inflation to radiation domination using a linear function and evaluated the regularized PS of PGWs post inflation. In such a case, we had shown that, over small scales, while the regularized PS continues to oscillate about zero, its amplitude decreases as $k^{-1}$. In this work, using the Born approximation, we examine the behavior of the regularized PS of PGWs over small scales when they are evolved through smoother and smoother transitions from inflation to the epochs of radiation and matter domination. We illustrate that, at small scales or high frequencies, the suppression in the regularized PS of PGWs occurs more and more sharply as the transition is smoothed further and further. With the help of examples, we also show that, in the case of transitions described by infinitely differentiable `effective potentials', the regularized PS of PGWs exhibits an exponential suppression on small scales. We argue that the observation of the exponential drop in the PS of PGWs can help us determine the energy scale and the time of the end of inflation. We clarify related issues and discuss the wider implications.

classification.title_zh: 高频原初引力波 II：功率谱中指数截断的出现
classification.abstract_zh: （节选）在慢滚暴胀中，源自量子真空的原初引力波功率谱在从未离开哈勃半径的波数k上呈k^2上升。事实上，在这些小尺度上，功率谱在暴胀后的任意时刻都表现出类似行为。我们曾论证必须对原初引力波功率谱进行正则化，以截断大波数处非物理的二次上升。在本文中，我们利用Born近似，研究了当量子真空涨落经历从暴胀到辐射和物质主导时期越来越平滑的过渡时，正则化功率谱在小尺度上的行为。我们证明，当过渡被进一步平滑，小尺度或高频处的抑制会越来越尖锐。通过实例我们还表明，对于由无穷可微“有效势”描述的过渡，原初引力波的正则化功率谱在小尺度上呈现指数压制。我们论证，观测到这种指数下降有助于确定暴胀结束的能量尺度与时间。
classification.one_liner: 通过平滑从暴胀到辐射/物质主导时期的过渡，证明原初引力波功率谱在小尺度上出现指数截断，并可用于测定暴胀结束的能量尺度与时间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于经典引力框架下的宇宙学原初引力波功率谱，与用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关，但与全息、凝聚态等主线无关。

2607.18998v3.title: Free energy and spectral edge of the SYK model
2607.18998v3.abstract: We introduce a microscopic framework that gives the first rigorous derivation of the Schwinger--Dyson thermodynamics of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. For fixed, even interaction order $q\geq 4$, we prove that the annealed and quenched normalized pressures converge to the Schwinger--Dyson pressure $p_{{\rm SD},q}(\beta)$, at any fixed inverse temperature $\beta>0$. The proof is derived from the finite-$N$ Gibbs state, and it contains three new ingredients: a single-site cavity expansion that keeps the bulk Gibbs state intact, a finite-dimensional locality estimate yielding label-uniform conditional factorization of the Euclidean cavity fields, and an exact Majorana-bath representation of the leading diagrams. We further determine the asymptotic location of the largest eigenvalue, which answers a question posed by Feng--Tian--Wei. Consequently, the sample free-energy density converges almost surely to the zero-temperature value along every sequence $\beta\equiv \beta_N\to\infty$.

classification.title_zh: SYK 模型的自由能与谱边
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入一个微观框架，首次对 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型的 Schwinger-Dyson 热力学给出严格推导。对于固定偶数相互作用阶数 q≥4，我们证明退火与淬火归一化压强在任意固定逆温度 β>0 下收敛到 Schwinger-Dyson 压强 p_{SD,q}(β)。证明基于有限 N 的 Gibbs 态，包含三个新要素：保持体 Gibbs 态完整的单点空腔展开、给出标签一致条件因子化的有限维局域性估计，以及主图的精确 Majorana 热库表示。我们进一步确定了最大特征值的渐近位置，回答了 Feng-Tian-Wei 提出的问题。因此，样本自由能密度沿任意 β≡β_N→∞ 的序列几乎必然收敛到零温值。
classification.one_liner: 严格证明了 SYK 模型的退火/淬火压强收敛到 Schwinger-Dyson 压强，并确定谱边与自由能密度的零温收敛。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 SYK 模型严格热力学与谱性质，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p 波序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、相变成核、QNM、探针膜或经典引力等方向。

2608.24140v2.title: Towards a Connection Formulation of Action-Dependent Palatini Gravity
2608.24140v2.abstract: Previous work has shown that first-order Palatini gravity may be cast as a non-conservative Herglotz Lagrangian field theory, which excludes the conformal mode from its space of dynamical variables. In the present work, we analyse the role of the $SO(1,3)$ gauge connection in the construction of this action-dependent theory. The connection may be algebraically decomposed into complementary sectors which we interpret as `shape' and `scale' components. Only the former is retained within the Herglotz theory, while the latter is incorporated into the action-dependent sector. It is shown that the choice of connection decomposition is a space that can be smoothly parameterised. Such an observation leads to the finding that there exists a `moduli space of frictional field theories', in which each point corresponds to a distinct algebraic splitting of the connection into shape and scale pieces. Movement within the moduli space transitions between Herglotz Lagrangians whose on-shell dynamics all reproduce first-order Palatini gravity. The distinction lies in how the reproduction of the scale dynamics of the original theory is partitioned between action dependence and dynamical torsion.

classification.title_zh: 走向作用依赖的Palatini引力的联络表述
classification.abstract_zh: 先前工作表明，一阶Palatini引力可以表述为非保守的Herglotz拉格朗日场论，该理论从其动力学变量空间中排除了共形模式。在本文中，我们分析了SO(1,3)规范联络在此作用依赖理论构建中的作用。联络可代数分解为互补的扇区，我们将其诠释为“形状”和“标度”分量。在Herglotz理论中仅保留前者，而后者并入作用依赖扇区。结果表明，联络分解的选择空间可以被平滑参数化。这一观察引出了“摩擦场论模空间”的存在，其中每个点对应联络在形状与标度部分之间的不同代数分割。模空间内的运动在不同Herglotz拉格朗日之间转换，它们的在壳动力学均复现一阶Palatini引力。其区别在于原始理论标度动力学的复现方式如何被划分到作用依赖与动力学挠率之间。
classification.one_liner: 本文研究作用依赖Palatini引力中SO(1,3)联络的分解，发现存在一个“摩擦场论模空间”，其中不同分割方式均复现一阶Palatini引力的动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于经典引力理论（作用依赖的Palatini引力）的形式研究，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力，但与用户关注的经典引力/广义相对论研究线直接相关。

2609.00200v1.title: Gravitational waves from core collapse of rotating very-massive stars: 3D numerical relativity computation
2609.00200v1.abstract: We numerically study the collapse of rotating, very-massive stellar cores with masses of $\approx 200$, $300$, $500$, and $1100M_\odot$ into black holes using both axisymmetric and three-dimensional (3D) numerical relativity. Our results indicate that when the dimensionless spin of the resulting black hole exceeds 0.8, a massive disk consistently forms around it. These massive, compact disks, carrying more than about 10\% of the black hole's mass, are prone to non-axisymmetric deformations that trigger gravitational-wave bursts with frequencies around 10-50 Hz. Such waves could be detected by the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer, even from sources a few Gpc away. We also summarize the gravitational-wave signals from axisymmetric collapse, which tend to have lower amplitudes and higher frequencies than those caused by non-axisymmetric instabilities.

classification.title_zh: 旋转超大规模恒星核心坍缩的引力波：三维数值相对论计算
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用轴对称和三维（3D）数值相对论方法，数值研究了质量约为200、300、500和1100倍太阳质量的旋转超大规模恒星核心坍缩成黑洞的过程。结果表明，当所得黑洞的无量纲自旋超过0.8时，周围会持续形成一个巨大盘。这些巨大致密的盘，携带超过黑洞质量约10%的物质，容易发生非轴对称不稳定性，触发频率约为10-50 Hz的引力波暴。即使在几Gpc外，这类波也能被爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者探测到。我们还总结了轴对称坍缩产生的引力波信号，这些信号往往具有比非轴对称不稳定性引起的引力波更低的振幅和更高的频率。
classification.one_liner: 通过三维数值相对论模拟揭示了旋转超大规模恒星坍缩成黑洞时，形成大质量吸积盘并产生10-50 Hz引力波暴。
classification.relevance_reason: 该研究与全息/量子引力无关，属于经典数值相对论与引力波天体物理。

2609.00339v1.title: A Fast and Scalable Transformer Pipeline for Binary Black Hole Detection
2609.00339v1.abstract: With the projected increase in the detection rate of compact-binary coalescences in the coming decade, there is critical need to develop fast, robust, and scalable alternatives to matched filtering for gravitational-wave searches. Transformer models have revolutionized natural language and audio processing but their application to gravitational-wave astronomy is still largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce \castor, a transformer-based coincident search pipeline for detecting binary black hole gravitational-wave signals from Advanced LIGO detectors. One of the major features of our model is that it allows the false-alarm rate to be estimated via time slides cheaply without requiring repeated evaluations of the neural network. We evaluate \castor\ on datasets from the Machine-Learning Gravitational-Wave Search Challenge (MLGWSC-1) and on approximately five months of real O3b observing strain. When tested on benchmark datasets, \castor\ ranks among the most sensitive machine-learning pipelines and successfully recovers the majority of confident events from the GWTC-3 catalog that lie within its training range. We also benchmark \castor\ against another transformer architecture, GW-Whisper, a domain-adaptation of OpenAI's audio foundation model. We find that \castor\ substantially outperforms the repurposed audio model in sensitivity and also reduces the computational cost of background estimation by a factor of 20. Our results demonstrate a highly practical, scalable approach for deep-learning gravitational wave searches and empirical background estimation for future observing runs.

classification.title_zh: 用于双黑洞探测的快速可扩展Transformer流水线
classification.abstract_zh: 随着下一年代致密双星并合探测率的预期增长，迫切需要开发快速、稳健且可扩展的匹配滤波替代方案用于引力波搜索。Transformer模型已经彻底改变了自然语言和音频处理，但在引力波天文学中的应用基本尚未探索。在这项工作中，我们介绍了CASTRO，一个基于Transformer的符合搜索流水线，用于从Advanced LIGO探测器的双黑洞引力波信号。我们模型的主要特点之一是可以通过时间平移低成本估计误报率，而无需重复评估神经网络。我们在机器学习引力波搜索挑战（MLGWSC-1）数据集以及约五个月的O3b真实观测应变上评估了CASTRO。在基准数据集上测试时，CASTRO在大多数敏感的机器学习流水线中位居前列，并成功恢复了GWTC-3星表中其训练范围内的多数可靠事件。我们还将CASTRO与另一个Transformer架构GW-Whisper进行了基准比较，后者是OpenAI音频基础模型的领域适配。我们发现CASTRO在灵敏度上大幅优于这种改造后的音频模型，并将背景估计的计算成本降低了20倍。我们的结果展示了一种高度实用、可扩展的引力波深度学习搜索及经验背景估计方法，适用于未来的观测运行。
classification.one_liner: 提出CASTRO，一种基于Transformer的双黑洞引力波探测流水线，利用时间滑动高效估计误报率，在基准和真实数据上性能优异。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文关注引力波信号的深度学习检测与背景估计，属于经典引力实验数据分析，与全息理论或经典引力理论本身无直接关联。

2609.00589v1.title: Directional Response Optimization through Linear Recombination of Time-Delay Interferometry Channels in Space-based Gravitational Wave Detection
2609.00589v1.abstract: Space-based gravitational-wave detectors such as LISA, Taiji, and TianQin employ time-delay interferometry (TDI) to cancel laser-frequency noise for unequal-arm constellations. Since different TDI observables exhibit distinct sky responses, a linear combination of candidate channels can enhance the average response over one sky region while suppressing that of another. We construct a frequency-domain response matrix for TDI combinations, average it across target and suppressed sky regions, and derive the optimal weights via a generalized eigenvalue problem that maximizes the ratio between these two regional responses. At millihertz frequencies, examples with the $A$, $E$, and $T$ channels, the Sagnac combinations $\alpha$, $\beta$, and $\gamma$, and 16-links TDI show that a sky-region null and a large regional contrast are possible near the chosen frequency, with eigenvalues $\rho$ ranging from $\mathcal{O}(10)$ for small bases to $\mathcal{O}(10^2)$ for the larger set. The method is therefore expected to be well suited to nearly monochromatic sources such as the resolved Galactic double white dwarf binaries in the millihertz band. The Target-to-Suppression Ratio (TSR) peaks near the design frequency and falls quickly away from it, so the optimized weight vector is inherently narrowband and suited to targeted searches around a chosen frequency and sky direction.

classification.title_zh: 空间引力波探测中通过时间延迟干涉通道线性重组实现方向响应优化
classification.abstract_zh: LISA、Taiji 与 TianQin 等空间引力波探测器使用时间延迟干涉(TDI)来消除不等臂星座中的激光频率噪声。不同 TDI 观测量具有不同的天区响应，因此候选通道的线性组合可以增强某个天区的平均响应并抑制另一个天区。本文构造了 TDI 组合的频域响应矩阵，在目标天区和被抑制天区上取平均，并通过一个最大化这两个区域响应之比的广义本征值问题得到最优权重。在毫赫兹频率下，使用 A、E、T 通道、Sagnac 组合 α、β、γ 以及 16 链路 TDI 的示例表明，在所选频率附近可以实现天区零点和大区域对比；本征值 ρ 对于小基组约为 O(10)，对于大基组约为 O(10^2)。因此，该方法预期很适合近单色源，例如毫赫兹波段中可分辨的银河系双白矮星。目标对抑制比(TSR)在设计频率处达到峰值并随远离频率而快速下降，所以优化后的权重向量本质上是窄带的，适合在选定频率和天空方向附近进行定向搜索。
classification.one_liner: 通过线性组合TDI通道并求解广义本征值问题，可增强空间引力波探测器对目标天区的响应、压制其他区域，形成适合毫赫兹单色源的窄带定向探测。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于空间引力波探测的数据分析与探测器响应优化方法，虽可纳入引力波应用方向，但核心内容不涉及全息、量子引力或强耦合理论，与用户主要关注的理论研究支线关联较弱。

2609.00934v1.title: Polarization Images of Neutron Stars Illuminated by a Thin Accretion Disk: A Comparison with Black Holes
2609.00934v1.abstract: We investigate linear polarization images of static, spherically symmetric neutron stars illuminated by a geometrically and optically thin accretion disk. Neutron star equilibrium configurations are constructed with a polytropic equation of state, and the null geodesic equations and the parallel transport equation for the linear polarization vector are solved in the geometric optics approximation. The numerical results show that the total polarized intensity is generally positively correlated with the total intensity and reaches its maximum near the neutron star surface. As the observer inclination increases, the symmetry of the polarization images is progressively broken. In addition, the magnetic field configuration mainly affects the direction of the polarization vectors, while its influence on the overall polarized intensity distribution is comparatively limited. To further characterize the spatial structure of the polarization direction, we introduce the net electric vector position angle $\chi_{\mathrm{net}}$ and the second azimuthal Fourier mode $\angle\beta_2$. A comparison with polarization images of a Schwarzschild black hole reveals clear differences between the two types of compact objects in the locations of strongly polarized regions and the size of the central region without a polarization signal. These results show that linear polarization images provide information beyond total intensity images for distinguishing neutron stars from black holes.

classification.title_zh: 薄吸积盘照明下中子星的偏振图像：与黑洞的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由几何薄且光学薄的吸积盘照明的静态、球对称中子星的线偏振图像。利用多方物态方程构建中子星平衡位形，并在几何光学近似下求解零测地线方程和线偏振矢量的平行输运方程。数值结果表明，总偏振强度通常与总强度呈正相关，并在中子星表面附近达到最大。随着观测者倾角增大，偏振图像的对称性逐渐被打破。此外，磁场位型主要影响偏振矢量的方向，而对整体偏振强度分布的影响相对有限。为进一步刻画偏振方向的空间结构，我们引入了净电矢量位置角χ_net和二阶方位角傅里叶模角β_2。与Schwarzschild黑洞偏振图像的比较显示，两类致密天体在强偏振区域位置和中心无偏振信号区域大小上存在明显差异。这些结果表明，线偏振图像可提供超出总强度图像的额外信息，用于区分中子星与黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 对薄吸积盘照明的静态球对称中子星做线偏振成像计算，并与Schwarzschild黑洞对比，发现偏振信号的空间分布可作为区分两类致密天体的新探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究的是经典广义相对论下中子星与黑洞的吸积盘偏振成像，属于用户关注的‘经典引力/广义相对论’支线。

2609.00945v1.title: Constraining AGN Disk Properties with Gravitational Waves from Inspiraling Stellar-Mass Binary Black Holes in Hierarchical Triple Systems
2609.00945v1.abstract: Space-based gravitational-wave detectors can observe stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) long before merger, allowing weak environmental perturbations to accumulate. For binaries embedded in active galactic nucleus (AGN) disks, the local gas density characterizes the environment of the supermassive black hole (SMBH) and compact-object migration. We study whether such signals can constrain this density when a stellar-mass BBH orbits a Kerr SMBH. We evolve the outer orbit with relativistic corrections and gaseous dynamical friction (DF), and construct the detector-frame waveform including BBH inspiral, de Sitter precession, DF phase correction, and moving-source effects. Using Fisher-matrix calculations for sampled systems, we estimate statistical uncertainties and systematic errors. Larger gas densities generally improve the statistical precision of several source and outer-orbit parameters, but also increase systematic errors when DF is omitted. For favorable GW190521-like systems observed by LISA for one year, the disk density can be constrained at the level of $\sigma_{\rho}\sim10^{-12}\text{--}10^{-10}\,{\rm g\,cm^{-3}}$. Such constraints would connect BBH merger environments to the gas structure of galactic nuclei and the conditions that support black hole growth. These results indicate that hierarchical BBH inspirals can probe AGN disk environments, provided that gas effects are modeled consistently.

classification.title_zh: 利用层级三星系统中旋近恒星质量双黑洞的引力波约束AGN盘性质
classification.abstract_zh: 空间引力波探测器可以在恒星质量双黑洞并合前很久就观测到它们，使微弱的环境扰动得以积累。对于嵌入活动星系核（AGN）盘中的双黑洞，局部气体密度表征了超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的环境以及致密天体迁移。我们研究当恒星质量双黑洞绕一个Kerr超大质量黑洞运行时，这样的信号能否约束该密度。我们考虑相对论修正和气体动力学摩擦来演化外轨道，并构建探测器帧波形，包括双黑洞旋近、de Sitter进动、动力学摩擦相位修正和运动源效应。利用采样系统的Fisher矩阵计算，我们估计统计不确定性和系统误差。较大的气体密度通常提高几个源和外轨道参数的统计精度，但当忽略动力学摩擦时会增加系统误差。对于有利的类似GW190521的系统被LISA观测一年，盘密度可以被约束在σ_ρ~10^-12到10^-10 g/cm^3的水平。这样的约束将把双黑洞并合环境与星系核的气体结构以及支持黑洞增长的条件联系起来。这些结果表明层级双黑洞旋近可以探测AGN盘环境，前提是气体效应得到一致建模。
classification.one_liner: 该研究利用空间引力波探测器如LISA对AGN盘中层级三星系统内双黑洞旋近的观测，通过Fisher矩阵分析表明可约束盘密度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论框架下的引力波天体物理应用，与用户经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息、量子引力或凝聚态等核心方向。

2609.01290v1.title: Deviations from Kerr: Polar critical curves and photon rings in a class of separable spacetimes
2609.01290v1.abstract: Black-hole critical curves and photon rings provide complementary probes of strong-field geometry, motivating a unified analytic description of these observables beyond Kerr and a direct comparison with the Kerr predictions. We develop such a description for polar observers in a radial class of stationary, axisymmetric spacetimes with separable null geodesics. The spacetime dependence is organized through natural optical combinations selected by the null dynamics and a Kerr-relative representation suited to weak deviations from Kerr. We derive compact exact expressions for the polar critical radius, Lyapunov exponent, time delay, and rotation parameter, together with general first-order formulas that can be applied once the deformation functions of a specific metric are supplied. The weak-deviation analysis shows that the combined polar observables probe only a finite set of local deformation values and radial derivatives at the critical orbit, rather than the full radial profiles.

classification.title_zh: 偏离Kerr：一类可分离时空中的极向临界曲线和光子环
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞临界曲线和光子环为强场几何提供互补的探针，激发了对超越Kerr的这些观测量进行统一解析描述，并与Kerr预言直接比较。我们针对具有可分离零测地线的径向类稳态轴对称时空中的极向观测者发展了这种描述。时空依赖性通过由零动力学和相对于Kerr的表示选择的自然光学组合来组织，适用于弱偏离Kerr的情形。我们推导了极向临界半径、Lyapunov指数、时间延迟和旋转参数的紧凑精确表达式，以及一旦给定特定度规的形变函数即可应用的一般一阶公式。弱偏离分析表明，组合的极向观测量仅探测临界轨道处有限的一组局部形变值及其径向导数，而非完整的径向分布。
classification.one_liner: 在可分离时空类中给出了极向光子临界曲线和光子环偏离Kerr的统一解析公式，表明弱偏离观测量仅依赖临界轨道的局部形变信息。

2609.01331v1.title: Gravitational-wave signatures of primordial black hole clusters and the imprint of an early dense-core collapse
2609.01331v1.abstract: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are expected to be born essentially non-spinning and, if the primordial curvature fluctuations possess non-Gaussian tails, strongly clustered. Any spin measured in a PBH population must therefore be dynamically generated. Using direct $N$-body simulations with \textsc{nbody6++gpu}, modified to treat nearly parabolic dynamical-capture mergers, we quantify the conditions under which an initially non-spinning PBH cluster develops the spin, mass and stochastic-background signatures that gravitational-wave observations are now sensitive to. We find a sharp tension: producing a root-mean-square spin $\chi_{\rm rms}\sim0.1 - 0.2$ in the $30 - 50\,M_\odot$ range requires initial Plummer radii of order $10^{-5}\,{\rm pc}$, whereas survival over cosmological times requires parsec-scale clusters. This tension is resolved naturally if PBHs form with a compact, short-lived core embedded in an extended halo, and we therefore simulate the two regimes as independent blocks. The core block ($4000$ PBHs, Plummer radii $3\times10^{-6} - 10^{-4}\,{\rm pc}$) collapses in days to years, producing a burst of mergers whose orbits are strongly non-circular ($e\to1$) and of low dimensionless orbital angular momentum, so that remnant spins are systematically below the quasi-circular value $\chi\simeq0.7$. Redshifted from their formation epoch, the core mergers deposit a stochastic background peaking in the $10^{-6}$--$10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$ band accessible to LISA. The picture predicts a specific division of labour between observables, spins set in the primordial collapse, detectable mergers set by the long-term halo, and a two-component stochastic background, and, in particular, that both the spin and the mass data favour a primordial mass function truncated near $50\,M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 原初黑洞星团的引力波信号与早期致密核坍缩的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞（PBH）预计在诞生时几乎不携带自旋，而如果原初曲率扰动具有非高斯尾部，它们会强烈成团。因此，在PBH族群中测量到的任何自旋都必然通过动力学过程产生。我们使用经修改以处理近抛物线动力学俘获并合的N体模拟程序nbody6++gpu，直接量化了初始无自旋PBH星团在什么条件下会发展出引力波观测如今已能探测的自旋、质量以及随机背景特征。我们发现一个尖锐的张力：要在30–50太阳质量范围内产生均方根自旋χ_rms~0.1–0.2，需要约10^-5 pc量级的初始Plummer半径；而要在宇宙学时间尺度上存活，则需要秒差距尺度的星团。若PBH形成时带有嵌入延展晕中的致密、短寿命核心，这一张力可自然得到解决，因此我们把这两个区域作为独立模块分别模拟。核心模块（4000个PBH，Plummer半径3×10^-6–10^-4 pc）在数天到数年内坍缩，产生轨道高度非圆（e→1）、无量纲轨道角动量较低的并合爆发，因此残余自旋系统地低于准圆值χ≃0.7。从形成时期红移后，核心并合产生的随机背景峰值落在10^-6–10^-4 Hz频段，可被LISA探测。该图景预见了可观测效应之间明确的分工：自旋在原初坍缩中确定，可探测并合由长期延展晕决定，随机背景则为双组分结构；并且，自旋与质量数据都倾向于支持在约50太阳质量处截断的原初质量函数。
classification.one_liner: N体模拟显示，带致密短寿命核心的原初黑洞星团可同时解释观测所需的自旋与LISA频段随机引力波背景，并暗示质量函数约在50太阳质量截断。

2609.01568v1.title: Enabling gravitational-wave astronomy with spin-precessing black holes on generic orbits
2609.01568v1.abstract: Binary black holes (BBHs) formed in dense stellar environments or in hierarchical triples can coalesce on eccentric orbits and carry spins of arbitrary orientation, leaving distinctive imprints on their gravitational-wave (GW) emission. We present SEOBNRv6EPHM: the first generic-orbit, spin-precessing model in the effective-one-body SEOBNR family, whose waveforms have underpinned LIGO-Virgo GW analyses since 2011. The model describes the dynamics and multipolar GW signal of generic BBHs, covering the inspiral-merger-ringdown of coalescing binaries and extending to dynamical captures and scattering encounters. We perform the first systematic accuracy assessment of a generic-orbit model against numerical relativity (NR) waveforms of spin-precessing BBHs, using 1437 quasi-circular (QC) and 87 eccentric simulations: median waveform mismatches remain below $1 \%$, matching the accuracy of the QC model SEOBNRv5PHM, and improving on the state-of-the-art generic-orbit model TEOBResumS-Dal\'i by a median factor of $ 4 $. The model also reproduces the non-perturbative phenomenology observed in NR simulations of generic-spin BBH scattering. It is $\sim 2 - 3$ times faster than SEOBNRv5PHM in the QC limit, and up to an order of magnitude faster than TEOBResumS-Dal\'i, bringing eccentric inference to the cost of current QC analyses. As a proof of principle, we analyze eleven GW events and focus on GW200129, strengthening its evidence for eccentricity $-$ a result supported by injection-recovery studies with synthetic NR signals of eccentric, spin-precessing BBHs. SEOBNRv6EPHM thus enables, for the first time, accurate and efficient GW analyses that jointly account for eccentricity and spin precession.

classification.title_zh: 实现自旋进动黑洞在一般轨道上的引力波天文学
classification.abstract_zh: 在致密恒星环境或层级三星系统中形成的双黑洞（BBH）可以在偏心轨道上合并，并携带任意方向的自旋，从而在其引力波（GW）发射上留下独特印记。我们提出了SEOBNRv6EPHM：有效单体SEOBNR家族中首个通用轨道、自旋进动模型，该家族的波形自2011年以来一直支撑LIGO-Virgo引力波分析。该模型描述了通用BBH的动力学和多极引力波信号，涵盖合并双星的旋进-合并-衰荡，并扩展到动力学捕获和散射遭遇。我们首次对自旋进动BBH的数值相对论（NR）波形进行了通用轨道模型的系统精度评估，使用1437个准圆（QC）和87个偏心模拟：中位波形失配保持在1%以下，与QC模型SEOBNRv5PHM的精度相当，并比最先进的通用轨道模型TEOBResumS-Dal'i提高中位因子4。该模型还再现了在一般自旋BBH散射的NR模拟中观察到的非微扰现象。在QC极限下，它比SEOBNRv5PHM快约2-3倍，比TEOBResumS-Dal'i快达一个数量级，使偏心推断的成本达到当前QC分析的水平。作为原理验证，我们分析了11个引力波事件并聚焦于GW200129，加强了其偏心率的证据——这一结果得到了使用偏心、自旋进动BBH的合成NR信号的注入-恢复研究的支持。因此，SEOBNRv6EPHM首次实现了准确且高效的引力波分析，可同时考虑偏心率和自旋进动。
classification.one_liner: 提出首个通用轨道自旋进动有效单体引力波模型SEOBNRv6EPHM，精度高且计算快，可同时分析偏心与自旋进动双黑洞。

2609.00095v1.title: Detectability-Aware Screening of Post-Merger Gravitational-Wave Damping Anomalies in Real Detector Noise: A Graph-Spectral Approach with Empirical Null Calibration
2609.00095v1.abstract: A two-stage methodological proof of concept for screening simplified post-merger gravitational-wave damping anomalies in real LIGO Livingston noise is presented. The injected signal is a controlled damped-sinusoid proxy rather than a physically complete binary-neutron-star post-merger waveform; it is used to test statistical detectability and damping-time scoring under real-noise calibration. Stage 1 constructs a local time-frequency graph from Constant-Q representations of whitened candidate windows and uses the leading eigenvalue as a detectability statistic, with its null distribution calibrated empirically on real detector noise. Stage 2 estimates an effective damping-time score for Stage-1-passing candidates using nonlinear least squares and an interpretable ridge/energy-decay estimator, with thresholds fixed before final held-out evaluation. The matched-filter SNR convention is checked with synthetic Gaussian noise, while the graph statistic is assessed through power-comparison and tile-shuffling tests. On a held-out real-noise test block, the nonlinear least-squares Stage-2 score gives AUC = 0.943 and TPR = 0.879 at FPR = 0.012, outperforming a calibrated power-only baseline.

classification.title_zh: 真实探测器噪声中并合后引力波阻尼异常的检测感知筛选：图谱方法与经验零校准
classification.abstract_zh: 本文针对真实 LIGO Livingston 噪声中并合后引力波阻尼异常的筛选，展示了一个两阶段的统计学方法学概念验证。注入信号为受控的阻尼正弦代理，而非物理上完整的双中子星并合后波形；该信号用于在真实噪声校准条件下测试统计可检测性和阻尼时间评分。第一阶段从白化候选窗口的 Constant-Q 表示构造局部时频图，并以最大特征值作为可检测性统计量，其零分布基于真实探测器噪声经验校准。第二阶段对通过第一阶段筛选的候选样本，使用非线性最小二乘和可解释的岭/能量衰减估计器估计有效阻尼时间评分，阈值在最终留出评估前固定。匹配滤波器信噪比约定通过合成高斯噪声检验；图统计量则通过功效比较和瓦片洗牌检验评估。在留出的真实噪声测试块上，非线性最小二乘第二阶段评分的 AUC=0.943，在 FPR=0.012 时 TPR=0.879，优于经校准的仅功率基线。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种基于时频图谱主特征值与经验零分布的两阶段方法，在真实 LIGO 噪声中筛选并合后阻尼异常代理信号，并取得优于功率基线的检测性能。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于引力波探测数据的统计检测方法学研究，使用阻尼正弦代理信号和真实探测器噪声；虽可归入经典引力/引力波应用，但不涉及广义相对论动力学、量子引力或全息理论，对理论物理研究线基本不相关。

2609.00229v1.title: Dimensional reduction associated with unchanged direction trajectories in flat fiber Robertson Walker spacetimes
2609.00229v1.abstract: In this article, we establish a new dimensional reduction result in (Galilean or Lorentzian) Robertson Walker spacetimes with Euclidean fiber. In this context, we prove that every unchanged direction observer can be embedded into a three dimensional totally geodesic timelike submanifold.

classification.title_zh: 平直纤维Robertson Walker时空中不变方向轨迹的维度约化
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在具有欧几里得纤维的（伽利略或洛伦兹）Robertson Walker时空中建立了新的维度约化结果。在此背景下，我们证明每个不变方向观测者都可以嵌入到三维全测地类时子流形中。
classification.one_liner: 在平直纤维Robertson-Walker时空中，证明不变方向观测者可嵌入三维全测地类时子流形，得到新的维度约化结果。
