2609.00965v1.title: The Radius of the Neutron Star PSR J0614-3329 from NICER Data
2609.00965v1.abstract: Neutron star radius measurements, particularly using X-ray data collected with the Neutron star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER), have provided invaluable information for models of cold, catalyzed matter at densities above that of nuclear saturation. Here we present an analysis of NICER data on the 318-Hz pulsar PSR J0614-3329, which has a mass ~1.4-1.5 solar masses determined from radio observations. The best-fitting model we explore has three uniform-temperature circular hot spots and yields a symmetric 68% credible range for the equatorial circumferential radius of 9.88-12.77 km. We also explore joint fits to the NICER data and the X-ray Multi-Mirror (XMM-Newton) data on this pulsar, but find that the models that best fit both data sets systematically underpredict the XMM-Newton data when, as is standard, it is assumed that the XMM-Newton background is known from observations of surrounding fields. Finally, we discuss the implications of our results, combined with data on other neutron stars, for the properties of the dense matter in neutron star cores.

classification.title_zh: 基于NICER数据的脉冲星PSR J0614-3329的半径测量
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星半径测量，特别是利用中子星内部组成探测器（NICER）收集的X射线数据，为核饱和密度以上的冷催化物质模型提供了宝贵信息。本文分析了NICER对318赫兹脉冲星PSR J0614-3329的数据，该脉冲星的质量由射电观测确定为约1.4-1.5太阳质量。我们探索的最佳拟合模型具有三个均匀温度的圆形热斑，并给出赤道周向半径的对称68%置信区间为9.88-12.77公里。我们还探索了联合拟合该脉冲星的NICER数据和X射线多镜（XMM-Newton）数据，但发现当按照标准假设XMM-Newton背景可由周围场观测得知时，最佳拟合两个数据集模型会系统性地低估XMM-Newton数据。最后，我们讨论了这些结果结合其他中子星数据对中子星核心致密物质性质的启示。
classification.one_liner: 该论文通过NICER数据测量中子星PSR J0614-3329的半径为9.88-12.77公里，并讨论了其对致密物质性质的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于利用观测数据测量中子星半径并约束物态方程，属于经典引力天体物理观测研究，与全息/量子引力理论支线无直接关联。

2202.13897v2.title: Timing of echoes in electromagnetic radiation from hot spots orbiting a Kerr black hole impostor
2202.13897v2.abstract: We investigate the light curve of an isolated bright spot in a Keplerian orbit around a Kerr black hole candidate to probe possible deviations from the standard event-horizon picture. In particular, we explore the presence of a reflective surface, namely a "mirror" near the horizon, and its observable consequences. We present estimates on the time delays of the echoes of electromagnetic radiation from the mirror or some other reflecting area related to black hole mimickers. Our results show that photon reflections from such a surface imprint distinct late-time features in the light curve, producing an electromagnetic analogue of gravitational wave echoes. For lower values of the spin, the reflected signal appears within the same orbital period and leads to a noticeable enhancement of the flux. In contrast, for higher spins, the effect emerges only after several orbits, giving rise to a characteristic echo-wave train. These features provide a potential observational signature of horizon-scale modifications in compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 绕Kerr黑洞冒名者轨道运行的热斑电磁辐射中回波的时间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了围绕Kerr黑洞候选体做开普勒轨道运动的孤立亮斑的光变曲线，以探测相对于标准事件视界图像的可能偏差。特别是，我们探索了视界附近存在反射面（即“镜子”）的情况及其可观测后果。我们给出了来自镜子或与黑洞模拟器相关的其他反射区域的电磁辐射回波时间延迟的估计。我们的结果表明，来自这种表面的光子反射会在光变曲线中留下明显的晚期特征，产生引力波回波的电磁类比。对于较低的自旋值，反射信号在同一轨道周期内出现，并导致通量的显著增强。相反，对于较高自旋，效应仅在几个轨道之后出现，产生特征性的回波波列。这些特征为致密天体中的视界尺度修改提供了潜在的可观测特征。
classification.one_liner: 研究黑洞候选体周围热斑的电磁辐射回波，探测视界尺度反射面，给出类引力波回波的电磁类比。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于黑洞视界替代物的电磁观测特征，属于经典引力/致密天体物理，与全息或量子引力无直接关联。

2604.24926v3.title: Sensitivity of black hole spectral instability to ultraviolet perturbations
2604.24926v3.abstract: Black hole quasinormal modes are known to exhibit spectral instability under ultraviolet perturbations of the effective potential. In the present work, we investigate the sensitivity of the fundamental mode to different types of localized perturbations through a combination of analytic and numerical analyzes. We show that the instability is governed primarily by the effective size of the perturbation rather than by its specific shape. In particular, the instability may persist even in the limit where the width of the perturbation vanishes, provided that the integrated strength of the perturbation is not zero. While a delta-function perturbation destabilizes the fundamental mode through an outward spiral, its interplay with a jump-discontinuity-type perturbation gives rise to competing inward and outward spiral motions. We further show that the stability of the fundamental mode depends sensitively on how the magnitude of the perturbation decreases as it moves away from the compact object, leading to qualitatively distinct outward spirals, inward spirals, and rotational trajectories. Finally, we investigate the motion of the fundamental mode in perturbed Regge-Wheeler potentials containing a jump discontinuity associated with a thin matter shell surrounding the black hole. The resulting behavior qualitatively resembles the spiral structure observed in double-sided P\"oschl-Teller potentials, suggesting that the mechanisms identified in analytically tractable models persist in more realistic black hole effective potentials. The present results indicate that the spectral instability of low-lying black hole modes is considerably richer than previously anticipated and may have important implications for black hole spectroscopy in realistic astrophysical environments.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞谱不稳定性对紫外扰动的敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞拟正规模态已知在有效势的紫外扰动下表现出谱不稳定性。在本工作中，我们通过解析和数值分析相结合，研究了基模对不同类型局域扰动的敏感性。我们表明，不稳定性主要由扰动的有效尺寸而非其具体形状决定。特别地，当扰动宽度趋于零但积分强度不为零时，不稳定性可能仍然存在。虽然δ函数扰动通过向外螺旋使基模失稳，但它与跳跃间断型扰动的相互作用会产生竞争性的向内和向外螺旋运动。我们进一步表明，基模的稳定性敏感地依赖于扰动随距离致密天体向外移动而减小的方式，这导致性质不同的向外螺旋、向内螺旋和旋转轨迹。最后，我们研究了在包含与围绕黑洞的薄物质壳相关的跳跃间断的扰动Regge-Wheeler势中基模的运动。所得行为在性质上类似于双侧Pöschl-Teller势中观察到的螺旋结构，表明在解析可处理模型中识别的机制在更真实黑洞有效势中仍然存在。这些结果表明，低位黑洞模的谱不稳定性比先前预期的丰富得多，并且可能对现实天体物理环境中的黑洞光谱学具有重要意义。
classification.one_liner: 展示了黑洞拟正规模谱不稳定性主要受扰动有效尺寸控制，并揭示了δ函数与间断扰动结合时更丰富的螺旋动力学。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦黑洞QNM的谱不稳定性，属于经典黑洞微扰理论，与用户重点标签中的QNM相关，但不是非线性演化或全息研究，相关度中等。

2605.27493v2.title: A no-go study on gravitational helicity in connection variables
2605.27493v2.abstract: We study the gravitational helicity using the covariant phase space method. Starting from the covariant phase space of general relativity expressed in terms of connection variables, we construct the symplectic form and identify a duality transformation based on the internal Hodge dual. In the complex self-dual Ashtekar variables the duality becomes a simple $U(1)$ phase rotation. We show, however, that this rotation is not a symmetry.We also show that the expression $\int_\Sigma\Sigma^{+AB}\wedge A^+_{AB}$ inspired by the electromagnetic helicity is neither a Noether charge nor a moment map.The duality of general relativity under a rotation of the curvature two-form is a symmetry of the equations of motion but not of the Lagrangian, and carries no Noether charge. An explicit computation shows that the mass and the NUT charge are not symplectically conjugate, so even in the reduced phase space of stationary solutions this duality has no moment map. This study therefore provides counter examples to the existence of a full-theory gravitational helicity in the covariant phase space approach.

classification.title_zh: 联络变量中引力螺旋度的一个不可能性研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用协变相空间方法研究引力螺旋度。从用联络变量表示的一般相对论的协变相空间出发，构造了辛形式，并基于内部霍奇对偶确定了一个对偶变换。在复自对偶Ashtekar变量中，该对偶变为简单的U(1)相位旋转。然而，我们表明该旋转并非对称性。我们还表明，受电磁螺旋度启发的表达式∫ΣΣ^{+AB}∧A^+_{AB}既不是Noether荷也不是矩映射。广义相对论在曲率二形式旋转下的对偶性是运动方程的对称性，但不是拉格朗日量的对称性，因此不携带Noether荷。显式计算表明，质量与NUT荷不是辛共轭的，因此即使在静态解约化相空间中，该对偶也没有矩映射。因此，本研究为协变相空间方法中不存在全理论引力螺旋度提供了反例。
classification.one_liner: 通过协变相空间方法证明，基于内部对偶的引力螺旋度变换在联络变量中不是对称性，且不存在相应的Noether荷或矩映射。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于经典引力理论中的对称性与荷，属于广义相对论基础研究，不涉及全息对偶或相关强关联体系。

2606.01569v3.title: Pitching Cosmic Curveballs: Environmental Effects on Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals with Spinning Secondaries
2606.01569v3.abstract: Much like the aerodynamic deflection of a spinning curveball, a rotating secondary in an extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) experiences Magnus and lift forces, in addition to the standard drag force, when traversing a gaseous environment. We present the first framework that incorporates these specific spin-coupled environmental effects (EEs) into the evolution of EMRI. Over the multi-year observation windows of space-based gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, these interactions imprint a unique, distinguishable dephasing signature on the signal. Crucially, a Fisher matrix analysis reveals that gas drag breaks the fundamental vacuum-projection degeneracy between the secondary's spin magnitude and inclination, thereby tightening parameter constraints. Thus, accounting for EEs is not merely a modeling necessity, but could potentially be a powerful tool for enhancing the detectability of the secondary's intrinsic spin, and could serve as a novel probe of accretion flows harboring massive black holes.

classification.title_zh: 投出宇宙曲线球：旋转次级体的极端质量比旋进中的环境效应
classification.abstract_zh: 类似于旋转曲线球的空气动力学偏转，极端质量比旋进（EMRI）中的旋转次级体在穿越气态环境时，除标准阻力外，还会经历马格努斯力和升力。我们提出了第一个将这些特定的自旋耦合环境效应（EEs）纳入EMRI演化的框架。在空间引力波（GW）探测器长达数年的观测窗口内，这些相互作用会在信号上留下独特且可区分的失谐特征。关键在于，Fisher矩阵分析表明，气体阻力打破了次级体自旋大小与倾角之间的基本真空投影简并，从而加强了参数约束。因此，考虑环境效应不仅是建模的必要条件，还可能成为增强次级体内禀自旋可探测性的有力工具，并可作为探测超大质量黑洞周围吸积流的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 首个将旋转次级体受气体环境导致的马格努斯/升力效应纳入EMRI演化的框架，可打破自旋参数简并并增强引力波探测能力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力中的EMRI与引力波信号，直接属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”范畴。

2607.07815v3.title: Causal Horizons, Geodesic Completeness and Stability in Slow Contraction Cosmology
2607.07815v3.abstract: We show that cosmological models with a semi-infinite phase of slow contraction (ekpyrosis) possess a combination of properties that can address several fundamental problems in cosmology, otherwise faced in contracting de Sitter phases or standard big bang expansion. In particular, slow contraction admits a stable past attractor asymptoting to Minkowski space, as well as a stable, flat, homogeneous, and isotropic future attractor with negligible Weyl curvature (and, therefore, negligible gravitational entropy). In bouncing cosmologies, this contracting attractor is terminated by a smooth, non-singular bounce that transforms the attractor properties at the end of contraction into the initial conditions for the subsequent expanding phase. Cosmologies incorporating a slow contraction phase have no particle horizon and therefore avoid the causal horizon problem. The past Minkowski attractor also generates an initial spectrum of vacuum-like quantum fluctuations on all wavelengths. Moreover, because the averaged expansion rate along past-directed geodesics is non-positive, models incorporating a semi-infinite phase of slow contraction also evade the Borde,Guth and Vilenkin theorem and are past geodesically complete. By contrast, contracting de Sitter space possesses a finite particle horizon and becomes unstable in the presence of scalar fields, matter, or radiation.

classification.title_zh: 慢收缩宇宙学中的因果视界、测地完备性与稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明，具有半无限慢收缩（ekpyrotic）阶段的宇宙学模型具备一系列性质组合，能够解决标准膨胀、收缩 de Sitter 阶段中面临的若干基本宇宙学问题。特别地，慢收缩允许一个稳定过去吸引子渐近于闵可夫斯基时空，以及一个具有可忽略 Weyl 曲率（因此引力熵可忽略）的稳定平坦、均匀、各向同性未来吸引子。在反弹宇宙学中，这一收缩吸引子由一个光滑、非奇异的反弹所终止，将收缩结束时的吸引子性质转化为随后膨胀阶段的初始条件。包含慢收缩阶段的宇宙学没有粒子视界，因此避免了因果视界问题。过去的闵可夫斯基吸引子还在所有波长上产生真空涨落的初始谱。此外，由于沿过去定向测地线的平均膨胀率非正，包含半无限慢收缩阶段的模型也规避了 Borde、Guth 和 Vilenkin 定理，并且在过去方向上是测地完备的。相形之下，收缩的 de Sitter 空间具有有限粒子视界，并且在存在标量场、物质或辐射时变得不稳定。
classification.one_liner: 该文论证慢收缩宇宙学具有稳定的闵可夫斯基过去吸引子、无粒子视界、过去测地完备性等特征，并通过非奇异反弹设定膨胀初始条件；相比而言，收缩 de Sitter 具有有限视界且不稳定。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究的是经典宇宙学中的慢收缩模型，与用户侧重的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、QNM与非线性演化等强关联/全息方向无直接交集，仅与经典引力/广义相对论大背景相关。

2607.11851v2.title: Corrected thermodynamics and radiation predictions of modified black bounce compact objects
2607.11851v2.abstract: We study the thermodynamic properties and radiation characteristics of a regular compact object obtained by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) regularisation to the Schwarzschild modified gravity black hole. The resulting SV-MOG spacetime, whose lapse function involves both the MOG coupling parameter alpha and the black-bounce parameter l, smoothly interpolates between a regular black hole, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole depending on the parameter l. We derive the Hawking temperature and heat capacity for the black hole branch, identifying second-order phase transitions signaled by sign changes in CV, and, for the horizonless wormhole branch where no causal horizon and hence no genuine Hawking radiation exists we instead construct a physically well-defined effective temperature from the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable photon sphere. Quantum gravitational corrections to the entropy are incorporated via logarithmic terms parameterized by coefficients beta1, beta2, whose theoretically preferred ranges in loop quantum gravity and string theory we discuss, and we show that deviations from the Bekenstein-Hawking area law become significant at small horizon radii. A linear scalar-perturbation analysis further shows that the effective radial potential remains non-negative throughout the black-hole exterior and across the wormhole throat, indicating stability against monopole perturbations independently of the thermodynamic stability inferred from the heat capacity.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 修正的black bounce致密天体的热力学与辐射预言
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将Simpson-Visser(SV)正则化应用于Schwarzschild修改引力黑洞所得到的正则致密天体的热力学和辐射性质。所得SV-MOG时空的lapse函数同时涉及MOG耦合参数alpha和black-bounce参数l，它随参数l平滑插值于正则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞之间。我们推导了黑洞分支的Hawking温度和热容，通过CV的符号变化识别出二级相变；对于没有因果视界因而没有真正Hawking辐射的无视界虫洞分支，我们改为从不稳定光子球的Lyapunov指数构造物理上定义良好的有效温度。通过由参数beta1、beta2参数化的对数项纳入对熵的量子引力修正，我们讨论了在圈量子引力和弦理论中理论上偏好范围，并显示相对于Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的偏差在小视界半径处变得显著。进一步的线性标量扰动分析表明，有效径向势在整个黑洞外部以及虫洞喉部保持非负，说明与从热容推断的热力学稳定性无关，系统对单极扰动是稳定的。
classification.one_liner: 研究修改的black bounce致密天体的热力学、Hawking/有效温度、热容相变和量子引力修正熵，并检验标量扰动稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦经典/修改引力下的黑洞与虫洞热力学和辐射，不涉及AdS/CFT等全息方向；仅匹配经典引力/广义相对论支线，故为中等相关。

2609.01261v1.title: Spin alignment of vector mesons in a plasma at finite density
2609.01261v1.abstract: We study the spectral functions and spin alignment of $J/\psi$ and $\phi$ mesons at finite density within a soft wall holographic model that provides the quark-gluon plasma background, with vector mesons represented by bulk vector fields. We derive the relation between the production rates in distinct spin channels and the corresponding in-medium spectral functions, and examine their dependence on the chemical potential, meson momentum, and temperature. We analyze the spin alignment induced by the motion of the vector meson relative to the thermal bath. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the $J/\psi$ spectral function exhibits a clear resonance peak, indicating that the $c\bar{c}$ pair can still form a quasistable bound state. As the chemical potential increases, this peak becomes lower and broader, signaling enhanced dissociation in the medium. For the $\phi$ meson at the same temperature, no pronounced peak is observed, indicating substantial melting; its spectral function thus better characterizes the distribution of unstable $s\bar{s}$ pairs in the thermal environment. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the helicity-frame spin alignment parameter $\rho_{00}$ shows a positive deviation from $1/3$ for the $J/\psi$ and a negative one for the $\phi$ meson. A finite chemical potential alters these deviations, reducing the magnitude for the $J/\psi$ while increasing it for the $\phi$ meson.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度等离子体中矢量介子的自旋排列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在软墙全息模型中研究了有限密度下 J/psi 和 phi 介子的谱函数与自旋排列。该模型提供了夸克-胶子等离子体背景，其中矢量介子由体矢量场表示。我们推导了不同自旋道产生率与介质中对应谱函数之间的关系，并考察了它们对化学势、介子动量和温度的依赖。我们分析了矢量介子相对于热浴运动所诱导的自旋排列。在 T = 0.15 GeV 时，J/psi 谱函数呈现清晰共振峰，表明 c-cbar 对仍可形成准稳定束缚态；随着化学势增大，该峰变低、变宽，标志着介质中解离增强。对于相同温度下的 phi 介子，没有观察到显著峰，表明其发生显著熔化；因此其谱函数更适合描述热环境中不稳定 s-sbar 对的分布。在 T = 0.15 GeV，螺旋度框架下的自旋排列参数 rho_00 对 J/psi 呈现相对于 1/3 的正偏差，对 phi 呈现负偏差。有限化学势会改变上述偏差：对 J/psi 减小其大小，对 phi 增大其大小。
classification.one_liner: 用软墙全息模型研究有限密度等离子体中 J/psi 与 phi 介子的谱函数和自旋排列，发现化学势会增强 J/psi 解离并显著改变 rho_00 的偏差。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理方向，聚焦有限密度下的矢量介子谱函数与自旋排列，未落入用户列出的具体子支线标签，但与该方向主题相通。

2606.26598v2.title: Holographic light-quark energy loss in a spinning plasma
2606.26598v2.abstract: In this work, we investigate light-quark energy loss in a strongly coupled plasma described by a spinning black-brane background obtained from the large-black-hole limit of the Myers--Perry geometry. The parameter $a$ characterizes the boost/rotation of the dual fluid in this holographic setup and is related to the angular velocity in the corresponding limit. We employ two complementary probes, the falling-string and shooting-string descriptions, to compute the stopping distance and the instantaneous energy loss of a light quark moving either transverse or parallel to the rotation axis. The results show that light quarks thermalize more readily in a hot environment. For parallel propagation, a counter-propagating configuration facilitates thermalization, whereas a co-propagating configuration suppresses it. For transverse propagation, increasing the magnitude of the rotational motion promotes thermalization. In addition, the instantaneous energy loss increases along the trajectory of the endpoint.

classification.title_zh: 旋转等离子体中的全息轻夸克能量损失
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由大黑洞极限下的Myers-Perry几何得到的旋转黑膜背景所描述的强耦合等离子体中的轻夸克能量损失。参数a表征该全息设置中双流体的推进/旋转，并与相应极限中的角速度相关。我们采用两种互补探针——下落弦和射击弦描述——来计算分别平行于旋转轴和垂直于旋转轴运动的轻夸克的停止距离与瞬时能量损失。结果表明，轻夸克在热环境中更容易热化。对于平行传播，逆流构型促进热化，而同向传播构型抑制热化。对于横向传播，增大旋转运动的幅度会促进热化。此外，瞬时能量损失沿着终点的轨迹增加。
classification.one_liner: 通过全息模型研究旋转等离子体对轻夸克能量损失的影响，发现平行旋转轴运动时逆流促进热化，横向运动时旋转增强热化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息QCD中的轻夸克能量损失，与用户重点标注的全息超导、非均匀凝聚、相变等方向不匹配，因此相关性较低。

2609.00172v1.title: A NICER view of PSR J1614$-$2230: a massive and compact millisecond pulsar
2609.00172v1.abstract: Using pulse profile modeling, we obtain the mass-radius measurement of a millisecond pulsar (MSP) with data from the Neutron Star Interior Composition ExploreR, XMM-Newton and the Chandra X-ray Observatory. We report here the radius of PSR J1614$-$2230, the second most massive MSP confirmed by radio timing. All of the data sets are well described by a simple model composed of two circular hot spots. The final result yields an equatorial radius of $R_{\rm eq}=10.06 ^{+1.25}_{-0.87}\,$km, and a gravitational mass of $M=1.937^{+0.012}_{-0.013}\,M_{\odot}$ (equally tailed 68% credible intervals). Although a non-thermal component was previously reported at higher energies, we find no sign of it in either our phase-averaged or phase-resolved spectral analyses. Using new relations linking the compactness to oblateness or surface gravity, and tailored to the spin frequency of PSR J1614$-$2230, we infer a configuration with one hot spot near the pole, and another near the equator. The tight mass posterior is essentially informed by radio timing, while the radius constraint is not as tight due to the low source signal (8.5$\sigma$ X-ray pulse significance). However, over all geometries and atmosphere models tested, the radius posterior tends toward low values ($\lesssim12.08\,$km, 90th percentile in all cases).

classification.title_zh: NICER 视角下的 PSR J1614−2230：一颗大质量且致密的毫秒脉冲星
classification.abstract_zh: 利用脉冲轮廓建模，我们使用中子星内部成分探测器（NICER）、XMM-Newton 和钱德拉 X 射线天文台的数据，获得了毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1614−2230 的质量-半径测量结果。所有数据集均可由两个圆形热斑组成的简单模型很好地描述。最终结果给出赤道半径 R_eq=10.06^{+1.25}_{-0.87} km，引力质量 M=1.937^{+0.012}_{-0.013} M⊙（68% 等尾可信区间）。尽管此前有报道称在更高能段存在非热成分，但我们在相位平均和相位分辨光谱分析中均未发现其迹象。利用将紧致度与扁率或表面引力联系起来并针对该源自转频率定制的新关系，我们推断出一个热斑靠近极区、另一个靠近赤道的构型。质量后验主要由射电计时约束，半径约束因 X 射线脉冲显著性较低（8.5σ）而不太紧；然而在所有测试的几何结构和大气模型中，半径后验均倾向于低值（第 90 百分位 ≤12.08 km）。
classification.one_liner: 通过对 NICER 等望远镜的脉冲轮廓建模，给出毫秒脉冲星 PSR J1614−2230 的质量和半径测量，其半径偏小，表明致密且质量大。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于中子星观测和经典引力下的质量-半径约束，与理论全息、AdS/CFT 或量子引力无关，仅与经典引力/广义相对论中的致密星体相关。

2511.02236v2.title: Magnetic-type Love number differentiating quark stars from neutron stars
2511.02236v2.abstract: The quark star (QS) is a hypothetical and yet undiscovered stellar object, and its existence would mark a paradigm shift in research on nuclear and quark matter. Although compactness is a well-known signature for distinguishing between two branches of QSs and neutron stars (NSs), some QSs can overlap with NSs in the radius-mass plane. To manifest their evident differences, we investigate the tidal properties of QSs and NSs. We then find that the magnetic-type Love number is a robust indicator for differentiating between QSs and NSs, whereas the electric-type one is insufficient when QSs and NSs have similar masses and radii. Finally, we show that gravitational waves from binary star mergers can, in principle, be sensitive to differences between QSs and NSs.

classification.title_zh: 磁型Love数区分夸克星与中子星
classification.abstract_zh: 夸克星（QS）是一种假设且尚未发现的恒星天体，其存在将标志着核物质和夸克物质研究的范式转变。尽管紧致度是区分两类QS与中子星（NS）的已知特征，但一些QS在半径-质量平面上可能与NS重叠。为揭示其明显差异，我们研究了QS和NS的潮汐性质。我们发现磁型Love数是区分QS和NS的稳健指标，而当QS和NS具有相似质量和半径时，电型Love数则不够充分。最后，我们表明来自双星并合的引力波原则上可以对QS与NS之间的差异敏感。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明磁型Love数能稳健区分夸克星与中子星，而电型Love数在质量和半径相似时不足以区分，且引力波原则上可探测其差异。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究属于经典引力/广义相对论中致密天体潮汐变形与引力波相关主题，且用户明确关注经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2609.01227v1.title: Terrestrial Gravitational Wave Detection with Atom Interferometers
2609.01227v1.abstract: Atom interferometers (AIFs) are highly precise inertial sensors and are considered promising instruments for the detection of gravitational waves (GWs) and certain dark matter (DM) candidates in the mid-frequency band. While GW detection with AIFs was initially proposed for space-based experiments with baselines spanning thousands of kilometers, recent developments suggest that terrestrial setups with baselines of at least 100 meters may also be capable of detecting GWs. In this work, we analytically derive the GW phase response formula of a ground detector, find an additional term compared to the existing literature and check it our findings numerically. Based on this treatment, we analyze the optimal geometric parameters for earth-bound AIF experiments. Subsequently, we numerically simulate GW detection schemes for these optimized interferometers using an open-source Python algorithm. Numerical simulations of these schemes have are not available to the community, yet crucial for the accurate modeling of noise and non-trivial gravitational backgrounds.

classification.title_zh: 基于原子干涉仪的地面引力波探测
classification.abstract_zh: 原子干涉仪（AIFs）是高精度惯性传感器，被认为是在中频段探测引力波（GW）和某些暗物质（DM）候选者的有前景仪器。虽然最初提出的基于AIF的引力波探测是空间任务，基线跨度达数千公里，但近期发展表明，基线至少100米的地面装置也可能探测到引力波。在这项工作中，我们解析地推导了地面探测器的引力波相位响应公式，发现其中比现有文献多出一项，并通过数值计算验证了我们的结果。基于这一处理方法，我们分析了地球约束AIF实验的最优几何参数。随后，我们使用一个开源Python算法对这些优化后的干涉仪的引力波探测方案进行了数值模拟。这些方案的数值模拟此前尚未公开，而对于精确模拟噪声和非平凡的引力背景至关重要。
classification.one_liner: 解析推导地面原子干涉仪引力波相位响应公式，发现新项，并优化几何参数及数值模拟。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文聚焦于经典引力波探测技术，与全息对偶或量子引力等理论无关，仅与广义相对论的实验检验间接相关。

2511.19597v2.title: Holographic duality between bulk topological order and boundary mixed-state order
2511.19597v2.abstract: We introduce a holographic framework for analyzing the steady states of repeated quantum channels with strong symmetries. Using channel-state duality, we show that the steady state of a $d$-dimensional quantum channel is holographically mapped to the boundary reduced density matrix of a $(d+1)$-dimensional wavefunction generated by a sequential unitary circuit. From this perspective, strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the steady state arises from the anyon condensation on the boundary of a topological order in one higher dimension. The conditional mutual information (CMI) associated with SWSSB is then inherited from the bulk topological entanglement entropy. We make this duality explicit using isometric tensor network states (isoTNS) by identifying the channel's time evolution with the transfer matrix of a higher-dimensional isoTNS. Built on isoTNS, we further construct continuously tunable quantum channels that exhibit distinct mixed-state phases and transitions in the steady states.

classification.title_zh: 体拓扑序与边界混合态序之间的全息对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 引入一个全息框架来分析具有强对称性的重复量子信道的稳态。利用信道-态对偶，证明 d 维量子信道的稳态被全息映射到一个由顺序幺正电路生成的 (d+1) 维波函数的边界约化密度矩阵。从这一视角，稳态中的强到弱自发对称破缺（SWSSB）源于高一个维度的拓扑序边界上的任意子凝聚，与 SWSSB 关联的条件互信息则继承自体拓扑纠缠熵。通过等距张量网络态（isoTNS）将信道的时间演化与高维 isoTNS 的转移矩阵等同，使该对偶具体化，并进一步构造了连续可调的量子信道，展示稳态中不同的混合态相和相变。
classification.one_liner: 通过量子信道稳态与高维体拓扑序边界态的对应，揭示 SWSSB 源于任意子凝聚，并利用等距张量网络构造了可调混合态相变模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究量子信道与拓扑序的体-边界全息对偶，属于量子信息/张量网络全息，而非传统 AdS/CFT 引力全息或用户关注的全息超导、经典引力等方向，与重点标签无交集。

2604.02405v3.title: Site selection for the Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA)
2604.02405v3.abstract: The Earth's Moon presents a uniquely advantageous environment for detecting astrophysical gravitational waves (GWs), particularly in the decihertz regime. The Laser Interferometer Lunar Antenna (LILA) project plans to perform GW measurements on the lunar surface, using the Moon's seismic quietness to access this band. Two mission concepts are considered: the proof-of-concept 1 km initial LILA (iLILA) and the full LILA Observatory, whose equilateral arms are at least 40 km long. The Moon's changing orientation and orbital motion provide the time-dependent source modulation needed for sky localization, so the detector response does not impose a unique lunar region. Practical considerations, most critically line of sight (LOS), nevertheless constrain deployment. A coarse-to-fine search of existing lunar datasets identifies and ranks candidate grid locations. Of 4,050 global grid seeds, 434 iLILA seeds and 71 Observatory circumcenters pass both search stages. These results demonstrate that sites suitable for GW detection naturally exist in large numbers on the lunar surface.

classification.title_zh: 月球激光干涉仪天线（LILA）选址研究
classification.abstract_zh: 地球的月球为探测天体物理引力波，特别是分赫兹频段的引力波，提供了独特而有利的环境。激光干涉仪月球天线（LILA）项目计划利用月球的低地震噪声在月球表面进行引力波测量。研究考虑两种任务概念：1公里长度的概念验证型初始LILA（iLILA）和臂长至少40公里的完整LILA天文台。月球的朝向变化与轨道运动提供了源定位所需的时间相关调制，因此探测器响应并不限定唯一月面区域。然而，实际因素（尤其是视线条件）限制了部署位置。通过从粗到细的现有月球数据集搜索，识别并排序了候选网格位置。在4050个全球网格种子中，有434个iLILA种子和71个天文台外心通过了两阶段搜索。结果表明，适合引力波探测的月面地点自然大量存在。
classification.one_liner: 评估月球引力波探测器LILA的候选选址，发现月球表面存在大量适合探测的地点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波探测实验选址研究，与理论全息或量子引力无关，仅与经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波方向有间接关联。

2609.00173v1.title: Equation of state and neutron star properties with new mass-radius constraints from PSR~J1614--2230, PSR~J2124--3358, and 47~Tuc~X7
2609.00173v1.abstract: We study the impact of new mass-radius information from PSR J1614-2230, PSR J2124-3358, and 47 Tuc X7 in a combined equation of state inference based on chiral effective field theory constraints at nuclear densities and using different high-density extensions, including perturbative QCD constraints. The largest impact stems from the heavy-mass PSR J1614-2230 star, which shifts heavy neutron stars to smaller radii by around 0.4 km. Moreover, the combined astrophysical NICER, LIGO/Virgo, and X-ray information drives the radius posterior to a more data-driven distribution, which is less sensitive to the high-density extension. For the equation of state, the new mass-radius information significantly tightens the pressure and speed-of-sound posterior distributions, especially around three times saturation density. Finally, we make predictions for the poorly constrained masses of PSR J2124-3358 and 47 Tuc X7 based on the combined equation of state analysis and the other astrophysical sources.

classification.title_zh: 状态方程与中子星性质：来自PSR J1614-2230、PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的新质量-半径约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了来自PSR J1614-2230、PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的新质量-半径信息对联合状态方程推断的影响，该推断基于核密度下的手征有效场论约束，并采用不同的高密度扩展，包括微扰QCD约束。最大的影响来自重质量PSR J1614-2230星，它使重中子星的半径减小约0.4公里。此外，结合NICER、LIGO/Virgo和X射线的天体物理信息，使半径后验分布更趋于数据驱动，并对高密度扩展的敏感性降低。对于状态方程而言，新的质量-半径信息显著收紧了压强和声速的后验分布，尤其是在约三倍饱和密度处。最后，我们基于联合状态方程分析和其它天体物理源，对约束较差的PSR J2124-3358和47 Tuc X7的质量进行了预测。
classification.one_liner: 利用来自脉冲星的新质量-半径观测与核物理约束，得到更紧致的中子星状态方程推论。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文主要研究中子星物态方程与质量-半径关系，属于经典引力背景下致密天体物理应用，而非广义相对论基本理论或全息研究；与重点标签中的经典引力有一定交集。

2609.01706v1.title: Holographic algebras at null infinity
2609.01706v1.abstract: We construct an algebra of observables associated to a cut of null infinity in asymptotically flat spacetimes. The Bondi mass associated with a sharp cut of future null infinity is not a well-defined quantum operator: its fluctuations diverge even after smearing in retarded time. We instead introduce a finite-radius, time-smeared version of the Bondi mass and adjoin this operator to the matter and graviton observables in an arbitrarily small asymptotic neighborhood of the cut. We separately analyze spacetimes with and without black holes and find, in both cases, Type III$_1$ von Neumann algebras that satisfy non-trivial nesting relations. In Minkowski spacetime, the resulting algebra reconstructs the spacelike wedge associated with the cut. In a stationary black hole spacetime, it reconstructs the region bounded by the cut and the black hole bifurcation surface, providing an asymptotically flat analogue of an entanglement wedge. In the limit as the cut is moved to past infinity, we recover a Type I$_{\infty}$ algebra for spacetimes without black holes and a Type II$_{\infty}$ algebra for black hole spacetimes. For algebras at finite cuts of retarded time, we construct a Type II$_\infty$ regularization of the black hole algebra whose renormalized von Neumann entropy agrees with the generalized entropy. In appendices, we prove two technical results about quantum fields, in a Schwarzschild spacetime, that asymptote to the Minkowski vacuum at infinity: a split property for unbounded, spacelike separated regions and the construction of a faithful, normal, and semifinite Hartle-Hawking weight whose modular flow is Schwarzschild time evolution.

classification.title_zh: 零无穷处的全息代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在渐近平坦时空中构造了与未来零无穷的一个截面对应的可观测代数。与未来零无穷的锐截止相关的 Bondi 质量并不是良好定义的量子算符：即使在推迟时间上抹平后其涨落也发散。我们改为引入有限半径、时间抹平的 Bondi 质量版本，并将该算符附加到该截面任意小的渐近邻域内的物质与引力子可观测量。我们分别分析了有黑洞和无黑洞的时空，发现在两种情况下都得到满足非平凡嵌套关系的 III₁ 型冯·诺依曼代数。在 Minkowski 时空中，所得代数重构了与截面对应的类空楔；在稳态黑洞时空中，它重构了由截面和黑洞分叉面界定的区域，给出渐近平坦的纠缠楔类比。当截面移到过去无穷时，对无黑洞时空我们恢复 I∞ 型代数，对黑洞时空恢复 II∞ 型代数。对于推迟时间有限截面上的代数，我们构造了黑洞代数的 II∞ 型正规化，其重整化冯·诺依曼熵与广义熵一致。在附录中，我们证明了 Schwarzschild 时空中在无穷远处趋于 Minkowski 真空的量子场的两个技术结果：对无界、类空分离区域的分裂性质，以及构造一个忠实、正规、半有限 Hartle-Hawking 权，其模流为 Schwarzschild 时间演化。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近平坦时空零无穷处构造可观测代数，给出黑洞时空中的纠缠楔类比重构并正则化熵与广义熵一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于平直时空/零无穷全息与代数量子场论，不涉及用户重点关注的超流超导、畴壁、多迹、气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜或经典引力支线，因此相关度低。

2609.01714v1.title: On-shell recursion and soft theorems for worldline quantum field theory
2609.01714v1.abstract: We derive a set of on-shell recursion relations for amplitudes in worldline quantum field theory (WQFT), an effective theory of gravity coupled to a massive worldline which is relevant for computing classical gravitational observables. We overcome the poor large-$z$ falloff of amplitudes under an all-line complex momentum deformation by deriving and exploiting a new soft-graviton theorem in the presence of a worldline. This theorem generalizes the leading (Weinberg) and subleading soft theorems with additional contributions due to soft emission from the worldline. Our main result is a $d$-dimensional recursion formula, expressing any $n$-graviton rational amplitude in terms of lower-point amplitudes from WQFT and pure gravity. Using the soft-worldline theorem, we can obtain amplitudes with any number of external worldline fluctuations from the corresponding all-graviton amplitudes, making the recursion sufficient to construct any rational amplitude of the theory. We verify our results by explicitly computing two-graviton and three-graviton amplitudes.

classification.title_zh: 世界线量子场论中的在壳递推与软定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在世界线量子场论（WQFT）中推导了一组振幅在壳递推关系。WQFT是引力与一个大质量世界线耦合的有效理论，用于计算经典引力观测量。我们通过推导并利用存在世界线时的新型软引力子定理，克服了在全动量复形变下振幅在大z区域衰减不佳的问题。该定理推广了领头阶（Weinberg）与次领头阶软定理，并包含世界线软发射带来的额外贡献。我们的主要结果是一个d维递推公式，将任意n-引力子有理振幅用WQFT和纯引力中的低点振幅表示。利用软世界线定理，我们可以从相应的全引力子振幅得到含任意数量外部世界线涨落的振幅，从而该递推足以构造理论中的任意有理振幅。我们通过显式计算双引力子与三引力子振幅验证了结果。
classification.one_liner: 在世界线量子场论中建立基于新型soft引力子定理的在壳递推，用于经典引力观测量计算。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于经典引力观测量计算中的世界线量子场论振幅方法，与重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’高度相关。

2609.01732v1.title: Truncated Polyakov bootstrap
2609.01732v1.abstract: We set up a truncated numerical approach in the Polyakov bootstrap (PB) framework. We employ a gradient descent optimization to solve PB sum rules numerically, and hence solve crossing for arbitrary deformations of the generalized free field (GFF) spectrum in an iterative way starting from a perturbative solution. For unitary deformations the solutions coincide with extremal CFT spectra. But more interestingly, our findings indicate that a general crossing solution, not necessarily unitary (i.e. without positivity), can be uniquely identified by a smooth connection to GFF. The truncated Polyakov bootstrap approach is established through a number of examples in both single and mixed correlator settings.

classification.title_zh: 截断 Polyakov 自举
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 Polyakov 自举（PB）框架中建立了一种截断数值方法。我们采用梯度下降优化来数值求解 PB 求和规则，从而从微扰解开始迭代地求解广义自由场（GFF）谱的任意形变所满足的 crossing 方程。对于幺正形变，解与极值 CFT 谱一致。更有趣的是，我们的结果表明，一般 crossing 解——即使不一定是幺正的（即没有正性条件）——也可以通过其与 GFF 的光滑连接被唯一确定。我们通过单关联器和混合关联器的多个例子确立了截断 Polyakov 自举方法。
classification.one_liner: 提出截断 Polyakov 自举的数值优化方法，并展示一般 crossing 解可由与广义自由场谱的光滑连接唯一确定。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要聚焦于 Polyakov 自举的截断数值方案以及 GFF 谱在 crossing 下的形变；摘要未明确讨论 AdS/CFT 对偶，但该方法与全息 CFT 的谱构造密切相关，故归入 AdS/CFT 基础但置信度较低。

2609.01986v1.title: Pre-Strings Lectures on Holographic Correlators and Analytic Bootstrap
2609.01986v1.abstract: Over the past decade, the bootstrap strategy has transformed the computation of holographic correlators and revealed structures suggesting an emerging scattering amplitude program in AdS. These notes, which are an extended version of the five lectures delivered at the Pre-Strings 2026 School, give a pedagogical introduction and synthesis of these developments. We start with a quick reminder of the essentials of CFT and a brief review of AdS perturbation theory. We then demonstrate in detail the bootstrap strategy for computing holographic correlators in the canonical example 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, at the level of four-point functions and in the regime dual to classical Type IIB supergravity. Several extensions, including higher-point functions, quantum corrections and stringy corrections, are discussed at varying levels of detail. We also explain how the bootstrap strategy can be extended to holographic CFTs with conformal defects, covering a diverse array of different setups.

classification.title_zh: 弦论预科讲座：全息关联函数与解析Bootstrap
classification.abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，bootstrap 策略改变了全息关联函数的计算，并揭示了 AdS 中涌现散射振幅程序的结构。这些笔记是 2026 年 Pre-Strings 学校五次讲座的扩展版，对这些进展进行了教学性介绍和综合。我们首先快速回顾 CFT 的基本概念并简要综述 AdS 微扰论。然后详细展示在典范例子四维 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 理论中计算全息关联函数的 bootstrap 策略，讨论四点函数及对应于经典 IIB 型超引力的区域。还讨论了包括多点函数、量子修正和弦修正等若干延伸，并说明如何将 bootstrap 策略扩展到具有共形缺陷的全息 CFT，涵盖多种不同设置。
classification.one_liner: 教学性综述，系统介绍利用解析 bootstrap 计算 AdS/CFT 全息关联函数的方法及其多种拓展。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础方法与计算技术，不直接涉及用户重点标签如全息超流、相变、QNM、探针膜等，因此与用户当前研究支线的直接相关度较低。

2609.02521v1.title: Universal fingerprint of topological defect cores
2609.02521v1.abstract: Topological defects are ubiquitous in physics, arising from condensed matter physics to the early universe. Although there exist many universal scaling laws for correlations between topological defects, such as Porod scaling, the fingerprint of topological defect cores has remained largely unexplored. Here, we discover a universal scaling law in the region $k>1/\xi$, where $\xi$ is the healing length of the topological defects, taking the scaling of the form factor $S_f \propto k^{-(d+p+2)}$, where $d$ is the spatial dimension and $p$ is the defect codimension. We analytically prove that this exponent originates from a universal V-shaped cusp at the defect core and is independent of the underlying system and dynamics. Numerical simulations verify this scaling law in four typical frameworks: the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau and Gross-Pitaevskii equations in the weak-coupling regime, the gauge/gravity duality model in the strong-coupling regime, and the Klein-Gordon equation in the Friedmann-Robertson-Walker background in cosmology. Our work provides a new probe for studying topological defects in systems ranging from superconductors to cosmological phase transitions.

classification.primary_topic: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
secondary_topics: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 拓扑缺陷核的普适指纹
classification.abstract_zh: 拓扑缺陷在物理学中普遍存在，从凝聚态物理到早期宇宙。虽然已有许多关于拓扑缺陷之间关联的普适标度律，例如Porod标度，但拓扑缺陷核的指纹仍未被充分探索。本文在k>1/ξ区域发现了一个普适标度律，其中ξ是拓扑缺陷的愈合长度，结构因子满足S_f ∝ k^{-(d+p+2)}，其中d是空间维数，p是缺陷余维数。我们解析证明该指数源于缺陷核处的普适V形尖点，并且与底层系统和动力学无关。数值模拟在四个典型框架中验证了这一标度律：弱耦合区域的含时Ginzburg-Landau和Gross-Pitaevskii方程，强耦合区域的规范/引力对偶模型，以及宇宙学Friedmann-Robertson-Walker背景下的Klein-Gordon方程。该工作为研究从超导体到宇宙学相变等系统中的拓扑缺陷提供了新的探针。
classification.one_liner: 研究发现拓扑缺陷核存在普适的结构因子标度律，其指数由缺陷核的V形尖点决定，并通过超导、BEC、全息和宇宙学模型得到验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文围绕拓扑缺陷核的普适标度展开，直接涉及畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀结构，并通过规范/引力对偶模型在强耦合区域进行验证，与全息超流超导及非均匀态研究高度相关。

2609.02814v1.title: Scale-separated AdS$_2$ flux vacua from type II
2609.02814v1.abstract: Motivated by the question of whether the internal scales of a compactification can be parametrically decoupled from the external curvature scale, and by the possibility of probing such vacua holographically, we construct the first AdS$_2$ flux vacua with parametric scale separation. We compactify type II string theory on a $G_2$ structure orbifold times a circle in the presence of smeared spacetime-filling O1/O5-planes or O4/O8-planes, together with NSNS and RR fluxes. We derive the two-dimensional dilaton-gravity effective theory and exhibit families of vacua in which unbounded $F_5$ and $H_7$ fluxes provide parametric control in type IIB, while unbounded $F_4$, $F_8$, and $H_7$ fluxes provide parametric control in type IIA. For large flux quanta, the string coupling becomes parametrically weak, all internal bulk radii become parametrically large in string units, and the Kaluza--Klein scale separates from the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ curvature scale. We analyze the ten-dimensional Killing-spinor equations and identify parametric branches preserving $\mathcal N=(1,1)$ supersymmetry in two dimensions. We explain how our geometrically scale-separated AdS$_2$ vacua are compatible with a recent no-go theorem for scale separation in theories with extended supersymmetry. Finally, we discuss various T-dualities leading to other type IIB and type IIA compactifications on $G_2$ structure spaces times a circle and $SU(3)$ structure spaces times a two-torus.

classification.title_zh: II 型弦论中具有尺度分离的 AdS$_2$ 通量真空
classification.abstract_zh: 在紧致化内禀尺度是否能与外部曲率尺度参数性退耦这一问题的启发下，并考虑到用全息方式探测此类真空的可能性，我们构造了第一族具有参数性尺度分离的 AdS$_2$ 通量真空。我们将 II 型弦论紧致化在 $G_2$ 结构轨道流形乘以一个圆上，并引入涂抹的时空填充 O1/O5 平面或 O4/O8 平面以及 NSNS 和 RR 通量。我们导出了二维 dilaton-引力有效理论，并展示了几族真空：在 IIB 中，无界的 $F_5$ 和 $H_7$ 通量提供参数控制；在 IIA 中，无界的 $F_4$、$F_8$ 和 $H_7$ 通量提供参数控制。对于大的通量量子数，弦耦合参数性地变弱，所有内部体半径在弦单位下参数性地变大，且 Kaluza–Klein 尺度与 AdS$_2$ 曲率尺度分离。我们分析了十维 Killing-旋量方程，并识别出在二维保持 $\mathcal N=(1,1)$ 超对称的参数性分支。我们解释了这些几何尺度分离的 AdS$_2$ 真空如何与近期关于扩展超对称理论中尺度分离的 no-go 定理相容。最后，我们讨论了若干 T-对偶，得到其他在 $G_2$ 结构空间乘以圆以及 $SU(3)$ 结构空间乘以二环上的 IIB 和 IIA 紧致化。
classification.one_liner: 通过 II 型弦论 $G_2$ 结构轨道流形与 NSNS/RR 通量及定向平面组合，首次构造成族参数性尺度分离、保持二维 $\mathcal N=(1,1)$ 超对称的 AdS$_2$ 通量真空，并验证其与 no-go 定理相容及讨论相关 T-对偶。
classification.relevance_reason: 用户重点方向集中于全息超流/超导、涡旋孤子、QNM/输运、经典引力等；本文关注的是弦论紧致化与 AdS2 尺度分离真空构造，除泛泛的全息背景外，与这些具体研究方向无直接交集。

2609.02816v1.title: Zero-damped modes of near-extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"{o}m black holes from exact WKB
2609.02816v1.abstract: The late-time ringdown dynamics of near-extremal black holes (BHs) are expected to be dominated by zero-damped modes (ZDMs), whose decay rates are parametrically suppressed relative to those of ordinary quasinormal modes. In this paper, we demonstrate that exact WKB methods provide an exceptionally powerful framework for analyzing the ZDM spectrum of near-extremal Reissner--Nordstr\"{o}m (RN) BHs. Focusing on massless, neutral scalar modes propagating on an RN background, we present the full Stokes geometry derived from the radial eigenvalue problem and establish the corresponding exact quantization condition (EQC). Our analytic computation of the Voros symbols entering the EQC achieves higher-order accuracy for the ZDM spectrum compared to previous studies and is systematically improvable. Ergo, this work serves as a proof of concept for investigations of ZDM spectra of other systems using exact WKB methods.

classification.title_zh: 近极端Reissner-Nordström黑洞的零阻尼模式：精确WKB方法
classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞的晚期振铃动力学预计由零阻尼模（ZDM）主导，其衰减率相对于普通准正规模呈参数化压低。在本文中，我们证明精确WKB方法为分析近极端Reissner-Nordström（RN）黑洞的ZDM谱提供了一个极其强大的框架。聚焦于RN背景上传播的无质量中性标量模，我们给出了从径向本征值问题导出的完整Stokes几何，并建立了相应的精确量子化条件（EQC）。我们对进入EQC的Voros符号的解析计算实现了比以往研究更高阶精度的ZDM谱，并且可以系统地改进。因此，这项工作为使用精确WKB方法研究其他系统的ZDM谱提供了概念验证。
classification.one_liner: 使用精确WKB方法研究近极端RN黑洞的零阻尼模，并给出高阶精度的量化条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞QNM研究，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度一致。

2609.01644v1.title: A Unified Treatment of the Self-Force Problem
2609.01644v1.abstract: This paper introduces formalism, based on worldline effective field theory, which allows one to systematically calculate the gravitational self-force on a compact object immersed in an environment with non-vanishing stress energy. Using the closed time path integral we present a universal effective action that can be used to calculate the equations of motion of a compact object due to its interaction with the environment to any order in the relevant expansion parameters, the relative importance of which depends upon the choice of environment. We show that the leading order equations of motion can be universally written in terms of the retarded two-point function of the stress-energy tensor for the environment. The resulting action can be used to calculate both dissipative (dynamical friction) and conservative forces in a completely relativistic fashion. We demonstrate the utility of the result by calculating the dissipative force due to dust, an inviscid fluid, and a coherent field. Our results agree with those previously derived in the literature. We furthermore show that the famous ``Coulomb Log" found by Chandrasekhar should be interpreted as a renormalization group log due to a UV divergence that renormalizes the dissipative part of the in-in action. We then prove that this log is universal in the Newtonian limit in that its value is universal, for a generic class of environments and trajectories. This log is the leading log in an RG flow in the dissipative action that has yet to be explored.

classification.title_zh: 自力问题的一个统一处理
classification.abstract_zh: 本文引入基于世界线有效场论的形式体系，使得能够系统计算沉浸于具有非零应力能量环境中的致密天体所受的引力自力。利用闭合时间路径积分，我们给出了一个普适有效作用量，可用于计算致密天体因与环境相互作用而产生的运动方程，阶数可至相关展开参数的任何阶；这些参数的相对重要性取决于环境的选择。我们证明，领头阶运动方程可以普适地写为环境应力能量张量推迟两点函数的形式。所得作用量可用于在全相对论方式下计算耗散力（动力学摩擦）和保守力。我们通过计算尘埃、无粘流体和相干场中的耗散力展示了该结果的实用性，结果与文献中先前推导一致。我们还表明，Chandrasekhar 发现的著名“库仑对数”应解释为由紫外发散重整化 in-in 作用量耗散部分而导致的重整化群对数。我们进而证明，在牛顿极限下该对数具有普适性，即其值对一类通用的环境和轨迹是普适的。该对数是在耗散作用量中尚未被探索的重整化群流内的首阶对数。
classification.one_liner: 基于世界线有效场论和闭合时间路径积分给出计算致密天体在环境中引力自力的统一形式体系，并阐明 Chandrasekhar 库仑对数为重整化群对数。

2609.01646v1.title: Parameter Space, Realistic Matter, and Universal Relations in Bose--Einstein Condensate Dark Stars
2609.01646v1.abstract: We study slowly rotating Bose--Einstein condensate (BEC) dark stars by solving the Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff, Hartle dipole, and Postnikov--Hinderer equations together for a polytropic equation of state with a Lee--Huang--Yang correction of strength $\zeta$~\citep{Panotopoulos2026}. A continuous scan of $\zeta$ from 0 to 1.5 shows the mean-field-to-corrected transition is smooth, with no hidden structure at intermediate values. Scanning the underlying boson parameters $(m,a_s)$ more broadly, we find that a $2\,M_\odot$ maximum-mass bound and a GW170817-like tidal bound $\Lambda_{1.4}\lesssim800$ cannot be satisfied simultaneously anywhere in this equation-of-state class. The $I$-Love universal relation holds to $0.13\%$ across twelve $(m,a_s,\zeta)$ models, and the $\zeta=0$ and $\zeta=1$ sequences sit on opposite sides of the master curve by a consistent, non-random offset. Applied without modification to realistic nuclear matter (SLy, APR4), the same solver reproduces published maximum masses to within $1\%$; applied to self-bound MIT-bag quark matter it gives the expected mass--radius shape; and once extended to a two-fluid baryon-plus-dark-matter formalism, it shows that the maximum mass of a hybrid star is not a monotonic function of the central dark-matter fraction. Pooling $I$-Love sequences across nuclear, hybrid, and BEC dark-star models, we find they collapse onto a single curve to within about $5\%$, while self-bound quark stars sit far off it, departing by up to $90\%$.

classification.title_zh: Bose--Einstein凝聚暗星中的参数空间、真实物质与普适关系
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过联合求解 Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff、Hartle 偶极和 Postnikov--Hinderer 方程，研究了慢旋转的 Bose--Einstein 凝聚（BEC）暗星，采用带 Lee--Huang--Yang 修正强度 ζ 的多方物态方程。对 ζ 从 0 到 1.5 的连续扫描表明平均场到修正的过渡是平滑的，中间值没有隐藏结构。更广泛地扫描底层玻色子参数 (m, a_s)，我们发现 2 M⊙ 最大质量界限和 GW170817 类似的潮汐界限 Λ1.4 ≲ 800 不能在此物态方程类中任何位置同时满足。I--Love 普适关系在十二个 (m, a_s, ζ) 模型上成立至 0.13%，且 ζ=0 和 ζ=1 序列在主曲线两侧以一致的非随机偏移分布。未经修改应用于现实核物质（SLy、APR4）时，同一求解器重现已发表最大质量至 1% 以内；应用于自束缚 MIT-bag 夸克物质时给出预期的质量--半径形状；一旦扩展到重子加暗物质双流体形式，显示混合星的最大质量不是中心暗物质分数的单调函数。汇总核物质、混合和 BEC 暗星模型的 I--Love 序列，发现它们以约 5% 以内坍缩到单条曲线，而自束缚夸克星远离该曲线，偏差高达 90%。
classification.one_liner: 研究BEC暗星的参数空间与普适关系，发现I--Love关系在多种物质模型下成立但夸克星例外。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要涉及经典引力框架下暗物质致密星的结构与普适关系，不涉及全息或量子引力，但属于经典引力/广义相对论研究支线。

2609.01704v1.title: Geodesics and thermodynamics of a $\kappa$-deformed anti-de Sitter black hole surrounded by a quintessence field
2609.01704v1.abstract: We investigate the geodesic structure and thermodynamics of a $\kappa$-deformed Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter black hole in a Kiselev quintessence field, where dynamics are governed by a mass-dependent lapse deformation. This term produces an inner Cauchy horizon without requiring charge or spin, yet it fails to resolve the central singularity; instead, the Kretschmann scalar diverges more strongly as $r^{-10}$. Because the deformation amplitude couples to the mass, the standard Bekenstein-Hawking area law violates the first law of thermodynamics. We resolve this by either deriving a modified entropy or rescaling the mass, both of which restore the first law and yield a consistent Smarr relation. Optically, an increasing deformation parameter shrinks both the photon sphere and the critical impact parameter. We also derive a closed-form Joule-Thomson coefficient, revealing that the $\kappa$-deformation triggers an inversion curve a feature absent in standard neutral SAdS. Notably, this occurs without generating a van der Waals critical point, demonstrating that Joule-Thomson inversion and van der Waals criticality can be cleanly decoupled. Finally, the deformation suppresses peak Hawking emission by a factor of roughly four and increases flux sparsity, an effect driven almost entirely by a drop in temperature rather than changes to the black hole shadow.

classification.title_zh: 环绕quintessence场的κ-变形anti-de Sitter黑洞的测地线与热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了Kiselev quintessence场中κ-变形Schwarzschild-anti-de Sitter黑洞的测地线结构和热力学，其中动力学由依赖于质量的lapse变形控制。这一项产生了内部Cauchy视界而无需电荷或自旋，但未能解决中心奇点；相反，Kretschmann标量以r^{-10}更强地发散。由于变形振幅与质量耦合，标准的Bekenstein-Hawking面积定律违反热力学第一定律。我们通过推导修正熵或重新标度质量解决这一问题，两者都恢复第一定律并给出一致的Smarr关系。在光学上，增大的变形参数同时缩小光子球和临界碰撞参数。我们还推导了闭式Joule-Thomson系数，揭示κ-变形引发反转曲线——这一特征在标准中性SAdS中不存在。值得注意的是，这发生在没有产生van der Waals临界点的情况下，表明Joule-Thomson反转和van der Waals临界性可以完全解耦。最后，该变形将峰值Hawking辐射抑制了约四倍并增加了通量稀疏性，这一效应几乎完全由温度下降而非黑洞阴影变化驱动。
classification.one_liner: 研究κ-变形AdS黑洞的测地线与热力学，发现变形产生内视界、修正熵并引发Joule-Thomson反转曲线而无van der Waals临界点。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦于κ-变形AdS黑洞在quintessence场中的经典测地线和热力学性质，属于经典引力/广义相对论范畴，与用户关注重点完全契合。

2609.01713v1.title: One-cycle radiation-reaction Magnusian for eccentric binaries through relative 1PN order
2609.01713v1.abstract: We derive the one-cycle first Magnusian for nonspinning compact binaries on planar, bound eccentric orbits through relative first post-Newtonian (1PN) order and linear order in radiation reaction, and construct the associated first-order periastron return map. Combining the conservative 1PN dynamics and its Jacobi transport with the 2.5PN and 3.5PN radiation-reaction forces, we obtain all four components in closed form for \(0<e<1\), without expanding in eccentricity. The dependence on all eight Iyer--Will radiation-reaction gauge parameters reduces to periodic coboundaries and therefore cancels over a radial cycle. The result reproduces the averaged energy and angular-momentum losses, their circular limit, and the secular evolution of the 1PN radial orbital elements. The two remaining components encode the dissipative angle-sector information. Projecting the resulting phase-space update onto the perturbed periastron return section yields the corrections to the return time and apsidal phase. We then compare the strict first-order map with a partially exponentiated map built from the same Magnusian. The comparison is observable dependent: at fixed periastron index, the strict map gives smaller residuals for a representative evolution over 40 radial cycles, whereas partial exponentiation reduces the accumulated periastron-timing residual by about an order of magnitude. Across a representative one-cycle grid at equal masses, partial exponentiation improves the radial-action and energy updates at every sampled point.

classification.title_zh: 偏心双星在相对一阶后牛顿阶的单周期辐射反作用Magnusian
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了无自旋致密双星在平面、束缚偏心轨道上、相对一阶后牛顿（1PN）阶且辐射反作用为线性阶的第一单周期Magnusian，并构造了相应的第一阶近星点回归映射。将守恒1PN动力学及其Jacobi输运与2.5PN和3.5PN辐射反作用力相结合，我们在0<e<1范围内以闭合形式得到全部四个分量，且未对偏心率展开。对所有八个Iyer–Will辐射反作用规范参数的依赖退化到周期余边界，因而在一个径向周期内抵消。该结果重现了能量和角动量损失的平均值、它们的圆极限以及1PN径向轨道要素的长期演化。其余两个分量编码了耗散的角度扇区信息。将所得相空间更新投影到受扰动的近星点回归截面上，可得到回归时间和近星点相位的修正。我们接着将严格一阶映射与由同一Magnusian构建的部分指数化映射进行比较。比较结果依赖具体观测量：在固定近星点指标下，严格映射在代表性的40个径向周期演化中给出更小的残差，而部分指数化可使累积的近星点定时残差减少约一个数量级。在等质量情形下具有代表性的单周期网格上，部分指数化在每一个采样点上改进了径向作用和能量更新。
classification.one_liner: 推导了偏心致密双星在相对1PN阶的单周期辐射反作用Magnusian与近星点回归映射，并比较了严格与部分指数化映射的残差。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文完全属于经典引力/广义相对论中的后牛顿双星动力学与辐射反作用研究，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”一致；但不涉及全息或量子引力。

2609.01720v1.title: How Much Geometry Does Horizon Entropy Determine? A Discourse on Entropy, Gravity, and Observable Quantities
2609.01720v1.abstract: Building on Jacobson's thermodynamics derivation of Einstein field equations, the "generalized entropy and varying-G" (GEVAG) framework was proposed to consistently incorporate generalized horizon entropy $S=f(A)/4G$ into both the thermodynamics and the geometry of spacetime. This leads to an effective gravitational coupling $G_\text{eff}=G/f'(A)$. A related "entropy-gravity correspondence" (EGC) instead is equivalent to promoting this horizon relation to a radially varying bulk coupling $G_\text{eff}(r)$. We clarify the similarities and fundamental distinctions between these approaches. Although they share the same horizon consistency relation, their global causal structures and asymptotic geometries can differ substantially. In addition, the radial prescription of EGC introduces an additional ambiguity for multi-center configurations. We further examine a near-horizon extension of GEVAG, which restores the equivalence between thermodynamic and ADM masses that is absent in the horizon-only formulation. We then discuss the implications of these different prescriptions for the Bekenstein bound. The Bekenstein bound provides a surprising link between $G_\text{eff}$ in near horizon GEVAG, EGC, and the one obtained in the recent $f(R)$-reconstruction approach of generalized entropy geometry via Wald entropy. Finally, we raise the most important question: what exactly is the $G$ measured in laboratories?

classification.title_zh: 视界熵决定多少几何？——熵、引力与可观测量的论述
classification.abstract_zh: 在 Jacobson 对爱因斯坦场方程的热力学推导基础上，人们提出了“广义熵与变 G”（GEVAG）框架，将广义视界熵 S=f(A)/4G 一致地纳入时空热力学和几何，从而得到一个有效引力耦合 G_eff = G/f'(A)。另一种“熵-引力对应”（EGC）则等价于把这一视界关系提升为随径向变化的体耦合 G_eff(r)。我们厘清了这些方法的相似之处与根本区别。尽管它们共享相同的视界一致性关系，但它们的整体因果结构和渐近几何可以显著不同。此外，EGC 的径向处方对多中心构型引入额外的不确定性。我们还考察了 GEVAG 的近视界扩展，该扩展恢复了仅在视界形式中不存在的热力学质量与 ADM 质量的等价性。随后我们讨论了这些不同处方对 Bekenstein 界的影响。Bekenstein 界在近视界 GEVAG、EGC 以及最近通过 Wald 熵对广义熵几何进行 f(R) 重构得到的 G_eff 之间提供了令人惊讶的联系。最后，我们提出了最重要的问题：实验室中实际测得的 G 究竟是什么？
classification.one_liner: 比较基于视界熵导出的 GEVAG 与 EGC 两种修改引力方案，展示其等价性、差异，并经由 Bekenstein 界与 f(R) 重构联系到实验室中 G 的意义。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文直接考察从视界热力学推导引力方程并构建有效引力理论，属于经典引力修改与黑洞热力学交叉，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度对应。

2609.02102v1.title: Cosmological implications for hairy black holes via spontaneous symmetry breaking: Are Hairy Black Holes Primordial?
2609.02102v1.abstract: We investigate whether hairy black holes generated through spontaneous symmetry breaking in Einstein-Scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (ESGB) theory, involving a complex scalar field with a global $U(1)$ symmetry, can be compatible with cosmological evolution. To this end, we introduce the ESGB theory with a scalar self-interaction that becomes relevant on cosmological scales while remaining negligible near the black hole. Owing to the time dependence of the GB term on cosmological scales, the scalar field dynamics in the evolving FLRW background differ qualitatively from those in the nearly static black hole background. In particular, for scalar-GB couplings compatible with hairy black hole formation, the effective potential supports a symmetry-broken vacuum throughout inflation. However, after inflation, a decelerated expansion changes the sign of the GB term, temporarily making the effective potential unbounded from below. As the GB contribution subsequently decreases, the scalar self-interaction eventually dominates and restores the symmetry. Within this schematic framework, we derive stringent constraints on the coupling strengths, the cutoff scale, and the black hole mass, which primarily arise for avoiding efficient tachyonic amplification of the scalar field perturbations during the unbounded phase. For cutoff scales compatible with both cosmological evolution and scalar hair formation, we find that only ultralight black holes with masses of the order of a few grams can develop scalar hair, identifying them as hairy primordial black holes.

classification.title_zh: 自发对称破缺毛状黑洞的宇宙学意义：毛状黑洞是原初的吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在爱因斯坦-标量-高斯-博内特（ESGB）理论中，通过自发对称破缺产生的毛状黑洞是否能与宇宙学演化相容。为此，我们引入了一个带全局U(1)对称性的复标量场的ESGB理论，其标量自相互作用在宇宙学尺度上变得重要，而在黑洞附近仍可忽略。由于GB项在宇宙学尺度上随时间变化，演化中的FLRW背景中的标量场动力学与近静态黑洞背景中的定性不同。特别是，对于与毛状黑洞形成相容的标量-GB耦合，有效势在整个暴胀期间支持对称破缺真空。然而，暴胀后，减速膨胀使GB项的符号改变，暂时使有效势从下方无界。随后GB贡献减小，标量自相互作用最终占主导并恢复对称性。在这个示意性框架内，我们推导了对耦合强度、截断尺度和黑洞质量的严格约束，这些约束主要来自避免在无界阶段期间标量场扰动的有效tachyonic放大。对于与宇宙学演化和标量毛形成都相容的截断尺度，我们发现只有质量在几克量级的超轻黑洞才能发展出标量毛，从而将其识别为毛状原初黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 研究ESGB理论中通过自发对称破缺形成的毛状黑洞与宇宙学演化的相容性，发现只有几克量级的超轻黑洞可形成标量毛，可能成为毛状原初黑洞。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典引力中标量-高斯-博内特毛状黑洞及其宇宙学限制，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，但与用户关注的全息/强耦合方向无直接关联。

2609.02380v1.title: The Analytical Solutions of Dyonic Black Holes in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg Theory
2609.02380v1.abstract: Recently, we constructed analytical purely electric and purely magnetic black-hole solutions in Einstein--Euler--Heisenberg theory, while the corresponding dyonic solutions were obtained numerically \cite{Luo:2026srx}. Motivated by the recent analytical construction of a dyonic black hole at the special coupling locus $b=a/2$ \cite{Ahmed:2026ufj}, we revisit the general dyonic sector. We show that exact analytical dyonic black-hole solutions can be constructed for nonlinear couplings satisfying $2b>a$, without imposing the restriction $b=a/2$. The mass function is expressed in closed form in terms of the Lauricella hypergeometric function. In particular, our construction yields an exact dyonic solution for the Euler--Heisenberg coupling $b=7a/4$. The solution of Ref.~\cite{Ahmed:2026ufj} is recovered in the limiting case $2b\rightarrow a$.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森伯格理论中双荷黑洞的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 最近，我们在爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森伯格理论中构造了解析的纯电和纯磁黑洞解，而相应的双荷解是在数值上获得的 [Luo:2026srx]。受最近在特殊耦合点 b=a/2 处双荷黑洞解析构造的启发 [Ahmed:2026ufj]，我们重新审视了一般双荷扇区。我们证明，对于满足 2b>a 的非线性耦合，可以在不强加 b=a/2 限制的情况下构造精确的解析双荷黑洞解。质量函数用 Lauricella 超几何函数闭合形式表达。特别地，我们的构造为欧拉-海森伯格耦合 b=7a/4 产生了一个精确的双荷解。文献 [Ahmed:2026ufj] 的解在极限 2b→a 中被恢复。
classification.one_liner: 本文在Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg理论中构造了满足2b>a的一般解析双荷黑洞解，质量函数以Lauricella超几何函数闭式表达，并在b=7a/4时给出具体实例。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文专注于爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森伯格理论中的经典双荷黑洞解析解，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；与用户关注的全息及凝聚态相关方向不直接相关，但符合重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2609.02615v1.title: Covariant linear response theory for a photon gas in curved spacetime
2609.02615v1.abstract: To overcome the failure of the conventional non-relativistic description of statistics in strong gravitational fields, we develop a covariant theory for a photon gas in curved spacetime, starting from the Boltzmann equation and employing the relaxation time approximation. The transport coefficients are computed up to second order, which are not a massless limit of the massive-particle results due to the fundamentally different phase-space geometry of null particles. At second order, the gravitational field renders the coefficients tensor-valued and induces transverse fluxes, analogous to the Hall effect. Using the first-order results, we derive relativistic generalizations of Fick's and Fourier's laws and obtain the radiation diffusion equation for spherically symmetric accretion disks. This provides a covariant description of radiative transport in strong gravitational fields for high-energy astrophysical applications.

classification.title_zh: 弯曲时空中光子气体的协变线性响应理论
classification.abstract_zh: 为克服传统非相对论统计描述在强引力场中的失效，我们从玻尔兹曼方程出发，采用弛豫时间近似，发展了弯曲时空中光子气体的协变理论。输运系数被计算到二阶，由于零质量粒子相空间几何的根本不同，这些系数并非有质量粒子结果的无质量极限。在二阶，引力场使系数变为张量值并诱导横向流，类似于霍尔效应。利用一阶结果，我们推导了菲克和傅里叶定律的相对论推广，并得到了球对称吸积盘的辐射扩散方程。这为高能天体物理应用提供了强引力场中辐射输运的协变描述。
classification.one_liner: 发展弯曲时空光子气体的协变输运理论，推导相对论性菲克/傅里叶定律及吸积盘辐射扩散方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文内容为经典引力背景下的光子输运，不涉及全息/量子引力或用户关注的全息支线。

2503.22805v2.title: Greybody Factor in AdS Black Brane Spectroscopy: A Study with Scalar and Electromagnetic Perturbations
2503.22805v2.abstract: We compute the greybody factor for scalar and photon radiations in AdS Schwarzschild black brane. We consider the linearized field equations satisfied by the minimally coupled massive scalar field and the transverse components of the Maxwell fields on the black brane background and recast them to the Heun's equations by appropriate change of variables and field redefinitions. At the asymptotic region, we consider appropriate linear combinations of the normalizable and non-normalizable solutions of the field equations to construct in/outgoing modes. We consider the ingoing solutions near horizon to construct the IN state and compute the coefficients of the in- and outgoing modes of the asymptotic solutions in terms of the connection coefficients of the Heun functions. Finally by calculating ratio of the coefficient of outgoing modes to the ingoing modes we find an exact expression for the greybody factor. We find that the greybody factor for the transverse Maxwell fields and that for the scalars dual to the conformal scalar primaries with integer scaling dimensions vanish off.

classification.title_zh: AdS黑洞膜光谱中的灰体因子：标量与电磁扰动研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了AdS Schwarzschild黑洞膜中标量和光子辐射的灰体因子。我们考虑了最小耦合有质量标量场和Maxwell场横向分量在黑洞膜背景上满足的线性化场方程，并通过适当的变量替换和场重定义将其改写为Heun方程。在渐近区域，我们取场方程的正规化与非正规化解的适当线性组合来构造入射/出射模式。我们考虑视界附近的入射解来构造IN态，并用Heun函数的连接系数计算渐近解的入、出射模式系数。最后，通过计算出射模式系数与入射模式系数之比，得到了灰体因子的精确表达式。我们发现横向Maxwell场的灰体因子与对偶于整数标度维度的共形标量原初标量场的灰体因子相互抵消。
classification.one_liner: 通过解析求解Heun方程，精确计算了AdS Schwarzschild黑洞膜上标量和电磁扰动的灰体因子，并发现两类场的贡献相互抵消。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及AdS黑洞背景上的经典场散射和灰体因子，可归入经典引力/广义相对论方向；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、相变、QNM等内容，相关性中等。

2509.26583v4.title: Higher-form (quasi)hydrodynamics from holography: deformations and dualities
2509.26583v4.abstract: We study the low-energy dynamics of systems with exact and approximate higher-form symmetries using Gauge-gravity duality. These symmetries are realised holographically via generalised Maxwell/Proca theories for massless/massive $p$-forms in AlAdS spacetimes. Double-trace deformations of the boundary theory are considered via appropriate boundary conditions. We compute thermal correlation functions in isotropic black brane backgrounds to characterise the near equilibrium regimes of the dual boundary theories. In the vanishing-mass limit, the theory exhibits a hydrodynamic regime for weak double-trace deformations (relative to a scale set by the temperature) and a quasihydrodynamic regime for strong deformations. Turning on the bulk mass gives rise instead to a triad of quasihydrodynamic regimes controlled by both the mass and the double-trace coupling. In general, we find the low-energy spectra to be constrained by pole collisions, emergent symmetries and duality relations, the latter originating in part from Hodge-type dualities in the bulk. For nonzero mass, there is an additional strong/weak duality of the double-trace couplings. We further show, in the low-density limit of background charge, that relevant deformations are necessary for stable diffusion of sufficiently high-dimensional charged objects.

classification.title_zh: 来自全息的高阶形式（准）流体力学：变形与对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用规范-引力对偶研究了具有精确和近似高阶形式对称性的系统的低能动力学。这些对称性通过 AlAdS 时空中的无质量/有质量 p-形式推广 Maxwell/Proca 理论在全息上实现。通过适当的边界条件考虑边界理论的双迹变形。我们计算各向同性黑膜背景下的热关联函数，以刻画对偶边界理论的近平衡区域。在零质量极限下，对于弱双迹变形（相对于温度设定的标度），理论表现出流体力学区域；对于强变形，则出现准流体力学区域。打开体质量则导致由质量和双迹耦合共同控制的三重准流体力学区域。总的来说，我们发现低能谱受到极点碰撞、涌现对称性和对偶关系约束，后者部分源自体中的 Hodge 型对偶。对于非零质量，还存在双迹耦合的强/弱对偶。我们还表明，在背景电荷的低密度极限下，稳定高维带电物体的扩散需要相关变形。
classification.one_liner: 论文从 AdS/CFT 导出具有高阶形式对称性的系统的（准）流体动力学，系统分析双迹变形、质量与 Hodge 对偶对低能谱的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及全息双迹变形与（准）流体力学模式，与用户的 multi-trace 和 QNM 相关研究支线有直接联系。

2602.00349v2.title: Running Love Numbers of Charged Black Holes
2602.00349v2.abstract: Loops of virtual particles from the vacuum of quantum field theory (QFT) render black holes tidally deformable. We compute the static tidal response of unspinning charged black holes at arbitrary radius, using the perturbative formalism developed in 2501.18684. Since the gravitational and electromagnetic tidal responses mix, we generalize the notion of Love numbers to Love matrices. We derive the coupled equations of motion for the metric and electromagnetic fluctuations around purely electric and magnetic backgrounds. For large charged black holes, which are described by the Effective Field Theory (EFT) of gravity, we compute the full set of Love matrices induced by an arbitrary tower of $F^{2n}$ operators. We find that, although quantum corrections break electromagnetic duality, the Love matrices in electric and magnetic backgrounds are related by a $Z_2$ symmetry under electric-magnetic exchange. Going beyond EFT, we compute the Love matrices of small magnetic black holes. We show that the running of the Love matrices is governed by the running of the $U(1)$ gauge coupling, and we derive the correspondence between Love and $U(1)$ beta functions for arbitrary harmonics. The overall picture that emerges is that the QFT-induced tidal response of magnetic black holes saturates in the strong-field regime. These results imply that nearly-extremal magnetic black holes charged under an Abelian dark sector could be probed by gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 带电黑洞的跑动Love数
classification.abstract_zh: 量子场论真空中的虚粒子圈使得黑洞具有潮汐形变。我们使用2501.18684中发展的微扰形式，计算任意半径下无自旋带电黑洞的静态潮汐响应。由于引力与电磁潮汐响应相互混合，我们将Love数的概念推广为Love矩阵。我们导出了纯电和纯磁背景周围度规与电磁涨落的耦合运动方程。对于由引力有效场论（EFT）描述的大带电黑洞，我们计算了由任意F^{2n}算符塔诱导的完整Love矩阵集合。我们发现，尽管量子修正破坏电磁对偶，但电背景与磁背景中的Love矩阵通过电-磁交换下的Z_2对称性关联。超越EFT，我们计算了小磁黑洞的Love矩阵。我们证明Love矩阵的跑动受U(1)规范耦合跑动支配，并推导了任意谐波下Love与U(1) beta函数之间的对应关系。总体图景是，QFT诱导的磁黑洞潮汐响应在强场区饱和。这些结果表明，在阿贝尔暗扇区下带电的近极端磁黑洞可通过引力波观测探及。
classification.one_liner: 计算带电黑洞的量子效应诱导Love矩阵，揭示其跑动与U(1) beta函数的对应，并预示近极端磁黑洞可被引力波探测。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文集中研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞潮汐响应与可观测效应，与用户重点标签'经典引力/广义相对论'直接匹配。

2605.15797v2.title: A fluid dual to the charged large D membrane paradigm
2605.15797v2.abstract: According to the formulation of the charged large $D$ membrane paradigm, an arbitrary dynamic black hole solution to a theory of gravity with a $U(1)$ gauge field is dual to the dynamics of a membrane in a non-gravitational background. This membrane is endowed with a stress-energy tensor and a charge current, whose conservation equations govern its dynamics. In this work, we demonstrate that the dynamics of these membrane configurations (at the leading nontrivial order in $1/D$) can be mapped to a relativistic charged fluid, establishing a correspondence for asymptotically flat black holes with a particular class of fluid systems. Unlike the standard AdS/Hydrodynamics correspondence, this dual fluid does not reside on an asymptotic boundary, but is localised strictly on the non-gravitational membrane worldvolume. By evaluating the system in both the Eckart and Landau frames, we systematically extract the out-of-equilibrium transport coefficients. We find that the fluid is governed by a negative effective thermal conductivity and a negative heat capacity. This mechanism provides a hydrodynamic interpretation of thermodynamic stability, effectively translating the previously established quasinormal mode damping of the large-$D$ Reissner-Nordstr\"om geometry into the language of fluid dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 带电大D膜范式的流体对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 按照带电大D膜范式的表述，带有U(1)规范场的引力理论中的任意动态黑洞解对偶于非引力背景中膜的动力演化。该膜带有应力能量张量和电荷流，其守恒方程控制其动力学。本文证明，这些膜组态的动力演化（在1/D的最低非平凡阶）可以映射为相对论性带电流体，从而为渐近平坦黑洞与特定一类流体系统建立对应关系。与标准的AdS/流体动力学对应不同，该对偶流体并不位于渐近边界上，而是严格定域在非引力膜的世界体上。通过在Eckart和Landau参考系中评估该系统，我们系统提取了非平衡输运系数，发现流体受负等效热导率和负热容支配。该机制提供了对热力学稳定性的流体动力学解释，有效地将先前建立的大D Reissner-Nordström几何中的准正则模阻尼转化为流体动力学语言。
classification.one_liner: 将带电大D膜范式映射为相对论性带电流体，提取出具有负热导率/负热容的非平衡输运系数，并用流体语言解释RN黑洞QNM阻尼。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究大D膜范式下的引力/流体对偶，并提取输运系数、联系QNM阻尼，与用户关注的经典引力及QNM方向相关；但主要属于经典引力中的高维展开方法，与全息凝聚态、超导等支线无关。

2606.01486v2.title: Approximate higher-form symmetries and dualities of massive p-forms in the holographic bulk
2606.01486v2.abstract: We develop a holographic framework for continuous higher-form symmetries and their low-energy effective descriptions, based on bulk path integrals, holographic renormalisation and boundary-condition-changing deformations. We show how approximate higher-form symmetries associated with a defect current can be realised holographically through massive antisymmetric tensor fields, either via parametrically small bulk masses or strong deformations associated with Robin boundary conditions. We further study the consequences of massless and massive Hodge dualities in the bulk, deriving the corresponding dualities between boundary theories related by different quantisation choices. Our results provide a unified perspective on approximate symmetries, dualities and strong/weak-coupling relations in holographic theories based on massive $p$-forms. In the self-dual case of an exact symmetry of degree $(d-3)/2$, we derive generalised constraints on holographic current-current correlators in the presence of double-trace deformations.

classification.title_zh: 全息体中的近似高阶对称性与有质量p-形式的对偶性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们基于体路径积分、全息重整化和边界条件改变形变，为连续高阶对称性及其低能有效描述发展了一个全息框架。我们展示了如何通过有质量反对称张量场，在体中以参数小体质量或与Robin边界条件相关的强形变，在全息上实现与缺陷电流相关的近似高阶对称性。我们进一步研究了体中无质量和有质量Hodge对偶性的后果，推导出由不同量子化选择相关的边界理论之间的相应二重性。我们的结果为基于有质量p-形式的全息理论中的近似对称性、二重性和强/弱耦合关系提供了一个统一视角。在精确(self-dual)对称度为(d-3)/2的情形下，我们推导了存在双trace形变时全息流-流关联函数的广义约束。
classification.one_liner: 发展了有质量p-形式全息描述高阶对称性的框架，推导了近似对称性与对偶性以及双trace形变下的约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究全息高阶对称性和有质量p-形式，与AdS/CFT字典和multi-trace形变相关，但偏离用户强调的具体体系。

2607.07364v2.title: Topological changes and response singularities in black hole thermodynamic branch structure
2607.07364v2.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how different diagnostics characterize the thermodynamic branch structure of black holes. In three charged AdS black hole examples, the thermodynamic topological transition point $\tau_a$, where the total topological number changes, is separated from the point $\tau_b$ where the branch response considered here, evaluated along a path with fixed charge parameters, becomes singular. Using the zero-point curves $\tau(r_h)$, we identify the local mechanisms behind this separation. At $\tau_a$, a zero point with nonzero winding enters or leaves the positive-radius physical branch set through the boundary of the counted domain, changing $W$ without making the corresponding positive-radius branch singular. At $\tau_b$, the zero-point curve develops a finite-radius turning point, where two branches with opposite winding numbers annihilate and the branch response diverges. Thus, in the analyzed examples, a change in the topological number records a change in branch membership, whereas a response singularity records a loss of local invertibility along an admitted branch. The two diagnostics therefore probe different local events of the same zero-point branch geometry.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 黑洞热力学分支结构中的拓扑变化与响应奇异性
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究不同诊断量如何刻画黑洞热力学分支结构。在三个带电 AdS 黑洞例子中，热力学拓扑转变点 τ_a 与沿固定电荷参数路径求得的所考虑的分支响应发散点 τ_b 彼此分离。利用零点曲线 τ(r_h)，作者识别了这种分离背后的局域机制：在 τ_a 处，具有非零绕数的零点从被计数域边界进入或离开正半径物理分支集合，改变总拓扑数 W 而不使相应正半径分支奇异；在 τ_b 处，零点曲线在有限半径处形成转向点，两个绕数相反的分支湮灭，分支响应发散。因此，在所分析的例子中，拓扑数的改变记录分支隶属关系的变化，而响应奇异性记录沿许可分支的局域可逆性丢失。两个诊断量探测的是同一零点分支几何的不同局域事件。
classification.one_liner: 本文通过零点曲线解析黑洞热力学拓扑转变与响应发散的不同局域机制：前者对应分支归属改变，后者对应局域可逆性丧失。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究 AdS 黑洞热力学拓扑和分支响应奇异性，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”和“相变与气泡成核”相关；但不涉及全息超流、全息 QCD、冷原子或探针膜等具体全息场论内容。

2608.08292v2.title: Complex CFTs: Holography and Interfaces
2608.08292v2.abstract: We investigate complex conformal field theories and interfaces between such theories, using methods of holography and two dimensional CFT. We use holography to prove the Im-flip property of complex conjugate CFTs. We construct a complex Janus solution and calculate some holographic observables. Complex RG-flow interfaces are obtained numerically. On the CFT side, complex interfaces are constructed for free boson CFTs with and without background charge. Boundary states are constructed, and transmission and reflection coefficients are calculated in both cases.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 复数 CFT：全息与界面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了复数共形场论以及这类理论之间的界面，使用全息和二维 CFT 方法。我们利用全息证明了复共轭 CFT 的 Im-flip 性质。我们构造了一个复数 Janus 解，并计算了一些全息观测量。复数 RG 流界面通过数值方法得到。在 CFT 侧，我们为带和不带背景电荷的自由玻色子 CFT 构造了复数界面。在两种情况下都构造了边界态，并计算了透射和反射系数。
classification.one_liner: 利用全息方法和二维 CFT 研究了复数 CFT 及其界面，构造了复数 Janus 解并计算了透射反射系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息界面与复数 CFT，虽与凝聚态全息超导不直接相关，但界面/Janus 解与畴壁/孤子等非均匀结构方向有关，且属于 AdS/CFT 字典。

2409.04623v2.title: Gravitational Baryogenesis in Energy-Momentum Squared~Gravity
2409.04623v2.abstract: We demonstrate that the matter sector itself can drive baryogenesis in energy-momentum squared gravity, $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$ with $\mathcal T^2\equiv T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$. High-density matter corrections provide new time-dependent sources for the baryon asymmetry through derivative couplings to $\mathcal T^2$ and to the full combination $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$. Notably, the decoupling temperature is not treated as a free parameter; instead, it is fixed by the freeze-out of the Weinberg $B-L$-violating operator, directly linking the asymmetry to the light-neutrino mass scale and to the modified expansion history. Analyzing representative powers $n=1/4$, $n=1/2$, $n=5/8$, and $n=1$, we find that entropy evolution sharply distinguishes the models. The $n=1/4$ branch cannot serve as a self-contained radiation-era model, the $n=1/2$ branch is entropy-safe but too weak to reproduce the observed asymmetry, and the $n=1$ branch survives only after entropy dilution. Remarkably, the $n=5/8$ branch provides the cleanest viable realization, generating the observed baryon-to-entropy ratio with controlled effective-field-theory hierarchies.

classification.title_zh: 能量-动量平方引力中的引力重子产生
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明物质扇区本身可以在能量-动量平方引力 $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$（其中 $\mathcal T^2\equiv T_{\mu\nu}T^{\mu\nu}$）中驱动重子产生。高密度物质修正通过与 $\mathcal T^2$ 以及完整组合 $f(R,\mathcal T^2)$ 的导数耦合，为重子不对称性提供了新的含时源。值得注意的是，退耦温度不视为自由参数；相反，它由 Weinberg $B-L$ 破坏算子的冻结过程固定，从而将不对称性与轻中微子质量标度和修正的膨胀历史直接联系起来。通过分析代表性幂次 $n=1/4$, $n=1/2$, $n=5/8$ 和 $n=1$，我们发现熵演化能清晰地区分这些模型。$n=1/4$ 分支不能作为自洽的辐射时期模型，$n=1/2$ 分支熵安全但过弱无法复现观测到的不对称性，$n=1$ 分支仅在熵稀释后存活。值得注意的是，$n=5/8$ 分支提供了最干净的可行实现，在受控的有效场论层级下产生观测到的重子-熵比。
classification.one_liner: 在能量-动量平方修改引力中，物质修正可在高密度下通过导数耦合产生重子不对称，其中 n=5/8 分支给出最干净的可行实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究修改引力中的宇宙学重子产生，与用户关注的全息/经典引力具体支线（如全息超流、QNM等）无关。

2602.16237v3.title: Phenomenological Rotating Extension of Black Holes with Primary Scalar Hair: Shadow Signatures in Beyond Horndeski Gravity
2602.16237v3.abstract: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) image of M87* provides a direct test of strong-field gravity, measuring an angular shadow diameter $\theta_{d}=42\pm 3~\mu\mathrm{as}$ and a circularity deviation $\Delta C\leq 0.1$. Such observations allow quantitative tests of the Kerr paradigm and of possible deviations from the no-hair theorem. In scalar-tensor extensions of gravity, black holes may possess primary scalar hair, introducing an additional independent parameter beyond mass and spin. In this work, we construct a rotating configuration inspired by black hole solutions with primary scalar hair in beyond Horndeski gravity and analyze their photon regions and shadow formation. We show that the scalar hair parameter $Q$ induces characteristic modifications of the shadow, and in particular negative $Q$ enlarges the shadow and reduces its oblateness, while positive $Q$ shrinks and enhances its distortion. Adopting M87* as a representative case within this framework and imposing the EHT bounds on $\theta_{d}$ and $\Delta C$, we identify the viable $(a,Q)$ parameter space. We find that current observations do not exclude rotating black holes with primary scalar hair, although the allowed region is significantly restricted for $Q>0$. Finally, the scalar-hair-induced deviations are of order $\mathcal{O}(\mu\mathrm{as})$, placing them near the sensitivity threshold of present instruments and within reach of next-generation horizon-scale imaging.

classification.title_zh: 带主标量毛发的旋转黑洞的现象学扩展：超越 Horndeski 引力中的阴影特征
classification.abstract_zh: 事件视界望远镜（EHT）对M87*的成像提供了强场引力的直接检验，测得其角阴影直径θd=42±3 μas，圆度偏差ΔC≤0.1。这类观测允许对Kerr范式以及对无毛定理可能偏离的情形进行定量检验。在引力的标量-张量扩展中，黑洞可能拥有主标量毛发，从而引入质量与自旋之外的额外独立参数。本文基于超越Horndeski引力中带主标量毛发的黑洞解，构造了一个转动构型，并分析了其光子区和阴影形成。我们发现，标量毛发参数Q会引起阴影的特征性修改：负Q使阴影增大并降低扁率，正Q则减小阴影并增强变形。以M87*作为代表性案例并施加EHT对θd和ΔC的约束，我们确定了可行的(a,Q)参数空间。我们发现，当前观测并不排除带主标量毛发的转动黑洞，尽管Q>0时允许区域受到显著限制。最后，标量毛发诱发的偏离约为微角秒量级，接近当前仪器的灵敏度极限，并处于下一代视界尺度成像的可及范围。
classification.one_liner: 用M87*的EHT观测约束带主标量毛发的旋转黑洞，发现负（正）毛发参数会增大（减小）阴影并改变形状，现有观测仍允许这类黑洞。

2608.24997v2.title: Anti-Ultralocality and Plateau Models of Inflation
2608.24997v2.abstract: Anti-ultralocality refers to the growth of spatial gradient terms relative to velocity terms in the coupled Einstein--scalar field equations. It is a characteristic feature of decelerated expansion before the onset of inflation. Previous numerical relativity studies have shown that anti-ultralocality prevents the onset of inflation in models with power-law inflaton potentials. In this paper, we show that models with plateau-shaped inflaton potentials, which are considered to be the simplest way to generate a tensor-to-scalar ratio below current observational upper limits, are especially vulnerable to anti-ultralocality effects. The reasons are the flatness of the plateau and the energy density gap of $\sim 10$ orders of magnitude between the Planck density and the plateau potential energy. To study the problem, we develop a protocol for assessing the viability of inflationary models in general, and we apply it to a plateau potential using a previously validated numerical relativity code. We find that, starting from generic initial conditions, the growth of gradient terms in the Einstein equations relative to non-gradient terms either prevents inflation from lasting for enough $e$-folds or triggers a phase of quantum runaway. We show that the fine-tuning of initial conditions necessary to avoid these issues becomes more severe as the energy scale of inflation is made smaller, disfavoring common approaches for reducing the tensor-to-scalar ratio.

classification.title_zh: 反超局域性与暴涨的高原势模型
classification.abstract_zh: 反超局域性指的是在耦合的爱因斯坦-标量场方程中，空间梯度项相对于速度项的增长。它是暴涨开始之前减速膨胀的一个特征。先前的数值相对论研究表明，在具有幂律暴胀势的模型中，反超局域性会阻止暴涨的开始。在本文中，我们表明，具有高原形暴胀势的模型——这被认为是产生低于当前观测上限的张标比的最简单方法——尤其容易受到反超局域性效应的影响。其原因在于高原的平直性以及普朗克密度与高原势能之间约10个数量级的能量密度差距。为研究此问题，我们开发了一个评估一般暴胀模型可行性的协议，并将其应用于高原势，使用先前已验证的数值相对论代码。我们发现，从一般初始条件出发，爱因斯坦方程中梯度项相对于非梯度项的增长要么使暴涨无法持续足够的e-折数，要么触发量子失控阶段。我们还表明，为避免这些问题所需的初始条件精细调节随着暴涨能标的降低而变得更加严重，这不利于降低张标比的常见方法。
classification.one_liner: 高原势暴胀模型因势的平坦性和巨大能量差，对反超局域性特别敏感，更容易导致e-折不足或量子失控，且低能标需要更精细的初始条件。

2609.01803v1.title: Exploration of Zero-Complexity Compact Stars in Higher Dimensions under the Finch-Skea Background
2609.01803v1.abstract: Motivated by the recent extension of Herrera's gravitational complexity to arbitrary higher-dimensional spacetimes, we investigate exact compact-star models that satisfy the vanishing-complexity condition within the Finch--Skea geometry in $(n+2)$-dimensional Einstein gravity. By combining the higher-dimensional Einstein field equations with the generalized complexity formalism, we obtain a new class of exact interior solutions describing anisotropic fluid spheres with zero complexity. The physical properties of these models are evaluated by analyzing the behavior of the matter variables, pressure anisotropy, and equilibrium conditions, alongside the standard requirements of regularity, energy conditions, causality, and stability. We further explore the influence of spacetime dimensionality on the structural characteristics of the stellar configurations, demonstrating that the presence of extra dimensions significantly modifies the internal matter distribution while preserving physical viability. The solutions presented here represent the first exact higher-dimensional Finch--Skea compact-star models constructed within this recently developed generalized complexity framework \cite{choudas}. These results provide a natural extension of zero-complexity stellar configurations beyond four-dimensional General Relativity and offer a robust framework for investigating self-gravitating systems in higher- dimensional gravity.

classification.title_zh: Finch-Skea背景下高维零复杂度紧致星的探索
classification.abstract_zh: 受最近Herrera引力复杂度向任意高维时空扩展的启发，我们在(n+2)维Einstein引力的Finch-Skea几何中研究了满足零复杂度条件的精确紧致星模型。通过将高维Einstein场方程与广义复杂度形式相结合，我们获得了一类新的描述零复杂度各向异性流体球的精确内部解。通过分析物质变量、压力各向异性和平衡条件的行为，以及正则性、能量条件、因果性和稳定性的标准要求，评估了这些模型的物理性质。我们进一步探讨了时空维度对恒星构型结构特征的影响，表明额外维度的存在显著改变了内部物质分布，同时保持了物理可行性。本文给出的解是在这一新发展的广义复杂度框架下首次构建的精确高维Finch-Skea紧致星模型。其结果将零复杂度恒星构型自然推广到四维广义相对论之外，并为研究高维引力中的自引力系统提供了稳健框架。
classification.one_liner: 在(n+2)维Einstein引力中构造了满足零复杂度条件的Finch-Skea各向异性紧致星精确解。
