2609.10220v1.title: Testing Source Dependence in Gravitational-Wave Tests of General Relativity with Mutual Information
2609.10220v1.abstract: Phenomenological deviation parameters used in gravitational-wave tests of general relativity need not represent universal fundamental properties of the sources. Instead, a deviation parameter can be a derived quantity that depends on source properties. Apparent violations of general relativity arising from waveform systematics or data-quality issues can also depend on source properties. In addition to diagnosing individual events, it is helpful to identify systematic trends at the population level. We introduce a nonparametric framework that uses mutual information to test whether the deviations depend on source properties. We validate the framework using simulations with massive graviton waveforms. Assuming we do not have prior knowledge of the underlying theory, massive graviton effects can be captured by a parameterized post-Einstein coefficient that is expected to depend on the luminosity distance and source mass. The results show that the mass and distance dependencies become clear for graviton masses of $\geq 1\times10^{-22}\,\mathrm{eV}$ at detector sensitivities representative of the current fourth observing run, while the controlled general relativity simulations yield null results. We then analyze public real-data products for tests of general relativity from GWTC-4.0 and 4-OGC, including phenomenological parameterized tests, modified dispersion tests, and parity violation tests. The phenomenological deviation parameters have tentative correlations with effective spin, and correlations of modified-dispersion or parity-violation parameters with source mass are visible. These results demonstrate that catalog-level dependence can identify patterns and thus be used to diagnose the origin of deviations in testing general relativity. The framework therefore complements single-event analyses and parameterized hierarchical population tests.

classification.title_zh: 用互信息检验引力波广义相对论检验中的源依赖性
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波广义相对论检验中使用的唯象偏差参数未必代表源的普适基本性质。相反，偏差参数可以是一个依赖于源性质的导出量。由波形系统误差或数据质量问题引起的表观广义相对论违反也可能依赖于源性质。除了诊断单个事件外，识别族群层面的系统性趋势也很有帮助。我们引入一个非参数框架，利用互信息检验偏差是否依赖于源性质。我们用大质量引力子波形模拟验证该框架。假设事先不知道底层理论，大质量引力子效应可由参数化的后爱因斯坦系数捕获，该系数预期依赖于光度距离和源质量。结果表明，在当前第四观测运行代表性的探测器灵敏度下，对于引力子质量不小于 1e-22 eV，质量依赖和距离依赖变得清晰，而受控的广义相对论模拟给出零结果。随后我们分析来自 GWTC-4.0 和 4-OGC 的公开真实数据产物中的广义相对论检验，包括唯象参数化检验、修改色散检验和宇称破缺检验。唯象偏差参数与有效自旋存在暂定相关性，修改色散或宇称破缺参数与源质量的相关性可见。这些结果表明，目录层面的依赖性可以识别模式，从而用于诊断广义相对论检验中偏差的来源。因此该框架补充了单事件分析和参数化层级族群检验。
classification.one_liner: 用互信息检验引力波广义相对论检验中的偏差参数是否依赖源性质，并在模拟与 GWTC-4.0/4-OGC 数据中寻找族群层面的系统趋势。

2609.10251v1.title: Pulsar Timing Response and Spatial Correlations of Shear Modes in Torsionless Palatini Spacetime
2609.10251v1.abstract: In the nanohertz band, spatial correlations between pulsar timing residuals provide a key observable for characterizing stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds and probing their polarization content. In torsionless Palatini spacetime, nonmetricity can generate two additional shear modes, referred to as the shear-$x$ and shear-$y$ modes. In this work, we investigate the pulsar timing response produced by the shear-induced motions of the emitting pulsar and the receiving Earth. Assuming that the electromagnetic field is minimally coupled to the physical metric and that the Earth and pulsar possess non-negligible effective hypermomentum responses, we derive the single-pulsar redshift, the frequency-domain two-point correlation function, and the corresponding spatial correlation. For a stationary and isotropic stochastic shear background, the normalized overlap reduction function (ORF) for distinct pulsars reduces in the short-wavelength limit to the pure dipolar form $\Gamma_{ab}^{\mathrm{sh}}(\zeta)=\cos\zeta$, where $\zeta$ is the angular separation between the two pulsars. The same dipolar correlation can also be produced by isotropic Solar System ephemeris errors, leading to a spatial degeneracy between the two signals. This degeneracy highlights the importance of information beyond the angular correlation for identifying Palatini shear signatures in PTA data.

classification.title_zh: 无挠 Palatini 时空中剪切模式的脉冲星计时响应与空间关联
classification.abstract_zh: 在纳赫兹频段，脉冲星计时残差之间的空间关联是刻画随机引力波背景及其偏振内容的关键观测量。在无挠 Palatini 时空中，非度规性可以产生两种额外的剪切模式，称为剪切-x 和剪切-y 模式。本文研究由发射脉冲星和接收地球的剪切诱导运动所产生的脉冲星计时响应。假设电磁场与物理度规最小耦合，并且地球和脉冲星具有不可忽略的有效超动量响应，我们推导了单脉冲星红移、频域两点关联函数以及相应的空间关联。对于稳态且各向同性的随机剪切背景，不同脉冲星的归一化重叠约化函数（ORF）在短波极限下约化为纯偶极形式 Γ_ab^sh(ζ)=cos ζ，其中 ζ 是两颗脉冲星之间的角分离。相同的偶极关联也可以由各向同性的太阳系历表误差产生，从而导致两种信号之间的空间简并。这种简并凸显了在 PTA 数据中识别 Palatini 剪切特征时，角度关联之外的信息的重要性。
classification.one_liner: 在无挠 Palatini 时空中推导剪切模式诱导的脉冲星计时空间关联，短波极限下为纯偶极形式，并与太阳系历表误差简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究 Palatini 修改引力中的剪切引力波模式及其脉冲星计时空间关联，属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波观测方向，与用户“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接相关；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.10345v1.title: Parity symmetry as a diagnostic for spin-precessing binary-black-hole waveform models
2609.10345v1.abstract: Parity invariance of general relativity imposes exact relations between waveforms and remnant properties of binary-black-hole configurations related by reversal of the in-plane spins and observer direction. We summarize these relations and construct consistency tests for spin-precessing waveform and remnant models. Applying a conservative, unmaximized overlap diagnostic to seven state-of-the-art waveform models, we find that models built from aligned-spin calibrated waveforms and parity-covariant precession dynamics satisfy the symmetry to numerical precision. The original \texttt{IMRPhenomXO4a} and \texttt{IMRPhenomXPNR} implementations instead exhibit median parity residuals of approximately $1.6\times10^{-3}$ with broad upper tails, while \texttt{NRSur7dq4} shows its largest violations at high mass ratio and large spin magnitude. The asymmetric extension of \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} exhibits a smaller, localized violation, while \texttt{NRSur7dq4Remnant} shows larger residuals in the recoil than in the final mass and spin. We trace these violations to an observer-dependent phase anchor in the \texttt{IMRPhenom} antisymmetric mode, non-invariant parameterization of the \texttt{NRSur7dq4} surrogate fits, and one non-invariant NR-calibrated coefficient in the asymmetric \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} extension. Local corrections restore waveform parity to numerical precision for the \texttt{IMRPhenom} and \texttt{SEOBNRv5PHM} cases; restoring it in \texttt{NRSur7dq4} requires refitting the surrogate. Reanalyses of eight GWTC-5.0 events show no qualitative change in astrophysical interpretation, although the \texttt{IMRPhenom} correction yields Jensen-Shannon divergences up to $5\times10^{-2}$ in individual marginalized posteriors. Exact symmetries thus provide inexpensive, model-independent consistency tests and should be imposed by construction in calibrated waveform models.

classification.title_zh: 宇称对称性作为自旋进动双黑洞波形模型的诊断工具
classification.abstract_zh: 广义相对论的宇称不变性对由面内自旋反向和观测方向反转相联系的双黑洞构型的波形与残余性质施加精确关系。我们总结这些关系，并为自旋进动波形和残余模型构建一致性检验。将一种保守的、未最大化的重叠诊断应用于七个最先进的波形模型，我们发现，由对齐自旋校准波形和宇称协变进动动力学构建的模型在数值精度上满足该对称性。原始的 IMRPhenomXO4a 和 IMRPhenomXPNR 实现反而表现出约 1.6×10^-3 的中位宇称残差，并带有宽的上尾，而 NRSur7dq4 在高质量比和大自旋量级处显示出最大的破坏。SEOBNRv5PHM 的非对称扩展表现出较小的局域破坏，而 NRSur7dq4Remnant 在反冲中的残差大于最终质量和自旋中的残差。我们将这些破坏追溯到 IMRPhenom 反对称模式中依赖观测者的相位锚点、NRSur7dq4 代理拟合的非不变参数化，以及非对称 SEOBNRv5PHM 扩展中一个非不变的 NR 校准系数。局域修正使 IMRPhenom 和 SEOBNRv5PHM 情形的波形宇称恢复到数值精度；在 NRSur7dq4 中恢复它需要重新拟合代理。对八个 GWTC-5.0 事件的再分析显示天体物理解释没有定性变化，尽管 IMRPhenom 修正会在单个边缘化后验中产生高达 5×10^-2 的 Jensen-Shannon 散度。因此，精确对称性提供了廉价、模型无关的一致性检验，并应在校准波形模型中通过构造加以施加。
classification.one_liner: 该文利用广义相对论的宇称不变性检验七个自旋进动双黑洞波形/残余模型，定位并修正若干模型的宇称破坏。

2609.10354v1.title: A Novel Scheme for Inter-Satellite Integrated Laser Ranging and Communication in Space-Based GW Detection
2609.10354v1.abstract: Adopting pseudo-random noise (PRN) codes for inter-satellite ranging, the resulting data-encoded PRN signal induces excessive laser phase measurement noise under the currently adopted integrated scheme in space-based gravitational wave (GW) detection systems. To suppress the noise, a scheme of inter-satellite integrated laser link is presented in this Letter, in which the data-encoded PRN signal for inter-satellite absolute distance measurement and communication is phase-modulated onto the ultra-stable oscillator (USO) clock signal before phase modulation onto the laser carrier. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that in the proposed scheme the noise is significantly suppressed compared with the currently-adopted one, while the noise stemming from the data-encoded PRN signal on clock noise transfer is limited within the requirement.

classification.title_zh: 空间引力波探测中星间集成激光测距与通信的新方案
classification.abstract_zh: 在星间测距中采用伪随机噪声（PRN）码时，当前空间引力波探测系统所采用的集成方案会使数据编码的 PRN 信号引入过大的激光相位测量噪声。为抑制该噪声，本文提出一种星间集成激光链路方案：将用于星间绝对距离测量和通信的数据编码 PRN 信号先相位调制到超稳振荡器（USO）时钟信号上，再相位调制到激光载波上。理论分析和仿真结果表明，与当前采用的方案相比，所提方案显著抑制了噪声，同时数据编码 PRN 信号对时钟噪声传递所引入的噪声被限制在要求范围内。
classification.one_liner: 提出将数据编码 PRN 信号先调制到 USO 时钟再调制到激光载波的星间集成激光链路方案，以抑制空间引力波探测中的相位测量噪声。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于空间引力波探测的激光链路工程，与经典引力/广义相对论支线中的引力波探测相关，但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论。

2609.09248v1.title: Decoding the Imprints of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity in Neutron Stars with Machine Learning Analysis
2609.09248v1.abstract: Neutron stars (NSs) provide a unique laboratory for testing gravity in the strong-field regime and for searching for deviations from General Relativity (GR). In this work, we investigate the effects of Energy-Momentum Squared Gravity (EMSG) on NS structure and examine whether its signatures can be identified from observable stellar properties using supervised machine learning (ML). We solve the modified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations for approximately $10^{4}$ nuclear equations of state (EOSs) for EMSG coupling parameters $\alpha=\{-5.01,-2.50,0,+2.50,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$, and calculate the gravitational mass $M$, radius $R$, dimensionless tidal deformability $\Lambda$, and fundamental $f$-mode oscillation frequency for each stellar configuration. Imposing observational constraints on $M$, $R$, and $\Lambda$, we split our datasets into train and test sets, and we employ Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), and Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB) to classify the representative sectors $\alpha=\{-5.01,0,+5.01\}\times10^{-38}\,\mathrm{erg}^{-1}\mathrm{cm}^{3}$ using $(M, R,\Lambda,f)$. The RF classifier performs best, achieving an accuracy of approximately $99.85\%$ with precision, recall, and F1-scores exceeding $99.8\%$, while KNN also achieves accuracy above $99\%$. The nearly diagonal confusion matrices demonstrate that the observationally viable NS configurations associated with different EMSG sectors remain highly separable in the multidimensional observable space. Our results show that NS observables retain robust signatures of EMSG even after observational filtering, establishing ML-assisted NS observations as a promising complementary approach for probing modified gravity with current and future multi-messenger observations.

classification.title_zh: 用机器学习分析解码能量-动量平方引力在中子星中的印记
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星（NSs）为在强场区域检验引力以及寻找对广义相对论（GR）的偏离提供了独特实验室。在本工作中，我们研究能量-动量平方引力（EMSG）对中子星结构的影响，并利用监督机器学习（ML）考察能否从可观测恒星性质中识别其印记。我们对约 10^4 个核物态方程（EOSs）求解修正的 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，EMSG 耦合参数取 α = {-5.01, -2.50, 0, +2.50, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3，并计算每个恒星位形的引力质量 M、半径 R、无量纲潮汐形变 Λ 以及基本 f 模振荡频率。在施加对 M、R 和 Λ 的观测约束后，我们将数据集分为训练集和测试集，并使用随机森林（RF）、K 近邻（KNN）、支持向量机（SVM）、逻辑回归（LR）和高斯朴素贝叶斯（GNB），基于 (M, R, Λ, f) 对代表性区间 α = {-5.01, 0, +5.01}×10^{-38} erg^{-1} cm^3 进行分类。RF 分类器表现最佳，准确率约 99.85%，精确率、召回率和 F1 分数均超过 99.8%；KNN 的准确率也超过 99%。近乎对角的混淆矩阵表明，与不同 EMSG 区间对应的、在观测上可行的中子星位形在多维可观测空间中仍高度可分离。我们的结果表明，即使经过观测筛选，中子星可观测星仍保留 EMSG 的稳健印记，从而确立机器学习辅助的中子星观测为一种有前景的补充方法，可用当前和未来的多信使观测探测修改引力。
classification.one_liner: 对约万个核物态方程求解EMSG修正TOV方程并用监督学习分类，发现中子星(M,R,Λ,f)仍能高精度区分EMSG参数。

2510.19047v3.title: Global time-frequency search for stellar-mass binary black holes in LISA
2510.19047v3.abstract: We present a complete pipeline for detecting and characterizing gravitational waves (GWs) produced by the inspiral of stellar-mass binary black holes in data from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). The analysis framework relies on an efficient time-frequency implementation of an adaptive semi-coherent detection statistic, which we show to be robust against non-stationary noise and the presence of gaps of varying duration and cadence. The search is able to detect signals with coherent signal-to-noise ratios as low as $\approx 11-14$ over the full parameter space of binary black holes with spins aligned to the orbital angular momentum and orbital eccentricity $\le 0.01$ when deployed on the 2-year-long LISA Data Challenge Yorsh. The search can be run within a day using $\approx 40$ GPUs. The techniques presented here have wider applications in GW astronomy, in particular the search for extreme-mass-ratio inspirals in LISA data.

classification.title_zh: LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞的全局时频搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一套完整流程，用于在激光干涉空间天线（LISA）数据中探测和表征由恒星质量双黑洞旋近产生的引力波。分析框架基于一种高效时频实现的自适应半相干探测统计量；我们表明该统计量对非平稳噪声以及不同持续时间和采样节奏的数据缺口具有鲁棒性。在为期两年的 LISA Data Challenge Yorsh 数据上，对于自旋与轨道角动量对齐、轨道偏心率 ≤0.01 的双黑洞全参数空间，该搜索能够探测相干信噪比低至约 11–14 的信号。使用约 40 个 GPU，该搜索可在一天内完成。这里提出的技术还可广泛用于引力波天文学，特别是 LISA 数据中极端质量比旋近的搜索。
classification.one_liner: 为 LISA 中恒星质量双黑洞旋近提出全局时频半相干搜索流程，可在非平稳噪声与数据缺口下探测低信噪比信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波天文学中的 LISA 数据分析与探测流程，贴合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息理论。

2510.21555v2.title: Gravitational and kinematic redshifts of black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics
2510.21555v2.abstract: Spacetimes arising from nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are a good laboratory for studying both the nature of regular black hole (RBH) solutions and the imprints of nonlinear electromagnetic fields within this context. Over the past few decades, NED-sourced black hole (BH) spacetimes have attracted considerable attention, but electrically charged RBHs obtained in the so-called $F$ framework have been less addressed in the literature. We consider two electrically charged, fully regular members of the h-family that are solutions to general relativity minimally coupled to NED. Because of their potential astrophysical and astronomical applications, we mainly focus our investigation on the motion of photons and its implications for the gravitational and kinematic redshifts, as well as for the shadow radius, considering the effective geometry followed by photons in NED. Moreover, we consider the observational data for Sagittarius A$^{\star}$ and Messier 87$^{\star}$ BHs to impose some constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio of the fully RBHs. We obtain the general equations that govern the gravitational and kinematic redshifts of NED-sourced BH spacetimes. In particular, for fully RBHs with BH charge-to-mass ratios above some moderate value, we observe discrepancies in their physical and geometrical properties compared to those of the Reissner--Nordstr\"om (RN) BH. Therefore, our results indicate that it is possible to distinguish NED-based RBH solutions from RN BHs, from the perspective of gravitational and kinematic redshifts, suggesting potential astrophysical relevance.

classification.title_zh: 非线性电动力学中黑洞的引力红移和运动学红移
classification.abstract_zh: 由非线性电动力学（NED）产生的时空是研究正则黑洞（RBH）解的性质以及非线性电磁场在此背景下印记的良好实验室。过去几十年中，NED 源黑洞（BH）时空引起了广泛关注，但在所谓的 F 框架下获得的带电 RBH 在文献中较少被讨论。我们考虑两个带电的、完全正则的 h 族成员，它们是广义相对论与 NED 最小耦合的解。由于它们潜在的天体物理和天文学应用，我们主要关注光子的运动及其对引力红移和运动学红移以及阴影半径的影响，同时考虑 NED 中光子遵循的有效几何。此外，我们考虑人马座 A* 和 M87* 黑洞的观测数据，以对完全 RBH 的荷质比施加一些约束。我们获得了支配 NED 源黑洞时空的引力红移和运动学红移的一般方程。特别地，对于荷质比高于某个中等值的完全 RBH，我们观察到其物理和几何性质与 Reissner–Nordström (RN) 黑洞存在差异。因此，我们的结果表明，从引力红移和运动学红移的角度，有可能区分基于 NED 的 RBH 解与 RN 黑洞，这暗示了潜在的天体物理相关性。
classification.one_liner: 研究非线性电动力学中带电正则黑洞的光子运动与红移，并利用观测数据约束荷质比，表明可与 RN 黑洞区分。

2512.22938v3.title: Multi-messenger detectability of continuous gravitational waves from the near future to next generation detectors
2512.22938v3.abstract: Continuous gravitational waves have the potential to transform gravitational wave astronomy and yield fresh insights into astrophysics, nuclear and particle physics, and condensed matter physics. We evaluate their detectability by combining various theoretical and observational arguments from the literature and systematically applying those arguments to known astronomical objects and future gravitational wave detectors. We detail and update previous estimates made in support of Cosmic Explorer [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]. It is commonly argued that the spins of accreting neutron stars are regulated by gravitational wave emission and that millisecond pulsars contain a young pulsar's magnetic field buried under accreted material. If either of these arguments holds, the first detection of continuous gravitational waves is likely with near future upgrades of current detectors, and many detections are likely with next generation detectors such as Cosmic Explorer and the Einstein Telescope. A lack of detections in the next several years would begin to raise serious doubts about current theories of millisecond pulsar formation.

classification.title_zh: 从近期到下一代探测器连续引力波的多信使可探测性
classification.abstract_zh: 连续引力波有潜力改变引力波天文学，并为天体物理、核与粒子物理以及凝聚态物理带来新见解。我们通过结合文献中的各种理论与观测论据，并将这些论据系统地应用于已知天体和未来引力波探测器，评估其可探测性。我们详细说明并更新了此前为支持 Cosmic Explorer 所作的估计 [M. Evans et al., arXiv:2306.13745; I. Gupta et al., Class. Quantum Grav. 41, 245001 (2024)]。通常认为，吸积中子星的自转由引力波辐射调节，并且毫秒脉冲星在被吸积物质掩埋下保留着年轻脉冲星的磁场。如果其中任一论据成立，连续引力波的首次探测很可能通过当前探测器的近期升级实现，而下一代探测器（如 Cosmic Explorer 和 Einstein Telescope）则可能实现大量探测。未来几年内若仍无探测，将开始对当前毫秒脉冲星形成理论提出严重质疑。
classification.one_liner: 结合理论与观测论据，评估连续引力波在近期升级与下一代探测器中的可探测性及其对毫秒脉冲星形成理论的检验。

2601.15201v3.title: Effects of massive spin-2 fields on gravitational wave propagation
2601.15201v3.abstract: Massive spin-2 fields in addition to the standard massless graviton arise naturally in extensions of general relativity, such as massive bigravity or models with extra dimensions. This work explores the observational signatures of these fields on the propagation of gravitational waves. Adopting a phenomenological framework consistent with such theories, we derive an analytical transfer function in the ultrarelativistic limit and establish detectability bounds for inspiral sources. Finally, we provide forecasts for the accessible parameter space using current and future gravitational wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 大质量自旋-2场对引力波传播的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论的扩展中，例如大质量双引力或额外维度模型，除标准无质量引力子外，会自然出现大质量自旋-2场。本文探讨这些场对引力波传播的观测印记。我们采用与这类理论一致的现象学框架，在极端相对论极限下推导出解析转移函数，并为旋近源建立可探测性界限。最后，我们利用当前和未来引力波探测器给出可及参数空间的预言。
classification.one_liner: 研究大质量自旋-2场在极端相对论极限下对引力波传播的修正，并预测当前与未来引力波探测器的可及参数空间。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论框架下的引力波传播与修改引力效应，属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”支线。

2601.19741v3.title: Effect of noise characterization on the detection of mHz stochastic gravitational waves
2601.19741v3.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays' hint for a stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) leverages the expectations of a future detection in the millihertz band, particularly with the LISA space mission. However, finding an SGWB with a single orbiting detector is challenging: It calls for cautious modelling of instrumental noise, which is also mainly stochastic. It was shown that agnostic noise reconstruction methods provide robustness in the detection process. We build on previous work to include more realistic instrumental simulations and additional degrees of freedom in the noise inference model and analyze the impact of LISA's sensitivity to SGWBs. Particularly, we model the two main types of noise sources with separate transfer functions and power spectral density spline fitting. We assess the detectability bounds and their dependence on the flexibility of the noise model and on the prior probability, allowing us to refine previously reported results.

classification.title_zh: 噪声表征对毫赫兹随机引力波探测的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列对随机引力波背景（SGWB）的暗示，增强了对毫赫兹频段未来探测的预期，尤其是借助 LISA 空间任务。然而，用单个轨道探测器发现 SGWB 具有挑战性：这要求对仪器噪声进行谨慎建模，而仪器噪声也主要是随机的。已有研究表明，不可知论式噪声重构方法能在探测过程中提供稳健性。我们在先前工作基础上，纳入更真实的仪器模拟和噪声推断模型中更多自由度，并分析 LISA 对 SGWB 灵敏度的受影响情况。特别地，我们用独立的传递函数和功率谱密度样条拟合来建模两类主要噪声源。我们评估可探测性界限及其对噪声模型灵活性和先验概率的依赖，从而改进此前报道的结果。
classification.one_liner: 研究更真实的仪器模拟与噪声推断自由度如何影响 LISA 对毫赫兹随机引力波背景的可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于引力波探测与 LISA 噪声建模，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2604.11755v3.title: Ringing of rapidly rotating black holes in effective field theory
2604.11755v3.abstract: Within the effective field theory approach to gravity, deviations from general relativity can be systematically described by higher-curvature operators. However, computing the resulting corrections to black hole quasinormal mode spectra remains challenging in the rapidly rotating regime, where perturbative expansions in the spin break down. We use recently constructed numerical rotating black hole solutions to compute quasinormal mode frequency corrections at leading order in the effective field theory. Focusing on scalar perturbations, we evaluate cubic-curvature corrections, which constitute the leading modifications. We employ a pseudo-spectral collocation method to solve the resulting perturbation equations on these backgrounds, enabling accurate computation across a broad parameter range. We obtain frequency corrections for fundamental modes with $l\le5$ for all $m$, and the first overtone of $2 \le l \le 5$ modes for all $m$ for spins up to $a=0.99M$, with relative errors below $10^{-4}$. We observe that corrections to certain modes grow significantly as the spin approaches the near-extremal regime.

classification.title_zh: 有效场论中快速旋转黑洞的振铃
classification.abstract_zh: 在引力的有效场论方法中，对广义相对论的偏离可由高阶曲率算符系统描述。然而，在快速旋转区域，计算由此产生的黑洞准正规模谱修正仍然困难，因为自旋微扰展开在此失效。我们使用近期构造的数值旋转黑洞解，计算有效场论领头阶的准正规模频率修正。聚焦标量扰动，我们评估三次曲率修正，它们构成领头修正。我们采用伪谱配置法在这些背景上求解所得扰动方程，从而在广泛参数范围内实现精确计算。我们得到 l≤5 的所有 m 基本模频率修正，以及 2≤l≤5 的所有 m 一阶泛音频率修正，自旋达到 a=0.99M，相对误差低于 10^{-4}。我们观察到某些模式的修正随着自旋接近近极端区域而显著增长。
classification.one_liner: 利用数值旋转黑洞背景和伪谱法计算高阶曲率有效场论对标量准正规模频率的领头修正，覆盖近极端自旋。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模在有效场论高阶曲率修正下的变化，并聚焦快速旋转黑洞，直接对应QNM与经典引力/修改引力重点方向。

2605.04154v2.title: A Master Equation for Screening in Luminal Horndeski Gravity
2605.04154v2.abstract: Determining the active screening mechanism from a general scalar-tensor Lagrangian remains a challenging problem. As a diagnostic tool, we present a systematic study of nonlinear cosmological perturbations in luminal Horndeski theories. Working in the $\alpha$-basis on a flat FLRW background, we derive and organise the full set of unapproximated second-order perturbation equations and systematically apply the quasistatic and weak-field limits. We find that second-order effects modify only the scalar-field equation. We derive, for static and spherically symmetric configurations, a master screening equation that classifies the nonlinear operators driving screening, recovering the Vainshtein mechanism and the onset of chameleon screening. We also identify a novel candidate regime, which we term Phaedrus screening, characterised by a screening radius that scales linearly with the source mass. For each mechanism, we derive analytical and numerical solutions and clarify the conditions under which they activate. Two new publicly available software packages are introduced: (i) xAlpha, a Mathematica package to compute and organize perturbation equations in scalar-tensor theories, and (ii) escut, a python module to solve the nonlinear scalar equation. In many cases, these tools enable the identification of the active screening type directly from a luminal Horndeski Lagrangian.

classification.title_zh: 光速 Horndeski 引力中屏蔽的主方程
classification.abstract_zh: 从一般的标量-张量拉格朗日量确定活跃的屏蔽机制仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。作为诊断工具，我们系统研究了光速 Horndeski 理论中的非线性宇宙学扰动。在平直 FLRW 背景上采用 α-基，我们推导并整理了完整的未近似二阶扰动方程，并系统地应用准静态和弱场极限。我们发现二阶效应只修正标量场方程。对于静态球对称位形，我们推导出一个主屏蔽方程，对驱动屏蔽的非线性算符进行分类，重现 Vainshtein 机制和 chameleon 屏蔽的开端。我们还识别出一个新的候选区域，称为 Phaedrus 屏蔽，其特征是屏蔽半径随源质量线性标度。对于每种机制，我们推导解析和数值解，并阐明其激活条件。引入两个新的公开软件包：(i) xAlpha，一个用于计算和整理标量-张量理论中扰动方程的 Mathematica 包；(ii) escut，一个用于求解非线性标量方程的 Python 模块。在许多情况下，这些工具能够直接从光速 Horndeski 拉格朗日量识别活跃的屏蔽类型。
classification.one_liner: 在光速 Horndeski 理论中推导静态球对称主屏蔽方程，统一分类 Vainshtein、chameleon 及新提出的 Phaedrus 屏蔽并发布配套计算工具。

2608.26271v2.title: Validating Timing-Model Accuracy for Continuous Gravitational Waves: A Comparison of LALSuite and PINT
2608.26271v2.abstract:
We present results of a systematic validation of the \lalsuite{} timing model for continuous gravitational waves against \pint{}, a modern high-accuracy pulsar-timing package. An accurate timing model is essential for tracking the signal phase, and hence for detecting and accurately characterizing continuous gravitational waves. In order to quantify the impact of timing inaccuracies, we derive and validate the leading-order relation $\mu \approx (2\pi f)^2\stddtau^2$, where $\mu$ is the fractional loss of signal power, $f$ is the signal frequency, and $\stddtau^2$ is the variance of the timing errors. We then compare the solar-system and binary components of the \lalsuite{} timing model against the corresponding models in \pint{}. With the original \lalsuite{} Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement is dominated by that component and has $\stddtau\simeq\SI{2.3}{\micro\second}$ (corresponding to $\mu\simeq\SI{0.02}{\percent}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$). With the newer Einstein-delay implementation, the total disagreement (over one year) drops to $\stddtau\lesssim\SI{31}{
ano\second}$ (or $\mu\lesssim
um{4e-8}$ at $f=\SI{1000}{\hertz}$) and is dominated by the observatory contribution to the \Romer{} delay, owing to the approximate Earth-rotation model used by \lalsuite{}. We additionally test binary delays using orbital parameters from 
um{474} catalogued binary pulsars and verify the self-consistency of the \lalsuite{} source-time derivatives. Finally, we derive and discuss the \lalsuite{} Shapiro delay for signals passing through the solar interior, a case only relevant to gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: 验证连续引力波计时模型的精度：LALSuite 与 PINT 的比较
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了对连续引力波 LALSuite 计时模型进行系统性验证的结果，并以高精度现代脉冲星计时软件包 PINT 作为对照。精确的计时模型对于跟踪信号相位，从而探测并准确刻画连续引力波至关重要。为量化计时不准确性的影响，我们推导并验证了领头阶关系 μ ≈ (2π f)^2 stdτ^2，其中 μ 是信号功率的分数损失，f 是信号频率，stdτ^2 是计时误差的方差。随后，我们将 LALSuite 计时模型的太阳系分量和双星分量与 PINT 中对应模型进行比较。使用原始 LALSuite Einstein 延迟实现时，总不一致由该分量主导，stdτ ≈ 2.3 μs（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≈0.02%）。使用较新的 Einstein 延迟实现后，总不一致（一年内）降至 stdτ ≲31 ns（在 f=1000 Hz 对应 μ≲4×10^-8），并由 Roemer 延迟中天文台贡献主导，这是由于 LALSuite 使用了近似地球自转模型。我们还使用来自 474 颗编目双星脉冲星的轨道参数测试双星延迟，并验证 LALSuite 源时导数的自洽性。最后，我们推导并讨论 LALSuite 对穿过太阳内部信号的 Shapiro 延迟，这种情况仅与引力波相关。
classification.one_liner: 系统比较 LALSuite 与 PINT 对连续引力波的计时模型，量化相位误差导致的功率损失，并评估太阳系与双星延迟项差异。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波计时模型验证，匹配‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签；但与全息、量子引力或 AdS/CFT 无直接关系。

2410.11858v2.title: Basic Data Processing of Gravitational Waves
2410.11858v2.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive guide to gravitational wave data processing, with a particular focus on signal generation, noise modeling, and optimization techniques. Beginning with an introduction to gravitational waves and the detection techniques used by LIGO and Virgo, the manual covers the essentials of signal processing, including Fourier analysis, filtering, and the generation of quadratic chirp signals. The analysis of colored Gaussian noise and its impact on interferometric detectors like LIGO is explored in detail, alongside signal detection methods such as the Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT). The paper also delves into optimization techniques like Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), which can be applied to improve signal estimation accuracy. By providing MATLAB-based implementations, this manual serves as both a theoretical and practical resource for researchers in the field of gravitational wave astronomy.

classification.title_zh: 引力波基础数据处理
classification.abstract_zh: 本文提供了引力波数据处理的综合指南，特别关注信号生成、噪声建模和优化技术。首先介绍引力波以及 LIGO 和 Virgo 使用的探测技术，随后涵盖信号处理基础，包括傅里叶分析、滤波和二次啁啾信号的生成。文中详细探讨了有色高斯噪声及其对 LIGO 等干涉探测器的影响，以及广义似然比检验 (GLRT) 等信号检测方法。本文还深入研究了粒子群优化 (PSO) 等优化技术，这些技术可用于提高信号估计精度。通过提供基于 MATLAB 的实现，本手册为引力波天文学领域的研究人员提供了兼具理论和实践价值的资源。
classification.one_liner: 一本关于引力波数据处理的手册，涵盖信号生成、噪声建模与优化技术，并提供 MATLAB 实现。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波数据处理支线，与经典引力重点标签相关；不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

2508.12697v4.title: Constraining initial orbital eccentricity of inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events with an analytic approximant
2508.12697v4.abstract: The LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA consortium has sporadically detected inspiral-dominated gravitational-wave events such as GW170817 and GW190425. These events offer an opportunity to constrain possible initial (residual) orbital eccentricities using inspiral template families. We detail an LALSuite approximant, TaylorF2Ecck, which analytically models inspiral gravitational waves from nonspinning compact binaries in post-Newtonian (PN)-accurate eccentric orbits and restricts initial-eccentricity contributions to leading order. Specifically, our frequency-domain approximant consistently incorporates orbital, advance of periastron, and gravitational-wave emission effects up to 3PN order. We conduct parameter-estimation studies of GW170817 and GW190425 using TaylorF2Ecck, following comprehensive sanity checks to validate model performance and investigate the influence of eccentricity and periastron advance in the relevant parameter space. The results indicate that the initial eccentricity at 20 Hz is negligible within the 90 percent credible intervals (less than 0.016 for GW170817 and less than 0.023 for GW190425, with both posterior distributions railing toward zero), and Bayes factors show no strong evidence favoring the eccentric waveform over the quasicircular waveform. At such negligible initial eccentricities, comparisons between eccentric models with and without periastron advance show no clear signature of this effect, with no significant model-dependent shifts in the posterior distributions and no strong Bayes-factor evidence favoring one model over the other. Additionally, these detailed studies reveal the importance of incorporating initial-eccentricity contributions at least up to 3.5PN order and discuss its implications. We substantiate this inference using versions of the quasicircular TaylorF2 approximant that incorporate Fourier phase contributions beyond the conventional 3.5PN order.

classification.title_zh: 用解析近似模型限制旋进主导引力波事件的初始轨道偏心率
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组已零星探测到GW170817和GW190425等旋进主导的引力波事件。这些事件提供了利用旋进模板族限制可能初始（残余）轨道偏心率的机会。我们详细介绍一个LALSuite近似模型TaylorF2Ecck，它在后牛顿（PN）精度下解析建模非自旋致密双星在偏心轨道上的旋进引力波，并将初始偏心率贡献限制在领头阶。具体而言，我们的频率域近似模型一致地纳入至3PN阶的轨道、近星点进动和引力波辐射效应。我们在进行全面合理性检验以验证模型性能并研究相关参数空间中偏心率与近星点进动影响后，使用TaylorF2Ecck对GW170817和GW190425进行参数估计研究。结果表明，在90%可信区间内，20 Hz处的初始偏心率可忽略（GW170817小于0.016，GW190425小于0.023，两个后验分布均趋向零），贝叶斯因子没有显示出强证据支持偏心波形优于准圆波形。在如此可忽略的初始偏心率下，包含与不包含近星点进动的偏心模型比较未显示该效应的清晰特征，后验分布没有显著依赖模型的移动，也没有强贝叶斯因子证据支持一个模型优于另一个。此外，这些详细研究揭示了至少纳入至3.5PN阶初始偏心率贡献的重要性，并讨论了其意义。我们使用包含超出传统3.5PN阶傅里叶相位贡献的准圆TaylorF2近似模型版本来证实这一推断。
classification.one_liner: 构建TaylorF2Ecck解析近似并用于GW170817/GW190425参数估计，发现初始偏心率在90%可信区间内可忽略。

2510.05883v2.title: Accretion, Jets, and Recoil in a Merging Supermassive Black Hole Binary: A Prompt Electromagnetic Postmerger Counterpart for LISA
2510.05883v2.abstract: We report the first three-dimensional general relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulation to follow, self-consistently in a dynamical spacetime, the magnetized gas around a misaligned-spin supermassive binary black hole, from late inspiral through merger to the gravitational-wave recoil of the remnant. The equal-mass binary, in a $\textit{hang-up kick}$ configuration, is embedded in an equilibrated circumbinary disk (CBD), relaxed for 165 binary orbits before we evolve the final $\sim\!40$ orbits. During the inspiral, each black hole hosts a strongly warped minidisk whose jet follows the local spin axis near the horizon before aligning with the binary's angular momentum farther out. The merger imparts a recoil of $\simeq\!1032$ $km\,s$$^{-1}$ to the remnant, which nonetheless retains its gravitationally bound CBD, and the relaunched jet preserves its pre-merger orientation. The bolometric luminosity brightens by a factor $\sim\!2.2$, powered by merger-driven shocks concentrated within $r \lesssim 15\,M$, and the enhancement persists through the recoil. We identify a distinctive postmerger electromagnetic signature: magnetized structures, generated at coalescence, drive correlated quasi-periodic modulations of the horizon magnetic flux, the Poynting flux, and the thermal output, decoupled from the accretion rate. The postmerger radiative efficiency $L_{\rm EM}/\dot{M}c^2$ rises by a factor $\simeq 2.6$ at nearly constant accretion rate, showing that this emission is powered by the merger rather than accretion. The transient turns on within minutes and lasts at least several hours for a $10^6 \ M_{\odot}$ LISA source, establishing recoiling remnants as prompt postmerger counterparts to massive black hole mergers and a first-principles framework for interpreting candidates such as 3C186.

classification.title_zh: 合并超大质量双黑洞中的吸积、喷流与反冲：LISA 的瞬发电磁并合后对应体
classification.abstract_zh: 我们报告了首个三维广义相对论磁流体动力学模拟，该模拟在动态时空中自洽地追踪了一个自旋错位超大质量双黑洞周围的磁化气体，从晚期旋近经过并合到引力波反冲遗迹的过程。等质量双黑洞处于“悬挂踢出”构型，嵌入在已弛豫的环双星盘中，在演化最后约40个轨道之前已弛豫了165个双星轨道。在旋近期间，每个黑洞都拥有一个强烈扭曲的迷你盘，其喷流在视界附近沿局部自旋轴方向，随后在更远处与双星角动量方向对齐。并合使遗迹获得约1032 km/s的反冲速度，但遗迹仍保留其引力束缚的环双星盘，且重新发射的喷流保持并合前的取向。热光度增亮约2.2倍，由集中在r ≲ 15M范围内的并合驱动激波提供能量，且这种增强在反冲过程中持续存在。我们识别出一个独特的并合后电磁特征：在并合时产生的磁化结构驱动视界磁通量、坡印廷通量和热输出的相关准周期调制，且与吸积率解耦。并合后辐射效率L_EM/Ṁc²在吸积率几乎不变的情况下上升约2.6倍，表明这一辐射由并合而非吸积提供能量。对于10^6倍太阳质量的LISA源，该瞬变现象在几分钟内开启并至少持续数小时，确立了反冲遗迹作为大质量黑洞并合的瞬发并合后对应体，并为解释如3C186这类候选体提供了第一性原理框架。
classification.one_liner: 首次三维广义相对论磁流体模拟显示超大质量双黑洞并合反冲后喷流保持方向，产生由并合而非吸积驱动的瞬发准周期电磁对应体。

2605.10467v2.title: Axial Quasi-normal Modes of Boson-Fermion Stars
2605.10467v2.abstract: We study axial quasi-normal modes of boson-fermion stars composed of ordinary nuclear matter and a self-interacting bosonic dark matter component. The equilibrium configurations are obtained by solving the coupled two-fluid Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations, where the neutron sector is modeled with several realistic equations of state and the bosonic sector is described by a repulsively self-interacting complex scalar field in the strong-coupling regime. We analyze linear axial perturbations governed by a Regge-Wheeler type equation whose effective potential reflects the combined matter distribution. Using a continued-fraction method, we compute the complex eigenfrequencies of the fundamental and overtone $w$ modes. We obtain the quasi-normal mode spectrum and investigate its dependence on the dark matter particle mass, self-coupling, and the central densities of both fluids for several realistic neutron star equations of state. We find that increasing the dark matter fraction shifts the oscillation frequencies and damping times. It can also reorder the mode hierarchy through crossings, and it drives a continuous transition from neutron star-like to boson star-like ringdown behavior. Our results demonstrate that the ringdown gravitational-wave signal from post-merger compact objects could encode clear imprints of a dark matter component, offering a new probe of the dark sector with future gravitational-wave observatories.

classification.title_zh: 玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由普通核物质和自相互作用玻色暗物质成分构成的玻色-费米星的轴向准正规模。平衡位形通过求解耦合的双流体 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程获得，其中中子部分使用若干现实状态方程建模，玻色部分由强耦合区域中具有排斥自相互作用的复标量场描述。我们分析由 Regge-Wheeler 型方程支配的线性轴向微扰，其有效势反映组合物质分布。使用连分式方法，我们计算基频和泛音 w 模的复本征频率。我们得到准正规模谱，并针对若干现实中子星状态方程研究其对暗物质粒子质量、自耦合以及两种流体中心密度的依赖。我们发现，增加暗物质占比会移动振荡频率和阻尼时间。它还可以通过交叉重新排列模式层级，并驱动从中子星型到玻色星型铃宕行为的连续转变。我们的结果表明，后并合致密天体的铃宕引力波信号可以编码暗物质成分的清晰印记，为未来引力波天文台探测暗部门提供新探针。
classification.one_liner: 通过双流体TOV与Regge-Wheeler扰动计算玻色-费米星轴向准正规模，显示暗物质占比改变铃宕频率、阻尼及模式层级。

2606.04910v2.title: Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets
2606.04910v2.abstract: We introduce a novel notion of Ollivier-Ricci curvature for causal sets using Lorentzian optimal transport. The construction is motivated by a new Lorentzian asymptotic formula of independent interest, which recovers timelike Ricci curvature, up to higher-order terms, from the transport distance between probability measures on nearby causal diamonds. Passing to the discrete setting, this leads to a mesoscopic notion of Ricci curvature defined along maximal chains and built from probability measures on causal diamonds. We study several variants, including idle and Lin-Lu-Yau type curvatures, prove local-to-global propagation results and timelike Bonnet-Myers theorems, and compute the curvature for a range of explicit causal sets. We design high-density Poisson sprinkling numerical experiments recovering the expected constant-curvature signatures of Minkowski, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter space. These results provide evidence that the construction captures timelike Ricci curvature from order-theoretic data.

classification.title_zh: 因果集的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用洛伦兹最优传输为因果集引入了一种新的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率概念。该构造由一个本身具有独立意义的新洛伦兹渐近公式驱动；该公式从邻近因果菱形上概率测度之间的传输距离出发，在更高阶项意义下恢复类时 Ricci 曲率。转到离散情形后，这导向一种沿最大链定义、并由因果菱形上的概率测度构建的细观 Ricci 曲率概念。我们研究若干变体，包括 idle 型和 Lin-Lu-Yau 型曲率，证明局部到整体的传播结果以及类时 Bonnet-Myers 定理，并计算一系列显式因果集的曲率。我们设计高密度 Poisson 撒点数值实验，恢复了 Minkowski、de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 空间预期的常曲率特征。这些结果提供了证据，表明该构造从序论数据中捕捉到了类时 Ricci 曲率。
classification.one_liner: 为因果集引入基于洛伦兹最优传输的 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率，并在高密度 Poisson 撒点中恢复 Minkowski、dS、AdS 的常曲率特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文非 AdS/CFT 全息；其核心是洛伦兹几何中的类时 Ricci 曲率、Ollivier-Ricci 曲率与因果集离散构造，与‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签相关，但不属于用户主要全息支线。

2606.21997v2.title: Failure of local equi-Lipschitzness for families of Lorentz distances to Cauchy surface foliations
2606.21997v2.abstract: The families of Lorentzian distance functions to and from points along a complete timelike line in a spacetime are known to be locally equi-Lipschitz continuous in a neighborhood of the line. This is an essential component in the proof of the classical Lorentzian splitting theorems. We show that this property fails in general for families of Lorentzian distances to and from the level sets of a given Cauchy temporal function. Moreover, we formulate conjectures based on the existence of Cauchy temporal functions in cosmological and timelike geodesically complete spacetimes such that the Lorentz distances to its level sets are equi-Lipschitz, which are equivalent to Bartnik's splitting conjecture.

classification.title_zh: Cauchy 面叶状结构的 Lorentz 距离族局部等 Lipschitz 性失效
classification.abstract_zh: 已知在时空中，沿一条完备类时线到其上的点以及从这些点出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，在该线邻域内局部等 Lipschitz 连续。这是经典 Lorentz 分裂定理证明中的关键要素。我们证明，对于给定 Cauchy 时间函数的水平集，到其以及从其出发的 Lorentz 距离函数族，这一性质一般而言会失效。此外，我们基于宇宙学且类时测地完备的时空上存在 Cauchy 时间函数，使得到其水平集的 Lorentz 距离等 Lipschitz，提出若干猜想；这些猜想等价于 Bartnik 分裂猜想。
classification.one_liner: 证明到 Cauchy 时间函数水平集的 Lorentz 距离族一般不局部等 Lipschitz，并给出与 Bartnik 分裂猜想等价的猜想。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典洛伦兹几何/广义相对论中的距离函数、Cauchy 叶状结构与 splitting 猜想，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；与全息对偶无直接关系。

2609.07774v2.title: Search for Long-Transient Gravitational Waves from Supernova SN2023ixf using GFH-v2 Pipeline
2609.07774v2.abstract: We present a directed search for long-transient gravitational waves from the possible newborn magnetar remnant of SN2023ixf, a nearby Type II core-collapse supernova in the M101 galaxy. The analysis uses LIGO Hanford and Livingston data from Engineering Run 15, using coincident data lying within the on-source window associated with the supernova. We target signals from a rapidly rotating, non-axisymmetric neutron star whose spin-down is dominated by gravitational-wave emission, producing a power-law decrease in frequency and a corresponding decrease in strain amplitude. The search is performed with the GFH-v2 pipeline, based on the Generalized Frequency Hough transform. No candidate survives the coincidence and follow-up analysis. We therefore set upper limits on the maximum detectable distance as a function of initial frequency and ellipticity. For the highest ellipticity interval, the 90% upper limits reach distances of about 1-2.5~Mpc across most of the analysed band. Although these limits are below the distance to M101, the search provides the first application of GFH-v2 to a nearby core-collapse supernova and characterizes its performance on real detector data.

classification.title_zh: 利用GFH-v2流程搜寻来自超新星SN2023ixf的长暂现引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了对来自SN2023ixf可能新生磁星遗迹的长暂现引力波的有向搜索，SN2023ixf是M101星系中附近的II型核心坍缩超新星。分析使用LIGO Hanford和Livingston在Engineering Run 15期间的数据，使用与超新星相关的on-source窗口内的符合数据。我们针对快速旋转、非轴对称中子星的信号，其自转减慢由引力波辐射主导，产生频率的幂律下降以及相应的应变振幅下降。搜索使用基于广义频率Hough变换的GFH-v2流程进行。没有候选者通过符合和后续分析。因此，我们设定了最大可探测距离作为初始频率和椭率函数的上限。对于最高椭率区间，90%上限在分析频带大部分达到约1-2.5 Mpc的距离。尽管这些限制低于M101的距离，该搜索提供了GFH-v2对附近核心坍缩超新星的首次应用，并刻画了其在真实探测器数据上的性能。
classification.one_liner: 利用GFH-v2对SN2023ixf磁星遗迹进行长暂现引力波搜索，未发现候选并给出距离上限。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波观测，使用LIGO数据搜寻超新星遗迹的长暂现引力波，并匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息理论。

2609.08801v2.title: Enabling new sampling strategies for continuous-wave analyses by integrating Bilby into PyFstat
2609.08801v2.abstract: Continuous-wave searches for rotating neutron stars usually cover wide parameter spaces and produce a large number of candidate signals. Stochastic sampling methods therefore play an important role in candidate follow-up and parameter estimation. We present the integration of the Bayesian inference library BILBY into the open-source continuous-wave analysis package PyFstat, enabling access to the broad range of stochastic samplers available through BILBY while preserving the existing PyFstat analysis infrastructure. The implementation is validated through injection studies in Gaussian noise for two representative single-stage follow-up configurations: candidates from a directed search and candidates from an all-sky search. Using the nested sampler DYNESTY, we obtain detection efficiencies consistent with the theoretical sensitivity predictions. In this setup, DYNESTY performs comparably to the existing PTEMCEE-based implementation of PyFstat for the directed case, and also provides an effective single-stage approach for the all-sky candidate follow-up considered here, where we did not identify a PTEMCEE setup with similar recovery performance. Percentile-percentile tests for DYNESTY further show well-calibrated credible intervals, demonstrating reliable parameter estimation. While a full exploration of DYNESTY settings, multi-stage setups, and other samplers is left for future work, these results demonstrate that this flexible and publicly available framework opens useful new possibilities for Bayesian continuous-wave analyses.

classification.title_zh: 通过将 Bilby 集成到 PyFstat 实现连续波分析的新采样策略
classification.abstract_zh: 对旋转中子星的连续波搜索通常覆盖宽广参数空间并产生大量候选信号，因此随机采样方法在候选后续跟踪与参数估计中发挥重要作用。我们介绍了将贝叶斯推断库 BILBY 集成到开源连续波分析软件包 PyFstat 中，从而在保留现有 PyFstat 分析基础设施的同时，能够使用 BILBY 提供的广泛随机采样器。我们通过高斯噪声中的注入研究，对两种代表性的单阶段后续跟踪配置（定向搜索候选和全天搜索候选）验证了该实现。使用嵌套采样器 DYNESTY，我们获得了与理论灵敏度预测一致的探测效率。在此设置下，DYNESTY 在定向情形中与 PyFstat 现有的基于 PTEMCEE 的实现表现相当，并且对于此处考虑的全天候选后续跟踪也提供了一种有效的单阶段方法，而我们未找到具有类似恢复性能的 PTEMCEE 设置。DYNESTY 的百分位-百分位检验进一步显示出校准良好的可信区间，表明参数估计可靠。虽然对 DYNESTY 设置、多阶段设置和其他采样器的完整探索留待未来工作，但这些结果表明，这一灵活且公开可用的框架为贝叶斯连续波分析开辟了有用的新可能性。
classification.one_liner: 将 Bilby 集成进 PyFstat，用 Dynesty 等采样器改进连续引力波候选的贝叶斯后续跟踪与参数估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于连续引力波数据分析与贝叶斯采样软件集成，不是理论全息、量子引力或经典引力理论研究；与用户的全息重点方向无关，仅与“经典引力/广义相对论”标签下的引力波/中子星主题有边缘方法学关联。

2601.11106v2.title: The properties of strange quark matter and evolution of strange quark stars
2601.11106v2.abstract: In this work, we study the properties of strange quark matter and reveal the evolution process of strange quark stars employing a self consistent thermodynamic treatment. A comprehensive and reliable thermodynamic basis for the study of the dynamic evolution from proto-strange quark stars to stable strange stars at a zero temperature is provided. The relative abundance of particles, equation of state, temperature, and mass-radius relationship at each stage of the evolution of stars are discussed, where the cold strange quark star are consistent with the observational mass and radius of Hess J1731-347, PSR J1231-1411, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0348+0432, and PSR J0740+6620, which could be difficult to be explained by the standard neutron star model. A schematic diagram is provided as well, illustrating the state of different stages along the evolution of stars at a fixed baryon-mass.

classification.title_zh: 奇异夸克物质的性质与奇异夸克星的演化
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们采用自洽热力学处理研究了奇异夸克物质的性质，并揭示了奇异夸克星的演化过程。我们为研究从原初奇异夸克星到零温稳定奇异星的动力学演化提供了全面而可靠的热力学基础。讨论了恒星演化各阶段的粒子相对丰度、物态方程、温度和质量-半径关系，其中冷奇异夸克星与 Hess J1731-347、PSR J1231-1411、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0348+0432 和 PSR J0740+6620 的观测质量和半径一致，而这些可能难以用标准中子星模型解释。还给出了示意图，说明固定重子质量下恒星演化不同阶段的状态。
classification.one_liner: 采用自洽热力学处理研究奇异夸克物质性质，并刻画从原初奇异夸克星到稳定奇异星的演化及质量-半径关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究奇异夸克物质与奇异夸克星演化，涉及致密星物态方程和观测质量半径，属于经典引力/致密星方向；不涉及全息、量子信息或所列其他重点标签。

2308.16783v2.title: Neutron Star vs Quark Star in the Multimessenger Era
2308.16783v2.abstract: Neutron stars (NSs) and self-bound quark stars (QSs) remain the two primary candidates for the compact objects observed as pulsars and in gravitational-wave (GW) events from binary mergers. Using a physics-agnostic equation of state (EOS) for compact star (CS) matter constructed via nonparametric Gaussian process regression, we perform Bayesian inference of the properties of NSs and QSs by analyzing multimessenger observations from GW170817, PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0030+0451, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0614$-$3329 together with {\it ab initio} calculations from perturbative quantum chromodynamics and chiral effective field theory. We consider competing cases arising from three scenarios: the NS scenario, in which all CSs are NSs; the udQS scenario, in which all CSs are up-down QSs; and the two-family scenario, in which NSs and strange QSs (SQSs) coexist. Our results based on systematic Bayesian model selection indicate that the most favored case belongs to the two-family scenario, with a Bayes factor of $6.1$ relative to the udQS case. In this case, PSR J0740+6620 is favored as an SQS, while the other five CSs, including the two in GW170817, are favored as NSs. The corresponding maximum mass of a static CS is $M_\text{TOV} = 1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_\odot$ for NSs and $M_\text{TOV} = 2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_\odot$ for SQSs at the $68\%$ confidence interval. Moreover, the inferred sound speed in both NS and QS matter increases monotonically and saturates at high densities, whereas a pronounced peak structure is found in the NS scenario. Our work provides a new framework for identifying the nature of individual CSs and constraining the properties of dense matter in both NSs and QSs. In particular, the most favored case provides potential astrophysical support for the absolute stability of strange quark matter according to the Witten hypothesis.

classification.title_zh: 多信使时代的中子星与夸克星
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星（NS）和自束缚夸克星（QS）仍是脉冲星观测以及双星并合引力波（GW）事件中致密天体的两个主要候选。我们使用通过非参数高斯过程回归构建的、对物理模型不敏感的致密星（CS）物质状态方程（EOS），结合GW170817、PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0030+0451、PSR J0437-4715和PSR J0614-3329的多信使观测，以及来自微扰量子色动力学和手征有效场论的第一性原理计算，对中子星和夸克星的性质进行贝叶斯推断。我们考虑三种情景下的竞争情况：NS情景，即所有致密星均为中子星；udQS情景，即所有致密星均为上-下夸克星；以及双家族情景，即中子星与奇异夸克星（SQS）共存。基于系统贝叶斯模型选择的结果表明，最受青睐的情况属于双家族情景，相对于udQS情况的贝叶斯因子为6.1。在该情况下，PSR J0740+6620被倾向于认为是SQS，而其他五颗致密星（包括GW170817中的两颗）被倾向于认为是NS。相应的静态致密星最大质量为：NS的M_TOV=1.72_{-0.16}^{+0.18} M_sun，SQS的M_TOV=2.63_{-0.31}^{+0.36} M_sun（68%置信区间）。此外，推断出的NS和QS物质中的声速都随密度单调增加并在高密度处饱和，而在NS情景中发现一个显著的峰结构。我们的工作为识别单个致密星的性质以及约束NS和QS中致密物质性质提供了新框架。特别地，最受青睐的情况为根据Witten假说奇异夸克物质的绝对稳定性提供了潜在的天体物理支持。
classification.one_liner: 利用多信使观测和贝叶斯模型选择，双家族情景（中子星与奇异夸克星共存）最受青睐，并为奇异夸克物质绝对稳定性提供潜在支持。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要利用多信使观测和贝叶斯推断研究中子星/夸克星状态方程，属于经典引力与致密星/引力波天体物理，而非全息对偶；与用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关，但与全息主线无关。

2604.03707v2.title: A Pontryagin class obstruction for purely electric and purely magnetic Weyl curvature tensors
2604.03707v2.abstract: Do all manifolds that admit Lorentzian metrics also admit such metrics that have a purely electric (PE) or purely magnetic (PM) Weyl curvature tensor? To (partially) answer this question, we show that for all algebraic curvature tensors on a $4k$-dimensional scalar product space that are even or odd under the action of a orientation-reversing isometry, the products of Pontryagin forms that land in the top-degree exterior power of the dual vector space vanish. We use this to derive the vanishing of all products of Pontryagin classes that land in the top-degree de Rham cohomology of a $4k$-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian manifold with a PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensor. For compact manifolds, this gives nontrivial cohomological obstructions to the existence of such pseudo-Riemannian metrics with globally PE or PM Riemann or Weyl curvature tensors. These obstructions can be linked to the existence of Lorentzian metrics of several Petrov subtypes, which play an important role in classifying exact solutions to the Einstein equations. Moreover, they can be applied to foliations by nondegenerate umbilic hypersurfaces, which may appear as timeslices of spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 纯电和纯磁 Weyl 曲率张量的 Pontryagin 类障碍
classification.abstract_zh: 是否所有容许洛伦兹度规的流形也都容许具有纯电（PE）或纯磁（PM）Weyl 曲率张量的此类度规？为了（部分）回答这个问题，我们证明：对于 4k 维标量积空间上所有在定向反转等距作用下为偶或为奇的代数曲率张量，落入对偶向量空间最高次外幂的 Pontryagin 形式乘积都为零。我们由此推出：对于具有 PE 或 PM Riemann 或 Weyl 曲率张量的 4k 维伪黎曼流形，所有落入最高次 de Rham 上同调的 Pontryagin 类乘积都为零。对紧流形，这给出了存在整体 PE 或 PM Riemann 或 Weyl 曲率张量的此类伪黎曼度规的非平凡上同调障碍。这些障碍可与若干 Petrov 子型的洛伦兹度规的存在性相联系，而 Petrov 子型在分类 Einstein 方程精确解中起重要作用。此外，它们可应用于由非退化脐超曲面构成的叶状结构，这些超曲面可作为时空的时间切片出现。
classification.one_liner: 该文用 Pontryagin 类给出伪黎曼/Lorentz 流形上整体纯电或纯磁 Riemann/Weyl 曲率张量存在的上同调障碍，并联系 Petrov 分类与 Einstein 方程精确解。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论洛伦兹/伪黎曼流形、Weyl 曲率、Petrov 分类与 Einstein 方程精确解，属于经典引力/广义相对论主题。

2609.12046v1.title: $\boldsymbol{{\rm AdS}_3}$ Recursion Relations, Double Copy and $\boldsymbol{{\rm CFT}_2}$ Ward Identities
2609.12046v1.abstract: We consider correlation functions of massless fields in three-dimensional Anti-de Sitter spacetime. Using embedding-space spinors akin to spinor helicity variables, we show that masslessness implies holomorphicity. We perform a deformation of the spinors, analogous to the BCFW shift for flat-space amplitudes, to bootstrap correlation functions of Chern-Simons theory in the bulk. We show that the resulting recursion relations in the bulk ${\rm AdS}_3$ are equivalent to the usual ${\rm CFT}_2$ Ward identities for the boundary conserved currents. The double copy of those recursion relations is equivalent to the Ward identities for the stress-energy tensor. Our findings illustrate how modern amplitude techniques can shed new light on CFT correlators, and provide a novel interpretation of fundamental results in two-dimensional conformal field theory.

classification.title_zh: AdS₃ 递推关系、双拷贝与 CFT₂ Ward 恒等式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑三维反德西特时空中无质量场的关联函数。使用类似于旋量螺旋度变量的嵌入空间旋量，我们证明无质量性意味着全纯性。我们对旋量进行形变，这类似于平空间振幅的 BCFW 平移，以 Bootstrap 体内 Chern-Simons 理论的关联函数。我们证明，体内 AdS₃ 中由此得到的递推关系等价于边界守恒流通常的 CFT₂ Ward 恒等式。这些递推关系的双拷贝等价于应力-能量张量的 Ward 恒等式。我们的发现说明现代振幅技术如何能为 CFT 关联函数提供新启示，并为二维共形场论中的基本结果提供一种新解释。
classification.one_liner: 利用类似 BCFW 的 AdS₃ 旋量形变推导体内 Chern-Simons 关联函数的递推关系，并证明其等价于 CFT₂ 守恒流和应力-能量张量的 Ward 恒等式，同时给出双拷贝解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典方向，研究 AdS₃ 体关联函数与 CFT₂ Ward 恒等式及双拷贝；但未落入用户列出的重点支线（如全息超导、相变与气泡成核、QNM、经典引力等）。

2609.12657v1.title: How Far Can Vierbeins Simplify Gravity?
2609.12657v1.abstract: We construct a classical formulation of gravity in terms of the vierbein that makes the Hilbert action polynomial in gravitational perturbations and identify some matter models that admit a polynomial coupling to such perturbations as well. We introduce the density vierbein variables that factorize the inverse metric density while retaining an explicit local Lorentz frame. With the introduction of a new auxiliary field, one can construct an action that is polynomial in such variables and their perturbations. Constructed the BRST complex for the model and derived propagators and interaction rules. In four dimensions, a scalar field with the canonical kinetic term and a potential admits a finite number of coupling terms with the density vierbein perturbations. Among all Horndeski gravity models, only a narrow subclass admits a polynomial coupling to the density vierbein perturbations. For instance, the Einstein--scalar--Gauss--Bonnet model always has an infinite tower of interactions with the density vierbein perturbation. Similarly, the standard kinetic term for the Dirac fermions and the standard kinetic term for a vector field both admit an infinite tower of interactions. Consequently, the density vierbein variables provide a great simplification for scalar-gravitational couplings, but the simplification is not strong enough to produce a realistic model with a finite number of matter-gravity terms.

classification.title_zh: Vierbein 能把引力简化到什么程度？
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了以 vierbein 表述的经典引力，使得希尔伯特作用量对引力扰动是多项式的，并识别出一些允许与这类扰动有多项式耦合的物质模型。我们引入密度 vierbein 变量，这些变量在保留显式局部洛伦兹标架的同时将逆度规密度因子化。通过引入一个新的辅助场，可以构造一个对此类变量及其扰动为多项式的作量。我们构造了该模型的 BRST 复形，并推导了传播子和相互作用规则。在四维中，具有正则动能项和势的标量场允许有限数目的与密度 vierbein 扰动的耦合项。在所有 Horndeski 引力模型中，只有很窄的一类子类允许与密度 vierbein 扰动有多项式耦合。例如，Einstein--标量--Gauss--Bonnet 模型总是与密度 vierbein 扰动有无限塔的相互作用。类似地，狄拉克费米子的标准动能项和矢量场的标准动能项都允许无限塔的相互作用。因此，密度 vierbein 变量为标量-引力耦合提供了极大简化，但这种简化不足以产生一个只有有限数目的物质-引力项的现实模型。
classification.one_liner: 用密度 vierbein 可将希尔伯特作用量对扰动多项式化，但标量之外的物质耦合仍出现无限相互作用塔，简化有限。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论，直接对应经典引力重点标签；但它不涉及全息对偶，也未触及全息超流、p波、multi-trace、QNM 等重点支线。

2609.12781v1.title: Accelerating black holes in higher-derivative gravity
2609.12781v1.abstract: Accelerating black holes in General Relativity are described by the C-metric. We study how this geometry is modified by higher-derivative corrections, focusing on cubic curvature terms of even and odd parity. Using a suitable metric ansatz, we obtain closed-form solutions at first order in the coupling constants. The corrected geometries contain new integration constants, which correspond to physical deformations of the C-metric, and exhibit different behavior depending on the parity of the correction. In particular, parity-violating terms generate an off-diagonal metric component and induce rotation. For AdS solutions, we analyze the thermodynamics, including the Hawking temperature, entropy, and string tensions, and discuss the subtleties in defining the mass and thermodynamic string lengths.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 高阶导数引力中的加速黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，加速黑洞由 C-metric 描述。我们研究高阶导数修正如何修改这一几何，重点关注偶宇称和奇宇称的三次曲率项。利用合适的度规拟设，我们得到在耦合常数一阶的闭式解。修正后的几何包含新的积分常数，它们对应于 C-metric 的物理形变，并且根据修正项的宇称表现出不同行为。特别地，宇称破坏项会产生非对角度规分量并诱导转动。对于 AdS 解，我们分析热力学，包括 Hawking 温度、熵和弦张力，并讨论定义质量和热力学弦长度时的微妙之处。
classification.one_liner: 研究奇/偶宇称三次曲率修正对加速 C-metric 黑洞几何和 AdS 热力学的影响，宇称破坏项会诱导转动并引入新积分常数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的加速黑洞 C-metric 及其高阶导数修正，并涉及 AdS 黑洞热力学，对应‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点支线；但摘要未明确联系 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。

2609.13036v1.title: Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub--NUT spacetimes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet AdS gravity
2609.13036v1.abstract: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub--NUT spacetimes in Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein--K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott--Deser--Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer--Wald formula and includes a Gauss--Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein--Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional thermodynamic charge and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-高斯-博内 AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub--NUT 时空的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究任意偶数维爱因斯坦-高斯-博内 AdS 引力中洛伦兹 Taub--NUT 时空的热力学，这些时空构造为爱因斯坦-凯勒底流形上的 U(1) 纤维丛。我们由表面引力计算温度，并利用离壳 Abbott--Deser--Tekin 形式，将能量作为与稳态 Killing 矢量相关的守恒荷来计算。在同一框架内，我们将熵作为视界 Noether 荷获得。结果与 Iyer--Wald 公式一致，并包含对 Bekenstein--Hawking 面积律的高斯-博内修正。只要 Misner 弦存在就予以保留，我们建立了一个所有参数均独立变化的第一定律，其中 NUT 参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外一个热力学荷及其共轭势，我们将其显式确定。我们还简要讨论了静态极限。
classification.one_liner: 在任意偶数维爱因斯坦-高斯-博内 AdS 引力中，用离壳 ADT 与 Iyer-Wald 方法计算洛伦兹 Taub-NUT 时空的热力学量，并建立包含 NUT 参数独立变化的第一定律。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线中的 AdS 黑洞热力学与守恒荷研究，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但未涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶、量子信息或凝聚态应用。

2609.13067v1.title: Dominant Young Diagrams in Matrix Models and Partial Deconfinement
2609.13067v1.abstract: We discuss dominant representations (or Young diagrams), in thermal matrix models with gauge symmetry from the perspective of partial deconfinement. We propose a prescription for defining the dominant representations for thermal matrix models with interaction terms. As an explicit example, we consider the large-$N$ Gaussian matrix model. We obtain the VKLS shape of the dominant Young diagrams through a new analytic saddle-point analysis based on a mapping of the representation theory of U($\infty$) to free fermions in two spacetime dimensions. This computation provides a direct derivation of the previously observed functional relation between the shape of the dominant Young diagrams and the eigenvalue distribution of the thermal holonomy: the position of the complex saddle point is naturally identified with the eigenvalue. The dominant Young diagrams admit a natural interpretation in terms of partial deconfinement: the number of rows in the dominant Young diagrams matches the size of the submatrix corresponding to the deconfined subsector.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 矩阵模型中的主导杨图与部分去禁闭
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从部分去禁闭的视角讨论具有规范对称性的热矩阵模型中的主导表示（或杨图）。我们提出一种方案，用于定义带相互作用项的热矩阵模型的主导表示。作为一个显式例子，我们考虑大 N 高斯矩阵模型。通过一种新的解析鞍点分析，基于将 U(∞) 表示论映射到二维时空中的自由费米子，我们得到了主导杨图的 VKLS 形状。该计算直接推导了此前观测到的主导杨图形状与热 holonomy 本征值分布之间的函数关系：复鞍点的位置自然被认同为本征值。主导杨图在部分去禁闭方面具有自然解释：主导杨图中的行数与对应于去禁闭子扇区的子矩阵大小相匹配。
classification.one_liner: 通过将 U(∞) 表示论映射到二维自由费米子，解析推导热大 N 高斯矩阵模型中主导杨图的 VKLS 形状，并将其与部分去禁闭的子矩阵尺寸联系起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及大 N 矩阵模型、部分去禁闭与热 holonomy 本征值分布，属于矩阵模型/规范理论方向，并与相变/热力学转变相关；但摘要未明确出现 AdS/CFT 对偶、经典引力，也未直接匹配超流、p 波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM 或探针膜等用户重点标签。

2609.13104v1.title: Thermodynamic topology of AdS black holes with $F^{\alpha\beta}F^{\gamma\lambda}R_{\alpha\gamma}R_{\beta\lambda}$ coupling in the grand canonical ensemble
2609.13104v1.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic and topological phase structure of charged AdS black holes with a nonminimal gauge--curvature coupling in the grand canonical ensemble. Working perturbatively in the nonminimal coupling, we find a rich phase structure as the electric potential is varied, including several distinct regimes of critical behavior, a double-critical region, and a regime where conventional criticality disappears. We complement the conventional thermodynamic analysis with a topological description based on the winding number of the thermodynamic vector field. The resulting $r_h$--$\tau$ diagrams reveal that the ordering and morphology of the black-hole branches depend sensitively on both the pressure and the off-shell inverse temperature, with monotonic, disconnected, S-shaped, and cusp-like structures appearing in different parameter ranges. Remarkably, these substantial rearrangements of the solution branches can occur without changing the global winding number. In particular, the system remains in the $W=+1$ topological class beyond the range of conventional criticality, before eventually entering a $W=0$ sector. Our results demonstrate that thermodynamic topology provides complementary global information that is not captured by conventional local criticality criteria alone.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 大正则系综中具有 $F^{\alpha\beta}F^{\gamma\lambda}R_{\alpha\gamma}R_{\beta\lambda}$ 耦合的 AdS 黑洞的热力学拓扑
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究大正则系综中具有非最小规范-曲率耦合的带电 AdS 黑洞的热力学与拓扑相结构。在非最小耦合中做微扰处理，我们发现随电势变化出现丰富的相结构，包括若干不同的临界行为区间、一个双临界区域，以及常规临界性消失的区间。我们用基于热力学矢量场绕数的拓扑描述来补充常规热力学分析。得到的 $r_h$--$\tau$ 图表明，黑洞分支的排序与形态敏感地依赖于压强和非壳层逆温度，在不同参数范围内出现单调、断开、S 形和尖点状结构。值得注意的是，这些解分支的重大重排可以在不改变全局绕数的情况下发生。特别地，系统在超出常规临界性范围后仍处于 $W=+1$ 拓扑类，随后最终进入 $W=0$ 区域。我们的结果表明，热力学拓扑提供了常规局域临界性判据无法捕捉的互补全局信息。
classification.one_liner: 在大正则系综中，非最小规范-曲率耦合带电 AdS 黑洞表现出丰富热力学相结构；其分支重排可由绕数拓扑刻画，且可发生在全局绕数不变时。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 AdS 黑洞在大正则系综中的热力学相变、临界性与拓扑描述，属于经典引力/黑洞热力学支线；摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT 对偶、边界 CFT 或量子信息，因此不归为理论全息。

2609.13137v1.title: Mixed state entanglement measures for open string geometry
2609.13137v1.abstract: In the gauge/gravity framework flavor degrees of freedom are introduced to the gauge theory side through the insertion of probe flavor $D$ branes in the supergravity background. Scalar, vector or spinor fluctuations on theses flavor branes perceive neither the background supergravity metric nor the worldvolume-induced metric of the flavor branes. Indeed, they follow an effective metric called the open string metric (OSM). Through a proper choice of worldvolume gauge fields, one can induce a horizon structure in these OSMs. Studying holographic information-theoretic quantities in these kinds of geometries is equivalent to studying information-theoretic quantities in the flavor sector on the gauge theory side. In this article, we have studied various information-theoretic measures like mutual information, entanglement wedge cross-section and entanglement negativity for an open string geometry. All the calculations are done by considering strip-like parallel boundary subsystems for three- and four-dimensional OSMs. We have also measured the change in these mixed-state information-theoretic quantities from the relevant quantities in the pure AdS geometry due to the application of a background electric field.

classification.title_zh: 开弦几何的混合态纠缠度量
classification.abstract_zh: 在规范/引力框架中，味自由度通过将探针味 D 膜插入超引力背景而引入规范理论侧。这些味膜上的标量、矢量或旋量涨落并不感知背景超引力度规，也不感知味膜的世界体积诱导度规。实际上，它们遵循一个称为开弦度规（OSM）的有效度规。通过适当选择世界体积规范场，可以在这些 OSM 中诱导出视界结构。研究这类几何中的全息信息论量等价于研究规范理论侧味部门的信息论量。在本文中，我们研究了开弦几何的各种信息论度量，如互信息、纠缠楔截面和纠缠负性。所有计算均针对三维和四维 OSM，并考虑条带状平行边界子系统。我们还测量了由于施加背景电场，这些混合态信息论量相对于纯 AdS 几何中相应量的变化。
classification.one_liner: 在探针味D膜诱导的开弦几何中计算互信息、纠缠楔截面与纠缠负性，并考察背景电场带来的混合态信息量修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息纠缠信息量计算，使用探针味D膜/开弦几何，与探针膜及全息量子信息方向相关；但摘要未具体指明D3-D7/D3-D5或Floquet驱动。

2609.11979v1.title: Future Completeness, $C^0$-Inextendibility and Cauchy Horizons in Homogeneous Einstein Spacetimes
2609.11979v1.abstract: We prove the future-completeness conjecture of G\"odeke and Rendall for expanding spatially homogeneous vacuum spacetimes in four spatial dimensions. More generally, an expansion-energy estimate gives future timelike and null geodesic completeness for homogeneous Einstein equations coupled to maps into complete Riemannian targets, through nine spatial dimensions for vanishing potential. In arbitrary dimension we obtain an affine-length criterion which includes positive potential floors and potentials that decay sufficiently slowly along the scalar trajectory. For future-global homogeneous solutions, the critical nine-dimensional bound also holds for a general stress tensor in an explicit normal energy-condition window, including a broad range of perfect fluids. At the opposite time end, we establish a quotient-stable $C^0$-inextendibility criterion for two-step nilpotent cosmologies. Its proof combines boundary localization with an optimal, intrinsically defined allocation of the central correction in timelike homotopies, and continues to apply when the diameter of compact spatial slices collapses. Exact Heisenberg solutions realize both conclusions. On every fixed compact Bianchi~II quotient, the expanding invariant vacuum data split into an open dense set with globally $C^0$-inextendible developments and a codimension-two locally rotationally symmetric locus with analytic compact Cauchy horizons. We determine the chronology-violating region of the exceptional extensions and quantify the exponentially small proper-time scale on which transverse anisotropy replaces the horizon by a singular end.

classification.title_zh: 齐次爱因斯坦时空中的未来完备性、C^0-不可延拓性与Cauchy视界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明了 Gödeke 和 Rendall 的关于四个空间维度中膨胀空间齐次真空时空的未来完备性猜想。更一般地，一个膨胀-能量估计给出了齐次爱因斯坦方程与映入完备黎曼靶空间的映射耦合时的未来类时和零测地线完备性，在势为零时直到九个空间维度成立。在任意维数下，我们得到一个仿射长度判据，其中包含正势下界以及沿标量轨迹衰减足够慢的势。对于未来全局齐次解，临界的九维界在显式正规能量条件窗口内对一般应力张量也成立，包括广泛范围的完美流体。在相反的时间端，我们为两步幂零宇宙学建立了一个商稳定的 C^0-不可延拓性判据。其证明结合了边界局域化与类时同伦中中心修正的最优、内蕴定义的分配，并且当紧致空间切片的直径塌缩时仍然适用。精确的 Heisenberg 解实现了这两个结论。在每个固定的紧致 Bianchi II 商上，膨胀的不变真空数据分裂为一个开稠密集，其发展是全局 C^0-不可延拓的，以及一个余二维的局部旋转对称轨迹，具有解析紧致 Cauchy 视界。我们确定了例外延拓的破坏时间序区域，并量化了横向各向异性将视界替换为奇异端点的指数小固有时尺度。
classification.one_liner: 证明齐次爱因斯坦时空的未来完备性猜想，并给出 C^0-不可延拓性判据与 Bianchi II Cauchy 视界分类。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与数学宇宙学，直接对应重点关注标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.12025v1.title: Komar superpotentials in extended theories of gravity
2609.12025v1.abstract: This paper investigates Lagrangians with arbitrary dependence on the Riemann tensor and any number of derivatives. Noether's second theorem is applied separately to ${\cal L}_{G}$ and ${\cal L}_{M}$, where the matter Lagrangian depends on a scalar field. For ${\cal L}_{G}$ diffeomorphism invariance requires that the generalized Einstein tensor satisfy $\nabla_{\alpha}E^{\alpha\beta}=0$ and that there is a current satisfying $0=\partial_{\alpha}(\sqrt{g}\, J^{\alpha}_{G2})$. The main result is an explicit formula for the superpotential $\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}$ that solves $\partial_{\mu}\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}=\sqrt{g}\,J^{\alpha}_{G2}$. Some applications to $f(R)$ gravity and various quadratic gravity theories are discussed. There are analogous results, including superpotentials, for the matter sector whenever the couplings to the matter fields contain derivatives of the metric.

classification.title_zh: 扩展引力理论中的 Komar 超势
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了任意依赖于黎曼张量及任意阶导数的拉格朗日量。Noether 第二定理分别应用于 L_G 和 L_M，其中物质拉格朗日量依赖于一个标量场。对于 L_G，微分同胚不变性要求广义爱因斯坦张量满足 ∇_α E^{αβ}=0，并且存在一个流满足 0=∂_α(√g J_G2^α)。主要结果是显式给出超势 Φ^{[αμ]} 的公式，使其满足 ∂_μ Φ^{[αμ]}=√g J_G2^α。文中还讨论了对 f(R) 引力及各种二次引力理论的一些应用。对于物质部分，当物质场耦合包含度规导数时，也有类似结果，包括超势。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Noether 第二定理，为任意依赖黎曼张量及其导数的引力拉格朗日量构造出 Komar 型超势，并应用于 f(R) 与二次引力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究扩展引力理论中的守恒量与 Komar 超势，符合用户列出的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2609.12773v1.title: Intrinsic pressure anisotropy in spherical Proca stars
2609.12773v1.abstract: Pressure anisotropy in relativistic stars is commonly prescribed through a phenomenological closure, obscuring its microscopic origin and relation to stress-energy conservation. Here it is derived directly from the minimally coupled Einstein-complex-Proca theory. For spherical Proca stars, the principal-pressure difference admits an exact on-shell form whose sign is controlled solely by the local mass-shell threshold. The stress is radially dominated in the core, reverses on a surface of fixed gravitational redshift, and becomes tangentially dominated in the envelope. At the first mass maximum, the fractional anisotropy reaches about 21% near the density maximum, whilst the region beyond the reversal contains about 9% of the mass. Its exact atmospheric limit is approximately 24%, equal in magnitude and opposite in sign to the scalar-boson-star limit. Because the usual local fluid variables remain non-zero at the crossing, no sign-definite closure constructed from them can reproduce the profile. These results identify an intrinsically vectorial stress reversal, generated without additional interactions, and provide a first-principles benchmark for anisotropic bosonic compact objects.

classification.title_zh: 球对称 Proca 星中的内禀压强各向异性
classification.abstract_zh: 相对论星体中的压强各向异性通常通过唯象闭合关系给定，掩盖了其微观起源与应力-能量守恒的关系。这里，它直接从最小耦合的 Einstein-复 Proca 理论导出。对于球对称 Proca 星，主压强差具有精确在壳形式，其符号完全由局部质量壳阈值控制。在核心区应力以径向为主，在固定引力红移的表面上反转，并在包层中变为切向为主。在第一个质量极大处，分数各向异性在密度极大附近达到约 21%，而反转之外的区域包含约 9% 的质量。其精确大气极限约为 24%，大小相等、符号相反于标量玻色子星极限。由于通常的局域流体变量在交叉处仍非零，任何由它们构造的符号确定的闭合关系都无法重现该分布。这些结果识别出一种内禀的矢量应力反转，无需额外相互作用即可产生，并为各向异性玻色型致密天体提供了第一性原理基准。
classification.one_liner: 从最小耦合 Einstein-复 Proca 理论直接导出球对称 Proca 星的内禀压强各向异性与应力反转，并给出质量极大处的各向异性基准。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与致密天体（Proca 星）方向，非全息/AdS 研究；与用户的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关。

2609.12828v1.title: Nonlinear Degrees of Freedom of Born-Infeld New Massive Gravity
2609.12828v1.abstract: Born-Infeld New Massive Gravity (BINMG) is an all-order curvature extension of New Massive Gravity in three dimensions, whose linearized spectrum around its unique maximally symmetric vacuum contains the two polarizations of a massive spin-two field. Whether an additional scalar degree of freedom appears in the full nonlinear theory has remained an open question. We perform a nonlinear canonical analysis of BINMG using its auxiliary-metric formulation. On the regular branch connected to the maximally symmetric vacuum, the Dirac algorithm yields three first-class diffeomorphism constraints and a second-class pair of scalar constraints. The resulting count gives exactly two local degrees of freedom per spatial point. Thus, nonlinear BINMG propagates no additional Boulware-Deser-type scalar mode on this branch.

classification.title_zh: Born-Infeld 新质量引力的非线性自由度
classification.abstract_zh: Born-Infeld 新质量引力（BINMG）是三维新质量引力的全阶曲率扩展，其围绕唯一极大对称真空的线性化谱包含一个大质量自旋二场的两个极化。完整非线性理论中是否出现额外标量自由度一直是一个未决问题。我们利用其辅助度规表述对 BINMG 进行非线性正则分析。在与极大对称真空相连的正则分支上，Dirac 算法给出三个第一类微分同胚约束和一对第二类标量约束。所得计数恰好对应每个空间点两个局域自由度。因此，非线性 BINMG 在该分支上不传播额外的 Boulware-Deser 型标量模。
classification.one_liner: 通过非线性 Dirac 约束分析证明 BINMG 在正则分支上仅有二个局域自由度，无额外 Boulware-Deser 标量模。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究经典引力/修改引力理论的非线性自由度与约束结构，属于经典引力支线，但与全息 AdS/CFT 研究无直接关联。

2609.13061v1.title: Particlelike solutions of the Einstein-Dirac-Higgs equations: ground, excited, and many-fermion states
2609.13061v1.abstract: We present an extended study of the gravitationally localized soliton-like solutions to the minimally-coupled Einstein-Dirac-Higgs equations, embedded in asymptotically Minkowski spacetimes. The equations of motion describing these Yukawa-coupled Dirac stars are generalized to any even number of constituent fermions. We first expand the discussion of two-fermion ground-state solutions initially analyzed in Leith et al. [Phys. Rev. D. 107, 106020 (2023)]. Upon extending our analysis to excited states and many-fermion states, we find that both exhibit different behaviors to their two-fermion ground-state counterparts. In these excited states and many-fermion states, the Higgs field may exhibit stepwise increases and at times decrease within the soliton, which has not been seen for the two-fermion ground states. We also propose the potential cause of a significant degree of ADM-to-fermion mass disparity, which is present in states with strong Yukawa-coupling.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程的类粒子解：基态、激发态与多费米子态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们扩展研究了最小耦合爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程在渐近闵可夫斯基时空中的引力局域化类孤子解。描述这些汤川耦合狄拉克星的方程被推广到任意偶数个组成费米子。我们首先扩展了对 Leith 等人 [Phys. Rev. D. 107, 106020 (2023)] 最初分析的两费米子基态解的讨论。将分析推广到激发态和多费米子态后，我们发现两者表现出与两费米子基态对应物不同的行为。在这些激发态和多费米子态中，希格斯场可能呈现阶梯式增加，有时在孤子内部减少，这在两费米子基态中未曾见过。我们还提出在强汤川耦合态中存在的显著 ADM 质量与费米子质量差异的可能原因。
classification.one_liner: 研究爱因斯坦-狄拉克-希格斯方程在渐近闵可夫斯基时空中的类孤子解，并推广至激发态与多费米子态。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线的自引力孤子与狄拉克星研究，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；但与用户列出的经典引力重点标签直接相关。

2609.13129v1.title: Tidal Love numbers of wormholes as black-hole mimickers
2609.13129v1.abstract: We study the dynamical scalar tidal Love numbers of wormholes that provide viable mimickers for black holes, focusing on thin-shell Schwarzschild and Damour-Solodukhin geometries. Using a matched near- and far-zone expansion, we determine their tidal response in the low-frequency regime. The presence of a long throat introduces an additional characteristic scale and naturally separates the modes into two classes. Super-throat modes probe the global wormhole geometry and are sensitive to both asymptotic regions, whereas sub-throat modes probe only one side of the wormhole and effectively perceive the throat as a black-hole horizon. We derive the scalar tidal Love numbers analytically for both classes of modes and show that their dissipative parts exhibit distinct low-frequency behavior, reflecting whether one or both potential barriers participate in the scattering process. We further find that, as the wormhole approaches the black-hole limit, the super-throat contribution becomes progressively negligible, while the sub-throat response smoothly reduces to that of a Schwarzschild black hole. These results demonstrate that the tidal response of wormholes depends crucially on whether the perturbation probes the global structure of the throat.

classification.title_zh: 作为黑洞模拟体的虫洞潮汐洛夫数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了可作为黑洞可行模拟体的虫洞的动力学标量潮汐洛夫数，重点关注薄壳史瓦西和 Damour-Solodukhin 几何。利用近区-远区匹配展开，我们在低频区域确定了它们的潮汐响应。长喉的存在引入了额外特征尺度，自然将模式分为两类。超喉模式探测整体虫洞几何并对两个渐近区域都敏感，而亚喉模式只探测虫洞一侧，并有效将喉视为黑洞视界。我们对两类模式解析导出了标量潮汐洛夫数，并表明其耗散部分展现出不同的低频行为，反映了散射过程中是一个还是两个势垒参与。进一步发现，当虫洞趋近黑洞极限时，超喉贡献逐渐可忽略，而亚喉响应平滑退化为史瓦西黑洞的结果。这些结果表明虫洞的潮汐响应关键取决于扰动是否探测喉的整体结构。
classification.one_liner: 研究薄壳虫洞的标量潮汐洛夫数，发现长喉将模式分为超喉和亚喉两类，并在黑洞极限下恢复史瓦西响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究经典引力中的虫洞潮汐响应，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与用户重点标签高度匹配。

2411.19172v2.title: Revisit the relationship between spread complexity rate and radial momentum
2411.19172v2.abstract: This article discusses the relationship between the boundary spread complexity rate and the radial momentum in the bulk within the framework of AdS/CFT. We demonstrate that the radial momentum of a freely falling particle, as measured by a stationary observer in the bulk, is equal to the spread complexity rate of the boundary conformal field theory. This relationship has been discussed in two previous works, but their formulations appear distinct. However, this paper demonstrates their consistency. While earlier studies focused on particles with large mass and massless particles, we show that the relationship \textit{formally} holds for particles of any mass. Additionally, we provide a simple method for obtaining spread complexity from radial momentum using optical geometry.

classification.title_zh: 重新审视扩展复杂度率与径向动量的关系
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在 AdS/CFT 框架下讨论边界扩展复杂度率与体径向动量之间的关系。我们证明，体中的静止观察者所测得的自由下落粒子的径向动量，等于边界共形场论的扩展复杂度率。此前两项工作讨论过该关系，但其表述似乎不同；本文证明它们是一致的。早期研究关注大质量粒子与无质量粒子，而我们表明该关系在形式上对任意质量粒子都成立。此外，我们提供了一种利用光学几何从径向动量得到扩展复杂度的方法。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/CFT 中证明边界扩展复杂度率等于体内静止观察者测得的自由下落粒子径向动量，并统一此前表述且推广到任意质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 全息复杂度主题，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、探针膜与Floquet驱动、QNM与非线性演化、相变与气泡成核等具体重点支线。

2512.19498v2.title: Six-loop gravitational interactions at the sixth post-Newtonian order
2512.19498v2.abstract: We compute the gravitational interaction of two coalescing compact objects at sixth post-Newtonian order in the static limit, employing the diagrammatic approach within the effective field theory framework of General Relativity. The calculation requires the evaluation of six-loop Feynman diagrams that are mapped onto two-point integrals with a gauge-theory-like structure, which are computed here for the first time. The resulting seventh-order contribution in Newton's constant is finite in three space dimensions. This result provides the most technically demanding missing ingredient for the determination of the conservative dynamics of the gravitational two-body system at sixth post-Newtonian order.

classification.title_zh: 第六后牛顿阶的六圈引力相互作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们采用广义相对论有效场论框架中的图方法，计算了两个并合致密天体在第六后牛顿阶静态极限下的引力相互作用。该计算需要计算六圈费曼图，这些图映射到具有类似规范理论结构的两点积分，并在此首次计算。所得牛顿常数七阶贡献在三维空间中是有限的。这一结果为确定第六后牛顿阶引力双体系统的保守动力学提供了技术上要求最高的缺失要素。
classification.one_liner: 在广义相对论有效场论框架下首次计算六圈费曼图，得到第六后牛顿阶静态极限引力相互作用及牛顿常数七阶有限贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的后牛顿近似与双体保守动力学，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2603.18147v2.title: Branching Universes
2603.18147v2.abstract: We propose the idea that our Universe is a realization among different possible branches, which can be observationally tested through the modified dispersion relation of the gravitational waves. We achieve this through a framework of spatially constrained vector fields. We show that the simplest realizations of such theories in flat and cosmological spacetimes do not introduce new propagating modes, but they give rise to tensor perturbations that differ from those of standard general relativity. As a result, they avoid the strong coupling issues or ghost modes that otherwise easily appear in vector-field models. We further show that such theories admit stealth black hole solutions, and we recover weak gravitational potentials, thus passing the solar system experiments. Finally, we discuss the implications of such theories and propose further generalizations.

classification.title_zh: 分支宇宙
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个想法：我们的宇宙是不同可能分支中的一种实现，可通过引力波的修正色散关系进行观测检验。我们通过空间约束矢量场框架实现这一点。我们表明，这类理论在平直和宇宙学时空中的最简单实现不会引入新的传播模式，但会产生不同于标准广义相对论的张量扰动。因此，它们避免了矢量场模型中容易出现的强耦合问题或鬼模。我们进一步表明，这类理论允许 stealth 黑洞解，并且我们恢复了弱引力势，从而通过太阳系实验。最后，我们讨论这些理论的含义并提出进一步推广。
classification.one_liner: 提出用空间约束矢量场构造分支宇宙框架，预言引力波修正色散关系，同时避免鬼模并保留 stealth 黑洞与太阳系检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典/修改引力与宇宙学，涉及引力波色散和 stealth 黑洞；与全息无关，但契合经典引力重点标签。

2606.27308v2.title: Universal Lichnerowicz Lifting of Near-Horizon Soft Modes
2606.27308v2.abstract: A recurring universality appears in the low-temperature quantum thermodynamics of near-extremal black holes, where distinct parent geometries often lead to the same logarithmic temperature dependence at one loop. In this work, we study the Lichnerowicz spectral origin of this infrared universality and understand why the relevant spectral data become insensitive to the details of the parent geometry. For extremal near-horizon geometries containing a two-dimensional maximally symmetric throat, we construct the normalizable transverse-traceless tensor zero modes associated with near-horizon reparametrizations. Turning on a small temperature lifts these zero modes through the first-order deformation of the Lichnerowicz operator. Although the local matrix element depends on detailed parent-geometry data, these data cancel after projection onto normalized tensor modes, leaving the universal result. For static spherically symmetric backgrounds, the resulting eigenvalue shift is proportional to the Fourier mode number and temperature. For rotating backgrounds, the same structure persists in the near-horizon reparametrization tensor sector, while angular warp factors only modify the overall projection factor. We fix the normalized coefficient explicitly, showing how radial integration and bulk normalization remove the near-horizon Taylor coefficients. We further show that this lifted bulk spectrum is the Lichnerowicz realization of the Schwarzian soft sector. Thus, the universal one-loop temperature dependence in the tensor sector is traced to an infrared bulk-boundary matching between near-horizon tensor zero modes and boundary reparametrization dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 近视界软模的普适 Lichnerowicz 提升
