classification.abstract_zh: 近极端黑洞的低温柔量热力学中反复出现一种普适性：不同的母几何往往在一圈层次给出相同的对数温度依赖。本文研究这种红外普适性的 Lichnerowicz 谱起源，并理解为何相关谱数据对母几何细节不敏感。对于包含二维最大对称喉部的极端近视界几何，我们构造与近视界重参数化相关的可归一化横向无迹张量零模。开启小温度会通过 Lichnerowicz 算符的一阶形变抬起这些零模。尽管局域矩阵元依赖于详细的母几何数据，但在投影到归一化张量模后这些数据相消，留下普适结果。对于静态球对称背景，所得本征值移动正比于傅里叶模数和温度。对于旋转背景，同样的结构在近视界重参数化张量扇区中持续存在，而角度翘曲因子仅修改整体投影因子。我们显式固定归一化系数，展示径向积分和体归一化如何消除近视界泰勒系数。我们进一步表明，这个被抬升的体谱是 Schwarzian 软扇区的 Lichnerowicz 实现。因此，张量扇区中普适的一圈温度依赖被追溯到近视界张量零模与边界重参数化动力学之间的红外体-边界匹配。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Lichnerowicz 谱分析，近极端黑洞近视界张量零模在有限温度下的提升是普适的，并对应边界 Schwarzian 软扇区。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心是近极端黑洞/近视界软模与 Schwarzian 全息，方法上涉及 Lichnerowicz 算符的经典引力微扰谱，因此与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关；但不属于全息超流、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7 等重点标签。

2608.21127v2.title: BMPV black holes in higher-derivative supergravity
2608.21127v2.abstract: There are five independent four-derivative superinvariants for the five-dimensional STU model, of which two are vector invariants that do not involve curvature tensors. We construct the corrected BMPV black hole directly in five dimensions with this set of general four-derivative couplings, a computation made possible with the help of AI. We find that the vector invariants do not correct the solution or the entropy, while the entropy associated with the heterotic corrections agrees with recent results.

classification.title_zh: 高导数超引力中的 BMPV 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 对于五维 STU 模型，存在五个独立的四导数超不变量，其中两个是不含曲率张量的矢量不变量。我们利用这组一般的四导数耦合，直接在五维中构造了修正后的 BMPV 黑洞；这一计算借助 AI 得以完成。我们发现，矢量不变量不会修正该解或熵，而与异质弦修正相关的熵与近期结果一致。
classification.one_liner: 用五维 STU 超引力的四导数不变量构造修正 BMPV 黑洞，发现矢量不变量不改变解与熵，异质弦修正的熵与近期结果一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究高导数超引力中的经典黑洞解与熵修正，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶；与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关，但与全息凝聚态、QNM、相变等具体支线无直接交集。

2604.07400v2.title: Quasinormal-mode residues and pole coalescence in hypergeometric black-hole models
2604.07400v2.abstract: We study source-normalized quasinormal-mode residues in radial boundary-value problems reducible to the Gauss hypergeometric equation. Hypergeometric connection coefficients separate the spectral condition from the normalization and spatial dependence of the frequency-domain Green function. We illustrate this construction for Dirichlet modes of the rotating Ba\~nados--Teitelboim--Zanelli black hole and mixed boundary conditions in two-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetime, and then apply it to the P\"oschl--Teller/Nariai problem. Near pole coalescence, we obtain finite-position residues for the two simple poles, while at the critical point both coefficients of the second-order Laurent expansion are reduced to closed finite sums. The subleading coefficient depends explicitly on the frequency derivative of the Green-function numerator and is therefore not determined by the spectral function alone. We also identify the range in which the usual vanishing-discriminant criterion characterizes the P\"oschl--Teller coalescence: it holds for the positive barrier considered here, whereas other double zeros or cancellations can occur outside that regime. These results provide a normalization-controlled analytic benchmark for relating spectral coalescence to sourced quasinormal response.

classification.title_zh: 超几何黑洞模型中的准正规模残数与极点并合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究可化为高斯超几何方程的径向边值问题中源归一化的准正规模残数。超几何连接系数将谱条件与频域格林函数的归一化和空间依赖性分离。我们以旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli 黑洞的 Dirichlet 模和二维反 de Sitter 时空中的混合边界条件为例说明该构造，然后将其应用于 Pöschl-Teller/Nariai 问题。在极点并合附近，我们得到两个单极点的有限位置残数，而在临界点，二阶 Laurent 展开的两个系数都化为闭式有限和。次领头系数显式依赖于格林函数分子的频率导数，因此不能仅由谱函数决定。我们还确定了通常的判别式消失判据刻画 Pöschl-Teller 并合的范围：对于此处考虑的正势垒它成立，而在该范围之外可能出现其他二重零点或相消。这些结果为将谱并合与有源准正规模响应联系起来提供了一个归一化控制的解析基准。
classification.one_liner: 用超几何连接系数研究黑洞准正规模残数与极点并合，并给出有限残数及临界点 Laurent 系数的解析基准。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究黑洞准正规模的解析结构、残数与极点并合，涉及 BTZ/AdS2 和经典引力；与 QNM 和经典引力标签相关，但未直接讨论全息对偶或凝聚态应用。

2604.27980v2.title: Mass inflation and thin shells in quasi-topological gravity
2604.27980v2.abstract: We study the null junction conditions in (re-summed) quasi-topological gravity theories, showing that no null thin shells exist within the realms of standard distributional theory for the pure gravity regular black hole solutions we have analyzed. This implies that the usual derivation of the mass inflation instability, which makes use of null thin shells, is not applicable in these theories. The problem of stability of inner horizons of regular black holes in quasi-topological gravity is hence still open and must be addressed with a more refined analysis, which does not rely on thin shells or the vacuum condition.

classification.title_zh: 准拓扑引力中的质量膨胀与薄壳
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究（重求和）准拓扑引力理论中的零类接头条件，表明在我们所分析的一类纯引力规则黑洞解中，标准分布理论框架下不存在零薄壳。这意味着通常利用零薄壳的质量膨胀不稳定性推导在这些理论中不适用。因此，准拓扑引力中规则黑洞内视界的稳定性问题仍然开放，必须通过不依赖薄壳或真空条件的更精细分析来处理。
classification.one_liner: 在准拓扑引力中，标准分布理论下不存在零薄壳，因此基于零薄壳的质量膨胀推导不适用于所分析的规则黑洞，内视界稳定性仍待更精细分析。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要聚焦准拓扑引力中规则黑洞内视界与质量膨胀的经典时空分析，未涉及 AdS/CFT、纠缠或量子信息；但与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线直接相关。

2605.08205v2.title: Analytical solution of traversable wormholes in the presence of positive cosmological constant
2605.08205v2.abstract: The construction of traversable wormholes with a cosmological constant, $\Lambda$, introduces significant challenges and leads to non-trivial modifications of the spacetime geometry. In this work, we obtain an analytical solution describing a locally traversable wormhole for $\Lambda>0$ following a perturbative approach. Starting from the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole geometry, we derive the metric deformation induced by the cosmological constant at linear order, assuming $\Lambda r^2_0\ll 1$, where $r_0$ represents the throat of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole. We further identify the radial domain of validity of the perturbative solution, which is restricted to $r\ll\sqrt{3/\Lambda}$. Within this domain, we find that the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole is modified by the cosmological constant; interestingly, the shape function takes a de Sitter-like form. Nevertheless, we verify that the flare-out condition holds at the deformed throat and find a violation of the null energy condition in its vicinity, as required for traversable WHs. Traversability is further analyzed by evaluating tidal forces and deriving constraints on the velocity required for safe human passage. Additionally, we discuss the possibility of constructing a global extension by matching the perturbative wormhole solution to a Schwarzschild-de Sitter exterior spacetime. Given the recent advances in the observational study of astrophysical compact objects, together with a variety of astrophysical and cosmological observations indicating the existence of a positive cosmological constant, the analytical solution presented here may be of considerable phenomenological interest.

classification.title_zh: 正宇宙学常数存在时可穿越虫洞的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 构造带有宇宙学常数 Λ 的可穿越虫洞会带来显著挑战，并导致时空几何发生非平凡修正。本文采用微扰方法，获得了描述 Λ>0 时局部可穿越虫洞的解析解。我们从 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞几何出发，在假设 Λ r_0^2 ≪ 1（其中 r_0 为 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞喉部）的条件下，推导了宇宙学常数在线性阶诱导的度规形变。我们进一步确定了微扰解的径向有效范围，其限制为 r ≪ sqrt(3/Λ)。在此范围内，我们发现 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞被宇宙学常数修正；有趣的是，形状函数呈现 de Sitter 型形式。尽管如此，我们验证了在形变后的喉部 flare-out 条件仍然成立，并发现其附近违背零能量条件，这是可穿越虫洞所要求的。我们还通过评估潮汐力并推导安全人体通过所需速度约束，进一步分析了可穿越性。此外，我们讨论了将微扰虫洞解与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 外部时空匹配以构造整体延拓的可能性。鉴于近期对天体物理致密天体观测研究的进展，以及多种表明正宇宙学常数存在的天体物理和宇宙学观测，本文给出的解析解可能具有相当大的现象学意义。
classification.one_liner: 从 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞出发，用微扰方法得到 Λ>0 下局部可穿越虫洞的解析度规，并检验 flare-out、零能量条件与潮汐力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签，研究带正宇宙学常数的可穿越虫洞解析解与经典时空性质。

2606.26848v3.title: Conservation law of super-Lorentz charges across spatial infinity
2606.26848v3.abstract: Under assumptions compatible with generic gravitational scattering, the vacuum relativistic gravitational field is entirely determined at leading order in the large radius expansion at spatial infinity by its supermomentum, its dual supermomentum and its global supertranslation frame. At subleading order, the gravitational field is determined by three additional sets of charges: the super-Lorentz charges, the leading mixed tail/ peeling-breaking charges and the leading peeling-breaking charges. In this work we provide a proper-supertranslation-invariant definition of these charges in terms of asymptotic Bondi-Sachs fields as well as a corresponding proper supertranslation and logarithmic translation invariant definition of these charges in terms of Beig-Schmidt fields. Using the properties of homogeneous and inhomogeneous solutions to relevant wave equations over the boundary de Sitter spacetime at spatial infinity, we derive the conservation law of super-Lorentz charges between the future and past of spatial infinity. We obtain that the super-Lorentz aspects are non-locally defined from the Bondi-Sachs fields.

classification.title_zh: 超洛伦兹荷跨越空间无穷远的守恒律
classification.abstract_zh: 在与一般引力散射相容的假设下，真空相对论引力场在空间无穷远处大半径展开的首阶完全由其超动量、对偶超动量和整体超平移参考系决定。在次阶，引力场由三组额外荷决定：超洛伦兹荷、领头混合尾/剥离破缺荷以及领头剥离破缺荷。本文用渐近 Bondi-Sachs 场给出这些荷的 proper 超平移不变定义，并用 Beig-Schmidt 场给出相应的 proper 超平移和对数平移不变定义。利用空间无穷远处边界 de Sitter 时空上相关波动方程的齐次与非齐次解的性质，我们推导了空间无穷远未来与过去之间超洛伦兹荷的守恒律。结果表明，超洛伦兹方面由 Bondi-Sachs 场非局域地定义。
classification.one_liner: 在空间无穷远处用渐近场定义超洛伦兹荷，并证明其在无穷远过去与未来之间守恒。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/渐近对称性与空间无穷远结构研究，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关；但不涉及全息、量子信息或所列其他全息专题。

2609.10755v2.title: Massive quantum divergence on the Cauchy horizon of a black hole
2609.10755v2.abstract: We investigate a quantum massive scalar field in the interior of a charged and spherically-symmetric (Reissner-Nordstr\"om) black hole. We examine the behaviour for varying values of the black hole charge, field mass and coupling constant when the field is in two quantum states: Hartle-Hawking (representing a black hole in thermal equilibrium) and Unruh (representing a black hole evaporating via the emission of Hawking radiation). We show that the vacuum polarization as well as the angular components of the quantum stress-energy tensor diverge on the Cauchy horizon, in stark contrast to what happens for massless fields. We also calculate the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates $\{u,v\}$. We show that these fluxes on the Cauchy horizon do not generically vanish. This implies, in particular, that in regular, Kruskal coordinates $\{U,V\}$ the ingoing flux diverges like $V^{-2}$ on the Cauchy horizon (where $V=0$). This divergence suggests that its backreaction via the semiclassical Einstein equations would yield a strong singularity, as opposed to its weaker, classical counterpart. Interestingly, there are exceptions, in which the energy fluxes in Eddington-Finkelstein coordinates vanish: (i) in the extremal limit (where the black hole is maximally charged); (ii) certain fine-tuned regions of parameter space, where the fluxes change sign.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞柯西视界上的大质量量子发散
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了带电球对称（Reissner-Nordström）黑洞内部的大质量量子标量场。考察黑洞电荷、场质量与耦合常数取不同值时，场处于两种量子态——Hartle-Hawking 态（代表热平衡黑洞）和 Unruh 态（代表通过霍金辐射蒸发的黑洞）——的行为。我们证明，真空极化以及量子应力-能量张量的角分量在柯西视界上发散，这与无质量场的情形形成鲜明对比。我们还计算了 Eddington-Finkelstein 坐标 {u,v} 中的能量通量，并表明这些通量在柯西视界上一般不为零。特别地，这意味着在正则 Kruskal 坐标 {U,V} 中，入射通量在柯西视界上以 V^{-2} 发散（其中 V=0）。这种发散表明，通过半经典 Einstein 方程的反作用会产生强奇异性，而非较弱的经典对应物。值得注意的是，也存在例外，此时 Eddington-Finkelstein 坐标中的能量通量消失：(i) 极端极限（黑洞达到最大电荷）；(ii) 参数空间的某些精细调节区域，通量变号。
classification.one_liner: 大质量标量场在 RN 黑洞柯西视界上产生发散的量子应力张量，半经典反作用可能形成强奇异性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于弯曲时空量子场论/半经典引力下的黑洞柯西视界研究，涉及经典 RN 黑洞时空与半经典反作用；与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点分支相关，但不是全息研究，也不涉及所列全息凝聚态、QCD、纠缠等支线。

2609.11908v2.title: Theoretical Aspects of Direct Waves in Kerr Black Holes: Pole-Splitting Method for Ringdown Analysis
2609.11908v2.abstract: We formulate the theoretical aspects of direct waves (DWs) in the case of extreme-mass merger. A DW is a source-driven waveform characterized by a complex frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$, which reflects the orbital motion of the particle in the vicinity of the black hole, including a part of the orbit inside the ergoregion: its real part is governed by frame dragging and its imaginary part by the redshift of the source. Using the Green's function technique, we derive the source-driven frequency $\omega_{\rm G}$, describe its screening by the potential barrier, and discuss its relation to dynamically excited quasinormal modes (QNMs). We then introduce a pole-splitting method that divides the full waveform into a QNM-pole sector and a non-QNM sector. Unlike QNM filtering, which multiplies the waveform spectrum by a filter function and thereby deforms it through a frequency-dependent time shift (i.e., group delay), our pole-splitting method merely divides the transfer function into pole and non-pole parts, separating the full waveform. Simulating a quasi-circular plunge into a Kerr black hole with medium and rapid spins, we find that the frequency and decay rate of the non-pole sector in the dominant mode, $\ell = m = 2$, evolve consistently with $\omega_{\rm G}$-or with its screened counterpart $\omega_{\rm screen}$-establishing the DW as a probe of the ergoregion and of the redshift effect around a black hole.

classification.title_zh: Kerr黑洞中直接波的理论方面：用于ringdown分析的极点分裂方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们针对极端质量合并的情形，建立了Kerr黑洞中直接波（DW）的理论框架。DW是一种源驱动波形，由复频率 ω_G 表征，反映粒子在黑洞附近（包括轨道位于能层内的一部分）的轨道运动：其实部由参考系拖曳决定，虚部由源的红移决定。利用格林函数方法，我们推导了源驱动频率 ω_G，描述了它如何被势垒屏蔽，并讨论了它与动态激发的准正规模（QNM）的关系。随后，我们引入极点分裂方法，将完整波形分为 QNM 极点部分和非 QNM 部分。与 QNM 滤波不同——后者通过将波形频谱乘以滤波函数，从而以频率依赖的时间移动（即群延迟）使其变形——我们的极点分裂方法只是把传递函数拆成极点部分和非极点部分，从而分离完整波形。模拟中等和快速自旋下准圆轨道俯冲进入 Kerr 黑洞，我们发现主导模式 ℓ=m=2 中非极点部分的频率和衰减率与 ω_G 或其被屏蔽的对应量 ω_screen 一致演化，从而确立 DW 可作为黑洞周围能层与红移效应的探针。
classification.one_liner: 提出极点分裂方法分离Kerr黑洞ringdown中的QNM极点与非极点直接波成分，并用源驱动频率ω_G刻画能层与红移效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究Kerr黑洞ringdown、QNM与经典引力波形分析方法，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”和“QNM与非线性演化”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.12058v1.title: Accretion onto a moving black hole for stiff equations of state
2609.12058v1.abstract: We revisit accretion of an asymptotically uniform fluid onto a moving Schwarzschild black hole, the relativistic analog of Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton accretion. Expanding on previous treatments, we focus on relativistic accretion of stiff fluids with adiabatic indices $\Gamma \geq 5/3$, which is particularly relevant for the treatment of primordial black holes captured by neutron stars. We perform numerical simulations to systematically explore the dependence of the steady-state accretion and drag rates on the asymptotic sound speed $a_\infty$ and relative speed $v_\infty$, and identify different regimes, both subsonic and supersonic, in which these rates either increase or decrease with respect to the spherical accretion rate for $v_\infty = 0$. We propose simple analytical approximations that capture the qualitative features observed in the dependence of the accretion and drag rates on $a_\infty$ and $v_\infty$.

classification.title_zh: 运动黑洞对硬状态方程流体的吸积
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新研究渐近均匀流体向运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞的吸积，这是 Bondi-Hoyle-Lyttleton 吸积的相对论类比。在已有处理的基础上，我们关注绝热指数 Γ ≥ 5/3 的硬状态方程流体，因为这特别关系到被中子星俘获的原初黑洞。我们进行数值模拟，系统探索稳态吸积率和阻力率对渐近声速 a∞ 与相对速度 v∞ 的依赖，并识别出亚声速和超声速的不同区域；在这些区域中，吸积率和阻力率相对于 v∞ = 0 的球对称吸积率可能增大或减小。我们提出简单的解析近似，以刻画吸积率和阻力率随 a∞ 与 v∞ 变化时所观察到的主要定性特征。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究运动 Schwarzschild 黑洞对硬状态方程流体的相对论吸积，并给出吸积率与阻力率的近似解析描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞吸积、阻力与流体动力学，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.12194v1.title: Distinguishing Dymnikova and Schwarzschild Black Holes through Gravitational Lensing with EFT-Corrected Photon Propagation
2609.12194v1.abstract: We investigate whether a Dymnikova regular black hole can be observationally distinguished from a Schwarzschild black hole through strong gravitational lensing, taking into account effective field theory (EFT) corrections to photon propagation. We derive the modified photon propagation law induced by non-minimal couplings between the electromagnetic field and spacetime curvature and analyze the resulting photon trajectories in the Dymnikova spacetime. Within the strong deflection limit, we derive the EFT corrections to the photon sphere and the strong-deflection coefficients characterizing the logarithmically divergent behavior of the deflection angle. Although the EFT corrections are parametrically small, their effects can become relevant in the strong-deflection regime, where the deflection angle is highly sensitive to photon propagation near the critical orbit. We evaluate the strong-deflection observables for representative values of the Dymnikova parameter $\ell$ and compare them with the corresponding Schwarzschild results. We find that EFT corrections to photon propagation leave characteristic imprints on the strong-lensing observables. Furthermore, the contribution of the EFT corrections becomes more pronounced as the Dymnikova parameter $\ell$ approaches its critical value, indicating that the near-critical regime provides a particularly sensitive setting in which curvature-dependent corrections to photon propagation may affect gravitational lensing. These results suggest that strong gravitational lensing, together with EFT-induced modifications of photon propagation, may provide a means of distinguishing Dymnikova regular black holes from Schwarzschild black holes.

classification.title_zh: 利用带 EFT 修正光子传播的引力透镜区分 Dymnikova 与 Schwarzschild 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在考虑光子传播的有效场论（EFT）修正后，能否通过强引力透镜将 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞在观测上区分开。我们推导由电磁场与时空曲率之间非最小耦合诱导的修正光子传播定律，并分析 Dymnikova 时空中由此得到的光子轨迹。在强偏转极限下，我们导出对光子球以及描述偏转角对数发散行为的强偏转系数的 EFT 修正。尽管 EFT 修正参数上很小，但在强偏转区域，偏转角对临界轨道附近的光子传播高度敏感，因此这些效应可能变得重要。我们对 Dymnikova 参数 ℓ 的代表性取值计算强偏转观测量，并与相应的 Schwarzschild 结果比较。我们发现，光子传播的 EFT 修正会在强透镜观测量上留下特征印记。此外，随着 Dymnikova 参数 ℓ 趋近其临界值，EFT 修正的贡献变得更加显著，表明近临界区域提供了一个特别敏感的场合，其中依赖曲率的光子传播修正可能影响引力透镜。这些结果表明，强引力透镜连同 EFT 诱导的光子传播修改，可能提供一种区分 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞的手段。
classification.one_liner: 研究 EFT 修正光子传播下强引力透镜能否区分 Dymnikova 正则黑洞与 Schwarzschild 黑洞。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞强引力透镜、光子球以及 EFT 修正光子传播，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.12279v1.title: Dynamics for Spin-$1/2$ Particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity II: Non-Relativistic Case
2609.12279v1.abstract: In this work, I investigate the non-relativistic quantum dynamics of spin-1/2 particles in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) gravity and establish a direct connection between higher-curvature corrections, fermionic dynamics, and the phenomenology of compact objects. Starting from the Dirac Hamiltonian in a static, spherically symmetric EGB spacetime, we perform a Fold-Wouthuysen transformation and derive the effective Hamiltonian, including relativistic kinetic, gravitational, spin-orbit, and higher-curvature contributions. Heisenberg equations are then used to obtain the dynamics of velocity, force, and spin, revealing explicit EGB corrections for both translational motion and spin transport. In particular, the spin-orbit sector induces a modified precession frequency whose fractional deviation from general relativity scales as $\delta_{\Omega}=-4(\xi/M^{2})(M/\rho)^{3}$, providing a clear dimensionless signature of the Gauss-Bonnet coupling. Through Ehrenfest's theorem, we also establish the correspondence between the dynamics of quantum operators and their semiclassical gravitational limit. As an astrophysical application, we consider the stellar-mass black hole A0620-00 and show that prospective relative sensitivities in spin precession on the order of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-4}$ can probe Gauss-Bonnet couplings in the range of approximately $10^{6}$ to $10^{8}\,{\rm m}^{2}$, depending on the orbital radius. This result identifies fermionic spin precession as a complementary channel for testing gravity with higher-curvature corrections and provides a quantum-mechanical framework connecting modified gravitational dynamics to precision phenomenology in strong-gravity regimes.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的动力学 II：非相对论情形
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我研究 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) 引力中自旋-1/2 粒子的非相对论量子动力学，并建立高阶曲率修正、费米子动力学与致密天体现象学之间的直接联系。从静态球对称 EGB 时空中的 Dirac 哈密顿量出发，我们执行 Fold-Wouthuysen 变换并导出有效哈密顿量，其中包括相对论动能、引力、自旋-轨道以及高阶曲率贡献。随后使用 Heisenberg 方程得到速度、力和自旋的动力学，揭示平动和自旋输运的显式 EGB 修正。特别地，自旋-轨道部分诱导修正的进动频率，其对广义相对论的分数偏差按 δΩ=-4(ξ/M^2)(M/ρ)^3 标度，为 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合提供清晰的无量纲特征。通过 Ehrenfest 定理，我们还建立量子算符动力学与其半经典引力极限之间的对应。作为天体物理应用，我们考虑恒星质量黑洞 A0620-00，并表明自旋进动约 10^-3 至 10^-4 的预期相对灵敏度可以探测约 10^6 至 10^8 m^2 范围内的 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合，具体取决于轨道半径。这一结果将费米子自旋进动确定为检验带高阶曲率修正引力的互补通道，并提供了一个连接修改引力动力学与强引力区精密现象学的量子力学框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中导出非相对论自旋-1/2 粒子的有效哈密顿量与自旋进动修正，并讨论用恒星质量黑洞 A0620-00 检验 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于修改引力/经典引力与黑洞时空检验方向，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息等全息研究支线。

2609.12476v1.title: A semicoherent resampling method for long-transient gravitational wave searches with applications to subsolar-mass primordial black-hole binaries
2609.12476v1.abstract: Resampling removes the modeled phase evolution of a frequency-evolving signal, transforming it into a monochromatic one. We introduce a novel implementation for long-transient gravitational-wave searches that evaluates the Fourier spectrum of the resampled data using a type-I non-uniform fast Fourier transform (NUFFT). This implementation can be up to two orders of magnitude faster than some previous implementations, depending on coherent length, sampling rate, and desired accuracy. To demonstrate its application, we benchmark the method with a semicoherent search for long-duration inspiral signals from subsolar-mass primordial black hole binaries. For a search over $40$--$60\,\mathrm{Hz}$ and chirp masses of $5\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$, with a coherent duration of $30\,\mathrm{s}$ and a realistic computing cost, the estimated horizon distance exceeds the Galactic Center for all of the parameter space considered and exceeds Andromeda for chirp masses above approximately $2\times10^{-2}M_\odot$. These results establish NUFFT-based resampling as a computationally efficient and broadly applicable approach for searches for modeled, frequency-evolving gravitational-wave signals.

classification.title_zh: 一种用于长瞬态引力波搜索的半相干重采样方法及其在亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星中的应用
classification.abstract_zh: 重采样可去除频率演化信号的模型相位演化，将其转化为单色信号。我们提出了一种用于长瞬态引力波搜索的新实现，利用 I 型非均匀快速傅里叶变换（NUFFT）评估重采样数据的傅里叶频谱。取决于相干长度、采样率和所需精度，该实现可比先前某些实现快达两个数量级。为展示其应用，我们用半相干搜索对来自亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星的长持续旋近信号进行了基准测试。对于 40–60 Hz 频段、啁啾质量 5×10^{-4}–10^{-1} M_⊙、相干时长 30 s 且计算成本现实的情况，估计的地平距离在所有考虑的参数空间内超过银河系中心，并在啁啾质量约高于 2×10^{-2} M_⊙ 时超过仙女座星系。这些结果确立了基于 NUFFT 的重采样作为一种计算高效且广泛适用的方法，用于搜索建模的频率演化引力波信号。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于 NUFFT 的半相干重采样方法，加速长瞬态引力波搜索，并用于亚太阳质量原初黑洞双星。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于引力波搜寻方法/数据分析，不涉及全息对偶或经典引力理论；仅与“经典引力/广义相对论”标签在引力波现象层面间接相关。

2609.12561v1.title: Shadows and Polarimetric Signatures of Rotating Simpson-Visser Black Holes with Thick Disk Illumination
2609.12561v1.abstract: In this manuscript, we investigate the shadow and polarization images of a Simpson-Visser rotating black hole surrounded by a ballistic approximation accretion flow model. Solving the numerically geodesic and radiative transfer equations, we discuss the influence of the regularization parameter $g$, spin parameter $a$, and observer inclination angle $\theta_o$ on the resulting images at $230\,\mathrm{GHz}$ with an infalling motion. The results interpret that, a bright circular ring corresponding to higher-order images is observed, accompanied by an inner region of decreased intensity. Both $g$ and $a$ has little influence on the size of the higher-order images, but significantly changes their shape and intensity distribution. Whereas, variation in $\theta_o$ modify the image morphology, producing a crescent-shaped bright region on the left side. Finally, the polarization patterns trace the brightness distribution and vary with both $g$ and $a$, reflecting the spacetime structure. These results demonstrates that the intensity and polarization in thick disk models provide probes of Simpson-Visser rotating black holes and near-horizon accretion physics.

classification.title_zh: 旋转 Simpson-Visser 黑洞在厚盘照明下的阴影与偏振特征
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究了被弹道近似吸积流模型包围的 Simpson-Visser 旋转黑洞的阴影和偏振图像。通过数值求解测地线和辐射转移方程，我们讨论了正则化参数 g、自旋参数 a 和观测倾角 θ_o 对 230 GHz 下具有下落运动的结果图像的影响。结果表明，可以观察到对应高阶像的明亮圆环，并伴随一个强度降低的内部区域。g 和 a 对高阶像的大小影响很小，但会显著改变其形状和强度分布。而 θ_o 的变化会改变图像形态，在左侧产生月牙形明亮区域。最后，偏振模式追踪亮度分布，并随 g 和 a 变化，反映了时空结构。这些结果表明，厚盘模型中的强度和偏振为探测 Simpson-Visser 旋转黑洞及近视界吸积物理提供了手段。
classification.one_liner: 数值研究旋转 Simpson-Visser 黑洞在厚盘吸积流下的阴影与偏振图像，并分析正则化参数、自旋和观测倾角的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞成像，不涉及全息对偶；若关注经典引力支线，则有中等相关性。

2609.12784v1.title: Compact binary systems in the post-Newtonian limit of gravitational theories with preferred frames
2609.12784v1.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of compact-binary inspirals offer the opportunity to test deviations from general relativity in both strong and weak-field regimes. In previous work, we developed a theory-independent formalism for describing compact-binary dynamics in metric theories of gravity without preferred frames, using the parametrised post-Newtonian (PPN) couplings together with an additional set of scalar sensitivity parameters that encode violations of the strong equivalence principle. Here, we extend this framework to include preferred-frame effects, of the type that can arise in (for example) vector-tensor theories of gravity. This is achieved by introducing a time-like vector field that identifies the preferred frame, and then by allowing compact body masses to depend on the invariant formed from this field and the body's four-velocity. We calculate the modified equation of motion up to first post-Newtonian order (1PN), where the preferred-frame PPN parameters $\alpha_1$ and $\alpha_2$ acquire contributions from our new vector sensitivities. We further combine scalar and vector sensitivities in a unified formalism, which we validate with an example scalar-vector-tensor theory. This approach provides the orbital dynamics required to extend gravitational-wave constraints on PPN and sensitivity parameters to theories of gravity that admit preferred frames, as well as those that do not.

classification.title_zh: 具有偏好参考系的引力理论后牛顿极限下的致密双星系统
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波对致密双星旋近的观测为在强场和弱场检验广义相对论偏离提供了机会。此前工作建立了描述无偏好参考系度规引力理论中致密双星动力学的理论无关形式，使用参数化后牛顿（PPN）耦合以及一组额外标量敏感度参数来编码强等效原理破缺。本文将框架扩展到偏好参考系效应，例如矢量-张量引力中可能出现的效应：引入一个类时矢量场标识偏好参考系，并允许致密天体质量依赖于该场与天体四维速度构造的不变量。我们计算至一阶后牛顿（1PN）的修正运动方程，其中偏好参考系 PPN 参数 α1 和 α2 获得新矢量敏感度的贡献。进一步将标量与矢量敏感度统一形式化，并用一个标量-矢量-张量理论示例进行验证。该方法提供了轨道动力学，可将引力波对 PPN 和敏感度参数的限制扩展到允许偏好参考系以及不允许偏好参考系的引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 将无偏好参考系的 PPN 致密双星动力学扩展到含偏好参考系效应，并给出 1PN 运动方程与矢量敏感度贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究后牛顿致密双星动力学与修改引力；与全息无关，但直接对应用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2609.12797v1.title: The Wavelet Detection Filter: a real time unmodeled pipeline for gravitational wave transients, ranking coincidences with a graph neural network
2609.12797v1.abstract: Accurate waveform models are unavailable for many potential sources of gravitational wave transients, motivating searches that do not assume a predefined template family. The Wavelet Detection Filter (WDF) is an unmodeled pipeline that identifies excess energy in the wavelet coefficients of whitened detector data. Here, we develop WDF into a low latency pipeline for both detection and reconstruction and this paper describes and validates that pipeline. We use a zero phase streaming autoregressive whitening filter that preserves transient morphology with a fixed latency and we use the retained wavelet coefficients to provide both a detection statistic and a sparse representation of the signal. By combining coefficients across consecutive analysis windows, the pipeline reconstructs transients longer than a single window. We represent candidate coincidences between detectors with a trigger graph and rank them with supervised and unsupervised graph neural networks (GNNs). We estimate the significance of the ranked coincidences from time shifted data. We validate the pipeline on Gaussian noise colored according to the Advanced LIGO sensitivity curve and on real O4 strain containing compact binary and core collapse supernova injections. Applied to GW250114, WDF identifies the event as the loudest zero lag candidate in the analyzed segment without using waveform templates. We measure the computational cost of the pipeline and the latency it introduces. Both are compatible with a low latency search,so WDF can run on a stream in real time.

classification.title_zh: 小波检测滤波器：一种用于引力波瞬变的实时非模板管线，利用图神经网络对符合事件排序
classification.abstract_zh: 对于许多潜在的引力波瞬变源，精确波形模型并不可用，这促使人们开展不假设预定义模板族的搜索。小波检测滤波器（WDF）是一种非模板管线，它识别白化探测器数据小波系数中的多余能量。在此，我们将 WDF 发展为同时用于探测和重建的低延迟管线，本文描述并验证了该管线。我们使用零相位流式自回归白化滤波器，以固定延迟保持瞬变形态，并使用保留的小波系数同时提供检测统计量和信号的稀疏表示。通过组合连续分析窗口中的系数，该管线能够重建长于单个窗口的瞬变。我们用触发图表示探测器之间的候选符合，并用监督和无监督图神经网络（GNN）对其排序。我们从时移数据估计排序后符合的显著性。我们在按 Advanced LIGO 灵敏度曲线着色的高斯噪声上，以及在包含致密双星和核心坍缩超新星注入的真实 O4 应变数据上验证了该管线。应用于 GW250114 时，WDF 在不使用波形模板的情况下将该事件识别为所分析片段中最响亮的零延迟候选。我们测量了该管线的计算成本和引入的延迟。两者都与低延迟搜索兼容，因此 WDF 可以实时在流数据上运行。
classification.one_liner: 将小波检测滤波器发展为低延迟、可重建的引力波瞬变非模板搜索管线，并用图神经网络对符合候选排序。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波探测方法与数据处理，不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或用户重点的全息支线。

2609.12986v1.title: \texttt{cWB-space}: A time-frequency transient-search pipeline for LISA
2609.12986v1.abstract: Gravitational-wave observations can reveal sources whose signals are not known in advance. Searches that do not require a predicted waveform are therefore an important complement to searches for specific source classes. For the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), the challenge is to find such signals among overlapping astrophysical sources and disturbances in the instrument. We present \texttt{cWB-space}, which identifies candidate signals by following how their power is distributed in time and frequency, and then reconstructs parts of their waveforms without imposing a source model. Simulations of merging massive black holes, other burst signals, and instrumental disturbances test both candidate identification and the information carried by the detector's response. The response comparison estimates its background from the observed data. Tests of disturbances in several laser measurements examine where a similar response can arise from an instrumental origin. Searching the Sangria simulated LISA data, we recover all six injected massive-black-hole binaries as the six highest-ranked candidates. Their reconstructed waveforms agree well with the injected signals over the intervals studied. The results demonstrate another route to investigating transients, while leaving the rate of false detections and general discrimination of instrumental disturbances to future validation.

classification.title_zh: \texttt{cWB-space}：面向 LISA 的时频瞬变搜索管线
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波观测可以揭示信号事先未知的源。因此，不要求预测波形的搜索是特定源类搜索的重要补充。对于激光干涉空间天线（LISA），挑战在于在重叠的天体物理源和仪器扰动中寻找这类信号。我们提出了 \texttt{cWB-space}，它通过跟踪信号功率在时间和频率上的分布来识别候选信号，然后在不施加源模型的情况下重建其部分波形。对大质量黑洞并合、其他暴发信号以及仪器扰动的模拟测试了候选识别和探测器响应所携带的信息。响应比较从观测数据估计其背景。对若干激光测量中扰动的测试考察了类似响应可能来自仪器起源的情况。搜索 Sangria 模拟 LISA 数据时，我们将全部六个注入的大质量黑洞双星恢复为排名最高的六个候选。在所研究的区间内，其重建波形与注入信号符合良好。结果展示了研究瞬变的另一条途径，同时将误检率和仪器扰动的一般区分留给未来验证。
classification.one_liner: 提出面向 LISA 的无模型时频瞬变搜索管线 cWB-space，并在模拟中恢复六个大质量黑洞双星信号并重建波形。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波天文学方向，涉及 LISA 瞬变源搜索和波形重建，对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；与全息、量子引力或 AdS/CFT 无关。

2609.10805v1.title: Alternative Boundary Conditions in Asymptotically Anti-de Sitter Spacetimes
2609.10805v1.abstract: Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes are not globally hyperbolic, so boundary conditions are generally needed for well-defined dynamics. Ishibashi and Wald (IW) determined boundary conditions yielding well-posed dynamics with conserved positive energy for scalar, electromagnetic, and linearized gravitational fields, using nonlocal potentials and individual spherical harmonic modes. In this paper, we determine which IW conditions are local in the primary fields and which are AdS-invariant. In four spacetime dimensions, the standard AdS-invariant boundary conditions set the rescaled magnetic field to zero for electromagnetism and the rescaled magnetic Weyl tensor to zero for Einstein gravity on the conformal boundary. We generalize these standard boundary conditions by setting arbitrary linear combinations of the electric and magnetic fields, or the corresponding Weyl tensors, to zero, and we conjecture that these exhaust the local, AdS-invariant, conservative boundary conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$. Boundary conditions with non-AdS-invariance and in different spacetime dimensions are also studied. The AdS-invariant conditions in AdS$_{1,3}$ extend to Yang-Mills theory and nonlinear gravity in a general Fefferman-Graham setting. We construct phase spaces for these general boundary conditions. The covariant phase spaces for general conditions are naturally associated with Lagrangians containing Pontryagin terms and, in gravity, a Gauss-Bonnet term. In gravity, except for the standard boundary condition, no nontrivial asymptotic gauge symmetries exist and all conserved charges such as ADM mass vanish identically, as in a closed universe. Spacetimes with Killing fields including AdS then exhibit linearization instability in the sense of Fischer and Marsden and Moncrief. For nonstandard boundary conditions, the modified symplectic structure yields new expressions for the entropy formula of black holes.

classification.title_zh: 渐近反德西特（AdS）时空中的替代边界条件
classification.abstract_zh: 反德西特（AdS）时空不是整体双曲的，因此通常需要边界条件才能定义良好的动力学。Ishibashi 和 Wald（IW）利用非局域势和各个球谐模式，确定了标量场、电磁场和线性化引力场中能给出适定动力学并具有守恒正能量的边界条件。本文确定哪些 IW 条件在基本场中是局域的，哪些是 AdS 不变的。在四维时空中，标准 AdS 不变边界条件在共形边界上分别将电磁场的重标度磁场设为零、将爱因斯坦引力的重标度磁外尔张量设为零。我们通过将电场与磁场，或相应的外尔张量的任意线性组合设为零，推广了这些标准边界条件，并猜想它们穷尽了 AdS$_{1,3}$ 中局域、AdS 不变且保守的边界条件。还研究了非 AdS 不变的边界条件以及不同时空维数中的边界条件。AdS$_{1,3}$ 中的 AdS 不变条件可推广到 Yang-Mills 理论以及一般 Fefferman-Graham 设定下的非线性引力。我们为这些一般边界条件构造了相空间。一般条件的协变相空间自然与包含 Pontryagin 项的拉格朗日量相关，在引力中则包含 Gauss-Bonnet 项。在引力中，除标准边界条件外，不存在非平凡的渐近规范对称性，并且所有守恒荷（如 ADM 质量）都恒为零，如同闭合宇宙。包含 AdS 在内的具有 Killing 场的时空随后会表现出 Fischer、Marsden 和 Moncrief 意义下的线性化不稳定性。对于非标准边界条件，修改后的辛结构给出了黑洞熵公式的新表达式。
classification.one_liner: 研究渐近 AdS 时空中局域且 AdS 不变的替代边界条件、相空间、守恒荷与黑洞熵修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要主要处理渐近 AdS 时空中的经典引力边界条件、协变相空间、守恒荷与黑洞熵，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

2609.12806v1.title: Reconstructing the Dark Matter Equation of State with Compact Object Inspirals
2609.12806v1.abstract: We investigate the gravitational wave (GW) signatures of compact binaries embedded in extended dark matter (DM) configurations in hydrostatic equilibrium. If a neutron star is surrounded by a sufficiently massive and extended envelope, an inspiraling companion experiences dynamical friction (DF) in addition to the standard GW energy loss. We show that this environmental effect can be isolated through a GW observable, the $D$-function, which directly characterizes the additional dissipative power induced by the surrounding medium. Since the density of the envelope is directly determined by the DM equation of state together with the stellar boundary conditions, the frequency dependence of the $D$-function provides direct information about the macroscopic properties of the dark sector. We develop a regression-based framework to reconstruct both the density profile and the DM equation of state over the density range probed by observations of the GW inspiral. Using representative DM models as benchmarks, we demonstrate that the method accurately recovers the input equation of state while remaining largely independent of the microscopic realization of DM. Our results show that future GW observations of compact binaries can provide a probe of the equation of state of DM.

classification.title_zh: 利用致密天体旋近重构暗物质状态方程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究嵌入处于流体静力学平衡的延展暗物质（DM）组态中的致密双星的引力波（GW）特征。若中子星被足够大质量且延展的包层包围，旋近伴星除标准GW能量损失外还会经历动力学摩擦（DF）。我们表明，这种环境效应可通过一个GW可观测量——D函数——分离出来，它直接刻画周围介质引起的附加耗散功率。由于包层密度由暗物质状态方程连同恒星边界条件直接决定，D函数的频率依赖性提供了关于暗部门宏观性质的信息。我们建立了一个基于回归的框架，以在GW旋近观测所探测的密度范围内重构密度剖面和DM状态方程。以代表性DM模型作为基准，我们证明该方法能准确恢复输入状态方程，同时基本不依赖于DM的微观实现。我们的结果表明，未来对致密双星的GW观测可以为暗物质状态方程提供探针。
classification.one_liner: 通过致密双星旋近中的动力学摩擦D函数，可从引力波观测重构暗物质密度剖面与状态方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波观测支线，并与致密天体环境效应相关；但不属于全息对偶研究，与用户多数全息重点标签关联较弱。

2609.12867v1.title: Probing Inflationary Origins of Primordial Black Holes with LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA O1--O4a data
2609.12867v1.abstract: Large primordial curvature perturbations not only produce primordial black holes (PBHs) but also inevitably source a scalar-induced stochastic gravitational-wave background upon horizon reentry. We analyze the combined LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA O1--O4a data to constrain two representative inflationary mechanisms for generating such perturbations: ultra-slow-roll inflation and an inflationary phase transition. Detecting no evidence for either scenario, we place 95% credible upper limits on the curvature-spectrum amplitude across the frequency range accessible to ground-based interferometers. Translated into the PBH context, these limits already exceed conventional constraints, probing abundance fractions far below unity. Our results remain robust even when the PBHs themselves are too rare to be directly detected or have evaporated. This work demonstrates that stochastic gravitational-wave observations offer a powerful and complementary probe of small-scale inflationary physics and PBH formation, with upcoming interferometers promising to extend sensitivity to a wider range of inflationary epochs and PBH masses.

classification.title_zh: 利用 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA O1–O4a 数据探测原初黑洞的暴胀起源
classification.abstract_zh: 大的原初曲率扰动不仅会产生原初黑洞（PBHs），在视界重新进入时还不可避免地产生标量诱导的随机引力波背景。我们分析 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA O1–O4a 联合数据，以限制产生此类扰动的两种代表性暴胀机制：超慢滚暴胀和暴胀相变。由于没有发现任一情形的证据，我们对地面干涉仪可及频率范围内的曲率谱振幅给出了 95% 可信上限。转换到 PBH 语境中，这些限制已经超过传统限制，探测到远低于 1 的丰度份额。即使 PBH 本身太稀少而无法被直接探测，或已经蒸发，我们的结果依然稳健。这项工作表明，随机引力波观测为小尺度暴胀物理和 PBH 形成提供了一种有力且互补的探针，未来干涉仪有望将灵敏度扩展到更广泛的暴胀时期和 PBH 质量范围。
classification.one_liner: 利用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O1-O4a 数据限制超慢滚暴胀和暴胀相变产生的标量诱导随机引力波背景，并由此约束原初黑洞形成。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学/原初黑洞/随机引力波观测，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息；因使用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 引力波数据，可归入经典引力/引力波支线，故对经典引力关注者有中等相关性。

2609.12998v1.title: An efficient approach to resistive GRMHD simulations of binary neutron star mergers
2609.12998v1.abstract: Astrophysical plasmas are often highly conducting, but finite resistivity can nevertheless influence the evolution of strongly magnetised systems. Capturing these effects in general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics is computationally challenging because high conductivity leads to stiff source terms in the evolution equations. Standard numerical approaches rely on implicit-explicit (IMEX) time integration to maintain stability, but this substantially increases the complexity and computational cost of the simulations. Building upon the previously developed Resistive Extension upGrade for Ideal MagnEtohydrodynamics (REGIME), we present a new fluid-frame formulation that simplifies the incorporation of leading-order resistive effects by avoiding matrix inversions required in previous approaches. The method is implemented in a general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics code and validated through one-dimensional current-sheet tests and simulations of isolated magnetised neutron stars and binary neutron star mergers. We find that the new formulation reproduces the expected resistive behaviour with accuracy comparable to IMEX-based methods, while substantially reducing the computational cost and complexity of the simulations. In binary neutron star mergers, finite resistivity leads to measurable differences in the post-merger gravitational-wave signal and remnant structure, showing that resistive effects can produce measurable changes in the post-merger dynamics even in the high-conductivity regime.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星并合电阻性GRMHD模拟的一种高效方法
classification.abstract_zh: 天体物理等离子体通常具有高导电性，但有限电阻率仍可能影响强磁化系统的演化。在广义相对论磁流体力学中捕捉这些效应在计算上具有挑战性，因为高电导率会导致演化方程中出现刚性源项。标准数值方法依赖隐式-显式（IMEX）时间积分来保持稳定，但这显著增加了模拟的复杂性和计算成本。在先前开发的理想磁流体力学电阻扩展升级版（REGIME）基础上，我们提出了一种新的流体参考系表述，通过避免先前方法所需的矩阵求逆，简化了领头阶电阻效应的纳入。该方法已在广义相对论磁流体力学代码中实现，并通过一维电流片测试以及孤立磁化中子星和双中子星并合的模拟进行了验证。我们发现，新表述以与基于IMEX的方法相当的精度再现了预期的电阻行为，同时大幅降低了模拟的计算成本和复杂性。在双中子星并合中，有限电阻率导致并合后引力波信号和遗迹结构出现可测量的差异，表明即使在高电导率区域，电阻效应也能对并合后动力学产生可测量的变化。
classification.one_liner: 提出一种避免矩阵求逆的流体参考系电阻GRMHD新形式，并在双中子星并合模拟中验证其效率及后并合引力波信号差异。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/数值相对论与GRMHD，而非全息对偶；与重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，但不涉及AdS/CFT、量子信息或全息凝聚态等。

2510.17125v2.title: From Stars to Waves: Non-deterministic Inference of Microlensed Gravitational Waves
2510.17125v2.abstract: Strongly lensed gravitational waves may pass through the stellar field of a lensing galaxy with additional modulations (on both phase and amplitude) due to gravitational microlensing effect of stars/remnants near the line of sight. These microlensed waveforms depend on the mass and location of thousands or more most relevant stars, so that their deterministic reconstruction from the data is computationally prohibitive. We classify the detection and parameter estimation of such events as non-deterministic inference problem and propose a solution with the implementation of normalizing flows. As a first step, we show that $8\%$ of microlensed events can be detected with significance $\ge 3 \sigma$ in the third generation era, with the chosen microlensing parameters correlated with the density of the underlying stellar field. This approach opens the door to probing microlensing effects and the properties of the underlying stellar fields. A similar construction may also be applied to other non-deterministic inference problems, such as detecting post-merger gravitational waves from binary neutron star coalescence and signals from core-collapse supernovae.

classification.title_zh: 从恒星到波：微透镜引力波的非确定性推断
classification.abstract_zh: 强透镜引力波在穿过透镜星系的恒星场时，可能因视线附近恒星/遗迹的引力微透镜效应而受到附加调制（相位和振幅两方面）。这些微透镜波形依赖于数千颗或更多最相关恒星的质量和位置，因此从数据中进行确定性重建在计算上不可行。我们将这类事件的探测和参数估计归类为非确定性推断问题，并提出用归一化流实现的解决方案。作为第一步，我们表明在第三代探测器时代，8%的微透镜事件可以以 ≥3σ 的显著性被探测到，且所选的微透镜参数与底层恒星场的密度相关。该方法为探测微透镜效应以及底层恒星场的性质打开了大门。类似的构造也可应用于其他非确定性推断问题，例如探测双中子星并合后的后合并引力波以及核心坍缩超新星信号。
classification.one_liner: 提出用归一化流处理强透镜引力波受恒星微透镜调制导致的非确定性推断，并估计第三代探测器可探测比例。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波强透镜/微透镜与非确定性推断，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息；对经典引力/引力波支线有中等相关性。

2603.06792v2.title: Spectral sirens cosmology from binary black holes populations with sharper mass features
2603.06792v2.abstract: Spectral-sirens inference enables the extraction of cosmological parameters from gravitational-wave data alone, without electromagnetic counterparts or galaxy catalogs. We introduce new parametric mass functions for the binary black hole population built as linear combination of truncated power-laws that capture significant structure across the mass spectrum. On analysing the latest gravitational-wave transient catalog, GWTC-4.0, we show that power-laws-only population models constrain the Hubble constant to $H_0 = 53.3^{+14.0}_{-10.8} ~\rm km \,s^{-1} \,Mpc^{-1}$ at $68\%$ confidence level. After probing the robustness of the results with respect to several modelling assumptions, we further test alternative cosmological models, establishing competitive constraints on modified gravitational-wave propagation, while bounds on the dark energy equation-of-state parameters remain uninformative. Projecting to the future O5 observing run with larger datasets at higher redshifts, we forecast substantial improvements in $H_0$ and modified propagation parameters. Our results highlight the strong interplay between the black hole mass distribution and inferred cosmology.

classification.title_zh: 具有更锐利质量特征的双黑洞族群的光谱汽笛宇宙学
classification.abstract_zh: 光谱汽笛推断能够仅从引力波数据中提取宇宙学参数，无需电磁对应体或星系目录。我们为双黑洞族群引入了新的参数化质量函数，它们由截断幂律的线性组合构成，能够刻画质量谱中的显著结构。通过分析最新的引力波瞬变目录 GWTC-4.0，我们表明仅使用幂律的族群模型在 68% 置信水平上将哈勃常数约束为 H0 = 53.3^{+14.0}_{-10.8} km/s/Mpc。在检验结果对若干建模假设的稳健性后，我们进一步测试替代宇宙学模型，对修改的引力波传播给出了有竞争力的约束，而对暗能量状态方程参数的约束仍无信息量。展望未来 O5 观测运行，利用更高红移处更大的数据集，我们预测 H0 和修改传播参数将显著改善。我们的结果凸显了黑洞质量分布与推断宇宙学之间的强烈相互作用。
classification.one_liner: 利用双黑洞质量谱结构开展光谱汽笛宇宙学推断，从 GWTC-4.0 约束 H0 与修改引力波传播。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波宇宙学与双黑洞族群统计，与经典引力/引力波支线相关，但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或用户列出的其他全息主题，因此对核心全息方向关联有限。

2603.21218v2.title: Kaniadakis Holographic Dark Energy: UV$-$IR Duality, Horizon Thermodynamics and Cosmological Constraints
2603.21218v2.abstract: We investigate the cosmological and thermodynamic implications of holographic dark energy derived from the Kaniadakis deformation of the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy. In a spatially flat FLRW universe, the generalized entropy generates an effective dark-energy density with an infrared correction proportional to $H^{-2}$, naturally producing an ultraviolet--infrared structure in the cosmological dynamics. Using the Hayward--Kodama formulation of apparent-horizon thermodynamics, we derive a geometric equation of state and identify Van der Waals-type criticality, characterized by an inverted first-order phase transition and an inverted swallowtail Gibbs potential. We interpret this behavior as the thermodynamic signature of a geometric phase transition of the apparent horizon rather than standard fluid coexistence. We also consider an extended model with a $\dot H$ contribution inspired by the Granda--Oliveros cutoff and show that this unconventional critical behavior persists. At the perturbative level, the same ultraviolet--infrared competition controls the effective sound speed and dark-energy response through a dimensionless coupling $A(z)$, which acts as a geometric order parameter. In the minimal model, $A(z)$ may cross zero during matter domination, marking a transition between infrared- and ultraviolet-dominated regimes, whereas the extended scenario remains ultraviolet dominated. Finally, we confront both models with cosmic chronometers, PantheonPlus Type Ia supernovae, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, and redshift-space distortion data. Bayesian comparison with $\Lambda$CDM, CPL, and standard holographic dark energy strongly disfavors the minimal model. The extended model yields the best maximum-likelihood fit among those considered, but remains disfavored relative to $\Lambda$CDM after accounting for its larger parameter volume.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: Kaniadakis 全息暗能量：紫外-红外对偶、视界热力学与宇宙学约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由 Bekenstein--Hawking 熵的 Kaniadakis 变形导出的全息暗能量的宇宙学和热力学含义。在空间平坦的 FLRW 宇宙中，广义熵产生了一个有效暗能量密度，其红外修正正比于 $H^{-2}$，自然地在宇宙学动力学中产生紫外--红外结构。使用表观视界热力学的 Hayward--Kodama 表述，我们推导了几何状态方程，并识别出 Van der Waals 型临界性，其特征是倒置的一阶相变和倒置的燕尾形 Gibbs 势。我们将这种行为解释为表观视界几何相变的热力学特征，而不是标准流体共存。我们还考虑了一个受 Granda--Oliveros 截断启发的、包含 $\dot H$ 贡献的扩展模型，并表明这种非传统临界行为持续存在。在微扰层面，相同的紫外--红外竞争通过一个无量纲耦合 $A(z)$ 控制有效声速和暗能量响应，该耦合充当几何序参量。在最小模型中，$A(z)$ 可能在物质主导期间穿过零，标志着红外主导和紫外主导机制之间的转变，而扩展情形仍由紫外主导。最后，我们用宇宙钟、PantheonPlus Ia 型超新星、DESI DR2 重子声学振荡和红移空间畸变数据检验了这两个模型。与 ΛCDM、CPL 和标准全息暗能量的贝叶斯比较强烈不偏好最小模型。扩展模型在考虑的参数中给出最佳最大似然拟合，但在计入其更大的参数体积后，相对于 ΛCDM 仍不被偏好。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kaniadakis 修正熵构造全息暗能量，研究其视界热力学相变并用多种宇宙学数据约束，发现最小模型被强烈不偏好，扩展模型拟合最佳但贝叶斯证据仍不如 ΛCDM。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及表观视界热力学、相变和经典宇宙学，与“相变与气泡成核/引力热力学”及“经典引力/广义相对论”重点部分重叠；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 对偶、全息凝聚态/超导、QNM、冷原子等用户多数重点支线，核心是全息暗能量宇宙学。

2604.24944v2.title: A general formalism for coupling scalar fields to the Einstein equations without a variational principle
2604.24944v2.abstract: The purpose of this work is to discuss how matter fields are coupled to gravity within the framework of General Relativity. Our particular focus here is on the coupling of scalar field models. In a first step, we suggest a new method for coupling scalar fields to the Einstein equations \emph{without} the use of a variational principle or Lagrangian. We show that, under the appropriate assumptions, this new method (for coupling scalar fields to gravity) reproduces the minimally and $k$-essence scalar field couplings with a non-zero potential. We therefore interpret this formalism as describing a \emph{generic} method for coupling scalar fields to gravity. The approach described here allows for a number of free fields which we interpret as constitutive freedoms. In a second step, we choose these free fields in such a way that the resulting system is somehow ``near minimal''. In this setting we investigate Bianchi I type solutions. We establish conditions under which the solutions are asymptotically Kasner, near the initial singularity, and investigate their stability properties.

classification.title_zh: 无需变分原理将标量场耦合到爱因斯坦方程的一般形式
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作旨在讨论广义相对论框架下物质场如何与引力耦合。我们特别关注标量场模型的耦合。第一步，我们提出一种新的方法，将标量场与爱因斯坦方程耦合，而无需使用变分原理或拉格朗日量。我们表明，在适当假设下，这种将标量场与引力耦合的新方法可重现具有非零势能的最小耦合和 k-essence 标量场耦合。因此，我们将此形式体系解释为描述标量场与引力耦合的一种一般性方法。该方法允许存在若干自由场，我们将其解释为本构自由度。第二步，我们以某种方式选择这些自由场，使所得系统在某种程度上“近最小”。在此设定下，我们研究 Bianchi I 型解。我们建立了解在初始奇点附近渐近为 Kasner 的条件，并研究其稳定性性质。
classification.one_liner: 提出无需变分原理的标量场-爱因斯坦方程耦合形式，并分析近最小情形下的 Bianchi I 解及其 Kasner 渐近与稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中标量场与爱因斯坦方程的耦合，并分析 Bianchi I 宇宙学解，直接匹配用户的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签。

2605.02078v2.title: Non-variational scalar field cosmology: Exact Bianchi I solutions for near-minimal scalar fields
2605.02078v2.abstract: The purpose of this work is to investigate spatially homogeneous and flat cosmological solutions of the Einstein equations coupled to a non-variational ``near-minimal'' scalar field. This coupling model represents a minimal departure from standard theory by decoupling the scalar field's self-interaction term from the derivative of its potential. By assuming a quadratic potential and a self-interaction term that is proportional to the potential, we derive four new exact Bianchi I solutions. We demonstrate that these solutions produce a diverse range of cosmological phenomena, including Big Bang, Big Crunch, and Big Rip singularities, as well as oscillatory (``cyclic'') behaviour. For our exact solutions, these singularities occur in infinite proper time and hence are never truly reachable by an observer. To assess the stability of these cosmologies, we perform a numerical stability analysis against spatially inhomogeneous perturbations of the mean curvature. We find that the oscillatory solution is unstable to perturbations of this type, as are solutions in possession of a crushing singularity. Conversely, solutions with a Big Rip singularity (at infinity) are stable to spatially inhomogeneous perturbations of the mean curvature.

classification.title_zh: 非变分标量场宇宙学：近最小标量场的精确 Bianchi I 解
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究爱因斯坦方程与一个非变分“近最小”标量场耦合时的空间均匀且平坦宇宙学解。该耦合模型通过将标量场的自相互作用项与其势的导数解耦，构成对标准理论的最小偏离。通过假设二次势以及自相互作用项与势成正比，我们导出了四个新的精确 Bianchi I 解。我们证明这些解会产生多种宇宙学现象，包括大爆炸、大挤压和大撕裂奇点，以及振荡（“循环”）行为。对于这些精确解，相应奇点出现在无限固有时中，因此观测者永远无法真正到达。为评估这些宇宙学模型的稳定性，我们针对平均曲率的空间非均匀扰动进行了数值稳定性分析。我们发现振荡解以及具有挤压奇点的解对此类扰动不稳定；相反，具有（位于无穷远处的）大撕裂奇点的解对平均曲率的空间非均匀扰动稳定。
classification.one_liner: 在非变分近最小标量场宇宙学中给出四个精确 Bianchi I 解，并分析其奇点类型与对非均匀扰动的稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/宇宙学中的精确解与稳定性分析，涉及爱因斯坦方程和非变分标量场，与经典引力支线相关；但不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，因此对全息主线相关性有限。

2606.18341v2.title: Orbital evolution of asymmetric binaries within accreting environments
2606.18341v2.abstract: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals embedded in accretion disks provide a natural arena for studying the interplay between relativistic orbital dynamics and environmental effects. In this work, we develop a framework to investigate the secular evolution of compact objects repeatedly crossing an accretion disk around a supermassive black hole. The orbital motion is modeled through Kerr geodesics, while disk interactions are encoded through effective prescriptions for mass accretion and dynamical friction. We find that disk-induced dissipation generically drives a two-stage evolution characterized by rapid alignment of the orbital plane with the disk, followed by slower eccentricity damping. By systematically comparing the dynamics with a purely Keplerian treatment, we show that cumulative relativistic effects produce deviations even at large orbital separations, where the Keplerian approximation would naively be expected to remain accurate. These discrepancies grow through repeated disk crossings and become increasingly pronounced in more relativistic orbital configurations. We further investigate the impact of the accretion-disk model by comparing the Sirko-Goodman and Novikov-Thorne prescriptions. Relativistic disk structures predict systematically lower densities and larger scale heights, leading to weaker orbital dissipation and slower secular evolution. By contrast, the spin of the central black hole has only a minor effect on the overall circularization efficiency. Our results demonstrate the importance of consistently modeling both relativistic orbital dynamics and disk structure when studying compact objects embedded in AGN disks, and provide a framework for exploring their long-term evolution, as well as a possible connection to quasi-periodic eruptions.

classification.title_zh: 吸积环境中非对称双星的轨道演化
classification.abstract_zh: 嵌入吸积盘中的极端质量比旋近为研究相对论轨道动力学与环境效应之间的相互作用提供了天然场所。在这项工作中，我们建立了一个框架，研究围绕超大质量黑洞、反复穿越吸积盘的致密天体的长期演化。轨道运动用 Kerr 测地线建模，而盘相互作用则通过质量吸积和动力学摩擦的有效处方来编码。我们发现，盘致耗散通常会驱动一个两阶段演化：轨道面与盘快速对齐，随后偏心率缓慢阻尼。通过将动力学与纯 Kepler 处理进行系统比较，我们表明累积相对论效应即使在较大轨道间距也会产生偏差，而 Kepler 近似通常被认为在这些间距仍然准确。这些差异随着反复穿越吸积盘而增长，并在更相对论性的轨道构型中变得更加显著。我们进一步通过比较 Sirko-Goodman 和 Novikov-Thorne 处方来研究吸积盘模型的影响。相对论性盘结构预测系统性更低的密度和更大的标高，导致更弱的轨道耗散和更慢的长期演化。相比之下，中心黑洞自旋对整体圆化效率仅有次要影响。我们的结果表明，在研究嵌入 AGN 盘中的致密天体时，一致地建模相对论轨道动力学和盘结构都很重要，并为探索其长期演化以及可能与准周期喷发的联系提供了框架。
classification.one_liner: 在 Kerr 时空与吸积盘相互作用框架下，极端质量比旋近先快速轨道面排列、后缓慢偏心率阻尼，且相对论效应与盘模型显著改变长期演化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 Kerr 时空中极端质量比旋近与吸积盘相互作用导致的轨道长期演化，属于经典广义相对论/黑洞天体物理，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；与全息对偶无关。

2608.07311v2.title: Oscillations of Dissipative Neutron Stars: The Impact of Hyperonic Reaction Rates
2608.07311v2.abstract: Tidal excitations of stellar oscillation modes during binary neutron-star inspirals offer a powerful probe of the composition of dense matter at supranuclear densities. Chemical equilibration plays a crucial, but often neglected, role in stellar perturbation calculations. If the chemical equilibration timescale is comparable to the oscillation timescale, then viscous effects can damp the modes. If the reactions are fast, some modes can completely disappear since their restoring force vanishes. Typically, these calculations, however, assume either instantaneous chemical equilibrium or no equilibration (frozen composition). Motivated by this, we investigate the effects of finite reaction rates on the oscillation spectrum of neutron stars containing hyperonic matter. We calculate the dominant non-leptonic weak interaction rates and incorporate them into the relativistic perturbation equations through a complex, frequency-dependent dynamical sound speed. We show that finite-rate effects naturally manifest as bulk-viscous dissipation, modifying the properties of both the fundamental ($f$) and gravity ($g$) modes. We further examine the impact on the tidal response by matching stellar perturbations to near-zone boundary conditions, demonstrating how viscous dissipation gives rise to a tidal lag. These results provide a consistent framework connecting microscopic reaction rates and the resulting bulk viscosity to the tidal dynamics of compact binaries, and represent a step towards incorporating viscous dissipation into gravitational-wave models of binary neutron-star inspirals.

classification.title_zh: 耗散中子星的振荡：超子反应率的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 双中子星旋近过程中恒星振荡模式的潮汐激发，为探测超核密度下致密物质组成提供了有力探针。化学平衡在恒星微扰计算中起着关键但常被忽略的作用。如果化学平衡时标与振荡时标相当，黏性效应会阻尼这些模式。如果反应很快，某些模式可能完全消失，因为其恢复力消失。然而，这类计算通常假设瞬时化学平衡或无平衡（组分冻结）。受此启发，我们研究有限反应率对含超子物质中子星振荡谱的影响。我们计算主导的非轻子弱相互作用反应率，并通过一个复的、依赖频率的动力学声速将其纳入相对论微扰方程。我们表明，有限速率效应自然表现为体黏性耗散，改变基频（f）模和重力（g）模的性质。我们进一步通过将恒星微扰与近区边界条件匹配来考察对潮汐响应的影响，展示黏性耗散如何导致潮汐滞后。这些结果为连接微观反应率及其产生的体黏性与致密双星潮汐动力学提供了一个一致框架，并朝着将黏性耗散纳入双中子星旋近引力波模型迈出了一步。
classification.one_liner: 将含超子中子星的非轻子弱反应率作为频率依赖体黏性纳入相对论微扰，研究其对 f/g 模和潮汐响应的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与致密星引力波物理，而非全息对偶研究；但与用户重点标签中的经典引力方向相关，尤其是双中子星旋近、潮汐响应和耗散效应。

2604.08506v2.title: The Heavy Tailed Non-Gaussianity of the Supermassive Black Hole Gravitational Wave Background
2604.08506v2.abstract: We study the non-Gaussian features of the gravitational wave (GW) background generated by a population of inspiraling supermassive black hole (SMBH) binaries. We show that the SMBH GW amplitude distribution (GWAD) features a universal heavy power-law tail $\propto A^{-4}$, while the low-amplitude tail depends on the SMBH merger rate and the energy-loss mechanisms of the binaries. The distribution of the induced timing residuals inherits this heavy tail. As a result, the ensemble averaged statistical moments of order three and higher diverge, limiting their usefulness as measures of non-Gaussianity, and the GW background from SMBH binaries exhibits the single loud source principle, according to which the strongest signals are more likely to be caused by a small number of loud sources. We confirm that the variance-averaged Gaussian approximation accurately describes the timing residual statistics. This approximation justifies a factored likelihood structure that combines standard Gaussian-process PTA posteriors with the non-Gaussian population prior, enabling consistent incorporation of non-Gaussian effects into SMBH model inference. We provide a fast and flexible Python implementation to compute the distribution of timing residuals from a given SMBH merger rate or GWAD.

classification.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞引力波背景的重尾非高斯性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由一群旋近的超大质量黑洞双星产生的引力波背景的非高斯特征。我们表明，超大质量黑洞引力波振幅分布具有普适的重幂律尾 ∝ A^{-4}，而低振幅尾依赖于超大质量黑洞并合率和双星的能量损失机制。诱导的计时残差分布继承这一重尾。因此，三阶及更高阶的系综平均统计矩发散，限制了它们作为非高斯性度量的用途，并且来自超大质量黑洞双星的引力波背景表现出单响亮源原理，即最强信号更可能由少数响亮源引起。我们确认方差平均高斯近似准确描述了计时残差统计。该近似支持一种因子化似然结构，将标准高斯过程脉冲星计时阵列后验与非高斯种群先验结合，使得能够将非高斯效应一致地纳入超大质量黑洞模型推断。我们提供一个快速灵活的 Python 实现，用于根据给定的超大质量黑洞并合率或引力波振幅分布计算计时残差分布。
classification.one_liner: 超大质量黑洞双星引力波背景的振幅分布具有 ∝A^{-4} 重尾，导致高阶矩发散并表现为单响亮源原理，同时可用方差平均高斯近似进行脉冲星计时阵列推断。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究超大质量黑洞双星引力波背景的非高斯统计与脉冲星计时阵列推断，属于经典引力/广义相对论及引力波现象，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，但不涉及全息对偶。

2607.18441v3.title: Detection of cosmic strings by gravitational wave lensing. Predictions for Einstein Telescope
2607.18441v3.abstract: Cosmic strings are not yet confirmed, topological defects formed in the early Universe. They can bend light or gravitational waves, which causes an effect similar to the gravitational lensing. Our goal is to check whether cosmic string could be detected as a lenses of gravitational waves by the Einstein Telescope (ET). To do that the apparatus of wave optics had been applied. Firstly we explored the amplification factor strength and behaviour. Next the wave effects in SNRs and waveforms was examined for different inclinations of the source. Lastly we estimated the string tensions based on eight mergers from the \textsc{StarTrack} simulation, using the Bayesian Inference methods. The wave effects were easily to see in waveforms, SNR and characteristic strains. Also most of the events could be detected, based on their Signal to Noise Ratio values. Almost whole characteristic strain lies in the range of the ET. When it comes to mock observations, we had got estimated vale of a logarithm of the CS tension equal to $\bar{\log{G\mu}}=-9.80^{+0.49}_{-0.56} $, which were consistent with injected value equal to $-10$. At the end we conclude that CSs could be detected by the ET.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力波透镜效应探测宇宙弦：爱因斯坦望远镜的预测
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙弦是早期宇宙中形成的拓扑缺陷，目前尚未被证实。它们可以弯折光线或引力波，产生类似引力透镜的效应。我们的目标是检验爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）能否将宇宙弦作为引力波透镜探测到。为此我们采用了波动光学方法。首先研究放大因子的强度和演化行为；然后考察不同源倾角下信噪比（SNR）和波形中的波动效应；最后基于StarTrack模拟的八个并合事件，使用贝叶斯推断方法估计弦张力。波动效应在波形、SNR和特征应变中都很容易看到。根据信噪比，大多数事件可以被探测到。几乎整个特征应变都位于ET的范围内。在模拟观测中，我们得到宇宙弦张力对数的估计值为 -9.80^{+0.49}_{-0.56}，与注入值 -10 一致。最后我们得出结论：ET可以探测到宇宙弦。
classification.one_liner: 该文用波动光学和贝叶斯推断评估ET通过引力波透镜探测宇宙弦的可行性，模拟表明多数事件可探测且弦张力估计与注入值一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波宇宙学与透镜效应，可直接归入经典引力支线；不涉及AdS/CFT或全息对偶。

2609.09955v2.title: Milky Way Structure from Double White Dwarf Gravitational-Wave Sources
2609.09955v2.abstract: The millihertz gravitational-wave sky will be dominated by $\sim10^{8}$ double white dwarfs while $\sim10^{4}$ be resolvable in the Milky Way, whose three-dimensional spatial distribution traces the Galaxy's structural parameters. We present \textsc{Galena}, a hierarchical Bayesian pipeline that recovers these parameters from a double white dwarf catalogue through an inhomogeneous Poisson-process likelihood. Each source's $3\times3$ Galactic position covariance is computed from the waveform Fisher information matrix and propagated analytically through a $3\times5$ Jacobian; the resulting measurement-error convolution is factored into a pre-computed sparse weight matrix, rendering the nested-sampling inference tractable. Applied to GBSIEVER-reported LISA Data Challenge sources ($N=2151$ after quality cuts), \textsc{Galena} recovers the disk scale length $R_d=2175^{+51}_{-52}$~pc and scale height $z_d=282^{+7}_{-7}$~pc, consistent with a canonical thin disk, together with the bulge fraction $A=0.187^{+0.011}_{-0.012}$ and bulge scale radius $R_b=773^{+26}_{-25}$~pc; the bulge fraction, now recovered much closer to the literature value of $0.25$ than in our earlier exact-position fit, is measured at $\sim6\%$ statistical precision. An independent particle-swarm optimisation of the same likelihood reproduces these values to within a fraction of a percent, supporting the attribution of the improvement to the Fisher-matrix error propagation rather than to the sampler. The search-stage astrophysical prior improves per-source distance estimates but leaves the hierarchical inference essentially unchanged.

classification.title_zh: 从双白矮星引力波源看银河系结构
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹引力波天空将被约 10^8 个双白矮星主导，其中约 10^4 个可在银河系内被分辨；它们的三维空间分布刻画了银河系的结构参数。我们提出 Galena，一套分层贝叶斯流程，通过非齐次泊松过程似然从双白矮星目录中恢复这些参数。每个源在银河系位置上的 3×3 协方差由波形 Fisher 信息矩阵计算，并通过 3×5 雅可比矩阵解析传播；由此得到的测量误差卷积被分解为预计算的稀疏权重矩阵，使嵌套采样推断可行。将其应用于 GBSIEVER 报告的 LISA Data Challenge 源（质量筛选后 N=2151），Galena 恢复出盘标长 R_d=2175^{+51}_{-52} pc 和标高 z_d=282^{+7}_{-7} pc，与典型薄盘一致；同时还恢复出核球比例 A=0.187^{+0.011}_{-0.012} 和核球标度半径 R_b=773^{+26}_{-25} pc；核球比例现在比此前的精确位置拟合更接近文献值 0.25，并以约 6% 的统计精度测得。对同一似然的独立粒子群优化再现这些值至百分之零点几以内，支持将改进归因于 Fisher 矩阵误差传播而非采样器。搜索阶段的天体物理先验改善了单源距离估计，但对分层推断基本没有影响。
classification.one_liner: 利用双白矮星引力波源目录和非齐次泊松分层贝叶斯推断测量银河系盘与核球结构参数。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于引力波天文学与银河系结构统计推断，不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或 AdS/CFT；虽含引力波与经典引力分支标签，但与用户重点的全息研究支线无关。

2609.12664v1.title: Phase Structure and Gravitational-Wave Phenomenology of a Thermal First-Order Phase Transition
2609.12664v1.abstract: We investigate the phase structure and gravitational-wave (GW) phenomenology of a cosmological first-order phase transition described by the finite-temperature effective potential $V(\phi,T)=D(T^2-T_0^2)\phi^2-ET\phi^3+\lambda\phi^4/4$. We derive the critical temperature and the broken-phase order parameter and identify the dimensionless combination $E^2/(D\lambda)$ that controls the critical-temperature shift. We then construct a dense numerical atlas containing $30\,000$ parameter points and map the resulting transition parameters onto the characteristic GW frequency and peak amplitude. The scan resolves the multidimensional correlations among $T_*$, $\alpha$, $\beta/H_*$, $v_w$, $f_{\rm peak}$ and $\Omega_{\rm GW}^{\rm peak}h^2$. The present analysis is phenomenological: $T_*$ is defined by the prescription $T_*=0.95T_c$, while $\beta/H_*$ and $v_w$ are treated as scan inputs. Consequently, the resulting GW signals are not interpreted as first-principles predictions. We identify the additional ingredients required for a predictive calculation, including the thermal bounce action, nucleation and percolation temperatures, the transition duration and a microscopic treatment of bubble-wall friction. The resulting framework provides a systematic numerical characterization of the connection between the phase structure of the finite-temperature potential and the corresponding phenomenological GW parameter space.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 热一阶相变的相结构与引力波现象学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由有限温有效势 V(φ,T)=D(T^2-T_0^2)φ^2-ETφ^3+λφ^4/4 描述的宇宙学一阶相变的相结构和引力波（GW）现象学。我们推导临界温度和破缺相序参量，并识别控制临界温度移动的无量纲组合 E^2/(Dλ)。然后构建包含 30000 个参数点的密集数值图谱，将所得相变参数映射到特征 GW 频率和峰值振幅。该扫描解析了 T_*、α、β/H_*、v_w、f_peak 和 Ω_GW^peak h^2 之间的多维关联。当前分析是唯象的：T_* 由 T_*=0.95T_c 的规定定义，而 β/H_* 和 v_w 被当作扫描输入。因此，所得 GW 信号不被解释为第一性原理预言。我们指出进行预测性计算所需的额外要素，包括热反弹作用、成核与渗流温度、相变持续时间以及气泡壁摩擦的微观处理。所得框架系统性地数值刻画了有限温势的相结构与相应唯象 GW 参数空间之间的联系。
classification.one_liner: 用三万个参数点扫描有限温有效势的一阶相变，唯象映射相变参数到引力波频谱，并列出预测化所需物理要素。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学一阶相变与引力波现象学，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶、量子信息或量子引力；与全息理论主线无关。

2609.13163v1.title: The Fuzzy-Sphere as a Black Hole in the IKKT Matrix Model: An Assessment
2609.13163v1.abstract: Black-hole thermodynamics has been reproduced with remarkable success from the BFSS matrix model, but the corresponding test in the closely related IKKT matrix model has awaited its recently proposed finite-temperature formulation. We investigate this correspondence within that framework. Introducing a cubic Myers term, we compute the complete one-loop thermodynamics -- free energy, internal energy, entropy, and heat capacity -- of a fuzzy $S^2$ background. No gravitational dual is known for this specific background, so we compare these quantities against the D0 and D2 black holes as the closest available reference points. At fixed Myers coupling, the leading entropy exhibits an $O(N^3)$ scaling rather than the $O(N^2)$ behavior characteristic of conventional black holes; this scaling mismatch is the central result of our analysis. We further find no intrinsic Hawking temperature -- only a characteristic scale -- and a heat capacity that is negative at both the low- and high-temperature endpoints. Holding the physical radius fixed instead yields a genuine $O(N^2)$ scaling, so the power of $N$ is convention-dependent rather than an unambiguous prediction -- though the sign and temperature-scale mismatches persist either way. Rather than establishing a black-hole interpretation of the finite-temperature IKKT matrix model, these results provide a quantitative benchmark against which future analytical, numerical, and holographic investigations can be tested.

classification.title_zh: 模糊球作为 IKKT 矩阵模型中的黑洞：一项评估
classification.abstract_zh: BFSS 矩阵模型已非常成功地再现了黑洞热力学，但在密切相关的 IKKT 矩阵模型中，相应的检验一直有待其最近提出的有限温度表述。我们在该框架内研究这一对应。引入立方 Myers 项后，我们计算了模糊 S^2 背景的完整单圈热力学——自由能、内能、熵和热容。对于这一特定背景，尚不知道任何引力对偶，因此我们将这些量与 D0 和 D2 黑洞作为最接近的可用参考点进行比较。在固定 Myers 耦合下，领头熵表现出 O(N^3) 标度，而不是常规黑洞特征的 O(N^2) 行为；这一标度不匹配是我们分析的核心结果。我们进一步发现没有内禀 Hawking 温度——只有一个特征尺度——并且热容在低温端和高温端均为负。若改为固定物理半径，则得到真正的 O(N^2) 标度，因此 N 的幂次依赖于约定，而不是一个无歧义的预言——尽管符号和温度尺度的不匹配在两种情况下都持续存在。这些结果并未确立有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型的黑洞解释，而是提供了一个定量基准，供未来解析、数值和全息研究检验。
classification.one_liner: 在有限温度 IKKT 矩阵模型中计算模糊 S^2 背景的单圈热力学，发现熵标度与常规黑洞不符，因而未能支持其黑洞解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 IKKT 矩阵模型/模糊球的黑洞热力学，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等具体支线。

2609.13381v1.title: The Conformal $w$-Algebra
2609.13381v1.abstract: Einstein gravity in four asymptotically flat dimensions is governed by a tower of soft theorems obeying an $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ commutator algebra. This algebra is deformed to $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ in the conformally related AdS$_4$ and dS$_4$ spacetimes. Here we construct the larger ``conformal $w$-algebra", denoted $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$, which acts on conformal gravity in all of these spacetimes. It includes $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$, $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ and the $\mathfrak{so}(4,2)$ 4D conformal algebra as subalgebras. We show that $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ is the conformal completion of either $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ or $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$. A derivation of $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ is given as the symmetry of the twistor action of self-dual conformal gravity.

classification.title_zh: 共形 w-代数
classification.abstract_zh: 四维渐近平直时空中的爱因斯坦引力由一族满足 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 交换子代数的软定理支配。该代数在共形相关的 AdS$_4$ 和 dS$_4$ 时空中变形为 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$。这里我们构造更大的“共形 w-代数”，记作 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$，它作用在这些时空中的共形引力上。它包含 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$、$\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 以及 $\mathfrak{so}(4,2)$ 四维共形代数作为子代数。我们证明 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ 是 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 或 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 的共形完备化。作为 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$ 的一个推导，它被给出为自对偶共形引力 twistor 作用的对称性。
classification.one_liner: 构造了作用在平直、AdS$_4$ 和 dS$_4$ 中共形引力上的共形 w-代数 $\mathcal{C}w_{1+\infty}$，并证明其是 $\mathcal{L}w_{1+\infty}$ 或 $\mathcal{L}_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$ 的共形完备化，作为自对偶共形引力 twistor 作用的对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究软定理与渐近对称代数，属于天球/平直全息方向，与用户列出的全息超导、QNM、探针膜、冷原子等支线及经典引力现象无直接重叠。

2609.13386v1.title: Matrix Theory from Holography
2609.13386v1.abstract: We propose a setup that embeds Matrix Theory for M-theory into the AdS/CFT correspondence, allowing the former to be tested using the latter. The central claim is a triality among the BMN matrix model of rank $m$, a large-charge monopole sector of ABJM theory with charge $J$, and M-theory on the maximally supersymmetric eleven-dimensional pp-wave with a compact lightlike direction. The relevant ABJM limit sends $N,k,J\to\infty$ while keeping $N/k^2$ and $m=J/k$ fixed. We provide quantitative evidence for this triality by showing that, in this triple-scaling limit, the ABJM superconformal index agrees precisely with a grand-canonical sum of Witten indices of the $U(m)$ BMN matrix model. This relation also yields a compact grand-canonical expression for the BMN index, which we use to revisit its large-$m$ behavior. Our analytic and numerical results reveal strong boson--fermion cancellations and show no evidence for the previously claimed $e^{O(m^2)}$ growth when the BMN charge scales as $Q \sim m^2$. We further study the correspondence between the BPS cohomologies of the two theories by constructing a letter-level dictionary. This leads to a new notion of BPS fortuity in ABJM theory that survives even at strict $N=\infty$: although the usual fortuity associated with finite-$N$ trace relations disappears in the triple-scaling limit, each fixed-monopole sector is governed by the effective rank $m$, and finite-$m$ trace relations generate fortuitous states that map directly to fortuitous states of the BMN matrix model. Finally, we discuss connections to related concepts such as large-charge matrix models, open--closed--open triality, and worldline holography.

classification.title_zh: 来自全息的矩阵理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个将 M 理论的矩阵理论嵌入 AdS/CFT 对应的方案，从而可用后者检验前者。核心主张是 rank m 的 BMN 矩阵模型、荷为 J 的 ABJM 理论大荷磁单极子扇区、以及具有紧致类光方向的十一维极大超对称 pp-wave 上的 M 理论之间的三重对偶。相关 ABJM 极限为 N,k,J→∞，同时保持 N/k^2 和 m=J/k 固定。我们通过证明在该三重标度极限下 ABJM 超共形指标精确等于 U(m) BMN 矩阵模型 Witten 指标的大正则求和，给出该三重对偶的定量证据。该关系还给出 BMN 指标的一个紧致大正则表达式，我们用它重新审视其大 m 行为。我们的解析与数值结果显示出强玻色—费米抵消，并未发现在 BMN 荷按 Q~m^2 标度时先前所声称的 e^{O(m^2)} 增长证据。我们进一步通过构造 letter 层面的字典研究两个理论 BPS 上同调之间的对应，由此引出 ABJM 理论中一种即使在严格 N=∞ 仍存活的新 BPS fortuity 概念：尽管与有限 N trace relation 相关的通常 fortuity 在三重标度极限中消失，每个固定磁单极子扇区由有效 rank m 支配，有限 m trace relation 产生可直接映射到 BMN 矩阵模型 fortuitous 态的 fortuitous 态。最后，我们讨论与大荷矩阵模型、open-closed-open triality 和 worldline holography 等相关概念的联系。
classification.one_liner: 提出 BMN 矩阵模型、ABJM 大荷磁单极子扇区与十一维 pp-wave 上 M 理论的三重对偶，并用超共形指标给出定量证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT、矩阵模型与 M 理论方向，但未直接匹配用户列出的重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）。

2609.13558v1.title: Electromagnetic Duality Sensitivity of Holographic Complexity
2609.13558v1.abstract: We investigate electromagnetic duality as a diagnostic of the sensitivity of information content of holographic complexity via "complexity=anything" in Einstein-ModMax theory. Functionals constructed solely from gravitational invariants are duality invariant, whereas matter-sensitive functionals can distinguish electromagnetic configurations that share the same bulk geometry and energy-momentum tensor. As an explicit example, we consider a functional involving $F_{\mu\nu}F^{\mu\nu}$ and show that its complexity and complexity growth vary along the duality orbit, interpolating between purely electric, mixed electric-magnetic, and purely magnetic configurations. This provides an explicit realization of the freedom inherent in generalized holographic complexity and shows that different choices of complexity functional can retain different sensitivity to information about the bulk matter sector even when the gravitational geometry is insensitive to that information.

classification.title_zh: 全息复杂度的电磁对偶敏感性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究电磁对偶，将其作为在 Einstein-ModMax 理论中通过“complexity=anything”诊断全息复杂度信息内容敏感性的工具。仅由引力不变量构造的泛函具有对偶不变性，而物质敏感泛函可以区分共享同一体几何和能量-动量张量的电磁位形。作为一个显式例子，我们考虑一个涉及 $F_{\mu\nu}F^{\mu\nu}$ 的泛函，并展示其复杂度和复杂度增长沿对偶轨道变化，在纯电场、电场-磁场混合和纯磁场位形之间插值。这显式实现了广义全息复杂度所固有的自由度，并表明即使引力几何对该信息不敏感，不同复杂度泛函的选择也可以保留对体物质部门信息的不同敏感性。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-ModMax 理论中，含 F^2 的 complexity=anything 泛函沿电磁对偶轨道变化，证明全息复杂度可敏感于体物质信息而几何不变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息复杂度/AdS-CFT 理论，但与用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子、探针膜和经典引力等重点方向无直接交集。

2609.14165v1.title: Modular flow and the area operator
2609.14165v1.abstract: In the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence, the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula relates the boundary modular Hamiltonian to the HRT area operator and the corresponding bulk modular Hamiltonian. In standard discussions of a holographic code built from perturbative excitations on a fixed classical background, the $A/4G$ term dominates over the bulk modular Hamiltonian in the limit $G \to 0$. However, this setup is insufficient to describe the action of boundary modular flows that change the classical background. In contrast, our recent discussion of `large' codes provides a useful framework to obtain a JLMS formula that relates bulk and boundary modular flows acting on appropriate states in the code. Here, one sees that the bulk modular Hamiltonian is not in fact subdominant when the modular flow defined by one state acts on another state peaked around a sufficiently different classical background. Instead, the bulk modular Hamiltonian can be of order $1/G$ and can dominate over the $A/4G$ term. Nevertheless, we show that if the two states have the same classical background except for data conjugate to the HRT area then, under mild assumptions and over a large range of flow parameters, the modular-flowed state is described by a classical background given by the HRT-area flow alone.

classification.title_zh: 模流与面积算符
classification.abstract_zh: 在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下，Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh（JLMS）公式将边界模哈密顿量与 HRT 面积算符及相应的体模哈密顿量联系起来。在基于固定经典背景上微扰激发构建的全息码的标准讨论中，当 G → 0 时，A/4G 项主导体模哈密顿量。然而，这种设置不足以描述改变经典背景的边界模流作用。相比之下，我们近期关于“大”码的讨论为获得一个 JLMS 公式提供了有用框架，该公式将作用于码中适当态上的体与边界模流联系起来。在这里可以看到，当一个态定义的模流作用于另一个围绕足够不同经典背景的态时，体模哈密顿量实际上并不次主导。相反，体模哈密顿量可以是 1/G 量级，并可能主导 A/4G 项。尽管如此，我们证明，如果两个态具有相同的经典背景，除了与 HRT 面积共轭的数据不同，那么在温和假设下并在很大的流参数范围内，模流后的态由仅由 HRT 面积流给出的经典背景描述。
classification.one_liner: 在全息大码框架中，模流作用于不同经典背景态时体模哈密顿量可主导 A/4G；若两态仅相差 HRT 面积共轭数据，则模流态由 HRT 面积流描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文聚焦 JLMS 公式、模流与 HRT 面积算符，属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子信息方向，不直接涉及用户重点列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等支线。

2609.14296v1.title: Holographic Casimir Effect for Mixed Boundary Conditions and non-CFTs
2609.14296v1.abstract: This paper investigates the holographic Casimir effect in AdS/BCFT with a brane-localized scalar field. The scalar field takes different values at the strip's two boundaries, leading to mixed boundary conditions. The massive brane-localized scalar field typically breaks the boundary conformal symmetries, allowing us to study the holographic Casimir effect in non-CFTs. In two-dimensional spacetime, we apply the holographic g-theorem to prove the holographic bound on the Casimir effect for general brane-localized matter fields. In higher dimensions, we find that the brane-localized scalar field reduces the Casimir amplitude when the mass squared \(m^2=0\), but can increase it when \(m^2 < 0\). Additionally, there is a no-hair theorem for the cases where \(m^2>0\). These findings indicate that relevant boundary deformations can enhance the Casimir effect. As a byproduct, we obtain a gravitational dual of the repulsive Casimir force under mixed boundary conditions and argue that it aligns with the cosmic censorship conjecture.

classification.title_zh: 混合边界条件与非 CFT 中的全息卡西米尔效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究 AdS/BCFT 中带有膜局域标量场的全息卡西米尔效应。标量场在条带两个边界取不同值，导致混合边界条件。有质量的膜局域标量场通常会破坏边界共形对称性，使我们能够研究非 CFT 中的全息卡西米尔效应。在二维时空中，我们应用全息 g-定理证明了对一般膜局域物质场的卡西米尔效应的全息界。在更高维中，我们发现当质量平方 m^2=0 时，膜局域标量场降低卡西米尔振幅，但当 m^2<0 时可以增大它。此外，对于 m^2>0 的情况存在无毛定理。这些发现表明相关边界形变可以增强卡西米尔效应。作为副产品，我们获得了混合边界条件下排斥卡西米尔力的引力对偶，并论证它与宇宙监督猜想一致。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS/BCFT 中研究带膜局域标量场与混合边界条件的全息卡西米尔效应，发现非 CFT 边界形变可增强卡西米尔力，并给出排斥卡西米尔力的引力对偶与宇宙监督的联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/BCFT 全息与卡西米尔效应，并涉及经典引力中的无毛定理与宇宙监督；但与用户列出的全息超导、探针膜、QNM、冷原子等具体重点支线无直接重合。

2609.14497v1.title: M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory
2609.14497v1.abstract: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×S7/Zk 中的 M2 膜：ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正与局域化对比
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究在 AdS4×S7/Zk 内部包裹 AdS2×S1 的 M2 膜的量子化，其对偶是 ABJM 理论中的 1/2-BPS 圆 Wilson 圈。此前已证明经典作用量和单圈贡献能重现规范理论的局域化结果。这里我们将分析推广到双圈阶。在适当的静态且 κ 对称规范下，世界体积作用量不包含三阶相互作用顶点，因此双圈修正完全由四次相互作用决定，并且明显没有对数紫外发散。我们发现玻色子和费米子贡献合并为一个完全平方 X^2，其中 X 是玻色子和费米子三维格林函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 X 需要固定无质量费米子模式的 AdS2 边界量子化。在由保持的超对称所选择的边界条件下，X 为零，因此完整的双圈修正为零。该结果与将 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于正则固定 (N,k) 局域化预言的大 N 展开不一致。相反，它精确符合最近的提议：半经典 M2 膜配分函数应与规范理论巨正则系综相匹配，其中 Wilson 圈期望值在微扰意义下单圈精确。因此双圈修正的消失为这一巨正则对应提供了非平凡检验。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS4×S7/Zk 中计算对偶于 ABJM 1/2-BPS 圆 Wilson 圈的 M2 膜双圈修正，发现修正为零，支持半经典 M2 膜配分函数对应规范理论巨正则系综、Wilson 圈微扰单圈精确的提议。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典中的 M2 膜/Wilson 圈/局域化精确检验，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、相变、QNM、探针膜等具体重点支线。

2609.14603v1.title: Attraction and repulsion along extremal Einstein--two-Maxwell--dilaton branches
2609.14603v1.abstract: We study extremal mass branches in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to one dilaton and two Maxwell fields with opposite-sign dilaton couplings.
