2604.18992v2.title: Estimating galactic foreground with the population of resolved galactic binaries
2604.18992v2.abstract: The stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) in the millihertz band constitutes a primary science target for future space-based interferometers. The detection of such a signal, however, poses substantial data-processing challenges, not least due to the overwhelming contribution from numerous compact binaries in our Galaxy. Only a fraction of these binaries are sufficiently bright to be resolved as individual sources. The superposition of gravitational waves from the inspiral phases of the unresolved majority gives rise to a confusion foreground that must be accurately estimated. In this work, we model this foreground as an anisotropic SGWB and derive the variation of detector response intensity by analyzing the spatial distribution of binary systems. We further examine the distribution of resolved systems to assess whether they are representative of the total population. Finally, we perform parameter estimation to an injected stochastic background using the modeled foreground within the Taiji Data Challenge II. Our results demonstrate that a foreground description based on the population properties of resolved Galactic binaries can yield preliminarily viable estimates.

classification.title_zh: 利用已分辨银河双星种群估计银河前景
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹频段的随机引力波背景（SGWB）是未来空间引力波干涉仪的主要科学目标之一。然而，探测这种信号面临巨大的数据处理挑战，尤其是来自银河系中大量致密双星的压倒性贡献。只有一部分双星足够明亮，可以被分辨为单个源。未分辨的大多数双星在旋近阶段的引力波叠加形成混淆前景，必须被准确估计。在这项工作中，我们将该前景建模为各向异性 SGWB，并通过分析双星系统的空间分布推导探测器响应强度的变化。我们进一步考察已分辨系统的分布，以评估它们是否能代表总体种群。最后，我们在 Taiji Data Challenge II 中，利用所建模的前景对注入的随机背景进行参数估计。结果表明，基于已分辨银河双星种群性质的前景描述能够给出初步可行的估计。
classification.one_liner: 用已分辨银河双星种群性质建模毫赫兹频段各向异性随机引力波前景，并在 Taiji Data Challenge II 中检验参数估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为空间引力波干涉仪数据中银河双星混淆前景建模与参数估计，属于引力波天文学/经典引力，与全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息研究无直接关系。

2606.06884v2.title: Tidal Disruption of Blanets by Supermassive Black Holes: From Test Particles to Planetary-Mass Bodies in Kerr Spacetime
2606.06884v2.abstract: Planetary-mass bodies formed in active galactic nucleus (AGN) discs, termed "blanets", may undergo tidal disruption by the central supermassive black hole (SMBH). We analyse this process in Kerr spacetime using Mino-time geodesics and the Marck tidal tensor in a parallel-transported tetrad, treating the blanet as a test particle with finite size entering through the disruption criterion. For a blanet of $100 M_{\oplus}$ and $6 R_{\oplus}$ around a $10^7 M_{\odot}$ SMBH, the tidal radius is 0.82 AU, or 8.3 gravitational radii, requiring a non-perturbative relativistic treatment. The Hills mass depends on bulk density as $M_{\rm Hills}\propto\rho_p^{-1/2}$ and is independent of blanet mass at fixed density. Rocky compositions yield a lower Hills mass than a Sun-like star, while volatile-rich compositions yield a higher value, suggesting a potential composition diagnostic. The frozen-in fallback model gives a peak time of about 15 yr and a peak luminosity of $3.7\times10^{40}$ erg/s, about $3\times10^{-5}$ of the Eddington luminosity, predicting a faint, ultraviolet-peaked transient lasting roughly a century. Scalar resonant relaxation in the surrounding nuclear star cluster may deliver blanets to disruptive orbits over $10^8$ to $10^9$ yr, implying an estimated per-AGN event rate of $10^{-7}$ to $10^{-6}$ per year. Gravitational waves from sub-Earth-mass debris fragments remain approximately nine orders of magnitude below Laser Interferometer Space Antenna sensitivity.

classification.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞对 Blanets 的潮汐瓦解：Kerr 时空中从测试粒子到行星质量天体
classification.abstract_zh: 在活动星系核（AGN）盘中形成的行星质量天体被称为“blanets”，它们可能被中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）潮汐瓦解。我们使用 Mino 时间测地线和沿平行传输四元标架中的 Marck 潮汐张量，在 Kerr 时空中分析这一过程，将 blanet 视为具有有限尺寸的测试粒子，并通过瓦解判据进入。对于围绕 10^7 M_⊙ SMBH 的 100 M_⊕ 和 6 R_⊕ 的 blanet，潮汐半径为 0.82 AU，即 8.3 引力半径，需要非微扰相对论处理。Hills 质量依赖体密度为 M_Hills ∝ ρ_p^{-1/2}，在固定密度下与 blanet 质量无关。岩石成分给出比类太阳恒星更低的 Hills 质量，而富挥发分成分给出更高值，表明潜在成分诊断。冻结回落模型给出峰值时间约 15 年，峰值光度 3.7×10^40 erg/s，约为 Eddington 光度的 3×10^{-5}，预测一个微弱、紫外峰值、持续约一个世纪的暂现源。周围核星团中的标量共振弛豫可能在 10^8 到 10^9 年将 blanets 送入瓦解轨道，意味着每个 AGN 的事件率估计为每年 10^{-7} 到 10^{-6}。来自亚地球质量碎片的引力波仍比 LISA 灵敏度低约九个数量级。
classification.one_liner: 在 Kerr 时空中研究 AGN 盘内行星质量 Blanets 被超大质量黑洞潮汐瓦解，预测微弱紫外暂现源、事件率与 LISA 可忽略的引力波。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是 Kerr 时空中经典广义相对论潮汐瓦解过程，属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，但不涉及全息对偶。

2609.13369v1.title: Diffraction of gravitational waves by extended dark objects
2609.13369v1.abstract: Many dark sector models predict the formation of dark objects, such as solitons and dark stars, which can be searched for through their gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs). Although these objects vary widely in size and compactness, most GW lensing studies have focused on point-like lenses. The finite size of an extended lens is important when it exceeds its Einstein radius. We evaluate the frequency-dependent effects on GW waveforms from extended lenses and demonstrate that they can be probed with current and future GW data. While finite-size effects can weaken the bounds on the fraction of dark matter in these objects compared to the point-like limit, current GW data provides complementary constraints to other gravitational tests for lens masses between $10^2M_\odot$ and $10^5M_\odot$; future LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA data and next-generation observatories will surpass their sensitivity. As expected, we find that the finite-size effects are important when the lens radius exceeds $\sim \text{few} \times 10^{6}R_\odot (M_L/100 M_\odot)^{1/2}$. Interpreting these constraints within specific models (a simple dissipative dark sector and axion stars), we show that current and future observations probe significant portions of the microphysical parameter space.

classification.title_zh: 延展暗天体对引力波的衍射
classification.abstract_zh: 许多暗区模型预言暗天体的形成，例如孤子和暗星，这些暗天体可以通过其对引力波（GWs）的引力透镜效应被搜寻。尽管这些天体在大小和致密程度方面差异很大，但大多数引力波透镜研究都集中于点状透镜。当延展透镜的有限尺寸超过其爱因斯坦半径时，该尺寸效应变得重要。我们评估了延展透镜对引力波波形产生的频率依赖效应，并证明它们可以用当前和未来的引力波数据探测。虽然与点状极限相比，有限尺寸效应可能削弱对暗物质在这些天体中所占份额的限制，但对于透镜质量在 10^2 M_sun 到 10^5 M_sun 之间，当前引力波数据提供了与其他引力检验互补的限制；未来 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 数据和下一代天文台将超越其灵敏度。正如预期，我们发现当透镜半径超过约几 × 10^6 R_sun (M_L/100 M_sun)^{1/2} 时，有限尺寸效应很重要。将这些限制在具体模型（一个简单耗散暗区与轴子星）中解释，我们表明当前和未来观测可探测微观物理参数空间的重要部分。
classification.one_liner: 研究延展暗天体对引力波波形的频率依赖衍射/透镜效应，并利用当前与未来引力波数据限制暗天体参数空间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究引力波透镜、广义相对论与经典时空现象，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.14494v1.title: NICER neutron stars with dark energy and dark matter: effects on the inferred equation of state
2609.14494v1.abstract: [Abridged] In this work, we compare neutron stars where dark energy or dark matter are present in the core, contrasting them against purely baryonic stars with the same central energy density. From this comparison, we find that the dark energy models are more constrained by neutron star observations than the dark matter models, suggesting that neutron stars can place strong constraints on dark energy parameters. We consider four configurations: purely baryonic neutron stars described by a piecewise polytropic (PP) equation of state (EoS), baryonic stars admixed with bosonic or fermionic asymmetric dark matter (ADM) cores, and stars with a dark energy core and baryonic shell, where the dark energy is described by the modified Chaplygin dark fluid (MCDF). Using the masses and radii of PSR J0740$+$6620, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0030$+$0451, we employ Bayesian inference to investigate how accounting for bosonic/fermionic ADM and MCDF cores affects the inferred neutron star properties. We find that MCDF cores, more than PP and ADM admixed models, substantially broaden neutron star mass-radius and pressure-energy density posterior distributions. Moreover, the MCDF EoS parameters can be tightly constrained. While bosonic and fermionic ADM cores decrease the inferred maximum mass, their posteriors strongly coincide with those of the PP model for ADM mass-fractions $F_\chi \leq 5\%$. These results demonstrate that current mass-radius observations cannot rule out MCDF cores, but they can constrain the MCDF parameter space to narrow regions. ADM admixed neutron stars, however, remain observationally identical to purely baryonic stars for all explored mass-fractions, even with improved mass-radius uncertainties. This suggests that mass-radius measurements alone are insufficient to detect ADM core inside neutron stars and that independent astrophysical or particle physics probes will be required.

classification.title_zh: 带暗能量与暗物质的 NICER 中子星：对推断状态方程的影响
classification.abstract_zh: [节略] 在这项工作中，我们比较了核心中存在暗能量或暗物质的中子星，并将它们与具有相同中心能量密度的纯重子星进行对比。通过比较，我们发现暗能量模型比暗物质模型受到中子星观测更强的约束，这表明中子星可以对暗能量参数施加严格限制。我们考虑四种位形：由分段多方（PP）状态方程（EoS）描述的纯重子中子星；混合玻色或费米非对称暗物质（ADM）核心的重子星；以及具有暗能量核心和重子壳层的星体，其中暗能量由修正 Chaplygin 暗流体（MCDF）描述。利用 PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0437−4715 和 PSR J0030+0451 的质量和半径，我们采用贝叶斯推断来研究考虑玻色/费米 ADM 和 MCDF 核心如何影响推断出的中子星性质。我们发现，与 PP 和 ADM 混合模型相比，MCDF 核心显著展宽了中子星质量-半径以及压强-能量密度后验分布。此外，MCDF 的 EoS 参数可以被严格约束。虽然玻色和费米 ADM 核心会降低推断的最大质量，但在 ADM 质量分数 Fχ ≤ 5% 时，它们的后验与 PP 模型的后验强烈重合。这些结果表明，当前质量-半径观测不能排除 MCDF 核心，但可以把 MCDF 参数空间限制到狭窄区域。然而，对于所有探索的质量分数，ADM 混合中子星在观测上仍然与纯重子星相同，即使质量-半径不确定度得到改善。这表明仅靠质量-半径测量不足以探测中子星内部的 ADM 核心，需要独立的天体物理或粒子物理探针。
classification.one_liner: 利用 NICER 质量-半径数据贝叶斯推断含暗物质或暗能量核心的中子星状态方程，发现暗能量核心参数可被约束，而 ADM 核心难以与纯重子星区分。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文以中子星质量-半径观测和状态方程为核心，属于经典引力/致密星与暗物质暗能量效应研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点方向。

2609.14768v1.title: Stability and Structural Properties of Hot Quark Stars within Perturbative QCD
2609.14768v1.abstract: The hypothesis of strange quark matter (SQM) and the possible existence of strange stars have been extensively investigated within the thermodynamic bag model, typically employing the free Fermi gas approximation with or without perturbative QCD corrections at zero temperature, where quark confinement is modeled by the bag pressure. In this work, based on the perturbative inclusion of quark mass effects, we develop a thermodynamically consistent equation of state (EOS) for SQM at finite temperature, incorporating perturbative corrections up to $\mathcal{O}(\alpha_s)$ in the strong coupling constant $\alpha_s$ while ensuring full adherence to the Maxwell relations. These corrections are essential for accurately describing hot quark stars potentially formed during core-collapse events. We present results for both fixed and running couplings, using a phenomenological model to include the breakdown of the perturbative running of $\alpha_s$ at low momenta. Our results demonstrate that incorporating finite-temperature perturbative QCD corrections leads to SQM configurations that fall within the absolute stability window, with equilibrium energies per baryon lying below that of iron, the most tightly bound nucleus. Our EOS supports compact stars with masses exceeding $1.4\,M_\odot$ (and above $2\,M_\odot$ for some values of the bag constant), in agreement with current astrophysical constraints from pulsar and gravitational-wave observations.

classification.title_zh: 微扰QCD中热夸克星的稳定性与结构性质
classification.abstract_zh: 奇异夸克物质（SQM）假说以及奇异星的可能存在，已在热力学袋模型框架下得到广泛研究，通常采用自由费米气体近似，并在零温下考虑或不考虑微扰QCD修正，其中夸克禁闭由袋压建模。在本工作中，基于对夸克质量效应的微扰纳入，我们构建了有限温度下SQM的热力学一致状态方程（EOS），其中包含至强耦合常数α_s的O(α_s)阶微扰修正，同时确保完全满足麦克斯韦关系。这些修正对于准确描述核心坍缩事件中可能形成的高温夸克星至关重要。我们给出了固定耦合和跑动耦合两种情形下的结果，并使用一个唯象模型来纳入α_s微扰跑动在低动量处的失效。结果表明，纳入有限温度微扰QCD修正后，SQM组态落入绝对稳定窗口，其每重子平衡能量低于最紧束缚核铁的能量。我们的EOS支持质量超过1.4 M_sun的致密星（对于某些袋常数取值还可超过2 M_sun），这与当前来自脉冲星和引力波观测的天体物理约束一致。
classification.one_liner: 构建有限温度微扰QCD修正的奇异夸克物质状态方程，并考察热夸克星的稳定性与质量约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要未涉及全息/AdS/CFT，主要讨论微扰QCD奇异夸克物质与热夸克星结构；若从经典引力/致密星支线看有一定关联，但与全息理论核心无关。

2609.01261v2.title: Spin alignment of vector mesons in a plasma at finite density
2609.01261v2.abstract: We study the spectral functions and spin alignment of $J/\psi$ and $\phi$ mesons at finite density in a soft-wall holographic model. The quark-gluon plasma background is described by a charged black hole geometry, and the vector mesons are treated as probe bulk vector fields. The present analysis extends the zero-density study of Phys. Rev. D 110 (2024) 056047 (Ref.~\cite{XLS2024}) to finite density; in the zero-density limit our results reproduce the corresponding findings. We derive the relation between the production rates in different spin channels and the corresponding in-medium spectral functions, and examine their dependence on the chemical potential, meson momentum, and temperature. We analyze the spin alignment induced by the motion of the vector meson relative to the thermal bath. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the $J/\psi$ spectral function exhibits a clear resonance peak, indicating that the $c\bar{c}$ pair can still form a quasistable bound state. As the chemical potential increases, this peak becomes lower and broader, signaling enhanced dissociation in the medium. For the $\phi$ meson at the same temperature, no pronounced peak is observed, indicating substantial melting; its spectral function thus better characterizes the distribution of unstable $s\bar{s}$ pairs in the thermal environment. At $T=0.15~\mathrm{GeV}$, the helicity-frame spin alignment parameter $\rho_{00}$ shows a positive deviation from $1/3$ for the $J/\psi$ and a negative one for the $\phi$ meson. A finite chemical potential alters these deviations, reducing the magnitude for the $J/\psi$ while increasing it for the $\phi$ meson. The calculations are performed within a bottom-up soft-wall model; the results should be read as model-based estimates rather than model-independent predictions.

classification.title_zh: 有限密度等离子体中矢量介子的自旋排列
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在软墙全息模型中研究有限密度下 J/ψ 和 φ 介子的谱函数与自旋排列。夸克-胶子等离子体背景由带电黑洞几何描述，矢量介子被视为探测体矢量场。本分析将 Phys. Rev. D 110 (2024) 056047 的零密度研究推广至有限密度；在零密度极限下，我们的结果重现相应发现。我们推导不同自旋通道的产生率与相应介质中谱函数之间的关系，并考察它们对化学势、介子动量和温度的依赖。我们分析由矢量介子相对于热浴运动诱导的自旋排列。在 T=0.15 GeV 时，J/ψ 谱函数呈现清晰共振峰，表明 c\bar{c} 对仍可形成准稳定束缚态。随着化学势增加，该峰变低变宽，表明介质中解离增强。对于同一温度下的 φ 介子，未观察到明显峰，表明大量熔化；其谱函数因而更好地刻画热环境中不稳定 s\bar{s} 对的分布。在 T=0.15 GeV 时，螺旋度框架自旋排列参数 ρ00 对 J/ψ 显示出相对于 1/3 的正偏离，对 φ 介子显示出负偏离。有限化学势改变这些偏离，减小 J/ψ 的幅度而增大 φ 介子的幅度。计算在自下而上软墙模型中进行；结果应理解为基于模型的估计，而非模型无关预言。
classification.one_liner: 在软墙全息模型中，有限密度等离子体里 J/ψ 与 φ 介子的谱函数和自旋排列随化学势、动量和温度变化，J/ψ 峰变低变宽而 φ 介子明显熔化。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理中的有限密度矢量介子谱函数与自旋排列研究，未涉及用户重点标签所列的全息超导、p波序参量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜或经典引力等支线。

2512.08911v2.title: Bayesian approach study of hybrid neutron stars
2512.08911v2.abstract: In this work, we explore how astronomical observations (specifically measurements of masses and radii) can constrain the presence of quark matter inside neutron stars, namely the phase transition from nuclear matter to deconfined quark matter. Our approach employs Bayesian analysis to study this constraint. In this sense to model Hadronic matter we used the relativistic mean-field approximation, for which we have selected two parameter sets: \(NL3^{*}\omega\rho\), representing hadronic matter with nucleons only, and $EL3\omega\rho$ with nucleons only and $EL3\omega\rho Y$, which includes hyperons. On the other hand deconfined quark matter is modeled using the vector-MIT bag model. Also, for our purpose, the first order phase transition is implemented using the Maxwell construction. Bayesian inference is performed by optimizing three parameters: the bag constant (i.e. $B^{1/4}$), the vector coupling constant \(\left(G_{v}\right)\), and the Dirac sea contribution ($b_{4}$). We found that a phase transition could exist at densities below \(2.0\,n_{0}\) for both the $EL3\omega\rho$ and $NL3^{*}\omega\rho$ parametrizations. As a consequence, the inferred parameters of the vector MIT bag model, based on our likelihood function, imply hybrid stars with large quark cores.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 混合中子星的贝叶斯方法研究
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们探索天文观测（特别是质量与半径测量）如何约束中子星内部夸克物质的存在，即从核物质到解禁闭夸克物质的一级相变。我们的方法采用贝叶斯分析来研究这一约束。为此，我们使用相对论平均场近似来建模强子物质，并选取两组参数集：NL3*ωρ（表示仅含核子的强子物质），以及 EL3ωρ（仅含核子）和 EL3ωρY（包含超子）。另一方面，解禁闭夸克物质用矢量 MIT 袋模型建模。此外，我们使用 Maxwell 构造实现一级相变。贝叶斯推断通过优化三个参数进行：袋常数（即 B^{1/4}）、矢量耦合常数 G_v 和狄拉克海贡献 b_4。我们发现，对于 EL3ωρ 和 NL3*ωρ 参数化，相变可能存在于低于 2.0 n_0 的密度。因此，基于我们的似然函数推断出的矢量 MIT 袋模型参数意味着具有大夸克核心的混合星。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯分析结合相对论平均场与矢量 MIT 袋模型，约束中子星内一级强子-夸克相变，并推断可能出现大夸克核心的混合星。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主题为中子星致密物质与强子-夸克相变，可与经典引力/中子星观测支线相关，但不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或引力场方程。

2510.20662v4.title: Topological Orders from Reflection Positive Frustration-free Hamiltonians
2510.20662v4.abstract: We establish a framework based on reflection positivity for analyzing topologically ordered quantum spin systems and reconstructing their boundary algebras. For any reflection positive frustration-free Hamiltonian, we prove that the local topological quantum order (LTQO) condition of ground states on a disk holds, if and only if the ground state on the sphere obtained by gluing the disk with its reflection is nondegenerate. Furthermore, we show that Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction produces the local net of boundary operator algebras from the local ground states, offering a constructive approach to topological holography through spatial reflection positivity.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
classification.title_zh: 来自反射正性无阻挫哈密顿量的拓扑序
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了一个基于反射正性的框架，用于分析拓扑有序量子自旋系统并重构其边界代数。对于任意反射正性无阻挫哈密顿量，我们证明：圆盘上基态的局域拓扑量子序（LTQO）条件成立，当且仅当通过将圆盘与其反射粘合得到的球面基态非简并。此外，我们表明 Osterwalder-Schrader 重构从局域基态产生边界算符代数的局域网，通过空间反射正性为拓扑全息提供了一种构造性途径。
classification.one_liner: 用反射正性为无阻挫自旋系统建立 LTQO 与球面基态非简并的等价，并构造边界算符代数网以实现拓扑全息。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于广义理论全息/拓扑全息方向，但与用户列出的 AdS/CFT、经典引力及全息凝聚态具体重点支线无直接重叠。

2609.16103v1.title: A LooKK at the Higuchi Bound
2609.16103v1.abstract: Massive spin 2 fields on de Sitter must satisfy the Higuchi bound, $m^2\geq 2H^2$. Compactifications of higher dimensional gravity to $\mathrm{dS}_4$ come with a tower of Kaluza-Klein gravitons whose masses are fixed by the internal geometry, so the bound becomes a constraint on the compactification. We propose that the KK gravitons of a consistent compactification never violate it, and test this in a few examples. On a circle stabilized by Casimir energy the bound holds unless the circle shrinks below the species scale, and on a warped interval with negative tension branes the tower is gapped at $m^2\geq \tfrac{9}{4}H^2$ for any length of the interval. On group manifolds, we argue that if the internal curvature is not parametrically larger than the Hubble scale, the bound can apparently be violated by smooth deformations. The violation disappears once one promotes these deformations to moduli, which are immediately extremized when solving the 10d equations of motion.

classification.title_zh: 对 Higuchi 界的一次 LooKK：KK 引力子与 de Sitter 紧化
classification.abstract_zh: de Sitter 上的大质量自旋 2 场必须满足 Higuchi 界，m^2≥2H^2。将高维引力紧化到 dS4 会得到一列 Kaluza-Klein 引力子，其质量由内部几何固定，因此该界成为对紧化的限制。我们提出，一个自洽紧化的 KK 引力子永远不会违反它，并在若干例子中检验这一点。在由 Casimir 能稳定的圆上，除非圆缩到 species scale 以下，该界成立；在带负张力膜的翘曲区间上，对任意区间长度，KK 塔都有间隙 m^2≥9/4 H^2。在群流形上，我们论证，如果内部曲率不是参数化地大于 Hubble 尺度，那么该界显然可以被光滑形变违反。一旦把这些形变提升为模量，而这些模量在求解 10 维运动方程时立即被极值化，这种违反就消失。
classification.one_liner: 论文提出自洽 de Sitter 紧化中的 KK 引力子塔不应违反 Higuchi 界，并在圆、翘曲区间与群流形例子中检验；群流形上的表观违反可由将形变提升为模量消除。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及 de Sitter、KK 紧化、膜世界与经典引力，与经典引力/膜世界支线相关；但不属于 AdS/CFT 或全息主线，也未使用用户重点关注的全息超流、多分量序参量、QNM 等具体标签。

2609.16109v1.title: Boundary duals of bulk detectors
2609.16109v1.abstract: What is the boundary dual of an Unruh-DeWitt detector in anti-de Sitter space? We argue that this question is naturally answered by the HKLL reconstruction program. A local detector in the bulk can be associated with a smeared detector in the boundary, where the choice of smearing depends on the choice of HKLL kernel. We use this formalism to analyze entanglement harvesting in the Poincar\'e patch of AdS$_{3}$ for a bulk Unruh-DeWitt detector paired either with a boundary detector or with a second bulk detector. We compute the amount of harvesting in the standard way, namely by evaluating the two-detector density matrix to quadratic order in the coupling $\lambda$. Additionally, we address an apparent tension between microcausality for spacelike-separated bulk detectors and the fact that the dual HKLL detectors may directly overlap in the boundary theory.

classification.title_zh: 体探测器的边界对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 反德西特空间中 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器的边界对偶是什么？我们认为这个问题可由 HKLL 重构方案自然回答。体中的一个局域探测器可以关联到边界中的一个涂抹探测器，其中涂抹的选择取决于 HKLL 核的选择。我们使用这一形式体系分析 AdS3 庞加莱片中的纠缠采集，其中体 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器与边界探测器或第二个体探测器配对。我们以标准方式计算采集量，即将双探测器密度矩阵展开到耦合 λ 的二阶。此外，我们处理类空分离体探测器的微因果性与对偶 HKLL 探测器可能在边界理论中直接重叠之间的表观张力。
classification.one_liner: 用 HKLL 重构将体 Unruh-DeWitt 探测器映射为边界涂抹探测器，并分析 AdS3 中纠缠采集与微因果性张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典及全息量子信息方向，讨论体探测器与边界对偶、HKLL 重构和纠缠采集；但不直接落在用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力等重点支线上。

2609.16113v1.title: When the gravity path integral describes a statistical average
2609.16113v1.abstract: We find the necessary and sufficient conditions for the gravitational path integral (GPI) to admit an interpretation in terms of (i) an inner product in the Hilbert space of open/closed universes or (ii) a statistical average of boundary observables. The conditions needed for (i) are necessary but not sufficient for (ii). Requiring the stronger condition (ii) places additional constraints on all wormhole amplitudes, giving a concrete diagnostic of whether the GPI computes an average or merely a pseudo-average. To exemplify the difference between the two constraints, we present a class of gravitational toy models that satisfy (i) but fail the stronger condition (ii); to emphasize the power of the stronger condition, we initiate a bootstrap study of statistical ensembles based on condition (ii), finding that the resulting constraints substantially sharpen the bounds on the moments of the ensemble obtained by imposing (i). More broadly, both of these positivity conditions impose nontrivial constraints on wormhole amplitudes and thereby restrict which gravitational effective field theories can be embedded in consistent theories of quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: 当引力路径积分描述统计平均时
classification.abstract_zh: 本文找到了引力路径积分（GPI）能够被解释为 (i) 开/闭宇宙希尔伯特空间中的内积，或 (ii) 边界可观测量的统计平均的充分必要条件。条件 (i) 所需的条件是 (ii) 的必要条件，但不充分。要求更强的条件 (ii) 会对所有虫洞振幅施加额外约束，从而给出一个具体诊断，判断 GPI 计算的是平均还是仅伪平均。为了例示两个约束之间的区别，我们给出一类引力玩具模型，它们满足 (i) 但不满足更强的条件 (ii)；为了强调更强条件的力量，我们基于条件 (ii) 启动对统计系综的 bootstrap 研究，发现所得约束显著收紧由施加 (i) 得到的系综矩的界。更广泛地说，这两个正性条件都对虫洞振幅施加非平凡约束，从而限制哪些引力有效场论可以嵌入一致的量子引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 给出引力路径积分对应于希尔伯特空间内积或边界统计平均的充要条件，并利用虫洞振幅约束与系综 bootstrap 区分真平均与伪平均。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于量子引力路径积分与系综平均的基础研究，未直接涉及用户重点的全息凝聚态、QCD、输运、畴壁、相变或经典引力等支线。

2609.16130v1.title: Single-Instance Observables in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
2609.16130v1.abstract: We present a diagrammatic expansion for thermal expectation values of low-weight Majorana strings in a fixed realization of the $N$-fermion Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev (SYK) model. At each order in the expansion, the observable is expressed as a finite sum of polynomials in the couplings multiplied by temperature-dependent kernels built from the large-$N$ melonic propagator. At fixed $\beta J$, the expansion is organized in powers of $N^{-1/2}$, and each order can be efficiently evaluated with classical resources polynomial in $N$. The expansion also extends to correlations at arbitrary imaginary times and sufficiently short real times. For the four-body SYK model, we show that the diagrammatic predictions give an excellent account of exact diagonalization results at sizes up to $N=24$. We also apply the method to the Maldacena--Qi (MQ) model formed from two identical copies of a fixed SYK realization. This enables the identification of a nearby SYK-like Hamiltonian whose thermofield double state has higher fidelity with the Maldacena--Qi ground state than the thermofield double of the original SYK Hamiltonian.

classification.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中的单实例可观测量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了在 N 费米子 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型的固定实现中，低权重 Majorana 弦的热期望值的图解展开。在展开的每一阶，可观测量表示为耦合的有限多项式之和，乘以由大 N melonic 传播子构造的与温度相关的核。在固定 βJ 下，展开按 N^{-1/2} 幂次组织，每一阶都可用关于 N 多项式的经典资源高效计算。该展开还可推广到任意虚时以及足够短的实时关联。对于四体 SYK 模型，我们表明图解预测与尺寸直至 N=24 的精确对角化结果吻合良好。我们还将该方法应用于由固定 SYK 实现的两个相同副本构成的 Maldacena-Qi (MQ) 模型。这使我们能够识别出一个邻近的类 SYK 哈密顿量，其热场双态与 Maldacena-Qi 基态的保真度高于原始 SYK 哈密顿量的热场双态。
classification.one_liner: 为固定 SYK 实现中的低权重 Majorana 弦建立图解展开，并用于识别与 Maldacena-Qi 基态更接近的类 SYK 哈密顿量。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要研究固定 SYK 实现中的单实例图解展开及 Maldacena-Qi 模型，未直接涉及用户列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等）。

2609.16154v1.title: Making the Great Desert Bloom
2609.16154v1.abstract: The absence of new physics beyond neutrino masses between the weak scale and the Planck scale is referred to as the great desert. It is often seen as a nightmare scenario for particle physics. Here we argue, by contrast, that the great desert assumption in fact has dramatic implications: it predicts that the Standard Model has a semi-classical AdS$_4$ vacuum with CFT$_3$ dual and, under reasonable assumptions, must be accompanied by at least one extra dimension significantly larger than Planck length. We also present one plausible candidate CFT$_3$ to be ``the" dual to the Standard Model.

classification.title_zh: 让大沙漠开花
classification.abstract_zh: 在弱尺度与普朗克尺度之间，除中微子质量之外不存在新物理，这被称为大沙漠。它常被视为粒子物理的噩梦场景。与此相反，我们论证，大沙漠假设实际上具有戏剧性含义：它预言标准模型具有半经典 AdS4 真空，并带有 CFT3 对偶；并且在合理假设下，必须伴随至少一个显著大于普朗克长度的额外维度。我们还给出了一个可能作为标准模型“对偶”的候选 CFT3。
classification.one_liner: 论证大沙漠假设预言标准模型具有带 CFT3 对偶的半经典 AdS4 真空，并可能要求一个大于普朗克长度的额外维度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与字典，但未涉及用户重点标签中的具体研究支线，因此相关性较低。

2609.16980v1.title: Constraints on Kasner Exponents from Holography and Energy Conditions
2609.16980v1.abstract: A central question in bottom-up holography is whether a given bulk effective theory admits a consistent holographic dual. In this work, we explore whether the near-singularity Kasner scaling of planar AdS black hole interiors can serve as a useful diagnostic based on interior-sensitive holographic probes. By examining the metric combinations that control interior-sensitive observables, including Complexity=Volume (CV), the bulk contribution to Complexity=Action (CA), Hartman-Maldacena (HM) entropy, and the thermal $a$-function, we derive algebraic bounds on the Kasner exponents $(p_t,p_s)$ for the relevant semi-classical regimes: finite-radius late-time branches of CV and HM, finite CA complexity, and a finite near-singularity thermal $a$-function. The resulting inequalities delineate the corresponding regions of Kasner space in which the terminal scaling alone is sufficient to realize these behaviors. Furthermore, we demonstrate that classical energy conditions, specifically the null and dominant energy conditions, provide simple sufficient criteria ensuring that the Kasner exponents fall within these holographically allowed regions. These results establish a direct connection between classical bulk energy conditions and the interior geometry selected by holographic probes, and suggest that Kasner scaling can provide a complementary diagnostic in bottom-up holography.

classification.title_zh: 全息与能量条件对 Kasner 指数的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 自下而上全息的核心问题之一是：给定的体有效理论是否允许一致的全息对偶。本文探讨平面 AdS 黑洞内部近奇异 Kasner 标度能否作为基于内部敏感全息探针的有用诊断。通过考察控制内部敏感可观测量的度规组合，包括 CV、CA 的体贡献、Hartman-Maldacena 熵和热 a 函数，我们推导了相关半经典区域中 Kasner 指数 (p_t,p_s) 的代数界：CV 和 HM 的有限半径晚期分支、有限 CA 复杂度以及有限的近奇异热 a 函数。所得不等式刻画了仅由终端标度就足以实现这些行为的 Kasner 空间区域。此外，我们证明经典能量条件，特别是零能量条件和主导能量条件，提供了简单充分判据，确保 Kasner 指数落入这些全息允许区域。这些结果在经典体能量条件与全息探针所选择的内部几何之间建立了直接联系，并表明 Kasner 标度可作为自下而上全息的一种补充诊断。
classification.one_liner: 用 CV、CA、HM 熵和热 a 函数对 AdS 黑洞内部 Kasner 指数给出全息约束，并说明经典能量条件可保证这些约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息黑洞内部、复杂度及经典能量条件相关，但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、畴壁/孤子、QNM 等具体支线。

2609.17086v1.title: Carrollian Conformal Dynamics and Flat-Space Holography
2609.17086v1.abstract: The conformal boundary of asymptotically flat spacetime is null and therefore carries a Carrollian rather than Lorentzian geometry. This changes the relation between symmetry, variational principles and evolution equations in an essential way: unlike a Lorentzian Levi-Civita connection, a torsion-free Carrollian connection compatible with the conformal structure contains genuine independent data. We develop a metric-affine formulation of conformal dynamics that keeps track of these connection degrees of freedom through hypermomenta. Local Carroll boosts, rotations, Weyl transformations and diffeomorphisms then imply a set of covariant evolution equations. We apply this framework to Einstein gravity in four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes. Penrose's conformal compactification identifies null infinity as a conformal Carrollian manifold; the undetermined transverse symmetric part of its compatible connection is the asymptotic Bondi shear. After fixing a Bondi-van der Burg-Metzner-Sachs (BMS) frame and identifying the Carrollian momenta and hypermomenta with the Bondi data, the general Carrollian evolution equations reproduce the standard evolution equations for the mass and angular-momentum aspects. The result provides a boundary-intrinsic derivation of the gravitational evolution equations and a geometric realization of radiative degrees of freedom in flat-space holography. This is a proceedings contribution to the "Athens Workshop in Theoretical Physics: 10th Anniversary", held at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens on December 17-19 2025.

classification.title_zh: Carroll 共形动力学与平直空间全息
classification.abstract_zh: 渐近平直时空的共形边界是零性的，因此携带 Carrollian 而非 Lorentzian 几何。这从根本上改变了对称性、变分原理和演化方程之间的关系：与 Lorentzian Levi-Civita 联络不同，与共形结构相容的无挠 Carrollian 联络包含真正独立的数据。我们发展了一种共形动力学的度规-仿射表述，通过超动量追踪这些联络自由度。局域 Carroll boost、转动、Weyl 变换和微分同胚随后给出一组协变演化方程。我们将此框架应用于四维渐近平直时空中的 Einstein 引力。Penrose 共形紧化将零无穷识别为一个共形 Carrollian 流形；其相容联络中未确定的横向对称部分就是渐近 Bondi shear。在固定 Bondi-van der Burg-Metzner-Sachs (BMS) 规范并识别 Carrollian 动量与超动量同 Bondi 数据之后，一般 Carrollian 演化方程复现质量和角动量方面的标准演化方程。该结果为引力演化方程提供了边界内禀推导，并给出了平直空间全息中辐射自由度的几何实现。这是 2025 年 12 月 17-19 日在雅典国立卡波季斯特里安大学举行的“Athens Workshop in Theoretical Physics: 10th Anniversary”的会议论文集贡献。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近平直时空中，以零无穷的 Carrollian 度规-仿射动力学和 Bondi 数据推导 Einstein 引力的边界演化方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 核心主题是平直时空全息中的 Carrollian/BMS 边界动力学，并应用于经典 Einstein 引力，与“dS/天球/平直时空/BMS-Carroll”及经典引力支线直接相关。

2609.17182v1.title: Generalized complexity and dynamical response in holographic Vaidya spacetimes
2609.17182v1.abstract: We investigate "Complexity=Anything" for smooth Vaidya geometries, using the Weyl squared functional as the most common candidate for our study. Our numerical analysis of candidates in 4- and 5-dimensional Reissner-Nordstr\"om (RN) and 5-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet (GB) shows evolution in both $r$ and $v$ ("doubled complexity"), unlike static solutions that depend only on $r$. We then study the difference between the complexity of static and dynamical solutions in the asymptotically AdS regime using a Fefferman-Graham expansion. By expanding the bulk metric, extremal embedding, induced metric, normal vector, and extrinsic curvature simultaneously, we show that the first four FG coefficients cancel between the two geometries. In contrast, the first nonvanishing contribution occurs at the fifth coefficient and is controlled by the boundary stress tensor and its derivatives. During the Vaidya quench, the derivative contribution encodes the time-dependent response of the boundary state. In linear response, this response is governed by the retarded stress-tensor correlator and, through generalized Kramers-Kronig relations, can be represented in terms of its spectral density. We thus identify a connection between generalized holographic complexity and the dynamical stress-tensor response, which in the linear-response regime can be represented in terms of the corresponding stress-tensor spectral density.

classification.title_zh: 全息 Vaidya 时空中的广义复杂度与动力学响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究光滑 Vaidya 几何中的“Complexity=Anything”，并采用 Weyl 平方泛函作为最常见候选。对 4 维和 5 维 Reissner-Nordström (RN) 以及 5 维 Gauss-Bonnet (GB) 的候选进行数值分析，结果显示复杂度同时随 r 和 v 演化（“加倍复杂度”），不同于仅依赖 r 的静态解。随后我们用 Fefferman-Graham 展开研究渐近 AdS 区域中静态解与动力学解的复杂度差异。通过同时展开体度规、极值嵌入、诱导度规、法向量和外曲率，我们表明前四个 FG 系数在两种几何之间相消。相反，首个非零贡献出现在第五个系数，并由边界应力张量及其导数控制。在 Vaidya quench 过程中，导数贡献编码了边界态的含时响应。在线性响应中，该响应由延迟应力张量关联函数支配，并通过广义 Kramers-Kronig 关系用其谱密度表示。因此，我们指出广义全息复杂度与动力学应力张量响应之间的联系；在线性响应区域，该响应可用相应应力张量谱密度表示。
classification.one_liner: 在 Vaidya 背景中，广义全息复杂度的动力学部分可由边界应力张量的延迟关联函数/谱密度刻画。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于全息复杂度与非平衡动力学响应，与用户重点标签中的具体支线没有直接对应，但属于理论全息的一般范围，可能对全息复杂度/动力学响应研究有中等参考价值。

2609.17359v1.title: Topological Modular Forms Constrain Threshold States in Extremal $\mathcal{N}=1$ AdS$_3$ Gravity
2609.17359v1.abstract: We identify a topological constraint on extremal $\mathcal{N}=1$ AdS$_3$ spectra that is not implied by genus-one modular covariance of the three even spin structure partition functions. Assuming the expected topological modular forms divisibility of the Ramond Witten index, we show that for infinitely many odd $n$ at central charge $c=12n$, an extremal holomorphic $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal field theory requires an odd number of Neveu--Schwarz primaries at the BTZ threshold. Thus the strict ansatz with no threshold primaries is excluded for this infinite family.

classification.title_zh: 拓扑模形式约束极值 N=1 AdS3 引力中的阈值态
classification.abstract_zh: 我们指认出对极值 N=1 AdS3 谱的一个拓扑限制，它不由三个偶自旋结构配分函数的亏格一模协变性所隐含。假设 Ramond Witten 指标具有预期的拓扑模形式整除性，我们证明：对于中心荷 c=12n 的无穷多个奇数 n，一个极值全纯 N=1 超共形场论需要奇数个位于 BTZ 阈值的 Neveu--Schwarz 初级场。因此，对于这个无穷族，没有阈值初级场的严格拟设被排除。
classification.one_liner: 利用拓扑模形式对 Ramond-Witten 指标的整除性约束，论文排除了无穷多个极值 N=1 AdS3 全纯 SCFT 中不存在 BTZ 阈值初级场的严格拟设。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS3/CFT2 与极值全纯 SCFT 的纯理论谱约束，与用户重点标签中全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜与 Floquet 驱动、经典引力等支线均无直接对应。

2609.17426v1.title: Channel-Resolved High-Overtone Quasinormal Modes Decode Kasner Scaling inside Black Holes
2609.17426v1.abstract: The high-overtone quasinormal-mode spectrum encodes the near-singularity Kasner scaling of black-hole interiors. We show that distinct structures in this spectrum independently determine the temporal and spatial Kasner grades, allowing the corresponding metric exponents to be reconstructed without imposing Kasner constraints or invoking holography. We demonstrate this independent reconstruction at the fixed Kasner point of five-dimensional asymptotically flat Schwarzschild and planar Schwarzschild--AdS$_5$, and then extend it to a continuously varying Gibbons--Maeda black-hole family. The reconstructed exponents satisfy the Kasner relation a posteriori, providing a nontrivial geometric consistency check. More generally, the high-overtone spectrum separates into global spectral data and local algebraic corrections whose fractional powers are fixed by the near-singularity Kasner geometry. These fractional corrections therefore provide a direct spectral probe of the local geometry behind the horizon.

classification.title_zh: 通道分辨的高泛音准正规模解码黑洞内部的 Kasner 标度
classification.abstract_zh: 高泛音准正规模谱编码了黑洞内部近奇点的 Kasner 标度。我们表明，该谱中的不同结构可独立确定时间与空间 Kasner 等级，从而无需施加 Kasner 约束或诉诸全息，即可重构相应的度规指数。我们在五维渐近平坦 Schwarzschild 与平面 Schwarzschild--AdS5 的固定 Kasner 点上展示了这种独立重构，并将其推广到连续变化的 Gibbons--Maeda 黑洞族。重构出的指数事后满足 Kasner 关系，提供了非平凡的几何一致性检验。更一般地，高泛音谱分离为整体谱数据和局域代数修正，而后者的分数幂由近奇点 Kasner 几何固定。因此，这些分数修正提供了对视界后局域几何的直接谱学探测。
classification.one_liner: 高泛音准正规模可独立重构黑洞内部 Kasner 指数，为视界后几何提供谱学探针。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及高泛音准正规模与经典黑洞内部 Kasner 几何，匹配 QNM 与经典引力重点标签；但摘要明确不依赖全息，因此不是全息研究。

2609.17528v1.title: Exact Black Branes in General Dimensions in Higher-Curvature Scalar-Tensor Gravity
2609.17528v1.abstract: We obtain two families of neutral planar black branes in a potential-free dilaton-coupled Lovelock--Horndeski theory. Heterotic compactification relates higher-dimensional curvature to scalar dynamics and motivates the interaction structure. At fixed scalar zero mode, the horizon radius and temperature vary while the complete stationary Wald entropy remains constant and positive. The exponential scalar factor at the horizon exactly compensates the area growth, giving this behavior a direct geometric explanation. An exact coefficient analysis determines the two four-dimensional branches and their continuation to every higher dimension through closed coupling relations. The linear family is conformally flat and leaves the AdS scale free at fixed couplings; the fractional family is Weyl curved and fixes that scale. The common kinetic relation also excludes their realization through a real one-scalar flat-torus reduction of a metric--dilaton parent.

classification.title_zh: 高曲率标量-张量引力中一般维度的精确黑膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们得到无势、与伸缩子耦合的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论中的两族中性平面黑膜。异弦紧化将高维曲率与标量动力学联系起来，并启发了该相互作用结构。在固定标量零模下，视界半径和温度变化，而完整的稳态 Wald 熵保持常数且为正。视界处的指数标量因子精确补偿面积增长，为这一行为提供直接的几何解释。精确系数分析确定了两个四维分支，并通过闭合耦合关系确定它们向每个更高维度的延拓。线性族是共形平坦的，并在固定耦合下使 AdS 标度自由；分数族具有 Weyl 曲率，并固定该标度。共同的动能关系还排除了它们通过度规--伸缩子母理论的一个实单标量平坦环面约化来实现的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 在无势、与伸缩子耦合的 Lovelock--Horndeski 理论中构造一般维度的两族精确中性平面黑膜，并分析其视界热力学与四维分支。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接给出高曲率标量-张量理论中的精确黑膜解、AdS 标度与 Wald 熵分析，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；摘要未提及 AdS/CFT 字典或 CFT 对应，故不标记为理论全息。

2609.16438v1.title: Analytical solutions to the non-equilibrium Green's functions in large-$q$ SYK models
2609.16438v1.abstract: It is known that the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model is exactly solvable at leading order in $1/q$; specifically, the instantaneously thermal time block after the quench is known in closed form. Thus far the remaining (inherently out of equilibrium) blocks have only been numerically accessible. Here we provide their analytical solutions for a quench between non-commuting $q/2$-body SYK Hamiltonians. We obtain the Green's functions in closed form for every time block. We extract a simple relation between the pre- and post-quench energies $\epsilon_1 \propto \epsilon_0$ leading to an exact temperature update rule. Via a Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we show that heating is inevitable for the closed system; hence, the second law emerges geometrically. The solution is used in a companion paper to address what ``instantaneous thermalization'' means at finite $q$.

classification.title_zh: 大 q SYK 模型中非平衡格林函数的解析解
classification.abstract_zh: 已知 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型在 1/q 领头阶精确可解；具体地，淬火后瞬时热化的时间块具有闭式形式。迄今为止，其余（本质上非平衡的）时间块只能通过数值方法获得。这里我们给出在非对易 q/2-体 SYK 哈密顿量之间淬火时这些时间块的解析解。我们得到了每个时间块的闭式格林函数。我们提取出淬火前后能量之间的简单关系 ε1 ∝ ε0，从而得到精确的温度更新规则。通过柯西-施瓦茨不等式，我们证明闭系统中加热不可避免；因此，第二定律几何地涌现。该解在姊妹篇中用于讨论有限 q 下“瞬时热化”的含义。
classification.one_liner: 给出大 q SYK 模型在非对易 q/2-体哈密顿量淬火下全部时间块格林函数的闭式解析解，并导出精确温度更新与闭系统加热必然性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究 large-q SYK 模型非平衡格林函数的解析解，属于全息量子引力中 SYK/JT 与非平衡热化主线，但未命中用户提供的重点标签（如全息超流超导、QNM、经典引力等），故相关性较低。

2609.16471v1.title: Study of Null Geodesics and their Stability in Kalb-Ramond Black Holes
2609.16471v1.abstract: We investigate null geodesics and their stability in four-dimensional charged Kalb-Ramond black holes with a cosmological constant. The non-vanishing vacuum expectation value of the background antisymmetric tensor field induces spontaneous Lorentz symmetry breaking, controlled by a dimensionless parameter $l$, and deforms the Reissner-Nordstr\"om-(A)dS geometry. We derive the effective potential for massless particles and obtain analytic expressions for the photon-sphere radius, critical impact parameter, capture cross section, and deflection trajectories. The limiting cases $l\rightarrow0$ recover the RN, RN-dS and RN-AdS geodesic structures, while finite values of $l$ shift the turning points, modify the bending of light and deform both first-kind and second-kind photon trajectories. In the AdS branch, we find a special limiting lima\c{c}on-type null geodesic whose angular structure is modified by the Kalb-Ramond parameter. We also compute the Lyapunov exponent of the unstable circular null orbit and show that the cosmological constant changes the instability timescale, whereas the Lorentz-violating parameter produces a non-trivial deformation of the photon-sphere instability. Our results identify null geodesics as sensitive probes of Lorentz-violating effects in charged black hole spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: Kalb-Ramond 黑洞中零测地线及其稳定性研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了四维带电 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞（含宇宙学常数）中的零测地线及其稳定性。背景反对称张量场的非零真空期望值诱导自发洛伦兹对称性破缺，由无量纲参数 $l$ 控制，并使 Reissner-Nordström-(A)dS 几何发生形变。我们推导了无质量粒子的有效势，并给出光子球半径、临界碰撞参数、捕获截面和偏折轨迹的解析表达式。$l\rightarrow0$ 的极限分别回到 RN、RN-dS 与 RN-AdS 的测地线结构；有限 $l$ 会移动转向点、修正光线弯曲，并形变第一类和第二类光子轨迹。在 AdS 分支中，我们发现一种特殊的蜗线型（limaçon 型）零测地线，其角结构受 Kalb-Ramond 参数修正。我们还计算了不稳定圆零轨道的 Lyapunov 指数，表明宇宙学常数改变不稳定时间尺度，而洛伦兹破缺参数对光子球不稳定性产生非平凡形变。结果表明，零测地线可作为探测带电黑洞时空中洛伦兹破缺效应的敏感探针。
classification.one_liner: 研究含宇宙学常数的带电 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞中零测地线、光子球稳定性及洛伦兹破缺效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究 Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的零测地线、光子球与稳定性，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，但不涉及全息、AdS/CFT 或量子信息。

2609.17471v1.title: Quasinormal modes of Kerr-Newman-de Sitter black holes from Heun connection formulae
2609.17471v1.abstract: We study quasinormal modes governed by the Teukolsky equation in Kerr-Newman-de Sitter spacetime, formally treating the spin weight and field charge as arbitrary parameters. We use exact Heun connection formulae expressed through classical conformal blocks. We analytically derive the quasinormal mode spectra in the small cosmological constant, near-extremal, and near-Nariai limits. In the small cosmological constant limit, we obtain the leading charged de Sitter spectrum together with its subleading corrections. In both the small cosmological constant and near-extremal limits, solving the full connection condition beyond the leading pole approximation gives rise to generically noninteger-power corrections to the quasinormal mode frequencies, whereas no analogous correction appears in the near-Nariai limit. We also analyze the angular eigenvalue problem as an illustration of the same connection-formula method.

classification.title_zh: 从 Heun 连接公式研究 Kerr-Newman-de Sitter 黑洞的准正规模式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Kerr-Newman-de Sitter 时空中由 Teukolsky 方程支配的准正规模式，并将自旋权重和场电荷形式地视为任意参数。我们使用通过经典共形块表示的精确 Heun 连接公式。我们解析推导了小宇宙学常数、近极端和近 Nariai 极限下的准正规模式谱。在小宇宙学常数极限下，我们得到领头带电 de Sitter 谱及其次领头修正。在小宇宙学常数和近极端两种极限下，求解超出领头极点近似的完整连接条件，会给出对准正规模式频率的通常为非整数幂的修正，而在近 Nariai 极限中不出现类似修正。我们还分析了角本征值问题，作为同一连接公式方法的示例。
classification.one_liner: 用经典共形块给出的 Heun 连接公式解析计算 Kerr-Newman-de Sitter 黑洞准正规模式，并给出小宇宙学常数、近极端与近 Nariai 极限下的谱及非整数幂修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究黑洞准正规模式及其解析谱，匹配 QNM 与经典引力/广义相对论支线；但未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或非线性演化。

2412.08689v3.title: The type IIA Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude in AdS$_4$ $\times$ CP$^3$ from ABJM theory
2412.08689v3.abstract: We consider tree level scattering of gravitons in type IIA string theory on $AdS_4\times \mathbb{CP}^3$ to all orders in $\alpha'$, which is dual to the stress tensor correlator in $U(N)_k\times U(N)_{-k}$ ABJM theory in the planar large $N$ limit and to all orders in large $\lambda\sim N/k$. The small curvature expansion of this correlator, defined via a Borel transform, is given by the flat space Virasoro-Shapiro amplitude plus AdS curvature corrections. We fix curvature corrections by demanding that their resonances are consistent with the superconformal block expansion of the correlator and with a worldsheet ansatz in terms of single-valued multiple polylogarithms. The first correction is fully fixed in this way, and matches independent results from integrability, as well as the $R^4$ correction at finite AdS curvature that was previously fixed using supersymmetric localization. We are also able to fix the second curvature correction by using a few additional assumptions, and find that it also satisfies various non-trivial consistency checks. We use our results to fix the tree level $D^4R^4$ correction at finite AdS curvature, and to give many predictions for future integrability studies.

classification.title_zh: AdS4×CP3 中来自 ABJM 理论的 IIA 型 Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑 AdS4×CP3 上 IIA 型弦论中引力子的树阶散射，精确到 α' 的所有阶；它等价于 U(N)_k×U(N)_{-k} ABJM 理论中应力张量关联函数在大 N 平面极限、大 λ~N/k 所有阶。该关联函数的小曲率展开（通过 Borel 变换定义）由平直空间 Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅加上 AdS 曲率修正给出。我们要求曲率修正的共振与关联函数的超共形分块展开一致，并以单值多重多对数的世界面拟设来固定这些修正。第一阶修正由此完全固定，并与可积性独立结果以及此前用超对称局域化固定的有限 AdS 曲率下 R^4 修正相符。利用若干额外假设，我们也能固定第二阶曲率修正，并发现它满足多种非平凡一致性检验。我们使用这些结果固定树阶有限 AdS 曲率下的 D^4R^4 修正，并给出对未来可积性研究的许多预言。
classification.one_liner: 从 ABJM 理论出发，利用超共形分块与单值多重多对数确定 AdS4×CP3 中 IIA 型 Virasoro-Shapiro 振幅的曲率修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶与弦振幅方向，但与用户列出的重点标签（全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力）均无直接对应。

2603.08783v2.title: Interface Minimal Model Holography and Topological String Theory
2603.08783v2.abstract: We study the dynamics of 2d fermions coupled to 3d Chern-Simons gauge fields. For $SU(N)$ gauge group and fermions in the fundamental representation, the resulting interfaces are closely related to $W_N$ minimal models. We give an holographic description of the interfaces within the A-model Topological String Theory. The model has exotic integrability properties, which allow us to propose an exact holographic match of all sphere correlation functions of meson operators. This construction embeds Minimal Model Holography in String Theory.

classification.title_zh: 界面最小模型全息与拓扑弦理论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究二维费米子与三维 Chern-Simons 规范场耦合的动力学。对于 SU(N) 规范群和基本表示费米子，所得界面与 W_N 最小模型密切相关。我们在 A 模型拓扑弦理论中给出这些界面的全息描述。该模型具有奇异的可积性，使我们能够提出介子算符所有球面关联函数的精确全息匹配。这一构造将最小模型全息嵌入弦理论。
classification.one_liner: 通过二维费米子与三维 Chern-Simons 场耦合构造与 W_N 最小模型相关的界面，并在 A 模型拓扑弦中给出精确全息匹配。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于高自旋/最小模型全息与弦论构造，与用户重点标签中的“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”有一定关联（界面/畴壁结构），但不直接涉及全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子等支线。

2604.23287v2.title: Chaos of Berry curvature for BPS microstates
2604.23287v2.abstract: We expect black hole microstates to differ in their chaotic properties from states associated with other geometries. For supersymmetric black holes, ordinary level statistics cannot diagnose this distinction, since their energy levels are exactly degenerate. We propose that there is an intrinsic probe of chaos, encoded in the mixing of the microstates under changes in the couplings of the theory, as determined by the non-Abelian Berry curvature of the BPS states under certain deformations. For states dual to horizonless geometries in holographic systems, such as 1/2-BPS states in the D1/D5 CFT and 1/4-BPS states in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, we find that the Berry curvature for marginal deformations is non-random and often exactly zero at generic couplings. By contrast, for states dual to supersymmetric black holes, we show through computations in $\mathcal{N}=2$ super-JT gravity and explicit numerics in the $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK model that the Berry curvature resembles a random matrix. We also uncover interesting topological features of the $\mathcal{N}=2$ SYK moduli space, as probed by Chern numbers. These results suggest that the Berry curvature sharply distinguishes black hole microstates from smooth horizonless states and provides a robust diagnostic of chaos in supersymmetric sectors.

classification.title_zh: BPS 微观态的 Berry 曲率混沌
classification.abstract_zh: 我们预期黑洞微观态在混沌性质上不同于与其他几何相关的态。对于超对称黑洞，普通能级统计无法诊断这一区别，因为它们的能级严格简并。我们提出一种内禀的混沌探针，它编码于微观态在理论耦合变化下的混合中，并由 BPS 态在某些形变下的非阿贝尔 Berry 曲率决定。对于全息系统中对偶于无地平线几何的态，例如 D1/D5 CFT 中的 1/2-BPS 态和 N=4 SYM 中的 1/4-BPS 态，我们发现边缘形变的 Berry 曲率为非随机，并且在一般耦合下常常严格为零。相反，对于对偶于超对称黑洞的态，我们通过在 N=2 超-JT 引力中的计算以及 N=2 SYK 模型中的显式数值表明，Berry 曲率类似随机矩阵。我们还揭示了 N=2 SYK 模空间的有趣拓扑特征，由 Chern 数探测。这些结果表明，Berry 曲率能清晰区分黑洞微观态与光滑无地平线态，并为超对称部门中的混沌提供稳健诊断。
classification.one_liner: 通过 BPS 态的非阿贝尔 Berry 曲率，区分黑洞微观态与无地平线几何态，并在 N=2 super-JT 与 SYK 中发现随机矩阵型混沌信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦 BPS 微观态、Berry 曲率与黑洞量子混沌，涉及 N=2 super-JT 和 SYK，但不直接落在用户列出的重点方向（如全息超流超导、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM 与非线性演化、相变气泡成核、D3-D7/Floquet 驱动等）上。

2605.24101v2.title: Bremsstrahlung function in $\mathcal{N}=2$ SCFTs far beyond the supergravity limit
2605.24101v2.abstract: We study the Bremsstrahlung function in two four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$ superconformal gauge theories: the E-theory, with hypermultiplets in the symmetric and antisymmetric representations, and the D-theory, with antisymmetric and fundamental matter. Using matrix model techniques, we derive exact results at arbitrary coupling for the first few orders in the large-$N$ expansion. At leading order, both theories are shown to be planar equivalent to $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills, while beyond the planar limit their behavior differs significantly. For the E-theory, we prove that the subleading correction is exactly given by a derivative of the free energy with respect to the coupling. This relation enables us to determine the complete strong-coupling expansion for the Bremsstrahlung function, including non-perturbative contributions, by exploiting known results for the free energy. For the D-theory, the exact expressions have a more intricate structure. We perform a detailed analysis of the strong-coupling regime of the subleading large-$N$ corrections, showing that, in this case, there are expansions in inverse powers of the coupling which truncate after finitely many terms. We further analyze the non-perturbative effects at strong coupling and derive closed-form expressions also for these contributions. These results provide precise predictions for the holographic duals of both theories beyond the supergravity approximation, probing higher orders in the large-$N$ expansion and the full subleading corrections at strong coupling.

classification.title_zh: N=2 超共形场论中远超超引力极限的轫致辐射函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了两个四维 N=2 超共形规范理论中的轫致辐射函数：具有对称和反对称表示超多重态的 E-理论，以及具有反对称和基本物质的 D-理论。使用矩阵模型技术，我们推导了在 large-N 展开前几阶中任意耦合下的精确结果。在领头阶，两个理论被证明与 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论平面等价，而在超出平面极限后，它们的行为显著不同。对于 E-理论，我们证明次领头修正恰好由自由能对耦合的导数给出。这一关系使我们能够利用自由能的已知结果，确定轫致辐射函数的完整强耦合展开，包括非微扰贡献。对于 D-理论，精确表达式具有更复杂的结构。我们对次领头 large-N 修正的强耦合区域进行了详细分析，表明在此情形下存在耦合倒数幂的展开，并在有限项后截断。我们进一步分析了强耦合下的非微扰效应，并为这些贡献推导出闭式表达式。这些结果为两个理论的全息对偶提供了超出超引力近似的精确预言，探测了 large-N 展开的高阶项以及强耦合下的完整次领头修正。
classification.one_liner: 用矩阵模型计算 N=2 E/D 理论中轫致辐射函数的大 N 精确结果，给出超越超引力近似的全息预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT/全息对偶的精确计算，讨论 N=2 SCFT 的 Bremsstrahlung 函数及超越超引力极限的对偶预言，但不涉及经典引力或所列重点标签支线。

2609.13104v2.title: Thermodynamic topology of AdS black holes with $F^{\alpha\beta}F^{\gamma\lambda}R_{\alpha\gamma}R_{\beta\lambda}$ coupling in the grand canonical ensemble
2609.13104v2.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic and topological phase structure of charged AdS black holes with a nonminimal gauge--curvature coupling in the grand canonical ensemble. In the minimal-coupling limit $\epsilon=0$, the system exhibits only Hawking--Page-like behavior and does not possess van der Waals criticality. Working perturbatively in the nonminimal coupling, we find that the $\epsilon\neq0$ interaction generates a rich phase structure as the electric potential is varied, including several distinct regimes of critical behavior, a double-critical region, and a regime where conventional criticality disappears. We complement the conventional thermodynamic analysis with a topological description based on the winding number of the thermodynamic vector field. The resulting $r_h$--$\tau$ diagrams reveal that the ordering and morphology of the black-hole branches depend sensitively on both the pressure and the off-shell inverse temperature, with monotonic, disconnected, S-shaped, and cusp-like structures appearing in different parameter ranges. Remarkably, these substantial rearrangements of the solution branches can occur without changing the global winding number. In particular, the system remains in the $W=+1$ topological class beyond the range of conventional criticality, before eventually entering a $W=0$ sector. Our results demonstrate that thermodynamic topology provides complementary global information that is not captured by conventional local criticality criteria alone.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 巨正则系综中带 F^{αβ}F^{γλ}R_{αγ}R_{βλ} 耦合的 AdS 黑洞热力学拓扑
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究巨正则系综中带非最小规范-曲率耦合的带电 AdS 黑洞的热力学与拓扑相结构。在最小耦合极限 ε=0 下，系统只表现出类 Hawking-Page 行为，不具备范德瓦尔斯临界性。对非最小耦合做微扰处理，我们发现 ε≠0 相互作用随电势变化产生丰富相结构，包括若干不同的临界行为区域、双临界区以及常规临界性消失的区域。我们用基于热力学矢量场绕数的拓扑描述补充常规热力学分析。所得的 r_h-τ 图显示，黑洞分支的排序和形态对压强与离壳逆温度均敏感，在不同参数范围内出现单调、断开、S 形和尖点状结构。值得注意的是，这些解分支的显著重排可以在全局绕数不变的情况下发生。特别地，系统在超出常规临界性范围后仍处于 W=+1 拓扑类，随后最终进入 W=0 扇区。结果表明，热力学拓扑提供了常规局域临界性判据无法捕获的互补全局信息。
classification.one_liner: 研究非最小规范-曲率耦合下带电 AdS 黑洞在巨正则系综中的热力学临界性与绕数拓扑分类。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接讨论 AdS 黑洞热力学相变与临界性，属于相变/引力热力学支线；同时以经典黑洞时空为背景，不涉及全息对偶或量子引力信息。

2601.04307v2.title: Spectator Composes a Gravitational Canon: Spectator-field-triggered Phase Transition During Inflation and its Anisotropic Gravitational Wave Signals
2601.04307v2.abstract: We propose a general framework in which a phase transition is triggered during cosmic inflation by the slow-roll dynamics of a spectator field. The topological defects formed at the transition are inflated outside the horizon, reenter it after inflation, and can subsequently generate characteristic gravitational-wave (GW) signals. Quantum fluctuations of the spectator field modulate the timing of the transition, imprinting large-scale anisotropies in the resulting GW background. As an explicit realization, the spectator field may be identified with the Higgs field in a supersymmetric Standard Model. More generally, our framework applies to a wide class of spectator-modulated phenomena, providing a generic mechanism for producing anisotropic GW signals.

classification.title_zh: 旁观者场谱写引力波卡农：暴胀期间旁观者场触发的相变及其各向异性引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个通用框架：在宇宙暴胀期间，由旁观者场的慢滚动力学触发相变。相变时形成的拓扑缺陷被暴胀到视界之外，在暴胀后重新进入视界，随后可产生特征性的引力波（GW）信号。旁观者场的量子涨落会调制相变发生的时间，从而在所得 GW 背景中留下大尺度各向异性。作为一个显式实现，旁观者场可被识别为超对称标准模型中的希格斯场。更一般地，我们的框架适用于一大类旁观者场调制的现象，为产生各向异性 GW 信号提供了一种普适机制。
classification.one_liner: 提出旁观者场慢滚触发暴胀时期相变，拓扑缺陷与量子涨落调制产生各向异性引力波信号的通用框架。
classification.relevance_reason: 与相变、拓扑缺陷和引力波各向异性相关，匹配“相变与气泡成核”“经典引力/广义相对论”等标签；但并非全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力研究，方法属于暴胀宇宙学与旁观者场模型。

2604.08968v2.title: Probing the Kinematic Dipole with LISA: an analytical treatment
2604.08968v2.abstract: The motion of the Solar System with respect to the cosmic rest frame induces a kinematic dipole in the stochastic gravitational-wave background (GWB). Detecting this signal with space-based interferometers would provide an independent measurement of our peculiar velocity and a GW probe of cosmic anisotropies. We present a fully analytic derivation of the response of the \emph{Laser Interferometer Space Antenna} (LISA) to a kinematic dipole, and construct an optimal estimator for its detection. We show that the dipolar response is governed by a single frequency-dependent function fixed by symmetry, and we compute its behaviour across the LISA band. Using Fisher forecasts, we find that for a scale-invariant background detectability requires $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-8}$ for \emph{fiducial} LISA, and $h^2\Omega_{\rm GW} \gtrsim 5\times 10^{-10}$ for a detector with characteristic instrumental-noise amplitudes improved by an order of magnitude. Prospects are more favorable for signals with richer frequency profile. We also explore the potential of the kinematic dipole to break degeneracies, particularly in the presence of strong galactic foregrounds or noise features that closely mimic the primordial signal.

classification.title_zh: 用 LISA 探测运动学偶极：一种解析处理
classification.abstract_zh: 太阳系相对于宇宙静止系的运动会在随机引力波背景（GWB）中诱导出一个运动学偶极。用空间干涉仪探测该信号将提供对本地特殊速度的独立测量，并提供宇宙各向异性的引力波探针。我们给出了激光干涉空间天线（LISA）对运动学偶极响应的完全解析推导，并构造了用于其探测的最优估计量。我们表明偶极响应由单个频率依赖函数决定，该函数由对称性固定，并计算了其在 LISA 频段内的行为。利用 Fisher 预报，我们发现对于尺度不变背景，可探测性要求 h^2Ω_GW ≳ 5×10^{-8}（基准 LISA），而对于特征仪器噪声幅度改善一个量级的探测器，要求 h^2Ω_GW ≳ 5×10^{-10}。对于频率剖面更丰富的信号，前景更有利。我们还探讨了运动学偶极在打破简并性方面的潜力，特别是在存在强银河系前景或与原始信号极为相似的噪声特征时。
classification.one_liner: 本文解析推导了 LISA 对随机引力波背景中运动学偶极的响应，并用 Fisher 预报评估其探测前景。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波/宇宙学观测与数据分析方向，可归入经典引力/广义相对论支线，但不是全息、量子引力或量子信息核心主题。

2606.28427v2.title: Reverse Isoperimetry from Boundary--Completed Canonical Energy
2606.28427v2.abstract: The reverse isoperimetric conjecture states that, at fixed thermodynamic volume, Schwarzschild--AdS black holes maximize entropy. We show that its local fixed-volume form admits a boundary-completed canonical-energy interpretation. The key observation is that the bulk Hollands--Wald canonical energy vanishes on exact stationary black-hole families, while the fixed-volume entropy Hessian is encoded in an asymptotic boundary contribution. The same structure governs the global comparison. We choose an affine parameterization of a fixed-volume stationary branch connecting Schwarzschild--AdS to the solution of interest. If the stationary boundary Hessian is non-negative along this comparison, entropy concavity gives the reverse isoperimetric bound, while equality is determined by the directions along which the boundary Hessian vanishes. In Einstein gravity this reproduces the area--volume inequality on the stated comparison branches, and the formulation extends naturally to Wald entropy in higher-derivative theories.

classification.title_zh: 从边界完备正则能量看反向等周
classification.abstract_zh: 反向等周猜想指出，在固定热力学体积下，Schwarzschild--AdS 黑洞使熵最大化。我们表明，其局域固定体积形式可采用边界完备的正则能量解释。关键观察是，体相的 Hollands--Wald 正则能量在精确稳态黑洞族上为零，而固定体积的熵 Hessian 则编码在渐近边界贡献中。同一结构支配全局比较。我们选取连接 Schwarzschild--AdS 与所关注解的固定体积稳态分支的仿射参数化。若沿此比较的稳态边界 Hessian 非负，则熵凹性给出反向等周界，而等号由边界 Hessian 为零的方向决定。在 Einstein 引力中，这在所述比较分支上重现面积--体积不等式，且该表述自然推广到高阶导数理论中的 Wald 熵。
classification.one_liner: 将反向等周猜想的固定体积形式解释为边界完备的 Hollands-Wald 正则能量条件，并在 Einstein 引力中重现面积-体积不等式。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力与黑洞热力学支线，匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2607.25311v2.title: Parametrized beyond-Teukolsky framework in the time domain
2607.25311v2.abstract: Modifications to General Relativity can significantly alter the perturbative response of black holes, leaving imprints on quasinormal-mode spectra, waveform amplitudes and phases, and late-time tails. The parametrized beyond-Teukolsky framework was introduced to capture possible deviations from Kerr dynamics, but the ringdown has so far only been explored as an eigenvalue problem. We present the first time-domain implementation of this framework and perform (2+1)-dimensional scattering experiments with Gaussian wave packets. This approach provides the full linear evolution of the perturbation, from the initial prompt response through the ringdown and into the late-time regime. Using frequency-domain eigenvalue results as benchmarks, we find excellent agreement for low azimuthal numbers, while higher azimuthal numbers are affected by mode mixing, which limits the precision of the extracted modes. We further use the time-domain waveforms to estimate quadratic and mixed coefficients within the linearized modified-potential model, providing a diagnostic for the regime of validity of the linear approximation. Beyond mode frequencies, we show that the deformation parameters can strongly affect the ringdown amplitude and phase, with trends that can be understood from the near-horizon structure of the modified potential. We also analyze the late- time behavior, finding that near-horizon deformations leave the tail exponent unchanged but can substantially shift the onset of the power-law decay. These results demonstrate that time-domain evolutions provide a complementary and flexible framework for testing parametrized deviations from General Relativity in black-hole perturbation theory.

classification.title_zh: 时域中的参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架
classification.abstract_zh: 对广义相对论的修改会显著改变黑洞的微扰响应，并在准正规模谱、波形振幅和相位以及晚期尾中留下印记。参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架被引入以刻画与 Kerr 动力学的可能偏离，但此前铃宕仅在特征值问题中研究。我们给出该框架的首个时域实现，并用高斯波包进行 (2+1) 维散射实验。该方法给出微扰从初始瞬态响应、经过铃宕到晚期区域的完整线性演化。以频域特征值结果作为基准，我们在低方位角数下发现良好一致，而较高方位角数受模式混合影响，限制了提取模式的精度。我们进一步利用时域波形估计线性化修改势模型中的二次和混合系数，为线性近似适用范围提供诊断。除模式频率外，我们表明形变参数能强烈影响铃宕振幅和相位，其趋势可由修改势的近视界结构理解。我们还分析晚期行为，发现近视界形变不改变尾指数，但可显著移动幂律衰减的起始。这些结果表明，时域演化提供了在黑洞微扰论中检验参数化广义相对论偏离的互补而灵活的框架。
classification.one_liner: 首次在时域实现参数化超越-Teukolsky 框架，用高斯波包散射研究修改引力下黑洞扰动、铃宕、晚期尾及波形振幅相位。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究黑洞扰动、QNM/ringdown 的时域演化与修改引力检验，属于经典引力/QNM 重点支线。

2608.03771v3.title: Local law and delocalization for the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model
2608.03771v3.abstract: We establish a mesoscopic local law and quantitative eigenvector-delocalization estimates for the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model (SYK) Hamiltonian of $N$ interacting Majorana fermions subject to a $q$-body interaction. For even $q\ll N^{\frac{1}{2}}$, we prove that the normalized Stieltjes transform is approximated, uniformly on bounded energy intervals, by an explicit deterministic profile which we construct as an asymptotic expansion in the proportion $\alpha_{N,q}$ of anticommuting $q$-body interaction terms. The result holds both on the full Hilbert space and in each fermion-parity sector. We derive mesoscopic eigenvalue counting and spectral form factor estimates. For fixed $q$, we further obtain high-probability $\ell^\infty$-delocalization bounds in any deterministic orthonormal basis for individual bulk eigenvectors. These are the first mesoscopic laws and eigenvector delocalization estimates for the SYK Hamiltonian, which we obtain using the resolvent method.

classification.title_zh: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型的局部律与退局域化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为具有 N 个相互作用 Majorana 费米子、含有 q 体相互作用的 Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 模型（SYK）哈密顿量，建立介观局部律和定量的本征矢量退局域化估计。对于偶数 q ≪ N^{1/2}，我们证明归一化 Stieltjes 变换在有界能量区间上一致地由显式确定性剖面逼近；该剖面通过按反交换 q 体相互作用项比例 α_{N,q} 的渐近展开构造。结果在全希尔伯特空间以及每个费米子宇称扇区均成立。我们推导介观本征值计数和谱形状因子估计。对于固定 q，我们进一步在任意确定性正交归一基中，对单个体能本征矢量得到高概率的 ℓ∞ 退局域化界。这些是 SYK 哈密顿量的首个介观律和本征矢量退局域化估计，我们使用预解式方法获得。
classification.one_liner: 用预解式方法为 SYK 哈密顿量证明介观局部律、本征值计数、谱形状因子估计及本征矢量退局域化界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 SYK/矩阵模型方向，但摘要聚焦局部律、本征矢量退局域化和谱形状因子等随机矩阵/谱统计，不涉及所列重点标签中的全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 等支线。

2608.10593v2.title: Octupolar Gravitational Radiation in de Sitter Spacetime
2608.10593v2.abstract: We derive the gravitational radiation generated by a localised matter source in de Sitter spacetime at octupolar order in the multipolar expansion, working in generalised harmonic gauge in the future Poincar\'e patch. The scalar, vector, and tensor perturbation equations are solved explicitly, taking into account the cosmological tail. This constitutes the first extension of the de Sitter multipolar expansion beyond quadrupolar order. A key technical ingredient is a universal multipole moment differentiation identity, which unifies the relations between multipole moments into a single recursive formula and enables a controlled extension to higher multipoles. Using the symmetric trace-free tensor formalism of Blanchet, Damour, and Iyer, we further develop a systematic translation of the radiative solution into a spherical harmonic basis, and apply it to both the quadrupolar and octupolar metric perturbations. This representation renders the angular structure of the radiation manifest, simplifies the verification of the linearised field equations, and facilitates direct comparison with Bondi-gauge and other perturbative treatments of de Sitter spacetime.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 时空中的八极引力辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在 de Sitter 时空的未来 Poincaré 片中，采用广义调和规范，推导了局域物质源在多极展开中八极阶产生的引力辐射。我们显式求解了标量、矢量与张量扰动方程，并考虑了宇宙学尾项。这是 de Sitter 多极展开首次被推广到四极阶之外。一个关键的技术要素是一个普适的多极矩微分恒等式，它将多极矩之间的关系统一为一个递归公式，并使得向更高多极的受控推广成为可能。利用 Blanchet、Damour 与 Iyer 的对称无迹张量形式，我们进一步发展了将辐射解系统翻译到球谐基的方法，并将其应用于四极和八极度规扰动。这种表示使辐射的角向结构变得显明，简化了线性化场方程的验证，并便于与 Bondi 规范以及 de Sitter 时空的其他微扰处理进行直接比较。
classification.one_liner: 首次将 de Sitter 时空中的多极引力辐射展开推进到八极阶，并给出球谐表示。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论，并直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；同时涉及 de Sitter 时空与 Bondi 规范，但不涉及全息对偶。

2608.30049v2.title: Periodic orbits around a magnetically charged black hole in $f(R,T)$ gravity coupled with Euler-Heisenberg electrodynamics
2608.30049v2.abstract: We systematically investigate the zoom-whirl periodic orbits of a small compact object orbiting a magnetically charged black hole in $f(R, T)$ gravity coupled with Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics. We evaluate the impact of the magnetic charge $Q_m$ and the Euler-Heisenberg parameter $a$ on the characteristics of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) and the marginally bound orbit (MBO). Particularly, we focus on the precession parameter q and systematically examine how the magnetic charge and other parameters affect the trajectories of periodic orbits. Using the numerical kludge method, we generate gravitational waveforms for these periodic orbits. The results presented in our work demonstrate that the magnetic charge can significantly modify not only the precession parameter but also the orbital trajectories of the periodic orbits. Moreover, changing the magnetic charge $Q_m$ could cause a significant phase shift in the gravitational waveforms, while other parameters exert a relatively weaker influence on the gravitational waves.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T) 引力耦合 Euler-Heisenberg 电动力学中磁荷黑洞周围的周期轨道
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统研究了在 f(R,T) 引力耦合 Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中，一个小致密天体绕磁荷黑洞运动的 zoom-whirl 周期轨道。我们评估了磁荷 Q_m 和 Euler-Heisenberg 参数 a 对最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）和边际束缚轨道（MBO）特征的影响。特别地，我们关注进动参数 q，并系统考察磁荷及其他参数如何影响周期轨道的轨迹。利用数值 kludge 方法，我们为这些周期轨道生成了引力波形。结果说明，磁荷不仅能显著修改进动参数，也能显著修改周期轨道的轨迹。此外，改变磁荷 Q_m 会导致引力波形出现显著相位移动，而其他参数对引力波的影响相对较弱。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 引力与 Euler-Heisenberg 非线性电动力学中，磁荷黑洞周围致密天体的周期轨道及其引力波特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/修改引力下的黑洞轨道与引力波研究，与用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2609.12025v2.title: Komar superpotentials in extended theories of gravity
2609.12025v2.abstract: This paper investigates Lagrangians with arbitrary dependence on the Riemann tensor and any number of derivatives. Noether's second theorem is applied separately to ${\cal L}_{G}$ and ${\cal L}_{M}$, where the matter Lagrangian depends on a scalar field. For ${\cal L}_{G}$ diffeomorphism invariance requires that the generalized Einstein tensor satisfy $\nabla_{\alpha}E^{\alpha\beta}=0$ and that there is a current satisfying $0=\partial_{\alpha}(\sqrt{g}\, J^{\alpha}_{G2})$. The main result is an explicit formula for the superpotential $\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}$ that solves $\partial_{\mu}\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}=\sqrt{g}\,J^{\alpha}_{G2}$. Some applications to $f(R)$ gravity and various quadratic gravity theories are discussed. There are analogous results, including superpotentials, for the matter sector whenever the couplings to the matter fields contain derivatives of the metric.

classification.title_zh: 扩展引力理论中的Komar超势
classification.abstract_zh: 本文研究对黎曼张量有任意依赖且可含任意阶导数的拉格朗日量。将诺特定理第二定理分别应用于 ${\cal L}_{G}$ 和 ${\cal L}_{M}$，其中物质拉格朗日量依赖于标量场。对于 ${\cal L}_{G}$，微分同胚不变性要求广义爱因斯坦张量满足 $\nabla_{\alpha}E^{\alpha\beta}=0$，并且存在满足 $0=\partial_{\alpha}(\sqrt{g}\, J^{\alpha}_{G2})$ 的流。主要结果是给出超势 $\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}$ 的显式公式，使其满足 $\partial_{\mu}\Phi^{[\alpha\mu]}=\sqrt{g}\,J^{\alpha}_{G2}$。文中讨论了在 $f(R)$ 引力和各种二次引力理论中的一些应用。当物质场与度规的耦合包含度规导数时，物质部分也有类似结果，包括超势。
classification.one_liner: 将诺特定理第二定理用于含任意黎曼张量依赖与任意阶导数的引力/物质拉格朗日量，导出Komar型超势的显式公式。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论，讨论扩展引力理论中的守恒量与超势；但不涉及全息对偶或AdS/CFT，因此相关性为中等。

2609.16135v1.title: Analog Gravity in Magneto-Viscous Fluids: Enhanced Analog Hawking Temperature in Accretion Disks
2609.16135v1.abstract: We present a three-dimensional visco-magnetoacoustic framework for analog gravity in magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) flows. While standard fluid dissipation typically breaks the Lorentzian signature of acoustic metrics, we demonstrate that evaluating wave perturbations in the eikonal limit alongside the Shakura-Sunyaev $\alpha$-viscosity prescription preserves a well-defined effective spacetime geometry for the fast magnetoacoustic mode. The slow-magnetoacoustic mode and Alfv\'en mode do not admit a non-degenerate metric. To investigate analog horizon thermodynamics, we utilize astrophysical accretion disks as background media, specifically modeling numerical magnetized advective accretion flows around rotating black holes and analytical advection-dominated inflow-outflow solutions (ADIOS). Standard self-similar ADIOS models strictly enforce a constant Mach number, precluding horizon formation. We therefore introduce a magnetic field perturbation that breaks self-similarity, generates a dynamic Mach number, and enables the formation of a visco-magnetoacoustic horizon. By evaluating the spontaneous phonon emission at these horizons, we reveal that the analog Hawking temperature is highly sensitive to the magnetic field topology; the spatial orientation of the background magnetic gradients dictates whether the Hawking radiation is amplified or suppressed. Furthermore, we find that increasing the viscosity parameter leads to a monotonic increase in the analog Hawking temperature.

classification.title_zh: 磁黏性流体中的类比引力：吸积盘中增强的类比霍金温度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个用于磁流体力学（MHD）流动中类比引力的三维黏磁声学框架。标准流体耗散通常会破坏声学度规的洛伦兹号差，但我们证明，在程函极限下评估波扰动，并结合 Shakura-Sunyaev α 黏性方案，可以为快磁声模保留一个定义良好的有效时空几何。慢磁声模和 Alfvén 模不允许非退化度规。为了研究类比视界热力学，我们利用天体物理吸积盘作为背景介质，具体建模了旋转黑洞周围的数值磁化平流吸积流以及解析的平流主导流入-流出解（ADIOS）。标准自相似 ADIOS 模型严格强制常马赫数，从而阻止视界形成。因此我们引入一个破坏自相似性的磁场扰动，产生动态马赫数，并使得黏磁声学视界得以形成。通过评估这些视界处的自发声子发射，我们揭示类比霍金温度对磁场拓扑高度敏感；背景磁场梯度的空间取向决定了霍金辐射是被放大还是被抑制。此外，我们发现增加黏性参数会导致类比霍金温度单调增加。
classification.one_liner: 在含黏性的磁流体吸积盘背景中构建三维类比引力框架，并发现磁场拓扑与黏性可显著调节类比霍金温度。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究磁黏性流体中的类比引力、有效时空与吸积盘类比霍金辐射，不属于 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息；仅与经典引力/有效时空支线间接相关。

2609.16238v1.title: Bridging the chirp-mass gap: searching for gravitational waves from inspiraling ultra-compact binaries using LIGO O4ab data
2609.16238v1.abstract: Gravitational-wave searches for subsolar-mass compact binaries have left a gap between the planetary-mass regime accessible to long-duration searches and the higher masses probed by conventional compact-binary analyses. We close this gap by searching for the inspiral of ultra-compact binaries with chirp masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ in LIGO O4ab data. Using the statistically robust BinaryGFH-v2 method, a time-frequency technique to search for rapidly evolving inspirals lasting minutes to hours, we cover this previously challenging parameter space with a computational cost of only $\sim 350$ CPU-hours, and find no significant candidates. We thus set 90\% confidence upper limits on the binary merger-rate density, providing the first gravitational-wave constraints across this chirp-mass range. Assuming that primordial-black-hole binaries formed in the early Universe with no binary suppression ($f_{\rm sup}=1$), these results provide the first gravitational-wave constraints on the primordial-black-hole \dmh fraction in this mass range, yielding upper limits with $f_{\rm PBH}<1$ for equal-mass binaries with component masses $10^{-2}$--$10^{-1}\,M_\odot$ and asymmetric binaries with secondary masses $m_2=3\times10^{-4}$--$10^{-2}\,M_\odot$ for a primary mass $m_1=2.5\,M_\odot$.

classification.title_zh: 弥合啁啾质量间隙：利用 LIGO O4ab 数据搜寻旋近的超致密双星引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 对亚太阳质量致密双星的引力波搜寻，在长时搜寻可及的行星质量区间与传统致密双星分析所探测的较高质量区间之间留下了一个间隙。我们通过在 LIGO O4ab 数据中搜寻啁啾质量为 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近信号来弥合该间隙。使用统计稳健的 BinaryGFH-v2 方法，这是一种用于搜寻持续数分钟至数小时的快速演化旋近信号的时间-频率技术，我们以仅约 350 CPU 小时的计算代价覆盖了这一此前具有挑战性的参数空间，并未发现显著候选体。因此，我们对双星并合率密度给出了 90% 置信度的上限，首次在这一啁啾质量范围内提供引力波限制。假设早期宇宙中形成的原初黑洞双星没有双星抑制（f_sup=1），这些结果为该质量范围内的原初黑洞暗物质分数提供了首个引力波限制：对于分量质量为 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的等质量双星，以及主质量 m1=2.5 M⊙、次质量 m2=3×10^{-4}--10^{-2} M⊙ 的非对称双星，得到 f_PBH<1 的上限。
classification.one_liner: LIGO O4ab 未发现啁啾质量 10^{-2}--10^{-1} M⊙ 的超致密双星旋近信号，并首次给出该质量范围并合率及原初黑洞暗物质分数上限。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文为引力波观测搜寻与经典引力/原初黑洞限制，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

2609.16463v1.title: Weak in the Presence of Beauty: Gravitational waves from the mergers of black holes and neutron stars as a messenger
2609.16463v1.abstract: In 2025, the 4th Gravitational Wave Transient Catalog reported the discovery of over 200 gravitational wave events since 2015. These gravitational waves (GWs) are emitted by compact binary coalescenses (CBCs) between neutron stars and black holes, and detected with a global network of ground-based laser interferometers. GWs represent a new `messenger' -- ripples in spacetime that propagate across cosmological distances, and carry information about the physical properties of compact objects and their location in the Universe. In this review, we consider what information we can learn about black holes and neutron stars using GWs as a messenger. We explore how the GW observation process allows us to transform the outputs of laser interferometers like LIGO, Virgo and KAGRA into knowledge about black holes and neutron stars. We show that the GW source population acts as a messenger that can lead us to breakthroughs in our understanding of stellar evolution, how the Universe has changed across cosmic time, and fundamental physics. Finally, we discuss three key opportunities to learn more about our Universe using GWs as a messenger in the coming decades.

classification.title_zh: 美中不足的微弱信号：黑洞与中子星并合的引力波作为信使
classification.abstract_zh: 2025 年，第四版引力波瞬变星表报告了自 2015 年以来发现的 200 多个引力波事件。这些引力波由中子星与黑洞之间的致密双星并合（CBC）发出，并由全球地面激光干涉仪网络探测到。引力波代表了一种新的“信使”——穿越宇宙学距离传播的时空涟漪，携带着关于致密天体物理性质及其在宇宙中位置的信息。在这篇综述中，我们考察以引力波作为信使能够了解到关于黑洞和中子星的哪些信息。我们探讨引力波的观测过程如何使我们把 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 等激光干涉仪的输出转化为关于黑洞与中子星的知识。我们表明，引力波源族群作为一种信使，能够引领我们在对恒星演化、宇宙如何随宇宙时间变化以及基础物理的理解上取得突破。最后，我们讨论未来数十年中以引力波作为信使来进一步了解宇宙的三个关键机遇。
classification.one_liner: 综述引力波作为信使，如何从致密双星并合中提取黑洞与中子星的性质，并展望未来机遇。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是引力波天文学与致密天体观测的综述，属于经典引力/天体物理范畴，不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息理论，与用户的全息研究支线无实质交集。

2609.16477v1.title: Correlated Galactic Confusion Foreground for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin Network and Its Implications for Resolvable Source Analysis
2609.16477v1.abstract: The millihertz gravitational-wave sky is expected to be observed by a network of space-based detectors (LISA, Taiji, and TianQin) in the 2030s. A dominant noise in this band is the confusion foreground produced by O(10^7) unresolved Galactic binaries (GBs). Because the same population projects onto the time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels of the different detectors, the foreground is necessarily correlated across the network. We construct the full foreground noise covariance matrix for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin network from a catalogue of ~3 x 10^7 GBs through numerical simulation, and we derive an analytic model of the cross-detector foreground coherence that provides a cross-check and physical interpretation of the numerical results. We derive the overall sensitivity of the detector network based on this covariance matrix, and further characterize the frequency- and time-dependent cross-detector foreground correlations. Taking massive black hole binaries (MBHBs) and GBs as representative transient and continuous sources, we further compare the block-diagonal (i.e., neglecting the cross-detector foreground correlation) and full-covariance noise models in terms of their impacts on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), parameter uncertainties, and Bayesian posteriors. The impact is confined to specific signal regimes, affecting primarily high-mass (M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun) MBHBs and low-frequency (f_0 <~ 2 mHz) GBs, with SNR relative differences of up to ~30% and ~10%, respectively. No statistically significant parameter bias arises under either noise model, as verified by probability-probability tests. Parameter estimations for MBHBs and GBs are performed using the network analysis pipelines implemented in the Triangle-BBH and Triangle-GB codes. Both repositories, together with the simulated foreground data and network sensitivities, are publicly released for diverse scientific investigations.

classification.title_zh: LISA-Taiji-TianQin 网络的相关银河系混淆前景及其对可分辨源分析的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹引力波天空预计将在 2030 年代由空间探测器网络（LISA、Taiji 和 TianQin）观测。该频段的一种主导噪声是约 10^7 个未分辨银河系双星（GB）产生的混淆前景。由于同一族群会投影到不同探测器的时间延迟干涉（TDI）通道上，该前景必然在网络中相关。我们通过数值模拟，从约 3×10^7 个 GB 的目录构建了 LISA-Taiji-TianQin 网络的完整前景噪声协方差矩阵，并推导了跨探测器前景相干性的解析模型，用于交叉检验和物理解释数值结果。基于该协方差矩阵，我们推导了探测器网络的整体灵敏度，并进一步刻画了随频率和时间变化的跨探测器前景相关性。以大质量黑洞双星（MBHB）和 GB 作为代表性的暂现源和连续源，我们比较了块对角（即忽略跨探测器前景相关性）与全协方差噪声模型对信噪比（SNR）、参数不确定性和贝叶斯后验的影响。影响限于特定信号区域，主要影响高质量（M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun）MBHB 和低频（f_0 <~ 2 mHz）GB，SNR 相对差异分别可达约 30% 和约 10%。概率-概率检验表明，在两种噪声模型下均未出现统计显著参数偏差。MBHB 和 GB 的参数估计使用 Triangle-BBH 和 Triangle-GB 代码中的网络分析流程完成。两个代码仓库以及模拟前景数据和网络灵敏度均已公开，以供多样化科学研究使用。
classification.one_liner: 为 LISA-Taiji-TianQin 网络建立相关银河系双星混淆前景的全协方差模型，并评估其对可分辨源参数估计的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及空间引力波探测器网络与双星前景建模，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但与全息对偶、量子引力等主线无关。

2609.16568v1.title: Thermodynamic topological classification of magnetically charged slowly rotating Kerr black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics with a cosmological constant
2609.16568v1.abstract: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic topological classification of slowly rotating Kerr black holes with magnetic charge in nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) using a reduced grand-canonical off-shell prescription. By constructing the generalized off-shell free energy and the associated topological vector field, we determine the local winding numbers and the global topological charge of the NLED-Kerr black hole in both de Sitter (dS) and anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetimes. The inverse-temperature curve starts from a finite nonzero value at the lower radial endpoint and diverges at large horizon radius. Together with the single zero of winding number $w=-1$, this behavior identifies the black hole as a realization of the predicted \(\overline{W}^{1-}\) subclass, with global topological number $W=-1$ and a single unstable branch. The classification remains unchanged over the sampled rotation, NLED, and magnetic-charge parameters. Within the same prescription, comparison with the two-branch $W^{0-}$ Kerr-AdS result associates the NLED effective mass function with the changed endpoint behavior and the absence of a stable large-black-hole branch. Thus, the physical novelty is an explicit rotating NLED realization of the predicted \(\overline{W}^{1-}\) subclass for both signs of the cosmological constant.
