classification.title_zh: 带宇宙学常数的非线性电动力学中磁荷慢转Kerr黑洞的热力学拓扑分类
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用约化的巨正则非壳方案，研究了非线性电动力学（NLED）中带磁荷的慢转Kerr黑洞的热力学拓扑分类。通过构造广义非壳自由能及相关的拓扑矢量场，我们确定了NLED-Kerr黑洞在de Sitter（dS）和anti-de Sitter（AdS）时空中的局部绕数和全局拓扑荷。逆温度曲线从较低径向端点处的有限非零值开始，并在大视界半径处发散。结合绕数w=-1的单个零点，这一行为将该黑洞识别为所预言的 \overline{W}^{1-} 子类的实现，其全局拓扑数为 W=-1，并具有单个不稳定分支。在取样的转动、NLED和磁荷参数范围内，该分类保持不变。在同一方案内，与双分支 W^{0-} Kerr-AdS 结果的比较将NLED有效质量函数与端点行为的改变以及稳定大黑洞分支的缺失联系起来。因此，物理新颖性在于：对于宇宙学常数的两种符号，给出了所预言的 \overline{W}^{1-} 子类的一个显式转动NLED实现。
classification.one_liner: 用非壳自由能拓扑方法将带磁荷慢转NLED-Kerr黑洞分类为 \overline{W}^{1-} 子类（W=-1），并表明该结果在dS/AdS及参数取样下不变。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/黑洞热力学，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但其主题是NLED-Kerr黑洞热力学拓扑分类，不涉及全息/量子引力。

2609.16698v1.title: At Most One Inner Killing Horizon in Stationary Black Holes
2609.16698v1.abstract: Stationary-axisymmetric black holes are the standard theoretical framework for astrophysical black holes, yet their interiors remain largely inaccessible: the absence of a hypersurface-orthogonal timelike Killing vector renders the metric non-diagonal, and frame dragging obstructs the usual techniques for probing the interior. We prove that any stationary-axisymmetric black hole satisfying the classical energy conditions contains at most one nondegenerate inner Killing horizon per connected interior branch, irrespective of its matter content. For compact horizon sections, we apply the Raychaudhuri equation to the congruence normal to constant-time hypersurfaces: the strong energy condition makes the squared lapse subharmonic, and the maximum principle excludes a second inner horizon. For noncompact planar and hyperbolic sections central to holography, the null energy condition instead yields a monotonicity obstruction through a geometric flow we introduce here, the ``inverse lapse flow,'' whose weak continuation via viscosity solutions we also construct. The attractive nature of gravity, encoded in these energy conditions, thus both drives horizon formation and caps the number of inner horizons, revealing a striking dual role of the same focusing mechanism.

classification.title_zh: 稳态黑洞中至多存在一个内 Killing 视界
classification.abstract_zh: 稳态轴对称黑洞是天体物理黑洞的标准理论框架，但其内部在很大程度上仍难以触及：不存在超曲面正交的类时 Killing 矢量使度规非对角，参考系拖曳阻碍了探测内部的常用技术。我们证明，任何满足经典能量条件的稳态轴对称黑洞，在其每个连通内部分支中至多包含一个非退化内 Killing 视界，且与其物质内容无关。对于紧致视界截面，我们将 Raychaudhuri 方程应用于垂直于等时超曲面的汇：强能量条件使 lapse 平方为次调和函数，而最大值原理排除了第二个内视界。对于全息中至关重要的非紧致平面和双曲截面，零能量条件则通过我们引入的一种几何流——“逆 lapse 流”——给出单调性阻碍；我们还构造了其经由粘性解的弱延拓。因此，以这些能量条件编码的引力吸引本性，既驱动视界形成，又限制内视界的数目，揭示了同一聚焦机制的引人注目的双重作用。
classification.one_liner: 在经典能量条件下，稳态轴对称黑洞每个内部连通分支至多有一个非退化内 Killing 视界；紧致情形用次调和性与最大值原理，非紧致平面/双曲情形用逆 lapse 流证明。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的黑洞内视界定理，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；仅在全息相关的平面/双曲视界截面处提及全息背景，不涉及 AdS/CFT 字典或全息计算。

2609.16844v1.title: An Abel-Inversion Formalism for Spacetime Metric Reconstruction from Light Deflection
2609.16844v1.abstract: We develop an inverse lensing formalism for reconstructing the metric function of a static, spherically symmetric spacetime directly from the gravitational deflection angle of light. By formulating the inverse problem through an Abel transformation, we derive an integro-differential relation connecting the observable deflection profile to the underlying spacetime geometry. As a consistency check, we consider the case of vanishing deflection, \(\alpha(b)=0\), and recover \(A(r)=1\), corresponding to flat Minkowski spacetime. We then apply the formalism to the gravitational deflection of light by the Sun using the observationally motivated leading-order expression $\alpha(b)=\frac{2(1+\gamma)GM_{\odot}}{c^{2}b}.$The resulting metric function is shown to recover the Schwarzschild form in the weak-field limit \(r\gg M\). We further consider the higher-order correction to the solar deflection angle and reconstruct the corresponding metric beyond the leading-order approximation. Interestingly, the \((M/r)^2\) term vanishes in the resulting weak-field expansion, yielding an improved approximation compared with the metric reconstructed from the leading-order deflection angle. Our results demonstrate that gravitational lensing observations can provide a direct route to reconstructing the underlying spacetime geometry without assuming a specific metric a priori. This formalism therefore, offers a novel framework for connecting observational light propagation with spacetime geometry.

classification.title_zh: 从光线偏折重建时空度规的 Abel 反演形式
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种逆引力透镜形式，用于直接从静态球对称时空的光线引力偏折角重建其度规函数。通过将逆问题表述为 Abel 变换，我们导出了联系可观测偏折剖面与底层时空几何的积分-微分关系。作为一致性检验，考虑偏折消失情形 α(b)=0，可恢复 A(r)=1，即平直 Minkowski 时空。随后将该形式应用于太阳对光线的引力偏折，采用观测启发的领头阶表达式 α(b)=2(1+γ)GM⊙/(c^2 b)。所得度规函数在弱场极限 r≫M 下可恢复 Schwarzschild 形式。我们还考虑太阳偏折角的高阶修正，并重建超出领头阶近似的相应度规。有趣的是，(M/r)^2 项在所得弱场展开中消失，从而比由领头阶偏折角重建的度规给出改进近似。结果表明，引力透镜观测可提供一条直接重建底层时空几何的途径，而无需先验假设特定度规。该形式为联系观测光传播与时空几何提供了一个新框架。
classification.one_liner: 提出基于 Abel 反演的逆引力透镜形式，可从静态球对称时空的光偏折角直接重建度规函数，并用太阳偏折与高阶修正作检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心是经典广义相对论中的引力透镜逆问题与时空度规重建，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

2609.16942v1.title: The Null Energy Condition through the Lens of Optimal Transport: Smooth and Non-Smooth Spacetimes
2609.16942v1.abstract: We survey recent developments on the null energy condition (NEC) from the perspective of optimal transport, with emphasis on non-smooth Lorentzian geometry. After recalling the role of classical energy conditions in general relativity, we discuss the relation between Ricci curvature and entropy convexity in optimal transport. The main focus is the authors' optimal-transport characterization of the NEC. In the smooth setting, the NEC is equivalent to displacement concavity of the Shannon entropy power along suitable null-geodesic transport plans supported on null hypersurfaces and measured with respect to rigged measures. We review the geometric ingredients of this characterization and applications, including a weighted Hawking area theorem. We then turn to the synthetic theory introduced in a second paper of the authors. Synthetic null hypersurfaces are defined using achronal boundaries, gauge functions, and reference measures in topological causal spaces. In this framework, the displacement-concavity characterization becomes a synthetic curvature condition, $\mathsf{NC}^{e}(N)$, meaningful without differentiable structure. We discuss compatibility with the smooth theory, invariance under natural changes of gauge and reference measure, and stability under convergence. Finally, we present a synthetic version of Penrose's singularity theorem for continuous Lorentzian metrics. These results indicate that geometric and causal consequences of the NEC persist beyond the smooth setting and highlight optimal transport as a framework connecting curvature, causality, and singularity formation in Lorentzian geometry.

classification.title_zh: 通过最优传输视角看零能量条件：光滑与非光滑时空
classification.abstract_zh: 本文从最优传输视角综述零能量条件（NEC）的近期进展，重点讨论非光滑洛伦兹几何。回顾经典能量条件在广义相对论中的作用后，讨论最优传输中 Ricci 曲率与熵凸性的关系。核心是作者对 NEC 的最优传输刻画：在光滑情形，NEC 等价于 Shannon 熵功率沿合适零测地传输计划的位移凹性；这些计划支撑在零超曲面上并用 rigged measure 度量。我们回顾该刻画的几何要素及应用，包括带权 Hawking 面积定理。随后转向作者第二篇论文引入的合成理论：合成零超曲面用拓扑因果空间中的 achronal 边界、规范函数和参考测度定义；在此框架下，位移凹性刻画成为无需可微结构的合成曲率条件 NC^e(N)。讨论其与光滑理论的兼容性、在规范与参考测度自然变化下的不变性，以及收敛稳定性。最后给出连续洛伦兹度规下 Penrose 奇点定理的合成版本。这些结果表明 NEC 的几何与因果后果可超出光滑情形，并突出最优传输作为连接洛伦兹几何中曲率、因果性与奇点形成的框架。
classification.one_liner: 从最优传输视角综述零能量条件，并将位移凹性设为非光滑时空中的合成曲率条件，进而导出合成奇点定理。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论中的零能量条件、最优传输刻画、Hawking 面积定理与 Penrose 奇点定理，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2609.16961v1.title: Limits on the Inferred Hubble Constant Bias from a Local McVittie Gravitational Field
2609.16961v1.abstract: We examine the exact propagation of light in a McVittie spacetime to quantify the observational bias introduced on the inferred Hubble constant $H_0$ by a localized central mass embedded in an expanding asymptotically de Sitter background. By integrating the Sachs optical equations for radial null geodesics, we derive linearized analytical expressions for the areal and luminosity distances to first order in the dimensionless Hawking-Hayward coupling parameter $\mu = H_{\text{dS}} m_H$. We evaluate the magnitude of this local gravitational field effect across realistic astrophysical scales, ranging from supermassive black holes ($\text{Sgr A}^*$) to galaxy cluster halos. We show that while a McVittie central mass induces a coordinate-invariant path-focusing effect on incoming photons, the quantitative correction for local galactic parameters ($\mu \sim 10^{-16}$) is negligible ($\sim 10^{-15}\%$), proving that a localized galactic mass alone cannot resolve the $\sim 8\%$ Hubble tension. We establish strict upper bounds on the extent to which local spacetime inhomogeneity can bias low-redshift distance ladder measurements.

classification.title_zh: 局域 McVittie 引力场对推断哈勃常数偏差的限制
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考察 McVittie 时空中光的精确传播，以量化一个嵌入在膨胀且渐近 de Sitter 背景中的局域中心质量对推断哈勃常数 H0 造成的观测偏差。通过积分径向零测地线的 Sachs 光学方程，我们推导出面积距离和光度距离在无量纲 Hawking-Hayward 耦合参数 μ = H_dS m_H 一阶下的线性化解析表达式。我们在现实天体物理尺度上评估这种局域引力场效应的量级，范围从超大质量黑洞（Sgr A*）到星系团晕。我们表明，尽管 McVittie 中心质量会对入射光子产生坐标不变的路径聚焦效应，但对于局域星系参数（μ ~ 10^{-16}），定量修正可忽略（约 10^{-15}%），证明仅靠局域星系质量无法解决约 8% 的哈勃张力。我们对局域时空非均匀性可能偏置低红移距离阶梯测量的程度给出了严格上限。
classification.one_liner: McVittie 时空中的 Sachs 方程计算表明，局域星系质量对 H0 的距离阶梯偏差仅约 10^{-15}%，无法解释约 8% 的哈勃张力。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典广义相对论时空中的光传播、宇宙学距离与哈勃常数推断，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2609.16990v1.title: Impact of the Host Galaxy on the Search for Gravitational-Wave Microlensing by Compact Objects
2609.16990v1.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) microlensing occurs when an intervening compact object causes diffraction of the GW, imprinting characteristic frequency-dependent modulations on the observed signal. Current searches for microlensing signatures in the detected GW events, including those used to constrain the fraction of dark matter in the form of compact objects, assume an isolated point mass lens (PML) model. However, astrophysical compact objects are typically embedded within larger structures, such as galaxies, whose potentials introduce additional convergence and tidal shear, thereby perturbing the lensed signal. In this work, we study the impact of the background galaxy in the search for microlensing by compact objects using a PML model. We distribute the compact objects inside a galaxy following the Navarro-Frenk-White density profile. We model the microlensing effects using the potential of a PML embedded in a constant convergence and shear, which are, in turn, calculated from a singular isothermal sphere model of the galaxy lens. We demonstrate that neglecting the galaxy's effects can systematically reduce sensitivity in microlensing searches, particularly for high microlens masses. Thus, future searches may need to incorporate the additional effect of the lens galaxy, particularly those aimed at placing robust constraints on the abundance of compact dark matter.

classification.title_zh: 宿主星系对致密天体引力波微透镜搜索的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 当致密天体作为透镜使引力波发生衍射时，会产生引力波微透镜效应，并在观测信号上留下特征性的频率相关调制。当前对已探测引力波事件中微透镜信号的搜索，包括用于限制致密天体暗物质占比的搜索，通常假设孤立的点质量透镜模型。然而，天体物理中的致密天体通常嵌入星系等更大结构之中，这些结构的势会引入额外的收敛和潮汐剪切，从而扰动透镜信号。本文研究在使用点质量透镜模型搜索致密天体微透镜时，背景星系的影响。我们按照 Navarro-Frenk-White 密度轮廓将致密天体分布在星系内。我们用嵌入恒定收敛和剪切中的点质量透镜势来建模微透镜效应，其中收敛和剪切由星系的奇异等温球模型计算得到。我们证明，忽略星系效应会系统性地降低微透镜搜索的灵敏度，尤其是在高微透镜质量情形下。因此，未来的搜索可能需要纳入透镜星系额外效应，特别是那些旨在对致密暗物质丰度给出稳健限制的搜索。
classification.one_liner: 研究表明，在致密暗物质引力波微透镜搜索中，忽略宿主星系的收敛和剪切会系统性降低灵敏度，尤其在高微透镜质量时。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于经典引力/引力波透镜与暗物质约束方向，与经典引力/广义相对论重点标签相符，但不涉及全息或量子引力。

2609.17077v1.title: Pseudospectrum of Braneworld Perturbations
2609.17077v1.abstract: Pseudospectral analysis provides a powerful way to probe the spectral stability of non-self-adjoint operators and has been widely used in black hole physics, but its application to braneworld scenarios has not yet been explored. In this work, we apply this method to tensor gravitational perturbations in a representative scalar-field-generated thick brane background. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first hyperboloidal formulation of braneworld perturbations and propose a height-function gauge adapted to the warped geometry. This construction converts the outgoing boundary conditions of quasinormal modes into regularity conditions at finite compactified boundaries and recasts the perturbation equation as a first-order system generated by a non-self-adjoint hyperboloidal evolution operator. With the corresponding energy norm, we compute the condition numbers and pseudospectra of the localized graviton zero mode and the quasinormal-mode spectrum. We find that the condition numbers grow rapidly along the overtone sequence and that the corresponding pseudospectral contours develop broad, connected structures in the high-overtone region. These results show a strongly mode-dependent spectral sensitivity: among the damped modes analyzed, the higher overtones are less robust than the fundamental mode. The zero mode also has a larger condition number than the fundamental mode, indicating stronger local first-order sensitivity. These diagnostics characterize sensitivity to generic norm-bounded operator perturbations. Relating that sensitivity to a specific braneworld deformation requires the corresponding self-consistent perturbation constraints.

classification.title_zh: 膜世界扰动的伪谱
classification.abstract_zh: 伪谱分析为探测非自伴算子的谱稳定性提供了有力工具，并已广泛用于黑洞物理，但其在膜世界场景中的应用尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将该方法应用于一个代表性标量场生成厚膜背景中的张量引力扰动。据我们所知，我们首次给出了膜世界扰动的双曲叶表述，并提出了适用于翘曲几何的高度函数规范。该构造将准正模的出射边界条件转化为有限紧化边界上的正则性条件，并将扰动方程改写为由非自伴双曲叶演化算子生成的一阶系统。利用相应的能量范数，我们计算了局域化引力子零模和准正模谱的条件数及伪谱。我们发现条件数沿泛音序列快速增长，且相应的伪谱等高线在高泛音区域形成宽而连通的结构。这些结果表明谱敏感性强烈依赖于模式：在所分析的阻尼模式中，较高泛音比基模更不稳健。零模的条件数也大于基模，表明更强的局域一阶敏感性。这些诊断刻画了对一般范数有界算子扰动的敏感性。将该敏感性与具体的膜世界形变联系起来，需要相应的自洽扰动约束。
classification.one_liner: 首次将伪谱方法用于厚膜世界张量引力扰动，构造双曲叶表述并比较引力子零模与准正模的谱稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究经典引力扰动、准正模谱与伪谱稳定性，直接匹配重点标签‘QNM与非线性演化’和‘经典引力/广义相对论’；但摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.17462v1.title: Symmetry of the Klein-Gordon Equation under Disformal Transformations with Higher-Order Derivatives
2609.17462v1.abstract: Scalar-Tensor theories extend General Relativity (GR) by including both a scalar field and a metric tensor in describing gravity. Although the matter sector is minimally coupled to the metric in GR, the scalar field coupling to matter may be adjusted by means of Disformal Transformations. One of the most general of these transformations, formulated by Takahashi, Motohashi, and Minamitsuji, include arbitrarily high-order derivatives of the scalar field and are designed to map between two ghost-free Higher-order Scalar-Tensor theories. We used these transformations to determine the most general conditions for the disformal form-invariance of the Klein-Gordon equation for the scalar field. In the second-order case, we identified a family of disformally-related metrics that result in the same propagation solutions. Additionally, higher-order cases could comply with theoretical and phenomenological constraints alongside KG-invariance. Finally, we investigated the notion of disformal transformations as ``deformations'' of the spacetime manifold.

classification.title_zh: 高阶导数 disformal 变换下 Klein-Gordon 方程的对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 标量-张量理论通过同时引入标量场和度规张量来描述引力，从而推广了广义相对论（GR）。在 GR 中物质部分与度规最小耦合，但标量场与物质的耦合可通过非共形（disformal）变换来调节。Takahashi、Motohashi 和 Minamitsuji 提出的这类变换中最一般的形式之一，包含标量场的任意高阶导数，旨在映射两个无鬼的高阶标量-张量理论。我们利用这些变换确定了标量场 Klein-Gordon 方程在 disformal 变换下形式不变的最一般条件。在二阶情形下，我们找到了一类 disformal 相关的度规，它们给出相同的传播解。此外，高阶情形也可以在满足 KG 不变性的同时符合理论与现象学约束。最后，我们研究了把 disformal 变换视为时空流形“形变”的概念。
classification.one_liner: 研究高阶导数 disformal 变换下标量场 Klein-Gordon 方程的形式不变性，并讨论其作为时空流形形变的解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/修正引力理论，研究标量-张量理论中的 disformal 变换与 Klein-Gordon 方程对称性，符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或用户列出的其他全息支线。

2609.13394v1.title: Nonlinear Phase Mixing in Einstein-Vlasov System near Schwarzschild Spacetime
2609.13394v1.abstract: We study the Einstein-Vlasov system near the Schwarzschild spacetime in spherical symmetry. In particular, we consider the case when the matter is supported on bounded geodesics. In this regime, the decay of the matter is driven by phase mixing rather than dispersion. For the linearized problem, we obtain quantitative phase mixing; the key new ingredient proved here is a monotonicity property of the period function. For the nonlinear coupled problem, we prove phase mixing up to the timescale expected from the nonlinear echo mechanism; this is achieved by analysis on dynamical action angle variables and the integral estimates with the vector field method. This construction is made possible by our gauge choice, an isotropic coordinate system together with a foliation of prescribed mean curvature, in which the Einstein equations gain derivatives over the matter due to its elliptic nature.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild 时空附近 Einstein-Vlasov 系统的非线性相位混合
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究球对称情形下 Schwarzschild 时空附近的 Einstein-Vlasov 系统。特别地，我们考虑物质被支撑在有界测地线上的情形。在此区域，物质的衰减由相位混合而非色散驱动。对于线性化问题，我们获得定量的相位混合；此处证明的关键新要素是周期函数的单调性。对于非线性耦合问题，我们证明相位混合可维持到非线性回波机制所预期的时标；这是通过动力学作用量-角变量分析以及向量场方法的积分估计实现的。这一构造之所以可行，是因为我们选取了各向同性坐标系并结合指定平均曲率的叶状结构；在该规范下，由于 Einstein 方程的椭圆性质，它们相对于物质项获得导数。
classification.one_liner: 在球对称 Einstein-Vlasov 系统中研究 Schwarzschild 附近的线性与非线性相位混合，属经典广义相对论与黑洞稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于 AdS/CFT/全息研究，但直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，研究 Schwarzschild 附近 Einstein-Vlasov 的经典非线性稳定性。

2609.16126v1.title: On the dynamical accessibility of twin stars
2609.16126v1.abstract: A sufficiently strong hadron-to-quark first-order phase transition can give rise to a third family of stable compact stars that are commonly referred to as hybrid hadron-quark stars. Stable hybrid stars that have the same gravitational mass as neutron stars are referred to as twin stars. Although equilibrium twin stars may exist, whether they can be dynamically formed remains an open question. We investigate this problem by examining the gravitational binding energy of competing equilibrium configurations at fixed baryonic rest mass and by performing general relativistic hydrodynamical simulations of several possible transition channels. While twin stars are more gravitationally bound than neutron stars with the same rest mass, this energetic preference alone does not determine the dynamical outcome. Compression and shocks during the evolution generate thermal pressure that can prevent the system from settling on the cold twin star branch. Our simulations show that sufficiently rapid cooling can remove this thermal support and enable twin star formation, whereas slower or no cooling generally favors a neutron star remnant. Accessing the twin star branch through the formation channels considered here requires cooling on a timescale comparable to or shorter than the stellar dynamical timescale. Since realistic cooling mechanisms operate on much longer timescales, our results suggest that in channels that conserve the total rest-mass neutron stars may be dynamically favored even when a more gravitationally bound twin star configuration exists with the same rest mass. Our results demonstrate a point of principle, at least for equations of state where the quark deconfinement density does not change appreciably for temperatures up to $10-20\,\textrm{MeV}.$

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 论孪生星的动力学可达性
classification.abstract_zh: 足够强的强子到夸克一阶相变可以产生第三族稳定致密星，通常称为混合强子-夸克星。与中子星具有相同引力质量的稳定混合星称为孪生星。尽管平衡态孪生星可能存在，但它们能否动力学形成仍是未决问题。我们通过考察固定重子静止质量下竞争平衡构型的引力束缚能，并对几种可能的转变通道进行广义相对论流体动力学模拟来研究此问题。虽然孪生星比相同静止质量的中子星束缚得更紧，但仅凭这种能量偏好并不能决定动力学结果。演化过程中的压缩和激波会产生热压强，可能阻止系统稳定到冷孪生星支。我们的模拟表明，足够快的冷却可以移除这种热支持并促成孪生星形成，而较慢或无冷却通常有利于中子星残留。通过这里考虑的通道到达孪生星支需要冷却时标与恒星动力学时标相当或更短。由于现实冷却机制在长得多的时标上运行，我们的结果表明，在守恒总静止质量的通道中，即使存在具有相同静止质量的更束缚孪生星构型，中子星也可能在动力学上占优。我们的结果至少对于夸克退禁闭密度在温度高达 10-20 MeV 时没有显著变化的物态方程，展示了一个原理性要点。
classification.one_liner: 广义相对论流体模拟显示，孪生星即使能量上更束缚，也因激波热压需要极快冷却才能动力学形成。
keywords: 广义相对论流体动力学
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要用广义相对论流体动力学研究致密星/中子星的动力学与强子-夸克一阶相变，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息对偶。

2609.16290v1.title: Formation of Merging Black Hole Binaries Inside Massive AGN Stars
2609.16290v1.abstract: Stars embedded in the disks of active galactic nuclei (AGN) can grow to hundreds of solar masses, and the same disks are expected to host a population of stellar-mass black holes. A star may therefore capture passing black holes, turning its interior into a potential factory for forming compact binary black hole systems and, ultimately, for the gravitational-wave events seen by our detectors. We test how readily this channel operates using three-dimensional hydrodynamic simulations of black hole--star encounters. As a proof of principle, we adopt a star-to-black-hole mass ratio of $34\!:\!1$, and find that the capture does not disrupt the structure of the star: it heats the star by $10$--$30\%$, and the star loses only $\lesssim1\%$ of its mass throughout. The captured black hole loses its orbital angular momentum rapidly to dynamical friction, sinking to the stellar center within a stellar dynamical time $\lesssim10^{4}\,$s. If the star already harbors a black hole at its center, the two form a bound binary whose gravitational-wave coalescence time falls below $10^{4}\,$yr. Depending on the geometry and speed of the encounter, the resulting orbit may be nearly circular or retain substantial eccentricity. Our calculations confirm that black hole--star encounters in AGN disks are indeed a viable channel for assembling stellar-mass black hole binaries and supplying sources for gravitational-wave detectors.

classification.title_zh: 大质量活动星系核恒星内部并合黑洞双星的形成
classification.abstract_zh: 嵌在活动星系核（AGN）盘中的恒星可以增长到数百太阳质量，而同一批盘预期也会容纳一批恒星级质量黑洞。因此，一颗恒星可能俘获经过的黑洞，将其内部变成形成致密双黑洞系统、并最终产生我们的探测器所看到的引力波事件的潜在工厂。我们利用黑洞—恒星相遇的三维流体动力学模拟，检验这一通道有多容易运行。作为原理验证，我们采用 34:1 的恒星与黑洞质量比，发现俘获不会破坏恒星结构：它使恒星加热 10–30%，并且恒星在整个过程中仅损失 ≲1% 的质量。被俘获的黑洞通过动力学摩擦迅速失去轨道角动量，在一个恒星动力学时标 ≲10^4 s 内沉入恒星中心。如果恒星中心已经有一个黑洞，两者会形成一个束缚双星，其引力波并合时标降到 10^4 yr 以下。取决于相遇的几何构型和速度，所得轨道可能接近圆形，也可能保留显著偏心率。我们的计算证实，AGN 盘中的黑洞—恒星相遇确实是组装恒星级质量黑洞双星、并为引力波探测器提供源的一个可行通道。
classification.one_liner: 三维模拟显示，AGN盘内大质量恒星可俘获黑洞并形成并合时标短于10^4年的双黑洞，为引力波源提供可行通道。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究AGN盘内黑洞-恒星相遇和双黑洞引力波并合，属于经典引力/天体物理，不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT或量子引力理论。

2609.16891v1.title: Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves by galaxy clusters
2609.16891v1.abstract: Strongly lensed gravitational waves (GWs) are commonly searched for using population priors, including time-delay and magnification-ratio distributions, to suppress false alarms. Current LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA (LVK) searches mainly adopt priors calibrated with galaxy-scale lenses; however, these may penalize the longer time delays produced by galaxy clusters, which could contribute 10%--20% of lensed events. Cluster member galaxies may also perturb the macro-lens potential and alter image magnifications. We investigate the time-delay and magnification-ratio distributions of binary black hole GWs lensed by galaxy clusters, together with microlensing systematics. In the full lensed sample, the median time delay is about 76 days for cluster lenses, compared with 6.9 days for galaxy lenses. After imposing an SNR threshold of $\rho>8$ at LVK O4 sensitivity, the medians are 15.4 and 0.24 days. The detected cluster sample retains a long-delay tail, with 9.1% of image pairs delayed by more than 365 days and 3.3% by more than 1000 days, so galaxy-based time-delay priors can suppress cluster-lensed pairs. By contrast, although cluster member galaxies broaden the magnification-ratio distribution of the full cluster sample, the detected cluster- and galaxy-lensing samples are very similar at O4 sensitivity, suggesting little bias in candidate selection. Cluster lenses also generally produce weak microlensing distortions: only about 0.8% of single-image mismatches exceed ${\cal M}=0.03$, while 4.8% exceed the parameter-estimation threshold $1.35/\rho^2$. Thus, microlensing is subdominant for most cluster-lensed events, mainly because images often form far from the brightest cluster galaxy, where the stellar density is low and dominated by intracluster light, although nearby satellites can locally enhance it. These results motivate a dedicated cluster-lensing pipeline for GW lensing searches.

classification.title_zh: 星系团对引力波的引力透镜效应
classification.abstract_zh: 强透镜引力波通常利用包括时间延迟和放大率分布在内的族群先验来搜索，以抑制误报。当前 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA（LVK）搜索主要采用由星系尺度透镜校准的先验；然而，这些先验可能惩罚星系团产生的更长时间延迟，而星系团可能贡献 10%--20% 的透镜事件。星系团成员星系也可能扰动宏观透镜势并改变像的放大率。我们研究星系团透镜化的双黑洞引力波的时间延迟和放大率分布，以及微透镜系统误差。在完整透镜样本中，星系团透镜的中位时间延迟约为 76 天，而星系透镜为 6.9 天。施加 LVK O4 灵敏度下 ρ>8 的信噪比阈值后，中位数分别为 15.4 天和 0.24 天。探测到的星系团样本保留长延迟尾部，9.1% 的像对延迟超过 365 天，3.3% 超过 1000 天，因此基于星系的延迟先验可能抑制星系团透镜像对。相反，尽管星系团成员星系展宽了完整星系团样本的放大率分布，但在 O4 灵敏度下探测到的星系团和星系透镜样本非常相似，表明候选选择偏差很小。星系团透镜通常产生较弱的微透镜畸变：只有约 0.8% 的单像失配超过 M=0.03，而 4.8% 超过参数估计阈值 1.35/ρ^2。因此，对大多数星系团透镜事件而言，微透镜是次主导的，主要是因为像常形成于远离最亮星系团星系之处，那里恒星密度低且由星系团内光主导，尽管附近卫星星系可以局部增强它。这些结果促使人们为引力波透镜搜索建立专门的星系团透镜管线。
classification.one_liner: 星系团透镜引力波的时间延迟远长于星系透镜，现有基于星系先验会漏掉长延迟事件；微透镜总体次要，因此需要专门的星系团透镜搜索管线。

2603.17669v3.title: Non-Schwarzschild black holes sourced by scalar-vector fields
2603.17669v3.abstract: In this work, we construct a static and spherically symmetric black hole solution sourced by a nonlinear scalar-vector sector within the framework of the Minimal Geometric Deformation (MGD) approach. Starting from a scalar-vector gravity theory in which the vector field is described by nonlinear electrodynamics, the gravitational field equations are integrated to obtain a non-Schwarzschild geometry. We show that the resulting family of solutions naturally splits into two black hole branches with distinct physical properties. While one branch satisfies the odd- and even-parity stability criteria, it violates the weak energy condition outside the event horizon. Conversely, the complementary branch exhibits a more satisfactory effective matter sector, admitting a real scalar-field reconstruction and a regular nonlinear electromagnetic coupling, although it does not satisfy the odd-parity stability criterion. The causal structure and stability properties of both black hole branches are analyzed and compared, whereas the matter reconstruction, geodesic motion and thermodynamic properties are investigated for the branch exhibiting the most satisfactory effective matter sector. These results reveal the rich structure of the MGD solution space and illustrate the interplay between dynamical stability, energy conditions and causal structure.

classification.title_zh: 由标量-矢量场源生的非史瓦西黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们在最小几何形变（MGD）方法框架内，构造了一个由非线性标量-矢量部分作为源的静态球对称黑洞解。从标量-矢量引力理论出发，其中矢量场由非线性电动力学描述，我们积分引力场方程以获得非史瓦西几何。我们表明，所得解族自然分成两个具有不同物理性质的黑洞分支。其中一个分支满足奇宇称和偶宇称稳定性判据，但在事件视界外违反弱能量条件。相反，互补分支表现出更令人满意的有效物质部分，允许实标量场重构和规则的非线性电磁耦合，尽管它不满足奇宇称稳定性判据。我们分析并比较了两个黑洞分支的因果结构和稳定性性质，而对具有最令人满意有效物质部分的分支研究了物质重构、测地线运动和热力学性质。这些结果揭示了MGD解空间的丰富结构，并说明了动力学稳定性、能量条件和因果结构之间的相互作用。
classification.one_liner: 在最小几何形变框架下构建由非线性标量-矢量场源生的非史瓦西黑洞解，并比较两个分支的稳定性、能量条件、因果结构与热力学性质。
classification.relevance_reason: 研究经典/修正引力中的黑洞解及其稳定性、能量条件与热力学，属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；不涉及全息、量子信息或其他重点标签。

2607.20687v4.title: A First-Order Gauge Approach to de Sitter General Relativity
2607.20687v4.abstract: We propose a first-order gauge formulation of de Sitter relativity in which the pseudo-radius l(x) is promoted to a spacetime field, locally breaking SO(4,1) to SO(3,1). Here, l(x) is a geometric compensator and dl(x) the associated order parameter. This modifies the Strong Equivalence Principle: the local vacuum follows the matter distribution instead of remaining fixed, while the propagating degrees of freedom of General Relativity are unchanged. At fixed l(x), the action is SO(3,1)-gauge invariant, but varying l(x) destroys covariance under the full translational sector of SO(4,1). Through the Inonu-Wigner contraction, abstract generators become explicit spacetime transformations, yielding nonlinear Killing vectors in both the macroscopic l tends to infinity and microscopic l tends to 0 limits. The generalized Noether theorem gives a unified energy-momentum current coupling the standard tensor to the proper conformal matter current. It vanishes identically without matter, causing the asymptotic extinction of local vacuum energy and the decay of the background to Minkowski spacetime. Independent variations yield the coupled de Sitter field equations, and we algebraically prove their equivalence to the tensorial splitting on the coordinate manifold. Gauge Bianchi identities further show that Lambda(x) is an intrinsic source of spacetime torsion, consistently identifying it with the local order parameter of the symmetry breaking. The cosmological constant problem is therefore recast, not numerically solved: deriving the decay of Lambda(x) from early-universe densities to its observed value remains future work.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 广义相对论的一阶规范方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 de Sitter 相对论的一阶规范表述，其中伪半径 l(x) 被提升为时空场，从而使 SO(4,1) 局域破缺到 SO(3,1)。这里 l(x) 是几何补偿子，而 dl(x) 是相应的序参量。这修改了强等效原理：局域真空跟随物质分布而非保持固定，但广义相对论的传播自由度不变。在固定 l(x) 时，作用量具有 SO(3,1) 规范不变性，但变化 l(x) 会破坏 SO(4,1) 完整平移部分的协变性。通过 Inonu-Wigner 收缩，抽象生成元变成显式时空变换，在宏观 l→∞ 和微观 l→0 极限下给出非线性 Killing 矢量。广义 Noether 定理给出统一的能量-动量流，将标准张量与适当共形物质流耦合。无物质时它恒为零，导致局域真空能量的渐近消失以及背景衰减到 Minkowski 时空。独立变分给出耦合的 de Sitter 场方程，我们代数地证明它们等价于坐标流形上的张量分解。规范 Bianchi 恒等式进一步表明 Λ(x) 是时空挠率的固有源，并一致地将其等同于对称破缺的局域序参量。因此宇宙学常数问题被重新表述，而非数值求解：从早期宇宙密度推导 Λ(x) 衰减到其观测值仍是未来工作。
classification.one_liner: 将 de Sitter 相对论写成一阶规范理论，把伪半径 l(x) 视为破缺 SO(4,1) 的时空场，并重述宇宙学常数问题。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论与 de Sitter 规范表述，并重述宇宙学常数问题，因而对经典引力支线有中等参考价值；但未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息，对全息主线相关性有限。

2609.03025v2.title: DANSur_HM: Modularly incorporating higher modes in a deep learning based gravitational-wave surrogate
2609.03025v2.abstract: Numerical relativity (NR) simulations provide the most faithful representation of the gravitational waves (GWs) emitted by binary black hole (BBH) systems during merger. In the context of GW astronomy, tasks such as parameter estimation can require vast numbers of waveform evaluations per second across the entire parameter space. Since performing full NR simulations for each evaluation is not computationally feasible, interpolating methods for existing NR waveforms, known as surrogate models, have been developed with marked success. In this paper, we build on our previous work to introduce methods to train a fast surrogate model based on neural networks in order to generate BBH merger waveforms, including the fundamental (2,2) mode, as well as the (3,3), (2,1), (4,4), (3,2), (4,3) and (5,5) higher-order modes. Applying a pretraining step on approximant data before fine-tuning on NR data allows us to smooth out the parameter space, and making use of the parallelization ability of GPUs to project the NR waveforms in the inclination-phase $(\iota, \phi)$ sphere during training allows the fitting of all the explored modes simultaneously. The developed surrogate model, \texttt{DANSur\_HM}, achieves average mismatches of the order of $10^{-4}$, with the worst mismatch at $2.5\times10^{-3}$, and achieves throughput above $6\times10^5$ waveforms/second on an NVIDIA V100 GPU. Parameter estimation tests confirm the usefulness of the inclusion of higher modes.

classification.title_zh: DANSur_HM：在基于深度学习的引力波替代模型中模块化地纳入高阶模式
classification.abstract_zh: 数值相对论（NR）模拟为双黑洞（BBH）系统在并合期间发出的引力波（GWs）提供了最忠实的描述。在引力波天文学中，参数估计等任务需要在整个参数空间每秒进行大量波形评估。由于对每次评估都进行完整 NR 模拟在计算上不可行，因此人们发展了用于插值现有 NR 波形的替代模型，并取得了显著成功。本文在我们之前工作的基础上，引入训练基于神经网络的快速替代模型的方法，以生成 BBH 并合波形，包括基模 (2,2) 以及 (3,3)、(2,1)、(4,4)、(3,2)、(4,3) 和 (5,5) 等高阶模式。在 NR 数据微调之前先对近似模型数据进行预训练，可平滑参数空间；利用 GPU 并行能力在训练期间将 NR 波形投影到倾角-相位 (ι, φ) 球面上，则可同时拟合所有探究的模式。所开发的替代模型 DANSur_HM 达到平均失配约 10^-4，最差失配 2.5×10^-3，并在 NVIDIA V100 GPU 上实现超过 6×10^5 波形/秒的吞吐量。参数估计测试证实了纳入高阶模式的有用性。
classification.one_liner: DANSur_HM 是一个基于神经网络的快速引力波替代模型，可同时生成双黑洞并合波形中的基模与多个高阶模式，并用于参数估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究双黑洞并合引力波数值相对论与快速替代模型，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2606.27658v2.title: Constraint damping on subextremal Kerr spacetimes
2606.27658v2.abstract: In the context of hyperbolic formulations of Einstein's field equations obtained via gauge fixing, constraint damping is a desirable feature that ensures that violations of the gauge condition and thus of the constraint equations are suppressed in evolution. Besides its utility in numerical relativity, it has played a key role in several (linear and nonlinear) stability proofs of spacetimes as solutions of the Einstein equation. In this paper, we show that an enhanced form of constraint damping can be implemented for the linearization of the Einstein equation around any subextremal Kerr black hole metric: the constraint propagation wave operator satisfies mode stability and has an arbitrarily large indicial gap at zero energy. The results proved here are a key ingredient in the author's proof of the nonlinear stability of the subextremal Kerr family.

classification.title_zh: 次极端 Kerr 时空上的约束阻尼
classification.abstract_zh: 在通过规范固定得到的 Einstein 场方程双曲形式中，约束阻尼是一种理想性质，可确保规范条件违反以及约束方程违反在演化中被抑制。除了在数值相对论中的用途外，它在若干时空作为 Einstein 方程解的（线性与非线性）稳定性证明中发挥了关键作用。本文证明，对于任意次极端 Kerr 黑洞度规周围的 Einstein 方程线性化，可以实现一种增强形式的约束阻尼：约束传播波算子满足模态稳定性，并在零能量处具有任意大的 indicial gap。本文证明的结果是作者关于次极端 Kerr 族非线性稳定性证明的关键组成部分。
classification.one_liner: 证明次极端 Kerr 线性化 Einstein 方程可实现增强约束阻尼，为 Kerr 非线性稳定性证明提供关键工具。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与黑洞稳定性研究，直接涉及 Einstein 方程、Kerr 时空和约束阻尼，与用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”高度相关。

2609.16330v1.title: Neutron Star Merger Universality Relations for a Quark--Hadron Crossover Equation of State
2609.16330v1.abstract: A crossover transition from hadronic to quark matter during the merger of neutron stars can lead to interesting observational consequences in the emergent gravitational radiation. In particular, the increased pressure in the crossover density region ($2-5$ times the nuclear saturation density) can lead to an extended duration of high-frequency ($\sim 2-3.5$ kHz) gravitational wave emission during the post-merger epoch. We study the universality relations for a variety of equations of state with and without a crossover transition to a quark mater based upon the QHC19 and QHC21 EoSs. We find that the long-duration post-merger gravitational-wave emission is more pronounced in the QHC21 EoS. We then consider universality relations among various observable quantities that have been identified in simulations with hadronic equations of state. We show that there are deviations from the universality relations for some quantities that may ultimately provide an observational signal that such a transition has occurred.

classification.title_zh: 夸克-强子交叉状态方程的中子星并合普适关系
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星并合期间从强子物质到夸克物质的交叉相变，可能在产生的引力辐射中带来有趣的观测后果。特别地，交叉密度区域（核饱和密度的2-5倍）压强升高，可能导致并合后阶段高频（约2-3.5 kHz）引力波发射持续时间延长。基于QHC19和QHC21状态方程，我们研究了多种含与不含向夸克物质交叉相变的状态方程的普适关系。我们发现，并合后长时标引力波发射在QHC21状态方程中更为显著。随后，我们考察了在强子状态方程模拟中已识别的各种可观测量的普适关系。我们表明，某些量相对于普适关系存在偏离，这可能最终提供此类相变已发生的观测信号。
classification.one_liner: 基于QHC19/QHC21状态方程研究夸克-强子交叉相变对中子星并合后引力波普适关系的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/中子星并合与引力波方向，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线相关；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2608.10083v2.title: Strongly Coupled Soft Functions
2608.10083v2.abstract: The renormalization of operators built out of Wilson lines that meet at an angle (cusp) involve what is known as the cusp anomalous dimension, a universal object appearing in many processes in QCD due to the divergences from gluonic interactions. In this paper, we consider the vacuum expectation value of a pair of cusped Wilson lines separated in the transverse direction. This configuration can be related to a simple observable in heavy quark transverse momentum-dependent (TMD) fragmentation as well as the TMD soft function. We compute the expectation values of Wilson loops in $N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory at strong coupling via the AdS/CFT correspondence, an approach complementary to perturbative calculations of the cusp anomalous dimension. We first present a thorough analysis, directly in Minkowski signature, of the Nambu-Goto action and its saddle points for a Wilson line configuration with a single cusp. We find that there are two different classes of saddle points whose contributions dominate different regions of parameter space. We calculate the cusp anomalous dimension $\Gamma_{\rm cusp}[\Delta\eta, \Delta\theta]$ for the whole range of $\Delta\eta$ from this setup, focusing on the cases $\Delta \theta = 0$ and $\Delta \theta = \pi$, and compare it with previous results in literature. We then use the techniques we developed to compute the expectation value of the two-cusp Wilson loop with transverse separation, and determine the profile of the transverse coordinate on the extremal surface in the large rapidity limit. We discuss the possible generalizations of our setup and results to soft functions in other gauge theories with a holographic dual.

classification.title_zh: 强耦合软函数
classification.abstract_zh: 由在角度（尖点）相交的 Wilson 线构成的算符的重整化涉及所谓的尖点反常维度，这是 QCD 中许多过程中出现的普适对象，源于胶子相互作用的发散。本文考虑在横向方向分离的一对尖点 Wilson 线的真空期望值。该位形可联系到重夸克横向动量依赖 (TMD) 碎裂中的一个简单观测量以及 TMD 软函数。我们通过 AdS/CFT 对应计算 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 理论强耦合下 Wilson 环的期望值，这是对尖点反常维度微扰计算的互补方法。我们首先直接在 Minkowski 签名下对具有单个尖点的 Wilson 线位形的 Nambu-Goto 作用量及其鞍点进行详尽分析。我们发现存在两类不同的鞍点，其贡献在不同参数区域占主导。我们由此设置计算整个 Δη 范围内的尖点反常维度 Γ_cusp[Δη, Δθ]，重点讨论 Δθ=0 和 Δθ=π 的情形，并与文献中先前结果比较。然后我们使用所发展的技巧计算具有横向分离的双尖点 Wilson 环的期望值，并确定大快度极限下极值面上横向坐标的剖面。我们讨论将我们的设置和结果推广到其他具有全息对偶的规范理论中的软函数的可能性。
classification.one_liner: 通过 AdS/CFT 在 N=4 SYM 强耦合下计算尖点 Wilson 环与双尖点 TMD 软函数，分析 Nambu-Goto 鞍点并确定尖点反常维度。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 在全息 QCD/TMD 软函数与尖点反常维度中的应用，但不直接涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子或经典引力等重点支线。

2609.16080v1.title: Bayesian Inferences on Analytical Equations of State Approximations of Neutron Stars
2609.16080v1.abstract: Equations of state (EoS) for dense matter are commonly provided in tabulated pressure-energy density relations, complicating numerical implementation and potentially compromising thermodynamic consistency. In this work, we propose a universal, piecewise-continuous functional form with a common parametrization capable of representing a broad class of dense matter EoSs. We validate this parametrization against tabulated EoSs from the CompOSE and LALSimulation repositories. Following the initial deterministic fitting, we employed two distinct Bayesian approaches: one based on synthetic EoSs generated by adding noise to the fitted EoS and another based on multimessenger measurements of neutron-star masses and tidal deformabilities. In both approaches, the initial best-fit parameters are used as reference values. For the considered EoSs, spanning from very soft to very stiff, the resulting fits reproduce the defined tabulated EoSs and the associated macroscopic neutron-star observables in the repositories with sufficient degree of accuracy. The inferred parameters exhibit strong correlations arising from the continuity conditions imposed at the segment boundaries. These correlations persist in the low- and intermediate-density segments under multimessenger inference but become weak in the core, reflecting the limited constraining power of current observations at high densities. The ability of a single functional form to describe EoSs derived from different microscopic frameworks, together with the recurrence of similar parameter correlations, suggests that diverse dense matter EoSs may share a common underlying structure.

classification.title_zh: 中子星解析状态方程近似的贝叶斯推断
classification.abstract_zh: 致密物质的状态方程（EoS）通常以表格形式的压力-能量密度关系给出，这使数值实现复杂化，并可能损害热力学一致性。本工作提出一种通用的分段连续函数形式，具有统一参数化，能够表示广泛类别的致密物质EoS。我们对照 CompOSE 和 LALSimulation 数据库中的表格EoS验证该参数化。在初始确定性拟合之后，我们采用两种不同的贝叶斯方法：一种基于向拟合EoS添加噪声生成的合成EoS，另一种基于中子星质量和潮汐形变性的多信使测量。两种方法中，初始最佳拟合参数被用作参考值。对于所考虑的从很软到很硬的EoS，所得拟合以足够精度再现了数据库中的既定表格EoS及相关的宏观中子星可观测量。推断出的参数表现出由分段边界处连续性条件引起的强相关性。这些相关性在多信使推断下在低密度和中密度分段中持续存在，但在核心处变弱，反映出当前观测在高密度区约束能力有限。单一函数形式能够描述源自不同微观框架的EoS，再加上相似参数相关性的反复出现，表明多种致密物质EoS可能共享共同底层结构。
classification.one_liner: 提出并贝叶斯验证一种统一的致密物质状态方程分段连续解析参数化，用于拟合中子星表格EoS及多信使观测。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究中子星状态方程与多信使潮汐形变约束，属于致密星/经典引力相关方向，但不涉及全息、量子引力或所列多数全息重点标签。

2604.24949v2.title: A Physics Informed Bayesian Neural Network for the Neutron Star Equation of State
2604.24949v2.abstract: We present a physics-informed Bayesian neural-network framework for inferring neutron-star equations of state from theoretical priors and propagating the resulting uncertainty to stellar observables. Trained on a representative set of hadronic EoSs, the model learns the equation of state through stochastic variational inference by representing the squared speed of sound with a bounded network output and obtaining the pressure by integration, so that causality, thermodynamic stability, and monotonicity are guaranteed by construction, with low-density nuclear and perturbative-QCD normalization anchors. Core EoSs are matched to an SLy4 crust and propagated through a unified Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff-plus-tidal solver to obtain posterior predictions in the mass-radius ($M$-$R$) and mass-tidal-deformability ($M$-$\Lambda$) planes. The physics-informed prior is then updated with current multi-messenger data: NICER radius measurements, the GW170817 tidal-deformability constraint, and the $2\,M_\odot$ maximum-mass bound; included directly in the variational objective. The observational update moves the canonical radius from $R_{1.4}=13.41\,\mathrm{km}$ in the prior to $R_{1.4}=12.74^{+0.97}_{-0.73}\,\mathrm{km}$ (nominal 90\% variational CI), with $\Lambda_{1.4}=428^{+249}_{-130}$ and $M_{\mathrm{max}}\gtrsim 2.0\,M_\odot$. This framework provides a non-parametric route from microphysical EoS uncertainty to neutron-star observables.

classification.title_zh: 用于中子星状态方程的物理信息贝叶斯神经网络
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个物理信息贝叶斯神经网络框架，用于从理论先验推断中子星状态方程，并将由此产生的不确定性传播到恒星可观测量。模型在一组代表性的强子状态方程上训练，通过随机变分推断学习状态方程：以有界网络输出表示声速平方，并通过积分获得压强，从而由构造保证因果性、热力学稳定性和单调性，同时使用低密度核物理和微扰QCD归一化锚点。核心状态方程匹配到SLy4壳层，并通过统一的Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff加潮汐求解器传播，以获得质量-半径（$M$-$R$）和质量-潮汐形变（$M$-$\Lambda$）平面上的后验预测。随后用当前多信使数据更新物理信息先验：NICER半径测量、GW170817潮汐形变约束以及$2\,M_\odot$最大质量下限；这些直接包含在变分目标中。观测更新将标准半径从先验中的$R_{1.4}=13.41\,\mathrm{km}$移动到$R_{1.4}=12.74^{+0.97}_{-0.73}\,\mathrm{km}$（标称90%变分置信区间），并给出$\Lambda_{1.4}=428^{+249}_{-130}$和$M_{\mathrm{max}}\gtrsim 2.0\,M_\odot$。该框架提供了从微观物理状态方程不确定性到中子星可观测量的非参数路径。
classification.one_liner: 用物理信息贝叶斯神经网络推断中子星状态方程，并用多信使数据更新质量-半径与潮汐形变预测。
classification.relevance_reason: 不涉及全息对偶，但属于经典引力/中子星状态方程与多信使观测方向，使用TOV方程和潮汐求解器。

2609.17656v1.title: The Kerr/CFT energy gap
2609.17656v1.abstract: Noether charges in gravity are always defined with respect to a reference metric, but the near-horizon extremal Kerr (NHEK) solution does not come with an obvious choice of reference metric (it is not asymptotically flat, for example). We discuss a one parameter generalization of the NHEK solution due to Kinnersley and Kelley which interpolates between NHEK and an analytically continued version of Minkowski spacetime. We use this interpolating family of solutions to compute the conformal energy of NHEK above the Minkowski reference metric. We find an interesting order of limits issue when computing the conformal energy of the Minkowski vacuum and we discuss a few natural prescriptions for fixing it, including one motivated by the Kerr/CFT correspondence.

classification.title_zh: Kerr/CFT 能隙
classification.abstract_zh: 引力中的诺特荷总是相对于一个参考度规定义，但近视界极端克尔（NHEK）解并没有显然的参考度规选择（例如它不是渐近平坦的）。我们讨论由 Kinnersley 和 Kelley 给出的 NHEK 解的单参数推广，它在 NHEK 与闵可夫斯基时空的一个解析延拓版本之间插值。我们利用这个插值解族计算 NHEK 相对于闵可夫斯基参考度规的共形能量。在计算闵可夫斯基真空的共形能量时，我们发现了一个有趣的极限顺序问题，并讨论了几种自然的修正方案，其中包括一个受 Kerr/CFT 对应启发的方案。
classification.one_liner: 利用 Kinnersley-Kelley 插值解族计算 NHEK 相对解析延拓 Minkowski 参考的共形能量，并讨论 Kerr/CFT 相关的极限顺序修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签，并涉及黑洞全息的 Kerr/CFT；但未涉及用户列出的全息凝聚态、超流超导等更具体支线。

2609.17666v1.title: Representation Theory of Three-dimensional Corner Symmetries
2609.17666v1.abstract: We study the representation theory of the three-dimensional extended corner symmetry group associated with a circular corner. Using induced representation techniques, we construct families of representations of the infinite-dimensional corner symmetry group and analyze their unitarity and irreducibility. We also determine the maximal central extension of the symmetry group and construct the corresponding projective representations. The analysis is motivated by the role that corner symmetries play in quantum gravity, where boundary degrees of freedom --- acted upon by the corner transformations --- are expected to encode aspects of the quantum structure of spacetime. In three dimensions, the representation-theoretic structures that emerge are closely related to symmetry groups and quantum theories that already appeared as central to the study of gravity. This work provides a first step toward a systematic description of quantum gravitational corner degrees of freedom in three dimensions.

classification.title_zh: 三维角对称性的表示论
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究与圆形角相关的三维扩展角对称群的表示论。利用诱导表示技术，我们构造了无限维角对称群的若干族表示，并分析其酉性与不可约性。我们还确定了该对称群的最大中心扩张，并构造相应的投影表示。该分析的动机来自角对称性在量子引力中的作用：受角变换作用的边界自由度被期望编码时空量子结构的某些方面。在三维中，所出现的表示论结构与已在引力研究中占据中心地位的对称群和量子理论密切相关。这项工作为系统描述三维量子引力角自由度迈出了第一步。
classification.one_liner: 研究三维圆形角处扩展角对称群的表示论，包括诱导表示、酉性、不可约性、最大中心扩张与投影表示，并联系量子引力中的边界自由度。

2609.17669v1.title: Full Eigenstate Thermalization in Quantum Field Theory: Free Cumulants and Gravitational Scrambling
2609.17669v1.abstract: Using thermal analyticity, we derive directional large-frequency bounds on the smooth functions entering full eigenstate thermalization in continuum quantum field theory. The strongest directions reproduce the scales previously identified for lattice systems, while the complete analyticity domain reveals a broader asymmetric multifrequency structure. In thermal two-dimensional conformal field theory, exact two- and three-point functions saturate the corresponding bounds. At fourth order, where genuine dynamical information first appears, we show that the holographic CFTs studied here saturate the strongest full-ETH bounds. These results establish a direct connection between full ETH, free cumulants, and gravitational scrambling, and are consistent with the emergence of asymptotic freeness realized by the gravitational scrambling algebra.

classification.title_zh: 量子场论中的完整本征态热化：自由累积量与引力扰乱
classification.abstract_zh: 利用热解析性，我们推导了连续量子场论中进入完整本征态热化的光滑函数的方向性大频率界。最强方向重现了此前为格点系统识别出的尺度，而完整解析性区域揭示了更广的非对称多频率结构。在热二维共形场论中，精确的两点和三点函数饱和相应的界。在四阶，真正动力学信息首次出现，我们表明这里研究的全息 CFT 饱和最强的完整 ETH 界。这些结果建立了完整 ETH、自由累积量与引力扰乱之间的直接联系，并与由引力扰乱代数实现的渐近自由性的出现一致。
classification.one_liner: 用热解析性导出连续 QFT 中 full ETH 的多频率界，并证明全息 CFT 在四阶饱和最强界，连接自由累积量与引力扰乱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 CFT 中的热化、混沌/扰乱与量子信息主题，与用户关注的理论全息研究相关；但不直接匹配所列重点标签（如全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力）。

2609.18028v1.title: Central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes
2609.18028v1.abstract: The Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, proportional to one quarter of the horizon area, is fundamental in black hole thermodynamics and can also be understood via the AdS/CFT correspondence, such as the 3D BTZ black hole and 2D CFT. In this work, we adopt the Kerr/CFT approach to analyze the central charge and black hole entropy for regular extremal black-bounce spacetimes, including the counterparts of the Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes. These spacetimes are free of curvature singularities at $r=0$. We derive the near horizon geometries of these spacetimes and find that they exhibit enhanced symmetry, namely SL$(2,\mathbb{R})\times \mathrm{U}(1)$ or SL$(2,\mathbb{R}) \times \mathrm{SO}(3)$. By imposing appropriate boundary conditions, we analyze their asymptotic symmetry groups, which contain diffeomorphisms as well as the $\mathrm{U}(1)_{\rm gauge}$ symmetry arising from the electromagnetic field. We then extract the central charge from the charge algebra and evaluate the left-moving temperature of the Frolov-Thorne vacuum. It is worth emphasizing that in the black-bounce Kerr-Newman case, the central charge from the electromagnetic contribution vanishes. Furthermore, in the black-bounce Reissner-Nordstr\"om case, we uplift the 4D geometry to a 5D configuration by incorporating a $\mathrm{U}(1)$ gauge fiber. Our results show that the microscopic entropy calculated from the Cardy formula is consistent with the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy. This agreement suggests that the Kerr/CFT approach remains valid for certain regular spacetimes without curvature singularities, thereby providing a microscopic statistical understanding of black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷和黑洞熵
classification.abstract_zh: Bekenstein-Hawking 熵与视界面积的四分之一成正比，是黑洞热力学的基本内容，也可通过 AdS/CFT 对应（如三维 BTZ 黑洞与二维 CFT）理解。本文采用 Kerr/CFT 方法分析正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷和黑洞熵，包括 Kerr、Kerr-Newman 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞的对应体。这些时空在 r=0 处没有曲率奇点。我们推导这些时空的近视界几何，发现它们具有增强对称性，即 SL(2,R)×U(1) 或 SL(2,R)×SO(3)。通过施加适当边界条件，我们分析其渐近对称群，其中包含微分同胚以及电磁场产生的 U(1)_gauge 对称性。随后从荷代数提取中心荷，并计算 Frolov-Thorne 真空的左手温度。需要强调，在黑洞反弹 Kerr-Newman 情形中，电磁贡献的中心荷消失。此外，在黑洞反弹 Reissner-Nordström 情形中，我们通过引入 U(1) 规范纤维将四维几何提升为五维构型。结果表明，由 Cardy 公式计算的微观熵与 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵一致。这种一致表明 Kerr/CFT 方法对某些无曲率奇点的正则时空仍然有效，从而为黑洞熵提供了微观统计理解。
classification.one_liner: 用 Kerr/CFT 方法计算正则极端黑洞反弹时空的中心荷，并由 Cardy 公式重现 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵。
classification.relevance_reason: 与黑洞熵、Kerr/CFT 和经典引力相关，但不属于所列重点标签中的全息超流超导、相变成核、QNM、冷原子等具体支线。

2609.18225v1.title: Growing Einstein-Rosen Bridge with Multi-partite Entanglement
2609.18225v1.abstract: Can quantum entanglement continue to grow even after the entanglement entropies of subsystems have saturated? We address this question using genuine multi-entropy, which probes multi-partite entanglement structure beyond bipartite entanglement. In a two-sided BTZ black hole, this quantity grows linearly with time after every subsystem entropy of a fixed tripartition has saturated, extending the interval in which entanglement detects Einstein-Rosen bridge growth. The result refines the ER=EPR relation by identifying multi-partite structure invisible to ordinary entanglement entropies. Some spin-chain models and the spatially partitioned Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model exhibit distinct transients, while the late-time plateau values in holography, the SYK model, and Haar-random states share a universal behaviour.

classification.title_zh: 多分体纠缠下增长的 Einstein-Rosen 桥
classification.abstract_zh: 量子纠缠能否在子系统的纠缠熵饱和之后继续增长？我们使用真正的多熵（genuine multi-entropy）来探讨这一问题，该量探测超出二分纠缠的多分体纠缠结构。在双边 BTZ 黑洞中，该量在一个固定三分划的每个子系统熵都饱和后随时间线性增长，扩展了纠缠能够探测 Einstein-Rosen 桥增长的区间。该结果通过识别普通纠缠熵不可见的多分体结构，细化了 ER=EPR 关系。一些自旋链模型和空间分割的 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型表现出不同的瞬态行为，而全息、SYK 模型和 Haar 随机态中的晚期平台值具有普遍行为。
classification.one_liner: 双边 BTZ 中，子系统纠缠熵饱和后真正的多熵仍线性增长，表明多分体纠缠可继续探测 ER 桥增长，并细化 ER=EPR。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究全息多体纠缠与 ER=EPR，涉及 BTZ 和 SYK，不属于用户列出的重点标签（全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC/凝聚态实验启发、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）中的具体支线。

2609.18295v1.title: Turbulent gravitational waves
2609.18295v1.abstract: We construct turbulent gravitational wakes in asymptotically AdS$_4$ spacetimes by solving the full non-linear Einstein equations in the characteristic formulation. Specifically, we show that a localized boundary deformation acting on a boosted black brane generates a wake whose boundary dynamics exhibit the formation of coherent vortical structures that are advected downstream by the background flow. Analysing a wake propagating along the x direction, we show that it displays the characteristic self-similar scaling of classical turbulent wakes. We then identify the geometric imprint of the wake on the horizon area density, the traceless horizon extrinsic curvature, and bulk metric perturbations, finding coherent structures that extend from the asymptotic boundary to the horizon. These results provide the first study of turbulent gravitational wakes in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 湍流引力波
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过在特征表述下求解完全非线性 Einstein 方程，在渐近 AdS$_4$ 时空中构造了湍流引力尾迹。具体而言，我们表明作用在 boosted 黑膜上的局域边界形变会产生一个尾迹，其边界动力学表现出相干涡旋结构的形成，并被背景流向下游平流输送。通过分析沿 x 方向传播的尾迹，我们表明它显示出经典湍流尾迹的特征自相似标度。随后，我们在视界面积密度、无迹视界外曲率以及体度规微扰中识别出该尾迹的几何印记，发现从渐近边界延伸到视界的相干结构。这些结果首次研究了四维渐近 AdS 时空中的湍流引力尾迹。
classification.one_liner: 在渐近 AdS4 中求解完全非线性 Einstein 方程构造湍流引力尾迹，发现经典湍流自相似标度、相干涡旋结构与延伸到视界的几何印记。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究全息框架下的非线性 Einstein 方程与湍流引力尾迹，属于非平衡/流体动力学与经典引力的交叉，包含涡旋结构、自相似标度与视界几何，匹配 QNM 与非线性演化、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

2609.18528v1.title: Schwinger stability of T-duality-inspired extremal black holes
2609.18528v1.abstract: We study the near-horizon charged-scalar instability associated with Schwinger pair production in the charged regular black hole geometry of the zero-point-length T-duality prescription. Using the same effective geometry and regularized gauge potential, we construct the extremal branch, its ${\rm AdS}_2 \times S^2$ near-horizon throat, and the charged-scalar instability threshold for a general form factor. For the explicit T-duality form factor the extremal branch terminates at $r_\mathrm{ext} = \sqrt2 \, l_0$, where the extremal charge and the near-horizon electric field vanish while the ${\rm AdS}_2$ radius remains finite at $\sqrt3 \, l_0$. At this endpoint the exact near-horizon instability parameter is negative. In the semiclassical regime the corresponding charge-to-mass threshold diverges as the endpoint is approached. Thus, for each fixed massive species with finite $q/m$, a sufficiently near-endpoint portion of the extremal branch is free of the local charged-scalar instability. For comparison, the Ay\'on-Beato-Garc\'ia (ABG) Einstein-nonlinear-electrodynamics solution has a nonvanishing extremal near-horizon electric field. For an additional minimally coupled charged-scalar probe, the corresponding local Schwinger threshold remains finite. Thus the divergent near-endpoint Schwinger barrier found in the T-duality branch is not a generic consequence of regularity.

classification.title_zh: T-对偶启发的极端黑洞的 Schwinger 稳定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究与 Schwinger 对产生相关的近视界带电标量不稳定性，对象是零点长度 T-对偶方案中的带电正则黑洞几何。使用相同的有效几何和正则化规范势，我们构造了极端分支、其 AdS2 × S2 近视界喉区，以及对于一般形式因子的带电标量不稳定性阈值。对于显式的 T-对偶形式因子，极端分支终止于 r_ext = √2 l0，此时极端电荷和近视界电场消失，而 AdS2 半径保持有限为 √3 l0。在此端点，精确的近视界不稳定性参数为负。在半经典区域，相应的荷质比阈值在接近端点时发散。因此，对于每个固定的有限 q/m 的大质量粒子种类，极端分支中足够接近端点的部分没有局域带电标量不稳定性。作为比较，Ayón-Beato-García (ABG) Einstein-非线性电动力学解具有非零的极端近视界电场。对于额外的最小耦合带电标量探针，相应的局域 Schwinger 阈值保持有限。因此，在 T-对偶分支中发现的发散的近端点 Schwinger 势垒并不是规则性的普遍结果。
classification.one_liner: 在 T-对偶启发的正则极端黑洞中，近视界带电标量 Schwinger 不稳定性阈值在极端分支端点附近发散，而 ABG 解保持有限，表明该发散并非规则性必然结果。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典正则极端黑洞的近视界几何与带电标量 Schwinger 不稳定性，并比较非线性电动力学黑洞，属于用户重点的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但未使用 AdS/CFT 对偶或量子信息框架。

2609.18566v1.title: Deep learning emergent spacetime from fermionic spectral functions in holography
2609.18566v1.abstract: We present a physics-informed machine learning framework based on Neural Ordinary Differential Equations that solves the holographic inverse problem: reconstructing the bulk spacetime and gauge field of a charged AdS black hole directly from boundary fermionic spectral functions. Encoding the UV asymptotics, horizon regularity, and zero temperature extremality as hard constraints in the neural network architecture, our framework reliably reconstructs the extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om AdS geometry across three quantum critical regimes set by the $U(1)$ probe charge---non-Fermi liquid, marginal Fermi liquid (strange metal), and Fermi-liquid-like states---and can jointly infer the probe charge itself to sub-percent accuracy. Relaxing the near-AdS boundary constraint uncovers a geometrical degeneracy: bulk profiles that differ throughout the radial direction but share the same near-horizon $AdS_2 \times \mathbb{R}^2$ data reproduce identical spectral functions near the Fermi surface. This isospectral non-uniqueness is precisely the bulk degeneracy expected on general holographic grounds at zero temperature, and its spontaneous emergence across independent training runs shows that the network isolates the IR CFT universality rather than overfitting a single UV completion.

classification.title_zh: 全息中从费米子谱函数深度学习涌现时空
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个基于神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）的物理信息机器学习框架，用于求解全息逆问题：直接从边界费米子谱函数重构带电 AdS 黑洞的体时空与规范场。我们将紫外渐近、视界正则性和零温极端性作为硬约束编码进神经网络架构；该框架可靠地重构了极端 Reissner-Nordström AdS 几何，并覆盖由 U(1) 探针电荷设定的三个量子临界区——非费米液体、边际费米液体（奇异金属）和类费米液体态——且能同时推断探针电荷，精度达到亚百分比。放松近 AdS 边界约束后，我们揭示了几何简并：在径向方向上处处不同、但共享相同近视界 AdS2×R^2 数据的体剖面对费米面附近的谱函数给出相同结果。这种等谱非唯一性正是零温下一般全息论证所预期的体简并；它跨独立训练运行自发出现，表明网络分离出了红外 CFT 普适性，而不是过拟合单一紫外完成。
classification.one_liner: 用神经常微分方程从边界费米子谱函数反演带电 AdS 黑洞体时空，并发现零温近视界 AdS2 数据导致的等谱体简并。

2609.18944v1.title: Reading Topological Hair from Black-Hole Entanglement
2609.18944v1.abstract:
Black-hole hair can affect boundary mixed-state entanglement through local stress-energy and through topological information invisible to the classical metric. We separate these channels for a Nielsen--Olesen vortex on a nonrotating BTZ black hole. A superselection theorem shows that Shannon sector entropy cancels from the Markov gap, while standard $U(1)$ symmetry-resolved reflected entropy in a thermal $U(1)_k$ CFT is equipartitioned at leading order, excluding a universal $\log|n|$ term in the imbalance-resolved gap. We therefore define a Wilson-threaded reflected moment in a probe $U(1)_k$ Chern--Simons completion coupled to the compact vortex-flux class. In a reflected-replica sector with linking number $
u$, its normalised phase is $2\pi\kappa pn
u/k$, where $\kappa\in\mathbb Z$ is the mixed topological coupling; for $\gcd(\kappa
u,k)=1$, a discrete Fourier transform reconstructs $n mod k$. The RT connectivity transition switches the specified linked contour on or off, whereas the independent scale $\ell_\star r_+/L^2=1.128378\ldots$ determines the direction of the vortex-induced shift of that transition. The charged-moment modulus and the ordinary Markov gap remain geometric observables and are computed from a horizon-anchored Einstein-Abelian-Higgs solution with a complete first-variation kernel including the motion of the entanglement-wedge cross-section endpoints. This phase and modulus separation distinguishes topological hair from gravitational dressing without assigning an unsupported winding-dependent entropy.

classification.title_zh: 从黑洞纠缠读取拓扑毛
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞毛可以通过局域应力能量以及经典度规不可见的拓扑信息影响边界混合态纠缠。我们针对非旋转 BTZ 黑洞上的 Nielsen-Olesen 涡旋分离这些通道。一个超选择定理表明 Shannon 扇区熵从 Markov gap 中相消，而热 U(1)_k CFT 中的标准 U(1) 对称分辨反射熵在领头阶是均分的，排除了非平衡分辨 gap 中普适的 log|n| 项。因此我们定义 Wilson 穿线反射矩，在探针 U(1)_k Chern-Simons 完成中与紧致涡旋磁通类耦合。在链接数 ν 的反射副本扇区中，其归一化相位为 2πκpnν/k，其中 κ∈Z 是混合拓扑耦合；对于 gcd(κν,k)=1，离散 Fourier 变换重构 n mod k。RT 连通性转变开启或关闭指定的链接围道，而独立标度 ℓ⋆ r_+/L^2=1.128378... 决定涡旋诱导的该转变移动方向。带电矩模量与普通 Markov gap 仍是几何可观测量，并由锚定于视界的 Einstein-Abelian-Higgs 解计算，包含完整的一阶变分核，包括纠缠楔截面端点的运动。这种相位与模量分离将拓扑毛与引力 dressing 区分开，而不赋予不支持的绕数依赖熵。
classification.one_liner: 在非旋转 BTZ 黑洞的 Nielsen-Olesen 涡旋背景中，用反射熵/Markov gap 与 Wilson 穿线反射矩的相位-模量分离来区分拓扑毛与引力 dressing。
classification.relevance_reason: 与用户关注的畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀方向相关，且涉及全息纠缠与黑洞信息；但核心不是全息超流超导、多分量序参量或经典引力主线，因此相关性中等。

2609.19075v1.title: When duality changes the poles: $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ transformations of linear response EFTs
2609.19075v1.abstract: We study how $SL(2,\mathbb Z)$ transformations act on pole-truncated linear-response effective theories in $(2+1)$ dimensions. For correlators meromorphic within a finite low-frequency domain, the EFT data include both derivative-expanded transport coefficients and the retained non-hydrodynamic poles. Since the $S$-trans\-for\-mation inverts the optical conductivity and exchanges its poles and zeros, it does not necessarily commute with the infrared truncation. We derive explicit maps for static susceptibilities, the Einstein relation and AC transport coefficients. In the purely hydrodynamic sector the map closes on the original transport data, while in quasihydrodynamic regimes the transformed pole positions and, in general, residues constitute additional infrared data. We test the construction in the alternatively quantised D3/D5 probe-brane system, where an EFT retaining one original gapped pole can correspond to transformed EFTs retaining zero, one or two. The holographic results verify the analytic maps and exhibit an inverse-Drude conductivity at large values of the control parameter.

classification.title_zh: 当对偶改变极点：线性响应 EFT 的 SL(2,Z) 变换
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 SL(2,Z) 变换如何作用于 (2+1) 维中极点截断的线性响应有效理论。对于在有限低频区域内亚纯的关联函数，EFT 数据既包括导数展开的输运系数，也包括保留的非流体力学校点。由于 S 变换反转光学电导率并交换其极点和零点，它不一定与红外截断对易。我们推导了静态磁化率、爱因斯坦关系和 AC 输运系数的显式映射。在纯流体力学区域，映射闭合于原始输运数据；而在准流体力学区域，变换后的极点位置以及一般情况下的留数构成额外的红外数据。我们在交替量子化的 D3/D5 探针膜系统中检验该构造，其中保留一个原始有能隙极点的 EFT 可以对应于保留零个、一个或两个极点的变换后 EFT。全息结果验证了解析映射，并在控制参数大时表现出逆德鲁德电导率。
classification.one_liner: 研究 SL(2,Z) 对偶如何改变 (2+1) 维线性响应 EFT 的极点截断，并在 D3/D5 探针膜中验证输运映射。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶框架，研究线性响应 EFT 的 SL(2,Z) 对偶变换，并在 D3/D5 探针膜中检验，与全息输运及 D3-D5 探针膜重点标签高度相关；经典引力不是主线。

2609.17582v1.title: Noether and Mei symmetries in static spherically symmetric quadratic gravity: variational consistency, constraints, and conserved curvature flux
2609.17582v1.abstract: The symmetry content of static spherical $f(R)$ gravity is reconsidered for the pure quadratic model. We first derive the radial action without prematurely eliminating the equation carried by the radial metric variable. The Schwarzschild-type gauge may then be imposed while retaining its associated gravitational constraint. For the resulting system, radial translations and one combined scaling are exact off-shell Noether symmetries. The scaling charge reduces, on the constraint surface, to a conserved radial flux of the scalar curvature. The same flux follows independently from the trace of the four-dimensional field equations. Noether invariance, the strong point-Mei criterion, and Lie invariance of the Euler--Lagrange system are examined separately. Within the full polynomial point ansatz of total degree at most two, the Lie algebra contains precisely three independent generators. The flux also separates the solution space into a nonzero constant-curvature Einstein sector, a degenerate scalar-flat sector, and a dynamical-curvature sector. In particular, the scalar-flat sector permits a Reissner--Nordstr\"om-form metric, although its inverse-square coefficient has no electromagnetic meaning in the absence of a Maxwell field.

classification.title_zh: 静态球对称二次引力中的 Noether 与 Mei 对称性：变分一致性、约束与守恒曲率通量
classification.abstract_zh: 重新考虑静态球对称 f(R) 引力在纯二次模型中的对称性内容。我们首先在不预先消去径向度规变量所满足方程的情况下导出径向作用量。随后可以施加 Schwarzschild 型规范，同时保留其关联的引力约束。对于所得系统，径向平移与一个组合标度变换是精确的离壳 Noether 对称性。该标度荷在约束面上约化为标量曲率的守恒径向通量。同一通量也可独立地从四维场方程的迹得到。分别考察 Noether 不变性、强点 Mei 判据以及 Euler-Lagrange 系统的 Lie 不变性。在总次数至多二的完整多项式点拟设内，Lie 代数恰好包含三个独立生成元。该通量还将解空间分为非零常曲率 Einstein 扇区、退化的标量平坦扇区和动力学曲率扇区。特别地，标量平坦扇区允许 Reissner-Nordström 形式的度规，尽管在没有 Maxwell 场时其平方反比系数没有电磁意义。
classification.one_liner: 在静态球对称纯二次 f(R) 引力中，通过保持径向约束的变分分析识别出精确 Noether 对称性、守恒曲率通量及三类解扇区。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究静态球对称二次 f(R) 引力的变分、约束、对称性与守恒量，属于用户明确列出的经典引力/广义相对论支线，而非全息研究。

2609.17588v1.title: First-Law Entropy and a Degenerate Extremal Remnant in a Minimal-Length Simpson--Visser-Type Regular Black Hole: Geometrothermodynamics, Phase Structure, and Observational Discriminants
2609.17588v1.abstract: We construct the first-law-consistent entropy of a geometrically minimal-length-deformed Schwarzschild spacetime, obtained via the areal-radius substitution $R(r)=\sqrt{r^{2}+\ell^{2}}$ on $r\in[0,+\infty)$ with $f(R)=1-2M/R$, whose nonvanishing Einstein tensor sources an effective geometric fluid with no classical matter counterpart. Integrating the first law gives $S=\pi[r_{h}R_{h}+\ell^{2}\ln((r_{h}+R_{h})/\ell)]$. This coincides in functional form with the semiclassical term found independently by Joshi and Joshi, but we fix its boundary condition $S(r_h=0)=0$ on independent physical grounds and adopt it, rather than the Bekenstein--Hawking area law, as the complete entropy of the model, building the free energy, geometrothermodynamics, and mode-stability analysis on it. Evaporation, governed by the Helmholtz free energy $F(M)$, terminates at $M_{\min}=\ell/2$ in a previously unrecognised endpoint: a degenerate extremal regular black hole, where the regular centre coincides with a degenerate Killing horizon of quadratic order, $f\approx r^{2}/(2\ell^{2})$, at areal radius $\ell$, with $T_{H}\to 0$, $S\to 0$, $C\to 0^{+}$, and finite curvature everywhere; we display its Penrose--Carter structure for the first time. The same entropy, with $\ell$, defines the equilibrium state space of a Legendre-invariant geometrothermodynamic (GTD) description whose curvature scalar diverges independently at the Davies-type transition $M^{*}=\ell/\sqrt{2}$ and at $M_{\min}$, a divergence with no counterpart in the minimal-length black hole literature, specific to a genuine horizon at $S=0$. We embed this remnant within the observational discriminant noted qualitatively by Tsukamoto: exact shadow degeneracy combined with a measurable photon-ring flux enhancement $r_{n}=e^{-2\pi/a}>e^{-2\pi}$, accessible to next-generation very-long-baseline interferometry.
