classification.title_zh: 最小长度 Simpson--Visser 型正则黑洞中的第一定律熵与退化极端遗迹：几何热力学、相结构与观测判别
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过面积半径替换 R(r)=√(r^2+ℓ^2)（r∈[0,+∞)）并在 f(R)=1-2M/R 下，构造了一个几何最小长度变形 Schwarzschild 时空的第一定律一致熵；其非零 Einstein 张量作为有效几何流体源，没有经典物质对应。积分第一定律给出 S=π[r_h R_h+ℓ^2 ln((r_h+R_h)/ℓ)]。该式在函数形式上与 Joshi 和 Joshi 独立得到的半经典项一致，但我们基于独立物理理由固定边界条件 S(r_h=0)=0，并采用它而非 Bekenstein--Hawking 面积律作为模型的完整熵，在此基础上构建自由能、几何热力学和模式稳定性分析。由 Helmholtz 自由能 F(M) 支配的蒸发终止于 M_min=ℓ/2，出现此前未认识的端点：一个退化极端正则黑洞，其中正则中心与二次阶退化 Killing 视界重合，f≈r^2/(2ℓ^2)，面积半径为 ℓ，且 T_H→0、S→0、C→0^+，曲率处处有限；我们首次展示其 Penrose--Carter 结构。同一熵（含 ℓ）定义了 Legendre 不变的几何热力学 (GTD) 描述的平衡态空间，其曲率标量在 Davies 型转变 M^*=ℓ/√2 与 M_min 处独立发散；这一发散在最小长度黑洞文献中没有对应，是 S=0 处真实视界特有的。我们将该遗迹嵌入 Tsukamoto 定性指出的观测判别：精确阴影退化与可测量的光子环通量增强 r_n=e^{-2π/a}>e^{-2π}，下一代甚长基线干涉测量可及。
classification.one_liner: 在最小长度正则 Schwarzschild 黑洞中基于第一定律熵发现退化极端遗迹，并分析其几何热力学、相结构与观测判别。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究修正/正则黑洞的经典时空、热力学与相结构，直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.17727v1.title: Scalar quasinormal and quasibound states of weakly magnetized Ernst--Schwarzschild spacetime: a confluent-Heun Wronskian approach
2609.17727v1.abstract: We study the quasinormal-mode and quasibound-state spectra of a massless scalar field in weakly magnetized Ernst--Schwarzschild spacetime. In the separated $O(B_0^2)$ regime, the Klein--Gordon equation reduces to a radial confluent-Heun equation. We construct an endpoint-selected spectral Wronskian directly from the canonical confluent-Heun recurrence and its regular-to-irregular connection limit. Quasinormal modes and quasibound states are then obtained as zeros of the same analytic spectral function on the radiative and bound sheets, respectively, providing a unified treatment of the two spectral sectors within the separated weak-field problem. The resulting QNM and QBS frequencies agree with independent weak-field Ernst and massive-Schwarzschild benchmarks available in the literature. We further show, for representative cases, that the frequencies selected by the local Heun-series termination relation examined here do not satisfy the endpoint-selected quasibound-state condition. The construction therefore provides a direct horizon-to-infinity spectral condition for both radiative and bound states within the weak-field Ernst problem.

classification.title_zh: 弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中标量准正规模与准束缚态：一种合流 Heun Wronskian 方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中无质量标量场的准正规模和准束缚态谱。在分离的 O(B0^2) 区域，Klein--Gordon 方程约化为径向合流 Heun 方程。我们直接从标准合流 Heun 递推及其正则到非正则连接极限构造端点选择的谱 Wronskian。随后，准正规模和准束缚态分别作为同一解析谱函数在辐射叶和束缚叶上的零点获得，从而在分离弱场问题中统一处理这两个谱扇区。所得 QNM 和 QBS 频率与文献中独立的弱场 Ernst 及有质量 Schwarzschild 基准一致。我们进一步对代表性情形表明，此处考察的局部 Heun 级数终止关系所选出的频率不满足端点选择的准束缚态条件。因此，该构造在弱场 Ernst 问题中为辐射态和束缚态提供了直接的从事件视界到无穷远的谱条件。
classification.one_liner: 用合流 Heun Wronskian 统一给出弱磁化 Ernst--Schwarzschild 时空中标量准正规模与准束缚态的谱条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接涉及标量准正规模/准束缚态和经典弯曲时空中的黑洞微扰，匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶。

2609.17794v1.title: What does "instant thermalization" in large-$q$ SYK models mean?
2609.17794v1.abstract: Motivated by the Planckian thermalization rate $\Gamma \sim T$ observed in the two-body interacting SYK model, we study thermalization in the $q/2$-body case. Previous studies of such systems have established the notion of instantaneous thermalization to leading order in $1/q$. It was conjectured that the thermalization may still be Planckian but with a divergent rate $\Gamma \sim T q$, explaining the ``instantaneous'' part. For an analytically and numerically tractable system, we calculate the effective temperatures after a quench at time $t = 0$ and indeed find a Planckian rate, albeit with the unexpected decaying behavior $\Gamma \sim T q^{-1} $. This is contrasted with the behavior of the causal Green's function $\mathcal{G}(t_1, t_2)$, which instantly acquires a thermal form in the two-time plane block $t_1, t_2 > 0$. The resulting picture is that instant thermalization is a meaningful concept only for this block, while the off-diagonal blocks $t_1 \cdot t_2 < 0$ are inherently non-thermal at any $q$. Since the effective temperature is obtained from correlations spanning all blocks, it inherits a finite rate set by the off-diagonal. We illustrate this directly by studying the non-thermal correlations' time dependence.

classification.title_zh: 大-$q$ SYK 模型中的“瞬时热化”意味着什么？
classification.abstract_zh: 受两体相互作用 SYK 模型中观测到的普朗克热化率 $\Gamma \sim T$ 启发，我们研究 $q/2$ 体情形下的热化。此类系统的先前研究已在 $1/q$ 领头阶确立了瞬时热化的概念。有人曾猜想热化可能仍是普朗克的，但具有发散速率 $\Gamma \sim T q$，从而解释“瞬时”部分。对于一个解析和数值上可处理的系统，我们计算了在 $t=0$ 时刻淬火后的有效温度，并确实发现普朗克速率，尽管具有出乎意料的衰减行为 $\Gamma \sim T q^{-1}$。这与因果格林函数 $\mathcal{G}(t_1, t_2)$ 的行为形成对比，后者在双时平面块 $t_1, t_2 > 0$ 中瞬间获得热的形式。由此得到的图像是：瞬时热化仅对这个块有意义，而非对角块 $t_1 \cdot t_2 < 0$ 在任何 $q$ 下本质上都是非热的。由于有效温度来自跨越所有块的关联，它继承了由非对角块设定的有限速率。我们通过研究非热关联的时间依赖性直接说明了这一点。
classification.one_liner: 大-$q$ SYK 的“瞬时热化”只发生在 $t_1,t_2>0$ 的因果格林函数块中；跨块的非热关联给出有限热化率 $\Gamma \sim T/q$。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究大-q SYK 模型中的瞬时热化与有效温度，属于全息/强关联非平衡动力学，但未涉及用户重点标签（全息超流超导、畴壁/孤子、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/BEC、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力等），仅可能对非平衡热化机制有间接参考。

2609.17912v1.title: Stochastic Thermodynamics of Dynamical Thin-Shell Wormholes: Effective Temperatures, Fluctuations and Conditional Quasi-Horizon Unification
2609.17912v1.abstract: We develop an effective stochastic and semiclassical framework for dynamical thin-shell wormholes connecting two asymptotic spacetime regions. The Israel junction geometry is separated from the phenomenological open-system description: stochastic dynamics is formulated in the radial phase space $(a,\dot a)$, whereas $\sigma$, $P$, and the effective temperature scales are induced observables. A one-dimensional Langevin--Fokker--Planck model is obtained only after an explicit overdamped/adiabatic approximation. Local acceleration scales are interpreted as reservoir temperatures only under additional KMS and detailed-balance assumptions. For a symmetric Schwarzschild--Schwarzschild wormhole, the transparent conservative shell defines the reference potential and restoring frequency, while dissipation and noise are introduced as open-system corrections. The stable linear response is closed by the constitutive slope $\beta_0^2=(dP/d\sigma)_0$. For $2M<a_0<3M$, stability requires a lower bound on $\beta_0^2$ that diverges as $a_0\to2M^+$. Moreover, the derivative along the family of static configurations equals the marginal-stability slope and must not be identified with the constitutive derivative of a stable stochastic shell. The reduced model determines stationary distributions, fluctuations, correlations, Markovian and non-Markovian spectra, and entropy production. Near the horizon, the junction conditions yield $T_{\rm stress}=T_{\rm acc}+O(\hbar\gamma/a)$, with equality at leading order under a specified dominance condition. A peeling temperature participates only if the ray-tracing map satisfies generalized Unruh/peeling and adiabaticity conditions. Thus, the three-temperature correspondence is conditional, while the stochastic coefficients remain phenomenological pending a microscopic shell--reservoir model.

classification.title_zh: 动态薄壳虫洞的随机热力学：有效温度、涨落与条件性准视界统一
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为连接两个渐近时空区域的动态薄壳虫洞发展了一个有效的随机半经典框架。Israel 衔接几何与现象学开放系统描述被分离开来：随机动力学在径向相空间 (a, \dot a) 中表述，而 σ、P 和有效温度标度是诱导可观测量。只有在显式过阻尼/绝热近似之后，才得到一维 Langevin–Fokker–Planck 模型。局域加速度标度只有在额外的 KMS 和细致平衡假设下才被解释为热库温度。对于对称 Schwarzschild–Schwarzschild 虫洞，透明保守壳定义参考势和恢复频率，而耗散和噪声作为开放系统修正引入。稳定的线性响应由本构斜率 β_0^2=(dP/dσ)_0 封闭。对于 2M<a_0<3M，稳定性要求 β_0^2 有一个下界，且该下界在 a_0→2M^+ 时发散。此外，沿静态构型族的导数等于边际稳定斜率，不能与稳定随机壳的本构导数等同。约化模型决定了稳态分布、涨落、关联、马尔可夫和非马尔可夫谱以及熵产生。在视界附近，衔接条件给出 T_{\rm stress}=T_{\rm acc}+O(\hbarγ/a)，在指定的主导条件下领头阶相等。剥离温度只有在光线追踪映射满足广义 Unruh/peeling 和绝热条件时才参与。因此，三温度对应是条件性的，而随机系数在微观壳–热库模型建立之前仍是现象学的。
classification.one_liner: 为动态薄壳虫洞建立随机半经典有效描述，并指出有效温度对应依赖 KMS/细致平衡与视界附近条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线（薄壳虫洞、Israel 衔接、Schwarzschild 稳定性），并涉及随机非平衡与有效温度；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶，因此对全息标签相关性低，但对经典引力重点标签直接相关。

2609.17936v1.title: Updated estimates of post-merger gravitational wave energy released in GW170817 and the maximum neutron star mass
2609.17936v1.abstract: In this work, benefiting from the increased sample of neutron stars with measured masses and radii as well as the incorporation of the chiral effective field theory and perturbative QCD constraints, the tidal parameter $\kappa_2^T$ is constrained to be $78^{+17}_{-11}$ (68.3% credible interval, mainly adopted in this work unless mentioned specifically) for the binary neutron stars involved in GW170817. Such a $\kappa_2^T$ is in favor of strong gravitational wave radiation in the post-merger phase and the corresponding energy is estimated to be $E_{\rm GW,p} \simeq 0.051^{+0.022}_{-0.017}\,M_\odot c^2$. Assuming the remnant from binary neutron star merger is a supramassive neutron star, as suggested by the modeling of the electromagnetic counterparts of GW170817, we examine the maximum mass of nonrotating neutron stars ($M_{\rm TOV}$) while accounting for the uncertainty in the remnant's lifetime ($t_{\rm c}$). Our results show that $M_{\rm TOV}$ varies from $2.09^{+0.11}_{-0.09}\,M_\odot$ for $t_{\rm c}=0.1$ s to $2.18^{+0.10}_{-0.09}\,M_\odot$ for $t_{\rm c}=1$ s. This result is consistent with that independently inferred from the re-construction of the equation of state of neutron star matter, i.e., $M_{\rm TOV,exc}=2.16^{+0.10}_{-0.07}M_\odot$, particularly if the very massive neutron stars with masses measured indirectly have been removed in constructing the prior distribution of $M_{\rm TOV}$. The consistency of the maximum mass of nonrotating neutron stars found in different approaches suggests a reasonable understanding of this key parameter for dense-matter physics.

classification.title_zh: GW170817 后合并阶段释放引力波能量与最大中子星质量的更新估计
classification.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，得益于具有质量和半径测量值的中子星样本增加，以及手征有效场论和微扰 QCD 约束的纳入，对于 GW170817 所涉及的双中子星，潮汐参数 κ2^T 被限制为 78^{+17}_{-11}（68.3% 可信区间，除非特别说明，本工作主要采用此值）。这样的 κ2^T 有利于后合并阶段的强引力波辐射，相应能量估计为 E_GW,p ≃ 0.051^{+0.022}_{-0.017} M⊙ c^2。假设双中子星并合遗迹是超大质量中子星，如 GW170817 电磁对应体建模所建议，我们在考虑遗迹寿命 t_c 不确定性的情况下检验非旋转中子星的最大质量（M_TOV）。结果表明，M_TOV 从 t_c=0.1 s 时的 2.09^{+0.11}_{-0.09} M⊙ 变化到 t_c=1 s 时的 2.18^{+0.10}_{-0.09} M⊙。该结果与独立地从中子星物质状态方程重建推断的结果一致，即 M_TOV,exc=2.16^{+0.10}_{-0.07} M⊙，特别是在构建 M_TOV 先验分布时移除了间接测量的大质量中子星后。不同方法得到的非旋转中子星最大质量的一致性表明，对致密物质物理这一关键参数有合理理解。
classification.one_liner: 结合扩展的中子星样本和核物理约束，本文更新了 GW170817 双中子星并合的潮汐参数及后合并引力波能量，并给出非旋转中子星最大质量的估计。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究双中子星并合后的引力波能量和中子星最大质量，属于经典引力/致密天体与引力波方向，与“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签相关；但不涉及全息对偶等理论全息主题。

2609.18105v1.title: Symmetry preservation in black hole quasinormal mode spectra
2609.18105v1.abstract: We establish a general relation between symmetries of gravitational theories and black hole (BH) quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra. We show that a symmetry implies isospectrality when it induces a bijection between the corresponding QNM boundary value problems. However, conformally related BHs have been reported to exhibit both conformal factor dependent and independent QNM spectra. To resolve this issue, we develop a reduction scheme for higher order perturbation equations. Applied to pure Weyl gravity, it yields the complete axial spectrum of Schwarzschild, including Regge-Wheeler and spin-1 branches. Our results show that these seemingly contradictory conclusions result from differences in the perturbation dynamics or in the boundary conditions.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞准正规模式谱中的对称性保持
classification.abstract_zh: 我们建立了引力理论对称性与黑洞（BH）准正规模式（QNM）谱之间的一般关系。我们表明，当对称性诱导相应 QNM 边值问题之间的双射时，它意味着等谱性。然而，已有报道称共形相关的黑洞会表现出依赖于共形因子和独立于共形因子的 QNM 谱。为了解决这一问题，我们为高阶微扰方程发展了一种约化方案。将其应用于纯 Weyl 引力，可得到 Schwarzschild 的完整轴向谱，包括 Regge-Wheeler 和自旋-1 分支。我们的结果表明，这些看似矛盾的结论源于微扰动力学或边界条件的差异。
classification.one_liner: 建立引力对称性与黑洞 QNM 谱等谱性的联系，并用高阶微扰约化方案解决共形相关黑洞谱矛盾，在纯 Weyl 引力中给出 Schwarzschild 完整轴向 QNM 谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究黑洞准正规模式谱、对称性及经典引力微扰，直接匹配重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”（QNM部分）与“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息或 AdS/CFT。

2609.18143v1.title: Horizon--orbit scale competition in chaos bound violation for spinning particles in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime
2609.18143v1.abstract: In this paper, we investigate the chaos bound through the local radial instability of charged spinning test particles on unstable circular orbits in the black-bounce--Kerr--Newman spacetime. Our results show that violation of the bound is governed by the competition between the local orbital-instability scale and the surface gravity scale, with variations of the black hole background and the particle dynamics providing two complementary routes to the same threshold crossing. Background variations affect both scales and can drive the system into the bound-violating regime when the surface gravity is suppressed more strongly than the orbital instability. At fixed background, by contrast, the surface gravity remains unchanged, and the transition across the threshold is driven by changes in the unstable orbit dynamics induced by the particle parameters. The background-controlled and probe-dynamics-controlled routes therefore represent two realizations of a unified horizon--orbit scale competition rather than independent mechanisms. Among the particle parameters considered, the total angular momentum plays the leading role in controlling the local radial instability, while the spin and charge further modify the instability strength and shift the threshold for chaos bound violation.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中自旋粒子违反混沌界限的地平线-轨道尺度竞争
classification.abstract_zh: 本文通过黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中带电自旋测试粒子在不稳定圆轨道上的局域径向不稳定性研究混沌界限。结果表明，混沌界限的破坏由局域轨道不稳定性尺度与表面引力尺度之间的竞争决定；黑洞背景变化和粒子动力学变化提供两条互补的越界途径。背景变化同时影响两个尺度，当表面引力被压制得比轨道不稳定性更强时，系统可进入破坏界限的区域。在固定背景下，表面引力不变，越界转变由粒子参数引起的不稳定轨道动力学变化驱动。因此，背景控制与探针动力学控制两种路径是统一的地平线-轨道尺度竞争的两种实现，而非彼此独立的机制。在所考虑的粒子参数中，总角动量对局域径向不稳定性起主导作用，自旋和电荷进一步改变不稳定性强度并移动混沌界限破坏的阈值。
classification.one_liner: 在黑洞反弹-Kerr-Newman时空中，自旋测试粒子的混沌界限破坏取决于地平线表面引力与轨道不稳定性尺度之间的竞争，背景变化和粒子参数可分别驱动越界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论分支，研究弯曲时空中测试粒子轨道稳定性与混沌界限，不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力；与经典引力/广义相对论重点标签直接相关，但与全息研究主线相关性有限。

2609.18606v1.title: Shadow and Polarized Images of Schwarzschild-MOG Black Hole Illuminated by Thick Accretion Disk
2609.18606v1.abstract: Recent EHT polarimetric observations provide a powerful probe of near-horizon physics and modified gravity. We investigate the shadow and polarization images of a static Schwarzschild-MOG black hole illuminated by geometrically thick, optically thin accretion flows. Adopting a phenomenological model and the Hou disk model, and solving null geodesics and relativistic radiative transfer, we study how the MOG parameter, inclination angle, anisotropic synchrotron emission, and flow geometry affect the total intensity and linear polarization. It is found that the MOG parameter mainly enlarges and brightens higher-order photon rings and broadens the shadow, while the inclination angle breaks axial symmetry and enhances polarized emission inside the shadow. The Hou disk model suppresses off-equatorial radiative interference and localizes polarization signals within higher-order rings. Electric vector position angle (EVPA) patterns are mostly azimuthal but vary rapidly near lensed images. These results provide theoretical diagnostics for constraining MOG with EHT/ngEHT polarimetric observations.

classification.title_zh: 厚吸积盘照亮的 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞阴影与偏振图像
classification.abstract_zh: 近期 EHT 偏振观测为近视界物理和修改引力提供了有力探针。我们研究了由几何厚、光学薄吸积流照亮的静态 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞的阴影和偏振图像。采用现象学模型和 Hou 盘模型，并求解零测地线与相对论辐射转移，我们考察了 MOG 参数、倾角、各向异性同步辐射和流几何对总强度与线偏振的影响。发现 MOG 参数主要增大和增亮高阶光子环并展宽阴影，而倾角破坏轴对称性并增强阴影内部的偏振辐射。Hou 盘模型抑制偏离赤道面的辐射干涉，并将偏振信号局域在高阶环内。电场矢量位置角（EVPA）图样大多为方位角向，但在透镜像附近快速变化。这些结果为利用 EHT/ngEHT 偏振观测限制 MOG 提供了理论诊断。
classification.one_liner: 通过厚吸积盘辐射转移计算，研究 Schwarzschild-MOG 黑洞阴影和偏振图像对 MOG 参数、倾角与盘几何的响应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与黑洞阴影/偏振成像方向，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2603.04214v2.title: Resumming Spinning Black Hole Dynamics at Third Post-Minkowskian Order
2603.04214v2.abstract: We investigate the relativistic scattering of spinning black holes using modern amplitude methods within a heavy-mass effective field theory formalism at third post-Minkowskian order. Using a systematic self-force expansion up to first order in the mass ratio, the gravitational amplitude and the associated eikonal-like phase are computed for a spin-aligned binary system comprising a heavy and a light black hole up to fifth order in the total spin and up to quadratic order in the spin of the light black hole. We also consider the resummation of the heavy black hole's spin in both the probe limit and the radiation-reaction sector, and verify that the resulting phase displays the characteristic ring singularity features associated with the Kerr metric.

classification.title_zh: 在三阶后闵可夫斯基阶重求和自旋黑洞动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在第三后闵可夫斯基阶，使用重质量有效场论形式下的现代振幅方法研究自旋黑洞的相对论散射。通过将自力展开系统地进行到质量比的一阶，我们计算了由重黑洞和轻黑洞组成的自旋对齐双星系统的引力振幅及相关的类 eikonal 相位，结果保留到总自旋的五阶以及轻黑洞自旋的二次阶。我们还考虑在探针极限和辐射反作用部分对重黑洞自旋进行重求和，并验证所得相位显示出与 Kerr 度规相关的特征环奇异性。
classification.one_liner: 用重质量 EFT 与振幅方法在 3PM 阶计算自旋黑洞散射，并重求和重黑洞自旋，重现 Kerr 环奇异性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究后闵可夫斯基阶自旋黑洞散射与经典引力动力学，直接符合“经典引力/广义相对论”重点方向。

2604.07463v2.title: Decoding multiway gravitational junctions in AdS in terms of holographic quantum maps
2604.07463v2.abstract: It has been shown that multiway junctions gluing $n$ copies of locally AdS$_3$ spacetimes ($n\geq 2$) can be described by $n-1$ strings obeying non-linear Nambu-Goto equations coupled by Monge-Amp\`{e}re like terms. Here we study how such junctions along with their stringy degrees of freedom can be interpreted in terms of an interface between $n$ identical holographic conformal theories each defined on a semi-infinite line (wire). We study the gravitational scattering problem at the multiway junction, and show that at the linearized order the dual interfaces correspond to quantum maps which factorize into a product of a scattering matrix determined only by the tension of the dual junction and relative automorphisms of the Virasoro algebra governed by the $n-1$ stringy modes. Both of these are universal in the sense that they are independent of linear modifications of the background state. These generalize earlier results for the 2-way junctions implying that the dual interface is a tunable energy transmitter. We comment on understanding the quantum map corresponding to the full non-linear gravitational problem, and study Ward identities and unitarity bounds.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 用全息量子映射解读 AdS 中的多路引力结
classification.abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，将 n 份局部 AdS3 时空（n≥2）粘合而成的多路结可由 n−1 条满足非线性 Nambu-Goto 方程、并通过类似 Monge-Ampère 项耦合的弦描述。本文研究此类结及其弦自由度如何解释为 n 个相同全息共形场论之间的界面，每个共形场论定义在半无限直线（线）上。我们研究多路结处的引力散射问题，并表明在线性化阶，对偶界面对应于量子映射；该映射因子化为一个仅由对偶结张力决定的散射矩阵与由 n−1 个弦模支配的 Virasoro 代数相对自同构的乘积。二者都是普适的，即不依赖于背景态的线性修改。这些结果推广了此前两路结的结果，意味着对偶界面是可调的能量传输器。我们评论了对完整非线性引力问题所对应量子映射的理解，并研究了 Ward 恒等式与幺正性界。
classification.one_liner: 将 AdS3 中多路引力结的对偶界面表述为由结张力散射矩阵和 Virasoro 自同构构成的量子映射，并讨论其普适性、Ward 恒等式与幺正性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶，核心对象是多路引力结/界面，直接对应‘非均匀态/畴壁/孤子/涡旋’支线；其引力侧涉及 AdS3 经典结与 Nambu-Goto 弦，因此也与经典引力支线相关。

2606.03049v2.title: Holographic complexity of de Sitter black holes
2606.03049v2.abstract: We investigate holographic complexity within the Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) black hole spacetime. Two distinct de Sitter holography prescriptions are examined: the static patch scheme restricted to the stretched horizon and the de Sitter/Conformal Field Theory (dS/CFT) correspondence scheme defined at asymptotic future and past infinities. We evaluate the Complexity equals Volume (CV) conjecture and extend the analysis to codimension-zero proposals, specifically Complexity equals Spacetime Volume (CV2.0) and Complexity equals Action (CA), through the Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) patch we construct. The behaviors of the complexity in the static patch holography at late time and in the dS/CFT at infinite spacelike boundary coordinate are studied, respectively. We find that under both the CV and CV2.0 conjectures, the static patch holographic complexity and the dS/CFT holographic complexity consistently exhibit linear growth. Conversely, regarding the CA conjecture, the holographic complexity growth rates for both the static patch and the dS/CFT correspondence vanish. This behavior is attributed to the finiteness of the (regularized) action within the restricted WDW region. Furthermore, we find that, in the limit in which the boundary coordinate is taken to infinity, the complexity growth rate in the static patch prescription coincides with its counterpart in the dS/CFT prescription. This agreement suggests a deeper connection between the two descriptions and may point toward a unified understanding of bulk dynamics in de Sitter holography.

classification.title_zh: de Sitter 黑洞的全息复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Schwarzschild-de Sitter (SdS) 黑洞时空中的全息复杂度。考察两种不同的 de Sitter 全息方案：限制在拉伸视界上的静态补丁方案，以及定义在渐近未来和过去无穷远的 de Sitter/共形场论 (dS/CFT) 对应方案。我们评估“复杂度等于体积”(CV) 猜想，并通过构造 Wheeler-DeWitt (WDW) patch，将分析推广到余维零提议，特别是“复杂度等于时空体积”(CV2.0) 和“复杂度等于作用量”(CA)。分别研究了静态补丁全息在晚期以及 dS/CFT 在空间类边界坐标趋于无穷时的复杂度行为。我们发现，在 CV 和 CV2.0 猜想下，静态补丁全息复杂度和 dS/CFT 全息复杂度均一致地呈现线性增长。相反，对于 CA 猜想，静态补丁和 dS/CFT 对应的全息复杂度增长率均消失。这种行为归因于受限 WDW 区域内（正则化）作用量的有限性。此外，我们发现，在边界坐标趋于无穷的极限下，静态补丁方案中的复杂度增长率与 dS/CFT 方案中的对应结果一致。这一一致性暗示两种描述之间存在更深联系，并可能指向 de Sitter 全息中体动力学的一个统一理解。
classification.one_liner: 在Schwarzschild-de Sitter黑洞时空中比较静态补丁与dS/CFT两种全息方案，CV/CV2.0显示线性增长而CA增长率为零，并在边界无穷极限下两者增长率一致。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于de Sitter全息与全息复杂度交叉，涉及经典黑洞时空和WDW作用量，与经典引力/全息复杂度关注相关；但未直接匹配用户重点标签中的超流、多分量、QNM、气泡成核等具体支线。

2606.05505v3.title: Dirichlet walls and the end of time
2606.05505v3.abstract: We study evolution in Einstein-Hilbert gravity with Dirichlet boundary conditions imposed on a finite surface. We argue that there are open sets of initial data where such evolutions terminate at finite times due to singularities that reach the boundary. In any dimension, the simplest such examples occur in cosmologies. However, in 2+1 dimensions we also show that Dirichlet walls initially outside a BTZ black hole can fall through the horizon, and that this also leads to generic singularities. A similar construction in higher dimensions leads to trapped surfaces that reach the wall, though the end result of such evolutions is more difficult to study.

classification.title_zh: Dirichlet 墙与时间的终结
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在有限曲面上施加 Dirichlet 边界条件的 Einstein-Hilbert 引力中的演化。我们认为，存在开集初值使此类演化在有限时间终止，原因是奇点到达边界。在任意维度，最简单的例子出现在宇宙学中。然而，在 2+1 维中我们还表明，初始位于 BTZ 黑洞外部的 Dirichlet 墙可以穿过视界，这也会导致一般性奇点。高维中的类似构造会产生到达墙的捕获面，尽管此类演化的最终结果更难研究。
classification.one_liner: 在带 Dirichlet 边界面的 Einstein-Hilbert 引力中，某些初值演化会在有限时间终结：低维含宇宙学与 BTZ 黑洞穿视界导致奇点，高维则出现抵达边界的捕获面。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究 Einstein-Hilbert 经典引力、Dirichlet 边界条件、BTZ 黑洞及时空奇点/捕获面演化，属于用户列出的经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；摘要未涉及全息对偶或量子信息，因此不归为理论全息。

2511.22671v2.title: Echoes of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov traversable wormhole
2511.22671v2.abstract: We study linear perturbations of massless scalar and vector gauge fields, treated as test fields, on the four-dimensional traversable wormhole of Maldacena, Milekhin, and Popov~\cite{Maldacena:2018gjk}. Both effective potentials vanish throughout the throat and rise in each mouth to a single barrier peaked at the extremal photon-sphere radius $r=2r_e$ for every multipole. In the tortoise coordinate these two barriers are only $\mathcal{O}(10^2)$ wide but sit a distance $2D\simeq\pi L_{\rm wh}\sim10^{35}$ apart, which puts direct time-domain evolution out of reach. We instead compute the single-barrier scattering amplitudes by Numerov integration, validated against an exactly solvable barrier and against an independent time-domain evolution, and then sum the multiple reflections in closed form. The parabolic WKB formula always gives a transmission probability of $1/2$ at the barrier top, whereas the true value is $0.62$. It also fails below the top, where the transmission falls as $|\kappa|^2\propto\omega^{6.4}$ for $l=1$. Echoes emerge at $T_m=(2m+1)D$ as narrow-band wave packets near the light-ring frequency. Their frequency decreases with each reflection and the energy decays algebraically, $E_m\propto m^{-1}$. The quasinormal spectrum splits into two families. Modes trapped between the barriers are extraordinarily long-lived, with quality factors up to $10^{41}$, and carry the same astronomical time-scale as the echoes. The photon-sphere modes of a single mouth are damped $10^{36}$ times faster than cavity modes, with quality factors of order unity at low multipoles. Only this second family of quasinormal modes is observable, characterising the ringdown of a single mouth. The echoes and the trapped cavity modes instead characterise the late-time dynamics of the throat, not a detectable signal.

classification.title_zh: Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 可穿越虫洞的回声
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究无质量标量场和矢量规范场作为试探场，在 Maldacena、Milekhin 和 Popov 的四维可穿越虫洞上的线性扰动。对于所有多极，两个有效势在喉部处处为零，并在每个口处上升为单个势垒，其峰值位于极值光子球半径 r=2r_e。在龟坐标中，这两个势垒宽度仅为 O(10^2)，但相距 2D≃π L_wh ∼10^35，这使得直接的时域演化无法进行。我们改用 Numerov 积分计算单势垒散射振幅，并用一个精确可解势垒以及独立的时域演化进行验证，然后以闭合形式对多次反射求和。抛物 WKB 公式在势垒顶部总是给出透射概率 1/2，而真实值为 0.62。它在顶部以下也失效，此时对于 l=1，透射率按 |κ|^2∝ω^6.4 下降。回声出现在 T_m=(2m+1)D，为光环绕频率附近的窄带波包。其频率随每次反射而降低，能量代数衰减，E_m∝m^{-1}。准正规模谱分裂为两个族。被囚禁在势垒之间的模式寿命极长，品质因子可达 10^41，并携带与回声相同的天文时间尺度。单个口的光子球模式比腔模式衰减快 10^36 倍，在低多极时品质因子为 1 量级。只有第二族准正规模是可观测的，表征单个口的铃宕。回声和被囚禁的腔模式则表征喉部的晚期动力学，而不是可探测信号。
classification.one_liner: 在 MMP 可穿越虫洞上计算标量与矢量试探场的线性扰动，发现回声和极长寿命腔模式，但可观测信号仅来自单口光子球准正规模。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题涉及准正规模、回声和经典弯曲时空中的线性扰动，与 QNM 及经典引力支线相关，但不涉及全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、相变气泡成核、multi-trace 或 Floquet 驱动等具体重点方向。

2601.15612v2.title: Gravitational equal-area law and critical phenomena of cuspy black hole shadow
2601.15612v2.abstract: The formation of a cusp on a black hole shadow is a striking signature of physics beyond the Kerr paradigm. Using the Konoplya-Zhidenko metric, a general parametrized deformation of Kerr black hole, we demonstrate that this morphological change fundamentally alters the shadow's topology with the topological charge flipping from 1 to -1. To analyze this topological transition, we introduce a gravitational equal-area law, analogous to Maxwell's construction in thermodynamics, and identify a critical point for cusp formation. Near this point, we uncover universal behavior characterized by a critical exponent 1/2, which places this gravitational lensing system within the mean-field universality class. These results establish a new framework for testing fundamental physics of black hole shadows, reframing the search for deviations from general relativity as a targeted hunt for a distinct topological and critical phenomenon.

classification.title_zh: 引力等面积定律与尖点黑洞阴影的临界现象
classification.abstract_zh: 黑洞阴影上尖点的形成是超越 Kerr 范式的物理的显著信号。利用 Konoplya-Zhidenko 度规——Kerr 黑洞的一种一般参数化变形——我们证明这种形态变化从根本上改变了阴影的拓扑，使拓扑荷从 1 翻转为 -1。为分析这一拓扑转变，我们引入引力等面积定律，类似于热力学中的麦克斯韦构造，并确定了尖点形成的临界点。在该点附近，我们发现由临界指数 1/2 表征的普适行为，这将该引力透镜系统置于平均场普适类中。这些结果建立了一个检验黑洞阴影基础物理的新框架，并将对广义相对论偏离的搜索重新表述为对一种独特拓扑与临界现象的有目标搜寻。
classification.one_liner: 在 Konoplya-Zhidenko 变形 Kerr 黑洞中，阴影尖点对应拓扑荷从 1 到 -1 的翻转，并可用引力等面积定律与临界指数 1/2 的临界现象描述。

2601.21065v2.title: Building Holographic Entanglement by Measurement
2601.21065v2.abstract: We propose a framework for preparing quantum states with a holographic entanglement structure, in the sense that the entanglement entropies are governed by minimal surfaces in a chosen bulk geometry. We refer to such entropies as holographic because they obey a relation between entropies and bulk minimal surfaces, known as the Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) formula, that is a key feature of holographic models of quantum gravity. Typically in such models, the bulk geometry is determined by solving Einstein's equations. Here, we simply choose a bulk geometry, then discretize the geometry into a coupling graph comprising bulk and boundary nodes. Evolving under this graph of interactions and measuring the bulk nodes leaves behind the desired pure state on the boundary. We numerically demonstrate that the resulting entanglement properties approximately reproduce the predictions of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula in the chosen bulk geometry. We consider graphs associated with hyperbolic disk and wormhole geometries, but the approach is general. We also introduce a procedure for decorating the graph which, when applied to the hyperbolic disk, yields a genuine CFT ground state with power-law correlations but which only partially obeys RT. The minimal ingredients in our proposal involve only Gaussian operations and measurements and are readily implementable in photonic and cold-atom platforms.

classification.title_zh: 通过测量构建全息纠缠
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个制备具有全息纠缠结构的量子态的框架，这里的含义是纠缠熵由所选体几何中的极小曲面支配。我们把这类熵称为全息的，因为它们满足熵与体极小曲面之间的关系，即 Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）公式，这是量子引力全息模型的一个关键特征。通常在这类模型中，体几何由求解 Einstein 方程确定。这里，我们直接选择一个体几何，然后将该几何离散化为一个由体和边界节点组成的耦合图。在该相互作用图下演化并测量体节点，会在边界上留下所需的纯态。我们数值证明，所得的纠缠性质近似再现所选体几何中 Ryu-Takayanagi 公式的预言。我们考虑与双曲圆盘和虫洞几何相关的图，但该方法是一般的。我们还引入一种装饰图的过程，将其应用于双曲圆盘时，会得到一个具有幂律关联但仅部分满足 RT 的真正 CFT 基态。我们方案中的最小要素仅涉及高斯操作和测量，并且容易在光子和冷原子平台上实现。
classification.one_liner: 通过图上的高斯演化和体节点测量，在边界制备出纠缠熵近似遵循选定体几何 RT 公式的全息纠缠态。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息纠缠、RT 公式与测量制备，并提及冷原子/光子平台实现，属于全息量子信息核心方向。

2604.16703v2.title: Memory of Robinson-Trautman waves
2604.16703v2.abstract: The memory effect for Robinson-Trautman waves is explicitly worked out. In a first step, we construct the combined frame rotation and coordinate transformation in which Robinson-Trautman waves are manifestly locally asymptotically flat at future null infinity. This allows us to apply well-established results on how to derive the memory effect in this context. In a second step, we construct a suitably improved generalized mass aspect that provides a local Lyapunov function for the flow in the sense that it is manifestly positive. News-free solutions are studied in detail and shown to coincide with the vacuum sector of Euclidean Liouville theory. They correspond to a boosted and rescaled Schwarzschild black hole. As a by-product, we show that the displacement and non-linear memory effects in locally asymptotically flat spacetimes at future null infinity are invariant under supertranslations and covariant under $\mathrm{BMS}_4$ Lorentz transformations and constant rescalings. A novel interpretation of modified flows that control the low harmonics in terms of keeping the system in its instantaneous rest frame is provided.

classification.title_zh: Robinson-Trautman 波的记忆效应
classification.abstract_zh: 本文明确计算了 Robinson-Trautman 波的记忆效应。第一步，我们构造了联合的标架旋转与坐标变换，使得 Robinson-Trautman 波在未来零无穷处显式地局部渐近平坦。这使我们能够应用关于如何在此背景下推导记忆效应的已有结果。第二步，我们构造了一个适当改进的广义质量 aspect，它提供了流的局部 Lyapunov 函数，即它显式为正。我们详细研究了无 news 解，并表明它们与欧几里得 Liouville 理论的真空 sector 一致。它们对应于一个作 boost 和重标度的 Schwarzschild 黑洞。作为副产品，我们表明未来零无穷处局部渐近平坦时空中的位移记忆效应和非线性记忆效应在超平移下不变，并在 BMS4 洛伦兹变换和常数重标度下协变。我们还给出了对控制低次谐波的修正流的一种新解释，即将其解释为保持系统处于其瞬时静止系。
classification.one_liner: 在局部渐近平坦未来零无穷处推导 Robinson-Trautman 波的位移与非线性记忆效应，并构造正定的广义质量 Lyapunov 函数。

2605.21584v2.title: Wave-optics gravitational wave lensing in modified gravity
2605.21584v2.abstract: We initiate the study of gravitational-wave lensing in the wave-optics regime within modified gravity. We consider a phenomenological setup in which the gravitational-wave amplitude obeys a curvature-coupled propagation equation. This framework reproduces the standard GR behaviour in the geometric-optics regime, while leading to qualitatively different infrared dynamics. In particular, the usual argument implying that the amplification factor approaches unity in the zero-frequency limit no longer applies. This is due to the persistence of curvature-induced interactions in the infrared, which modify the natural propagation basis itself. As a result, the standard Fresnel treatment ceases to be valid at sufficiently low frequency. The correct infrared regime is instead controlled by an interacting static Green function, with a finite-frequency completion provided by a partial-wave formulation. We show that this structure admits an equivalent distorted-wave interpretation, in which the curvature interaction is absorbed into a dressed reference propagation basis, while the residual lensing effect is encoded in finite-frequency phase shifts. We further demonstrate that these phenomena admit a natural interpretation in the language of scattering amplitudes. Wave-optics lensing can therefore probe propagation-level departures from GR that remain entirely invisible in geometric optics.

classification.title_zh: 修改引力中的波光学引力波透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们启动了修改引力中波光学区引力波透镜的研究。我们考虑一个现象学设置，其中引力波振幅服从曲率耦合的传播方程。该框架在几何光学区再现标准广义相对论行为，同时导致定性不同的红外动力学。特别地，通常论证零频极限下放大因子趋于1不再适用。这是由于红外中曲率诱导相互作用的持续存在，改变了自然传播基本身。因此，标准菲涅耳处理在足够低频下失效。正确的红外区反而由相互作用的静态格林函数控制，有限频率完成由分波表述提供。我们证明该结构允许等价的畸变波解释，其中曲率相互作用被吸收进修饰的参考传播基，而残余透镜效应编码在有限频率相移中。我们进一步证明这些现象在散射振幅语言中有自然解释。因此，波光学透镜可以探测几何光学中完全不可见的传播层面偏离广义相对论。
classification.one_liner: 修改引力中波光学引力波透镜在红外区偏离广义相对论，可由静态格林函数、分波相移与散射振幅描述。

2606.13167v2.title: Thermodynamics of polymerized vacuum regular black holes in anti-de Sitter spacetime
2606.13167v2.abstract: We derive a class of vacuum regular black holes inspired by effective loop quantum gravity dynamics and extend the construction to asymptotically anti-de Sitter spacetimes. The derivation is based on a deparameterized Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi formulation, where an auxiliary dust field is introduced only to define an internal time and does not act as a matter source. In spherical symmetry, the dynamics reduces to a set of independent radial shells, giving rise to a factorized shell Hamiltonian and to a Birkhoff-type property: for a fixed reconstruction function and cosmological constant, the static geometry is uniquely determined by the mass. Within this framework, we establish the conditions for curvature regularity at the center and construct several regular black hole models with de Sitter cores and corresponding models with anti-de Sitter cores. We then study their thermodynamics in the extended phase space, using the Hawking--Page transition to compare the de Sitter- and anti-de Sitter-core branches and show that their quantitative differences arise from the deformation of the physical outer-horizon branch rather than from regularity alone.

classification.title_zh: 反德西特时空中聚合化真空规则黑洞的热力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了一类受有效圈量子引力动力学启发的真空规则黑洞，并将该构造推广到渐近反德西特时空。推导基于去参数化的 Lemaitre--Tolman--Bondi 表述，其中引入辅助尘埃场仅用于定义内时，而不作为物质源。在球对称下，动力学约化为一组独立的径向壳层，产生因子化的壳层哈密顿量以及一个 Birkhoff 型性质：对于固定的重构函数和宇宙学常数，静态几何由质量唯一确定。在此框架内，我们建立了中心曲率规则性的条件，并构造了若干具有 de Sitter 核心的规则黑洞模型以及相应的具有 anti-de Sitter 核心的模型。随后我们在扩展相空间中研究其热力学，利用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 de Sitter 核心和 anti-de Sitter 核心分支，并表明它们的定量差异来自物理外视界分支的形变，而非仅来自规则性。
classification.one_liner: 构造了有效圈量子引力启发的 AdS 真空规则黑洞，并在扩展相空间中用 Hawking--Page 相变比较 dS 核与 AdS 核分支，指出热力学差异主要源于外视界分支形变而非规则性本身。

2609.17570v1.title: Observationally Reconstructed Spacetime of NGC 5907: Dark-Matter-Corrected Black Hole Thermodynamics and Galactic Shadow
2609.17570v1.abstract: We present an observationally guided relativistic framework to investigate the thermodynamic and optical properties of a black hole in the NGC 5907 galaxy. By reconstructing the spacetime directly from the observed rotation curve, we obtain a dark-matter-corrected metric that incorporates both the galactic halo and the central compact object. The reconstructed geometry admits horizon solutions, allowing us to evaluate the Hawking temperature, Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, and heat capacity, which indicate a thermodynamically stable supermassive black hole influenced by its dark matter environment. We further analyze photon motion and the resulting gravitational shadow, deriving the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and shadow size. Comparison with WISE W1 infrared photometry shows consistency with the predicted suppression of photon escape near the shadow radius. These results establish a unified link between galactic rotation curves, dark matter, black hole thermodynamics, and observable photometric signatures.

classification.title_zh: NGC 5907 的观测重构时空：暗物质修正的黑洞热力学与星系阴影
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个由观测引导的相对论框架，用来研究 NGC 5907 星系中黑洞的热力学与光学性质。通过直接从观测到的旋转曲线重构时空，我们得到了一个同时包含星系晕和中心致密天体的暗物质修正度规。重构几何允许视界解，使我们能够计算 Hawking 温度、Bekenstein-Hawking 熵和热容，结果表明该超大质量黑洞在暗物质环境影响下热力学稳定。我们进一步分析光子运动及由此产生的引力阴影，推导出光子球、临界碰撞参数和阴影大小。与 WISE W1 红外测光比较，显示与阴影半径附近光子逃逸受到抑制的预言一致。这些结果在星系旋转曲线、暗物质、黑洞热力学和可观测测光特征之间建立了统一联系。
classification.one_liner: 从 NGC 5907 旋转曲线重构含暗物质晕与中心天体的度规，研究黑洞热力学、光子球与引力阴影。

2609.17580v1.title: Exceptional points and the breaking of Schwarzschild isospectrality under local potential perturbations
2609.17580v1.abstract: The odd- and even-parity gravitational perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole are governed by the distinct Regge-Wheeler and Zerilli potentials, yet their quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra are identical in vacuum. Building on our previous study of the odd-parity Regge-Wheeler spectrum [M. Ould El Hadj and S. R. Dolan, arXiv:2608.16283], we investigate the corresponding even-parity Zerilli problem and compare the two sectors under the same perturbation of amplitude $\epsilon$ at radius $r_0$. Using the Chandrasekhar-Detweiler relation, we derive an exact relation between the normalized Wronskians and show that Schwarzschild QNM isospectrality is not preserved under an identical nonzero localized defect. We find that the even- and odd-parity repelling-point branches approach the same Schwarzschild QNM frequencies at large $r_0$, with their first parity-dependent separation appearing at order $1/\mathcal R^2$, where $\mathcal R=r_{0*}/M$ is the dimensionless tortoise-coordinate location of the defect. The corresponding exceptional points (EPs) form two shifted sequences with the same asymptotic spacing in the tortoise coordinate, while their relative displacement is fixed by the phase of the asymptotic Chandrasekhar-Detweiler factor. The critical perturbation amplitudes share the same exponential decay rate in the two sectors, whereas the ratio of their asymptotic prefactors is fixed by the modulus of the same factor. We further find that the even- and odd-parity EPs connect the same neighboring QNM overtones, with nearly identical arclengths for the corresponding spectral bridges. Finally, the exceptional degeneracy is parity selective: at identical values of $(r_0,\epsilon)$, a pair of QNMs may coalesce at an EP in one parity sector while remaining distinct in the other, leading to a corresponding difference in the local pole structure of the ringdown response.

classification.title_zh: 局部势扰动下的例外点与史瓦西等谱性的破缺
classification.abstract_zh: 史瓦西黑洞的奇宇称与偶宇称引力扰动分别由不同的 Regge-Wheeler 和 Zerilli 势描述，但在真空中它们的准正规模（QNM）谱相同。基于我们此前对奇宇称 Regge-Wheeler 谱的研究 [M. Ould El Hadj and S. R. Dolan, arXiv:2608.16283]，我们研究相应的偶宇称 Zerilli 问题，并在半径 r0 处施加相同振幅 ε 的扰动下比较这两个扇区。利用 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 关系，我们推导了归一化 Wronskian 之间的精确关系，并表明在相同的非零局域缺陷下，史瓦西 QNM 等谱性不再保持。我们发现，偶宇称与奇宇称的排斥点分支在大 r0 下趋近相同的史瓦西 QNM 频率，其首个依赖宇称的分离出现在 1/R^2 阶，其中 R = r_{0*}/M 是缺陷在无量纲龟坐标中的位置。相应的例外点（EP）形成两个平移序列，在龟坐标中具有相同的渐近间距，而其相对位移由渐近 Chandrasekhar-Detweiler 因子的相位固定。两个扇区的临界扰动振幅具有相同的指数衰减率，而其渐近前因子的比值由同一因子的模固定。我们进一步发现，偶宇称与奇宇称 EP 连接相同的相邻 QNM 泛音，相应谱桥的弧长几乎相同。最后，例外简并是宇称选择性的：在相同的 (r0, ε) 值下，一对 QNM 可能在一个宇称扇区中于 EP 处合并，而在另一个扇区中仍保持分开，从而导致铃宕响应局域极点结构的相应差异。
classification.one_liner: 该文研究史瓦西黑洞奇偶宇称准正规模的等谱性如何被局域势缺陷破坏，并揭示其例外点谱结构及宇称选择性。

2609.17585v1.title: Horizon Structure and Geodesic Properties of Simpson-Visser Black Holes in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg Theory
2609.17585v1.abstract: We investigate a regularized charged black hole (BH) spacetime constructed by applying the Simpson-Visser (SV) prescription to a BH in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) theory. The resulting Simpson-Visser Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (SV-EEH) geometry incorporates nonlinear electromagnetic corrections through the parameter $(a)$ and the SV regularization through the length scale $(b)$. By varying these parameters, spacetime provides a smooth interpolation between a regular BH, a one-way wormhole, and a traversable wormhole configuration. Introducing the effective areal radius $(R=\sqrt{r^{2}+b^{2}})$, we analyze the horizon structure and derive the conditions for degenerate and extremal configurations. Furthermore, we examine the null and timelike geodesic structures, computing the photon sphere radius, the BH shadow size, and the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). Our results demonstrate how nonlinear electrodynamics and SV regularization jointly modify the causal and geodesic structure of charged BHs while preserving the appropriate Reissner-Nordstr\"om and SV limits.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 理论中 Simpson-Visser 黑洞的视界结构与测地线性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个正则带电黑洞时空，它通过将 Simpson-Visser (SV) 方案应用于 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) 理论中的黑洞而构造。所得的 Simpson-Visser Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (SV-EEH) 几何通过参数 (a) 引入非线性电磁修正，并通过长度尺度 (b) 引入 SV 正则化。通过改变这些参数，该时空可在正则黑洞、单向虫洞和可穿越虫洞构型之间平滑插值。引入有效面积半径 R = sqrt(r^2 + b^2) 后，我们分析了视界结构，并推导了简并与极值构型的条件。此外，我们考察了零测地线和类时测地线结构，计算了光子球半径、黑洞阴影大小和最内稳定圆轨道 (ISCO)。我们的结果表明，非线性电动力学和 SV 正则化如何共同修改带电黑洞的因果与测地线结构，同时保留相应的 Reissner-Nordström 和 SV 极限。
classification.one_liner: 将 Simpson-Visser 正则化与非线性的 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 电动力学结合，研究正则带电黑洞/虫洞的视界、测地线、光子球、阴影和 ISCO。

2609.17587v1.title: Fold-Point Scaling and Phenomenological Cascade Closures in Regular Black Hole Spacetimes
2609.17587v1.abstract: Semiclassical analyses of regular black holes suggest that inner-horizon instabilities can drive the trapped region to evaporate faster than the Hawking time and seed a transient anti-trapped region. Whether this repeats into a cascade terminating in a horizon-free configuration requires a self-consistent solution of the semiclassical Einstein equations, which we do not attempt. Instead, within the static Bardeen family, we show that the renormalized-stress-tensor (RSET) result of Arrechea, Liberati and Spadafora (arXiv:2608.03538) does not by itself force any damping of a hypothetical cascade near extremality, since its near-extremal limit at fixed cycle duration is finite and nonzero. We then prove, under explicit nondegeneracy hypotheses on any static metric family whose horizons merge at a fold point, that the inner-horizon surface gravity scales as |kappa_-| ~ (M-M_crit)^{1/2}, and verify this in two regular black hole families, Bardeen and Hayward, with a quantified systematic uncertainty. A phenomenological closure built on this scaling gives a mass gap decaying as x_n ~ n^{-2}, generalizing to x_n ~ n^{-1/(pq)} for a fold exponent p and an uncalibrated closure exponent q; the required cycle count is a property of the closure, not a physical prediction. As a separate exercise, we build an effective adiabatic model for the outer-horizon mass from the exact Einstein tensor of a generalized Vaidya-Bardeen ansatz matched to the cited RSET flux; the resulting law includes an O(1) correction absent from the naive Schwarzschild-Vaidya relation, relaxes to M_crit only asymptotically, and gives a timescale shorter than the inner-horizon amplification timescale by up to four orders of magnitude away from extremality but longer very close to extremality. We distinguish what is derived under stated assumptions from what the closure simply postulates.

classification.title_zh: 规则黑洞时空中的折叠点标度与现象学级联闭合
classification.abstract_zh: 对规则黑洞的半经典分析表明，内视界不稳定性可驱动囚禁区比霍金时间更快蒸发，并孕育瞬态反囚禁区。这是否重复成终止于无视界位形的级联，需要对半经典 Einstein 方程的自洽求解，而作者并未尝试。相反，在静态 Bardeen 族中，他们表明 Arrechea、Liberati 和 Spadafora 的重整化应力张量（RSET）结果本身并不强制假设级联在近极端处的任何阻尼，因为固定循环周期下其近极端极限有限且非零。随后，在对任何在折叠点视界合并的静态度规族施加显式非退化假设下，他们证明内视界表面引力按 |κ_-| ~ (M-M_crit)^{1/2} 标度，并在 Bardeen 与 Hayward 两个规则黑洞族中验证，给出了量化系统不确定度。基于该标度的现象学闭合给出按 x_n ~ n^{-2} 衰减的质量间隙，并推广为 x_n ~ n^{-1/(pq)}，其中折叠指数 p、未校准闭合指数 q；所需循环数是闭合的性质，而非物理预言。作为单独练习，他们由匹配到所引 RSET 通量的广义 Vaidya-Bardeen 拟设的精确 Einstein 张量，构建外视界质量的有效绝热模型；所得规律包含朴素 Schwarzschild-Vaidya 关系中缺失的 O(1) 修正，仅渐近松弛到 M_crit，并给出在远离极端处比内视界放大时标短最多四个数量级、但在非常接近极端处更长的时标。作者区分了在所述假设下导出的内容与闭合仅假设的内容。
classification.one_liner: 在规则黑洞中，作者证明折叠点处内视界表面引力的平方根标度，并据此构造现象学级联闭合，同时澄清 RSET 与推导/假设的边界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究半经典规则黑洞、内视界不稳定性与经典时空度规族，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.17591v1.title: From Geometry to Gravity: A Friendly Introduction to the Schwarzschild Metric
2609.17591v1.abstract: The first exact solution to the field equations of general relativity was found by the German physicist and astronomer Karl Schwarzschild in 1916. Due to its simplicity and its various astronomical applications, the Schwarzschild solution is the most important, which gives it great educational potential. However, this potential is not usually exploited, since the Schwarzschild solution is generally taught in advanced undergraduate physics courses or in specialized graduate courses. The objective of this article is to offer a friendly introduction to the Schwarzschild solution, and at the same time analyze some concepts of Riemannian geometry and general relativity, employing only simple mathematical tools that do not go beyond the rudiments of differential and integral calculus.

classification.title_zh: 从几何到引力：Schwarzschild度规的友好导论
classification.abstract_zh: 德国物理学家和天文学家卡尔·史瓦西于1916年找到了广义相对论场方程的第一个精确解。由于其简洁性以及多种天文学应用，史瓦西解是最重要的，这赋予它巨大的教育潜力。然而这种潜力通常未被充分利用，因为史瓦西解一般在高级本科物理课程或专门的研究生课程中讲授。本文旨在对史瓦西解作友好介绍，同时分析黎曼几何与广义相对论的一些概念，仅使用不超过微积分初步的简单数学工具。
classification.one_liner: 一篇仅用微积分基础、面向初学者的Schwarzschild解与广义相对论/黎曼几何概念教学导论。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，但为教学性介绍而非新的研究结果。

2609.17616v1.title: A closer look at Viaggiu Holographic Dark Energy with Statefinder Hierarchy and Fractional Growth Diagnostics
2609.17616v1.abstract: We employ the statefinder hierarchy along with the fractional growth parameter to investigate the recently proposed noninteracting Viaggiu holographic dark energy (VHDE) model with the future event horizon as the infrared cut-off. By adjusting different values of the VHDE model parameter $\delta$, we illustrate the evolution trajectories of several important parameters, prticularly, the statefinder hierarchy $S_3^{(1)}$, $S_3^{(2)}$, $S_4^{(1)}$, $S_4^{(2)}$ and the fractional growth parameter $\epsilon$ against the redshift $z$ and the fractional energy density of matter, $\Omega_m$. Together with the growth rate of matter perturbations, we present the statefinder hierarchy that defines a composite null diagnostic (CND), which can differentiate dynamical dark energy from $\Lambda$CDM. The joint use of the statefinder hierarchy and the fractional growth parameter offers a powerful diagnostic tool for probing VHDE, effectively resolving the degeneracy between different parameter choices within the model. We find that employing a CND pair, rather than a single diagnostic, significantly enhances the diagnostic power for the VHDE model. Finally, we perform an $\omega_d-\omega_d'$ analysis and, in addition, assess the squared sound speed $v_{s}^{2}$ to determine the model's dynamical stability under small perturbations.

classification.title_zh: 利用状态查找器层级与分数增长诊断细察 Viaggiu 全息暗能量
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用状态查找器（statefinder）层级以及分数增长参数，研究最近提出的、以未来事件视界为红外截断的非相互作用 Viaggiu 全息暗能量（VHDE）模型。通过调节 VHDE 模型参数 δ 的不同取值，我们展示了若干重要参数的演化轨迹，特别是状态查找器层级 S_3^(1)、S_3^(2)、S_4^(1)、S_4^(2) 和分数增长参数 ε 随红移 z 以及物质分数能量密度 Ω_m 的变化。结合物质扰动增长率，我们给出了定义复合零诊断（CND）的状态查找器层级，它能够区分动力学暗能量与 ΛCDM。联合使用状态查找器层级和分数增长参数为探测 VHDE 提供了强有力的诊断工具，有效解决了模型内部不同参数选择之间的简并。我们发现，采用 CND 对而非单一诊断，显著增强了对 VHDE 模型的诊断能力。最后，我们进行了 ω_d-ω_d' 分析，并评估平方声速 v_s^2，以确定模型在小扰动下的动力学稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 用 statefinder 层级和分数增长诊断检验 Viaggiu 全息暗能量模型，并用复合零诊断区分动力学暗能量与 ΛCDM。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文虽以‘全息暗能量’为名，但属于宇宙学暗能量模型诊断，不涉及 AdS/CFT 对偶或量子引力全息；与用户重点的全息强关联、纠缠/量子信息等方向关联较低，仅与经典引力/宇宙学有边缘关联。

2609.17674v1.title: Massively parallel transdimensional sampling with data assimilation: an application to LISA galactic binaries
2609.17674v1.abstract: Transdimensional Bayesian inference is becoming a key ingredient in gravitational-wave astronomy. In many relevant applications, the number of components needed to describe the data is not known a priori and must be inferred jointly with their parameters. We present a transdimensional Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework designed to exploit massive parallelism. The method evolves a population of particles through a sequence of tempered distributions and uses the No-U-Turn Sampler for the exploration of fixed-dimensional parameter space while reversible-jump birth and death moves allow the number of components to vary. The same SMC construction also enables posterior samples obtained from a shorter data segment to be updated as additional data become available, enhancing the overall efficiency of the analysis. We validate the approach on two proof-of-concept problems: the recovery of a sequence of Gaussian pulses and a simplified LISA Galactic-binary inference problem. In both cases, the method recovers the injected number of components and produces consistent posterior estimates. These results indicate that the proposed method is a promising avenue toward scalable and parallel Bayesian transdimensional inference for current and future gravitational-wave astronomy.

classification.title_zh: 大规模并行跨维采样与数据同化：应用于 LISA 银河双星
classification.abstract_zh: 跨维贝叶斯推断正在成为引力波天文学的关键组成部分。在许多相关应用中，描述数据所需的组分数目并非先验已知，必须与其参数联合推断。我们提出一个跨维序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架，旨在利用大规模并行性。该方法使粒子群通过一系列退火分布演化，并使用 No-U-Turn Sampler 探索固定维参数空间，同时可逆跳变的生灭移动允许组分数目变化。同一 SMC 构造还使得从较短数据段获得的后验样本能够在更多数据可用时得到更新，从而提高分析的整体效率。我们在两个概念验证问题上验证了该方法：恢复一系列高斯脉冲和一个简化的 LISA 银河双星推断问题。在这两种情况下，该方法都恢复了注入的组分数目，并产生一致的后验估计。这些结果表明，所提出的方法是为当前和未来引力波天文学实现可扩展并行贝叶斯跨维推断的一条有前景的途径。
classification.one_liner: 提出可大规模并行的跨维序贯蒙特卡洛推断框架，用可逆跳变与 NUTS 处理未知组分数，并在 LISA 银河双星等概念验证中验证。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波天文学/经典引力支线中的贝叶斯推断与数据同化方法，非全息研究；若关注 LISA 与引力波推断则相关，但与 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶无直接关系。

2609.18337v1.title: Searching for gravitational wave echo with group equivariant neural posterior estimation
2609.18337v1.abstract: Current methods for the gravitational-wave (GW) echo searches generally require substantial computational time and resources. Recent advances in group equivariant neural posterior estimation (GNPE) have demonstrated the potential to substantially accelerate posterior inference. In this work, we adopt this framework and train a GNPE model to perform echo searches, significantly improving computational efficiency while maintaining comparable inference accuracy. We apply it to the O4a events and find no significant evidence for the GW echo.

classification.title_zh: 用群等变神经后验估计搜寻引力波回声
classification.abstract_zh: 当前引力波（GW）回声搜寻方法通常需要大量计算时间和资源。群等变神经后验估计（GNPE）的最新进展已显示出大幅加速后验推断的潜力。在这项工作中，我们采用该框架并训练一个 GNPE 模型来进行回声搜寻，在保持相近推断精度的同时显著提高计算效率。我们将其应用于 O4a 事件，未发现引力波回声的显著证据。
classification.one_liner: 采用群等变神经后验估计加速引力波回声搜寻，并在 O4a 事件中未发现显著回声证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波观测与推断方法，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线；与全息对偶或量子引力理论无直接关联。

2609.19065v1.title: Fermionic Signatures of Antispacetime-spacetime Domain Walls
2609.19065v1.abstract: Antispacetime arises naturally in the vielbein formulation of general relativity yet remains invisible to probes coupling only to the metric. We show that domain walls separating spacetime from antispacetime constitute physically distinct and observable structures. Fermions interacting with such walls exhibit striking signatures: scattering induces particle-hole conversion, reflecting tetrad orientation reversal, while the wall hosts localized zero-energy Majorana and chiral modes. In 1+1 dimensions, these modes acquire a pseudoscalar mass term tied to topology and quantum anomalies, providing a direct link to the observability of $\theta$ vacua. These results identify fermionic response as a definitive probe of antispacetime and establish its domain walls as physically detectable.

secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 反时空-时空畴壁的费米子特征
classification.abstract_zh: 反时空自然出现在广义相对论的标架（vielbein）表述中，但对仅与度规耦合的探针不可见。我们表明，分隔时空与反时空的畴壁是物理上不同且可观测的结构。与这类畴壁相互作用的费米子表现出显著特征：散射诱导粒子-空穴转换，反映标架取向反转；同时畴壁承载局域化的零能 Majorana 模和手征模。在 1+1 维中，这些模获得与拓扑和量子反常相关的赝标量质量项，为 θ 真空的可观测性提供直接联系。这些结果将费米子响应确定为反时空的决定性探针，并确立其畴壁在物理上可探测。
classification.one_liner: 反时空-时空畴壁可通过费米子散射的粒子-空穴转换和局域 Majorana/手征模被探测，1+1 维质量项联系拓扑与 θ 真空。
classification.relevance_reason: 不属于 AdS/CFT 全息，但直接涉及广义相对论标架表述中的时空/反时空畴壁，并研究局域费米子模式，匹配经典引力与畴壁/非均匀重点标签。

2609.17665v1.title: Unifying spatial correlation with hierarchical population inference to constrain the AGN channel for binary black hole mergers
2609.17665v1.abstract: The origin of the stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs) observed in gravitational wave (GW) events by the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) detectors remains uncertain. One promising formation pathway is the active galactic nucleus (AGN) channel, in which BBHs embedded in AGN accretion discs experience enhanced merger rates and may produce rapidly spinning black holes in the upper mass gap. Previous constraints on the AGN contribution to the LVK merger population have relied either on spatial correlations between GW localisations and AGN catalogues or on modelling the intrinsic properties of GW sources. We develop a hierarchical Bayesian framework that unifies these approaches within a single likelihood for the fraction of AGN-hosted GW events, $f_{\rm agn}$. This framework, combined with the latest gravitational wave transient catalogue GWTC-5.0 and the electromagnetic Quaia AGN catalogue, cannot exclude an AGN contribution to the observed merger rate. For unobscured AGN in the optical and infrared bands with bolometric luminosities $L_{\rm bol}\geq\{10^{44.5},10^{45.5},10^{46.5}\}\,\mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$, we exclude $f_{\rm agn} \geq \{0.52,0.41, 0.61\}$ at the 95 percent credible level under our fiducial model. The methodology and results presented in this work lay down the pathway for combining the full GW posterior with electromagnetic observations to infer the properties of GW populations and AGN discs.

classification.title_zh: 将空间关联与分层族群推断统一起来以限制双黑洞并合的AGN通道
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA（LVK）探测器在引力波（GW）事件中观测到的恒星级双黑洞（BBH）的起源仍不确定。一个有前景的形成途径是活动星系核（AGN）通道，其中嵌入AGN吸积盘内的BBH经历增强的并合率，并可能在上质量间隙中产生快速自旋的黑洞。此前对AGN在LVK并合族群中贡献的限制，要么依赖于GW定位与AGN星表之间的空间关联，要么依赖于对GW源内禀性质的建模。我们发展了一个分层贝叶斯框架，将这两种方法统一在关于AGN宿主GW事件比例 f_agn 的单个似然中。该框架结合最新的引力波瞬变星表 GWTC-5.0 和电磁 Quaia AGN 星表，无法排除AGN对所观测并合率的贡献。对于光学和红外波段中未被遮蔽、热辐射光度 L_bol ≥ {10^44.5, 10^45.5, 10^46.5} erg/s 的AGN，在我们基准模型下，我们在95%可信水平排除 f_agn ≥ {0.52, 0.41, 0.61}。这项工作提出的方法和结果为将完整GW后验与电磁观测结合起来以推断GW族群和AGN盘的性质铺平了道路。
classification.one_liner: 该工作提出统一空间关联与分层族群推断的贝叶斯框架，利用 GWTC-5.0 与 Quaia AGN 星表限制双黑洞并合的 AGN 通道贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于引力波与黑洞天体物理，使用GW观测和AGN星表限制双黑洞并合形成通道，可归入“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线中的引力波方向；但它不涉及全息、AdS/CFT或量子引力。

2609.17668v1.title: Proper Time Shifts in Pulsar Timing Arrays
2609.17668v1.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays are a powerful tool for probing low-frequency gravitational phenomena and physics beyond the Standard Model. We establish a general, gauge-invariant framework for the timing residual by identifying the measurable quantity as the proper time interval between consecutive pulse arrivals at Earth. In linearized general relativity, we derive a general expression for this proper time shift and show that it decomposes into Doppler, Shapiro, and Einstein delay contributions whose sum is gauge invariant, similar to frameworks that have been developed for other gravitational-wave detectors such as laser and atom interferometers. We also provide a recipe for computing the resulting timing residual for any specified perturbation, and we illustrate the method with several physically well-motivated sources, recovering known results where they exist in the literature. This recipe can be directly applied to search for new physics from real pulsar timing data using existing numerical software.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时移
classification.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列是探测低频引力现象和超越标准模型物理的有力工具。我们建立了一个关于计时残差的普适且规范不变的框架，将可测量量认定为地球处连续脉冲到达之间的固有时时间间隔。在线性化广义相对论中，我们推导了该固有时移的一般表达式，并表明它分解为多普勒延迟、夏皮罗延迟和爱因斯坦延迟贡献，其总和规范不变，类似于为激光干涉仪和原子干涉仪等其他引力波探测器所建立的框架。我们还给出了对任意指定微扰计算所得计时残差的方法，并用若干物理动机明确的源来说明该方法，在文献已有结果处重现了已知结果。该方案可直接应用于利用现有数值软件从真实脉冲星计时数据中搜寻新物理。
classification.one_liner: 建立脉冲星计时阵列中规范不变的固有时移框架，统一推导多普勒、夏皮罗与爱因斯坦延迟并用于新物理搜寻。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究线性化广义相对论、引力波探测与脉冲星计时，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2609.17928v1.title: Infrared Universality of Scalar Induced Gravitational Waves Beyond Second Order
2609.17928v1.abstract: Primordial black hole dark matter is formed from the collapse of enhanced primordial density fluctuations. The formation of primordial black holes is accompanied by scalar induced gravitational waves whose infrared scaling only depends on the equation of state, $w$, of the background at leading order. Establishing whether this characteristic scaling remains robust under corrections of arbitrary perturbative order, including in the presence of non-Gaussianities, requires a physical understanding of the infrared scaling. In this work, we provide such a physical interpretation. We find that the stress of sound waves with nearly equal frequencies produces a slow beat. Although the incoming waves oscillate rapidly, this slow beat continues to source the long wavelength tensor perturbation before its horizon entry, thus generating an infrared scaling that only depends on the expanding background. We show that higher order interactions generate freely propagating waves that finally lead to the same slow beat deep inside the horizon. Since non-Gaussianities would not change the speed of the freely propagating waves, they do not modify the infrared scaling. As the source with a slow beat has enough time to accumulate before the horizon entry of the infrared tensor mode, it records the background expansion and thus the infrared scaling could provide a robust probe of the cosmological equation of state.

classification.title_zh: 二阶以上标量诱导引力波的红外普适性
classification.abstract_zh: 原初黑洞暗物质由增强的原初密度扰动坍缩形成。原初黑洞的形成伴随标量诱导引力波，其红外标度在领头阶只依赖于背景的状态方程 w。要确定这一特征标度在任意微扰阶修正下（包括存在非高斯性时）是否仍然稳健，需要对红外标度有物理理解。本文提供了这种物理解释。我们发现，频率近似相等的声波应力会产生慢拍。尽管入射波快速振荡，这种慢拍在其视界进入之前持续作为长波长张量扰动的源，从而产生只依赖于膨胀背景的红外标度。我们表明，高阶相互作用会产生自由传播的波，这些波最终在视界深处导致相同的慢拍。由于非高斯性不会改变自由传播波的速度，因此它们不会修改红外标度。由于具有慢拍的源在红外张量模进入视界之前有足够时间积累，它记录了背景膨胀，因此红外标度可以为宇宙学状态方程提供稳健的探针。
classification.one_liner: 标量诱导引力波的红外标度源于近等频声波的慢拍，只依赖于背景状态方程，且对高阶微扰和非高斯性稳健。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于宇宙学中的标量诱导引力波/经典引力波研究，匹配‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签，但与全息、AdS/CFT 及各全息凝聚态支线无直接关系。

2609.18664v1.title: Timelike Ollivier-Ricci curvature
2609.18664v1.abstract: We introduce a codimension one construction of coarse Ricci curvature in Lorentzian geometry. Using the $1$-Lorentz-Wasserstein distance $\ell_1$, we compare probability measures supported on small spacelike hypersurfaces through nearby events and recover, in a precise asymptotic regime, the ambient Ricci curvature in future-directed unit timelike directions, with a universal dimensional prefactor reflecting this codimension one construction. The construction echoes the Raychaudhuri equation, which relates the evolution of spatial volume expansion along timelike geodesics to Ricci curvature. Our quantitative estimates rely on transport maps with controlled displacement, constructed through a Moser-type flow. At leading order, the slice construction is insensitive to smooth weights. By smearing the spacelike slices into thin timelike tubes and calibrating the temporal and spatial scales, we recover the timelike Bakry-\'Emery tensor $\mathrm{Ric}+\mathrm{Hess}\,V$ associated with the weighted reference measure $\smash{\mathfrak{m}=\mathrm{e}^{-V}\,\mathrm{vol}_g}$.

classification.title_zh: 时间性 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率
classification.abstract_zh: 我们引入一种在洛伦兹几何中余维一构造的粗粒化 Ricci 曲率。利用 1-Lorentz-Wasserstein 距离 ℓ1，我们通过邻近事件比较支撑在小类空超曲面上的概率测度，并在精确渐近区域恢复沿未来指向单位类时方向的背景 Ricci 曲率，具有反映该余维一构造的普适维度前因子。该构造呼应 Raychaudhuri 方程，后者将沿类时测地线的空间体积膨胀演化与 Ricci 曲率联系起来。我们的定量估计依赖于通过 Moser 型流构造的受控位移输运映射。在领头阶，切片构造对光滑权重不敏感。通过将类空切片涂抹为薄类时管并校准时间与空间尺度，我们恢复与加权参考测度 m=e^{-V} vol_g 相关的时间性 Bakry-Émery 张量 Ric+Hess V。
classification.one_liner: 在洛伦兹几何中通过最优传输构造余维一粗粒 Ricci 曲率，并渐近恢复时间性 Ricci 曲率及 Bakry-Émery 张量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典洛伦兹几何/广义相对论中的 Ricci 曲率与 Raychaudhuri 方程主题，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；不涉及全息、量子引力或黑洞信息。

2601.05734v2.title: A nonlinear voice from GW250114 ringdown
2601.05734v2.abstract: Gravitational-wave astronomy, by detecting ripples in spacetime, has opened a new window to observe compact objects and probe theories of gravity in the nonlinear strong-field regime. The ringdown signal of a binary black hole merger contains a superposition of damped sinusoids known as quasi-normal modes (Ref.[1]), whose frequencies are completely determined by the mass and spin of the remnant black hole and form the basis of black hole spectroscopy (Refs.[2-4]). A crucial prediction yet to be observationally confirmed is the existence of quadratic quasi-normal modes, which represent fundamental properties associated with wave-wave coupling in general relativity, and the leading mode is predicted to be detectable with next-generation ground-based detectors (Refs.[5-7]) using traditional methods. Here we show the first observational evidence for a set of quadratic quasi-normal modes in the ringdown of the binary black hole merger GW250114, the loudest gravitational-wave event detected to date, enabled by a novel analysis. These nonlinear modes result from the quadratic coupling of the linear $(2,2,n)$ modes with $n\leq3$. Starting the analysis at a time corresponding to four times the remnant mass ($M_\mathrm{f}$) after the merger, the evidence for their presence reaches a Bayes factor of 62. A phenomenological test allowing these modes to deviate from the theoretical prediction rejects the zero-amplitude hypothesis at a significance of 3.4 $\sigma$, while the inferred amplitude and complex frequency are consistent with the prediction of general relativity. This finding provides the first observational evidence of gravitational wave-wave interaction and extends black hole spectroscopy from the linear to the nonlinear regime. It also establishes a new direction for testing the fundamental nonlinear structure of general relativity with the most extreme gravity.

classification.title_zh: 来自 GW250114 铃宕的非线性之声
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波天文学通过探测时空中的涟漪，打开了观测致密天体并在非线性强场区检验引力理论的新窗口。双黑洞并合的铃宕信号包含被称为准正规模的阻尼正弦叠加，其频率完全由残余黑洞的质量和自旋决定，并构成黑洞谱学的基础。一个尚未被观测证实的关键预言是二次准正规模的存在，它们代表广义相对论中波-波耦合相关的基本性质，并且主要模式被预测可用传统方法在下一代地面探测器中被探测到。这里我们展示了对双黑洞并合 GW250114（迄今探测到的最响引力波事件）铃宕中一组二次准正规模的首次观测证据，这得益于一种新的分析。这些非线性模式来自线性 (2,2,n) 模式（n≤3）的二次耦合。从并合后对应于四倍残余质量 (M_f) 的时间开始分析，它们存在的证据达到贝叶斯因子 62。一个允许这些模式偏离理论预言的唯象检验以 3.4σ 的显著性排除零振幅假设，而推断的振幅和复频率与广义相对论的预言一致。这一发现提供了引力波-波相互作用的首次观测证据，并将黑洞谱学从线性扩展到非线性区。它也为用最极端引力检验广义相对论的基本非线性结构确立了一个新方向。
classification.one_liner: 在 GW250114 铃宕中发现二次准正规模的观测证据，将黑洞谱学从线性推进到非线性区。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文直接研究双黑洞并合铃宕中的准正规模与非线性波-波耦合，属于经典引力/广义相对论，并对应 QNM 与非线性演化重点方向。

2603.08795v2.title: Inspirals into bosonic dark matter stars and chirp mimickers
2603.08795v2.abstract: We investigate extreme--mass--ratio inspirals in which a stellar-mass compact object orbits a supermassive bosonic dark matter star, modeled as a boson star, using fully relativistic perturbative methods. Unlike inspirals around electro-vacuum black holes, these systems can shed scalar matter through dynamical friction which significantly alters the inspiral dynamics. We show that this additional dissipation can induce a chirp-like gravitational-wave signal closely resembling that of black hole binaries, allowing boson stars to act as gravitational-wave chirp mimickers even when they are not ultracompact. The inspiral evolution and resulting waveform depend sensitively on the compactness of the central boson star: highly compact configurations trigger dipolar scalar radiation, leading to a rapid plunge, whereas less compact stars yield smoother inspirals dominated by gravitational and quadrupolar scalar waves. To support waveform modeling, we derive semi-analytical prescriptions for the gravitational and scalar energy fluxes that remain accurate deep into the relativistic regime. Our findings indicate that future space-based detectors such as LISA could distinguish these mimicker signals from true black hole inspirals through measurable phase dephasings induced by scalar dissipation.
