classification.title_zh: 向玻色暗物质星的旋进与啁啾模仿者
classification.abstract_zh: 我们使用完全相对论性的微扰方法研究极端质量比旋进，其中一颗恒星级致密天体绕着一颗超大质量玻色暗物质星（建模为玻色星）运行。与绕电真空黑洞的旋进不同，这些系统可以通过动力学摩擦抛出标量物质，从而显著改变旋进动力学。我们表明，这种额外耗散可以产生类啁啾引力波信号，与黑洞双星的信号高度相似，使得玻色星即使在并非超致密时也能充当引力波啁啾模仿者。旋进演化和由此产生的波形敏感地依赖于中心玻色星的致密度：高度致密的构型会触发偶极标量辐射，导致快速坠落；而致密度较低的星体产生由引力和四极标量波主导的更平滑旋进。为支持波形建模，我们推导了引力和标量能量通量的半解析表达式，这些表达式在深入相对论区域时仍保持准确。我们的发现表明，未来天基探测器（如 LISA）可以通过标量耗散引起的可测量相位退相，将这些模仿者信号与真实黑洞旋进区分开。
classification.one_liner: 玻色暗物质星上的极端质量比旋进可通过动力学摩擦耗散标量物质，产生与黑洞双星相似的啁啾引力波，LISA 可借相位退相区分。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波天体物理，涉及玻色星（孤子/非均匀构型）和 EMRI；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2605.28376v2.title: Distorting Kerr Images with Parity-Odd Scalar Hair
2605.28376v2.abstract: We investigate thin-disk imaging of Kerr black holes with synchronized scalar hair, focusing on backreacted parity-odd excited states of a complex scalar field minimally coupled to Einstein gravity. The spacetime displays a core-double-torus lensing structure, with a central black hole surrounded by two scalar clouds. We study the dependence of the images on hair strength and viewing angle, identifying a weak-hair regime close to Kerr. With increasing hair, the photon ring and shadow region shrink and become more distorted. In the strong-hair regime, gravitational lensing produces new features, including multiple disconnected shadow components, crescent-shaped structures, and signatures of chaotic lensing. For nearly edge-on viewing angles, repeated equatorial crossings generate nested ring-like patterns. These results highlight possible geometric signatures of black holes with excited scalar hair.

classification.title_zh: 宇称奇标量毛发对 Kerr 黑洞图像的扭曲
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有同步标量毛发的 Kerr 黑洞的薄盘成像，重点关注复标量场与 Einstein 引力最小耦合的反作用宇称奇激发态。该时空呈现核心-双环面透镜结构，中心黑洞被两个标量云包围。我们研究了图像对毛发强度和观测角度的依赖，识别出接近 Kerr 的弱毛发区域。随着毛发增强，光子环和阴影区域收缩并变得更加扭曲。在强毛发区域，引力透镜产生新特征，包括多个不连通的阴影成分、新月形结构以及混沌透镜的迹象。对于近乎侧视的观测角度，重复的赤道穿越产生嵌套环状图案。这些结果突出了具有激发标量毛发的黑洞可能的几何特征。
classification.one_liner: 宇称奇同步标量毛发会显著扭曲 Kerr 黑洞的薄盘图像，在强毛发下产生多阴影、新月形和混沌透镜等几何特征。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论中的黑洞时空与强透镜成像，并对应重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2606.10776v3.title: Self-stimulated avalanche in superradiant axion clouds
2606.10776v3.abstract: Boson clouds formed via superradiance around spinning black holes offer a novel probe of ultralight particles. We show that such gravitational atoms can undergo a self-stimulated avalanche: a coherent quadrupolar transition is seeded by external gravitational waves and amplified by self-generated radiation feedback. We formulate an effective two-level description that captures the logistic population transfer and the resulting delayed gravitational-wave pulse with a characteristic envelope. This cooperative emission mechanism opens a new observational avenue into the ultralight dark sector.

classification.title_zh: 超辐射轴子云中的自激雪崩
classification.abstract_zh: 围绕旋转黑洞通过超辐射形成的玻色子云为探测超轻粒子提供了新途径。我们表明，此类引力原子可以经历自激雪崩：一个相干四极跃迁由外部引力波种子触发，并通过自身产生的辐射反馈被放大。我们建立了一个有效二能级描述，刻画了逻辑斯蒂布居转移以及由此产生的具有特征包络的延迟引力波脉冲。这种协同发射机制为观测超轻暗部门开辟了新途径。
classification.one_liner: 黑洞超辐射轴子云可通过自激雪崩产生特征延迟引力波脉冲，为超轻暗物质探测提供新途径。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于黑洞超辐射与引力波相关的经典引力现象，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但与全息对偶及其重点全息支线无直接关系。

2607.01724v2.title: Classical and Loop Quantum Cosmology of Interacting Dark Energy: A Dynamical System Analysis with Superfluid Dark Matter and Dust Matter
2607.01724v2.abstract: We study the cosmological dynamics of interacting dark energy and dark matter in Classical Einstein Gravity and Loop Quantum Cosmology. Two dark matter scenarios are considered: superfluid dark matter described by a generalized cubic equation of state and the standard pressureless fluid. The dark energy component is modeled using both a generalized nonlinear equation of state and a constant equation of state. We examine two phenomenological interaction terms, $Q=\alpha\dot{\rho}_m$ and $Q=\beta\dot{\rho}_d$, which govern the energy transfer between the dark sectors. In classical gravity, the pressureless matter model exhibits stable late-time attractors, whereas the superfluid dark matter model admits only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. Extending the analysis to Loop Quantum Cosmology, quantum geometric corrections replace the Big Bang singularity with a nonsingular quantum bounce, and significantly modify the phase-space dynamics. As a result, the stable attractors of the classical pressureless matter model disappear, and all interacting models possess only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. These findings highlight the significant influence of both dark matter properties and quantum gravitational effects on the asymptotic evolution of interacting dark-sectors.

classification.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量的经典与圈量子宇宙学：超流暗物质和尘埃物质的动力学系统分析
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在经典爱因斯坦引力和圈量子宇宙学中研究相互作用暗能量与暗物质的宇宙学动力学。考虑两种暗物质情形：由广义三次状态方程描述的超流暗物质，以及标准无压流体。暗能量组分则分别用广义非线性状态方程和常状态方程建模。我们考察两个现象学相互作用项，Q=α\dot{\rho}_m 和 Q=β\dot{\rho}_d，它们控制暗部门之间的能量转移。在经典引力中，无压物质模型展现出稳定的晚期吸引子，而超流暗物质模型只允许鞍点和非双曲临界点。将分析推广到圈量子宇宙学后，量子几何修正将大爆炸奇点替换为无奇点量子反弹，并显著改变相空间动力学。结果，经典无压物质模型的稳定吸引子消失，所有相互作用模型都只具有鞍点和非双曲临界点。这些发现凸显了暗物质性质和量子引力效应对相互作用暗部门渐近演化的显著影响。
classification.one_liner: 论文用动力学系统比较经典引力与圈量子宇宙学中相互作用暗能量模型，发现量子反弹修正会消除经典稳定晚期吸引子。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文包含经典爱因斯坦引力框架下的宇宙学动力学，并属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；但主体是暗能量/暗物质动力学系统与圈量子宇宙学，不涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

2609.02825v2.title: Charged black-hole binary radiation at second post-Newtonian order
2609.02825v2.abstract: In this work, we build on Ref.~[Phys.~Rev.~D 112, 124060 (2025)], where we derived the dynamics of an electrically charged binary system at second post-Newtonian (2PN) order, by extending the analysis, at the same PN accuracy, to the associated emission of electromagnetic and gravitational radiation. We focus on non-spinning binaries that evolve quasi-adiabatically along a sequence of circular orbits, and compute the 2PN expression for the corresponding total energy flux at infinity. With respect to the well-known case of a neutral binary, the presence of charge induces both a new leading-order electromagnetic contribution of dipolar nature and additional charge-dependent corrections in the gravitational sector. To account for this richer phenomenology, we extend both the PN-matched multipolar post-Minkowskian and the effective field theory approaches to the radiation sector of charged binaries, with exact agreement for the contributions computed independently in both formalisms. We derive the radiative symmetric-trace-free multipole moments of the vector and gravitational fields at 2PN order. In doing so, we also compute 2PN-accurate charge-dependent corrections to the spherical multipoles of the waveform emitted by the binary, including a new memory contribution sourced by the stress-energy tensor of the electromagnetic radiation. These results lay the foundation for developing accurate waveform models capable of assessing the observational signatures of electric charge in gravitational-wave signals.

classification.title_zh: 带电黑洞双星在二阶后牛顿阶的辐射
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在先前工作的基础上，将电带电双星系统在二阶后牛顿（2PN）阶的动力学分析扩展到相应的电磁辐射与引力辐射发射。作者聚焦于无自旋、沿圆轨道准绝热演化的双星，计算了无穷远处总能量通量的2PN表达式。与中性双星情形相比，电荷会引入新的领头阶偶极电磁贡献，并在引力部分带来额外的电荷相关修正。为处理这一更丰富的现象学，作者将PN匹配的多极后闵可夫斯基方法和有效场论方法推广到带电双星辐射部分，两种形式独立计算的贡献完全一致。文中给出了矢量场与引力场在2PN阶的辐射对称无迹多极矩，并计算了双星发射波形的2PN精度电荷相关球多极修正，其中包括由电磁辐射应力能量张量产生的新记忆贡献。这些结果为发展能够评估引力波信号中电荷观测特征的精确波形模型奠定了基础。
classification.one_liner: 将带电黑洞双星的2PN动力学推进到辐射 sector，计算电磁与引力能量通量、多极矩及波形中的新记忆效应。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论框架下带电双星的引力波与电磁辐射，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线。

2609.14199v2.title: From massless wormholes to massive black bounces: Shadows and multiple light rings
2609.14199v2.abstract: We develop a general framework for constructing massive black bounce geometries from massless wormhole seeds by introducing a position-dependent mass function while preserving the underlying areal-radius profile. We apply this procedure to the generalized Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole and obtain a new family of generalized Bardeen-like black bounce space-times, which continuously interpolates between traversable wormholes and regular black holes. We investigate the motion of massive particles and photons and show that, in contrast with the simpler orbital structure of the massless generalized Ellis-Bronnikov geometry, the generalized Bardeen-like space-time can exhibit multiple circular orbits and a rich light ring structure, including configurations with two unstable circular photon orbits separated by a stable one. We determine the corresponding photon sphere and shadow radii and compare our predictions with Event Horizon Telescope observations of Sgr A*, deriving observational constraints on the parameter space of the model. We further investigate the optical appearance produced by a geometrically and optically thin accretion disk through ray tracing. Multiple light rings generate characteristic nested structures in the high-resolution intensity profiles, whose relative brightness is strongly affected by the mass deformation and gravitational redshift. However, after modeling the finite angular resolution of the EHT with a Gaussian beam convolution, these fine structures are largely washed out, revealing a strong observational degeneracy between these exotic compact objects and standard black hole geometries at current EHT resolution.

classification.title_zh: 从无质量虫洞到有质量黑洞反弹：阴影与多重光环
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个通用框架，通过引入位置相关的质量函数，同时保持底层面积半径剖面，从无质量虫洞种子构造有质量黑洞反弹几何。我们将该过程应用于广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞，得到一类新的广义类 Bardeen 黑洞反弹时空，它在可穿越虫洞和规则黑洞之间连续插值。我们研究有质量粒子和光子的运动，并表明与无质量广义 Ellis-Bronnikov 几何较简单的轨道结构相比，广义类 Bardeen 时空可以表现出多重圆轨道和丰富的光环结构，包括两个不稳定圆光子轨道被一个稳定圆光子轨道分隔的构型。我们确定相应的光子球和阴影半径，并将我们的预言与事件视界望远镜对 Sgr A* 的观测比较，得到模型参数空间的观测约束。我们进一步通过光线追踪研究几何和光学薄吸积盘产生的光学外观。多重光环在高分辨率强度剖面中产生特征性的嵌套结构，其相对亮度受到质量形变和引力红移的强烈影响。然而，在用高斯光束卷积模拟 EHT 有限角分辨率后，这些精细结构在很大程度上被抹平，表明在当前 EHT 分辨率下，这些奇异致密天体与标准黑洞几何之间存在强烈的观测简并。
classification.one_liner: 通过位置相关质量函数从无质量虫洞生成有质量黑洞反弹，发现多重光环与阴影，并指出当前EHT分辨率下与标准黑洞存在观测简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 纯经典引力/致密天体阴影与光环研究，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，与全息对偶无直接关系。

2609.15119v2.title: Inspiral waveforms of charged compact binaries and observational constraints
2609.15119v2.abstract: Electric charges carried by compact objects can affect binary dynamics and imprint characteristic signatures on gravitational-wave signals. We derive next-to-leading-order post-Newtonian frequency-domain waveforms for charged compact binaries in both the gravitational-quadrupole and electric-dipole dominated regimes, including electromagnetic corrections beyond leading-order electric-dipole radiation that reduce the degeneracy between the component charge-to-mass ratios. Using gravitational wave events from GWTC-5.0, we place constraints on the charge-to-mass ratio and mass of each component of the binary system.

classification.title_zh: 带电致密双星的旋进波形与观测约束
classification.abstract_zh: 致密天体所携带的电荷会影响双星动力学，并在引力波信号中留下特征性印记。我们推导了带电致密双星在引力四极主导和电偶极主导两种情形下的次领头阶后牛顿频域波形，包含超越领头阶电偶极辐射的电磁修正，这些修正降低了各分量电荷质量比之间的简并。利用 GWTC-5.0 的引力波事件，我们对双星系统各分量的电荷质量比和质量给出了约束。
classification.one_liner: 推导带电致密双星次领头阶后牛顿频域旋进波形，并利用 GWTC-5.0 约束电荷质量比与质量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典引力/广义相对论框架下的引力波旋进波形与观测约束，符合用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2609.16016v2.title: Inverse Reconstruction of Causal Nonlinear Electrodynamics: Functional Families, Spectral Constraints, and Single-Horizon Black Holes
2609.16016v2.abstract: Nonlinear electrodynamics (NLED) admits many causal theories, so causality alone does not provide a unique selection principle. We formulate an inverse construction in which constitutive integrability, the Maxwell weak-field limit, and causal propagation are imposed before either a Lagrangian or a spacetime geometry is chosen. An affine-separable reduction of the two-invariant Pleba\'nski class yields an infinite-dimensional causal family $\mathcal{C}_X$, characterized by a bounded logarithmic index; Born-Infeld is its unique self-dual member, while generic members are birefringent. On the magnetic axis, complete monotonicity gives a positive spectral representation. Finite monopole self-energy is equivalent to the existence of the spectral moment of order $-1/4$, whereas global magnetic causality restricts the support. Generalized-gamma spectra are simultaneously causal and finite-energy precisely for $1/4<\gamma\le1/2$, independently of the shape parameter, and a separate criterion determines when the magnetic law admits a causal two-invariant completion. After coupling to Einstein gravity, a positive magnetic response and characteristic factor, finite self-energy, and nonnegative residual mass imply a strictly increasing metric function, excluding more than one positive horizon; positive residual mass guarantees a unique horizon. The two optical metrics of $\mathcal{C}_X$ remain Lorentzian with overlapping timelike cones, establishing symmetric hyperbolicity of the electromagnetic subsystem. Thus inverse matter selection connects local causal consistency to global black-hole structure without prescribing the geometry.

classification.title_zh: 因果非线性电动力学的逆重构：函数族、谱约束与单视界黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 非线性电动力学（NLED）允许许多因果理论，因此仅凭因果性并不能提供唯一的选择原则。我们提出一种逆构造：在选定拉格朗日量或时空几何之前，先施加本构可积性、麦克斯韦弱场极限和因果传播条件。对双不变量 Plebański 类的仿射可分约化给出一个无限维因果族 C_X，其特征是有界对数指标；Born-Infeld 是其唯一的自对偶成员，而一般成员具有双折射。在磁轴上，完全单调性给出正谱表示。有限单极自能等价于 -1/4 阶谱矩的存在，而全局磁因果性限制其支集。广义伽马谱同时满足因果性和有限能量，当且仅当 1/4<γ≤1/2，且与形状参数无关；另一个判据决定磁定律何时允许因果的双不变量完备化。耦合到 Einstein 引力后，正磁响应与特征因子、有限自能以及非负剩余质量意味着度规函数严格递增，从而排除多于一个正视界；正剩余质量保证唯一视界。C_X 的两个光学度规保持洛伦兹号差且时间锥重叠，确立了电磁子系统的对称双曲性。因此，逆物质选择将局部因果一致性与全局黑洞结构联系起来，而无需预先指定几何。
classification.one_liner: 通过逆构造从因果性、可积性和弱场极限筛选非线性电动力学，并证明其与爱因斯坦引力耦合时限制黑洞视界数量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典非线性电动力学及其与爱因斯坦引力的耦合，涉及黑洞视界结构，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息。

2609.16477v2.title: Correlated Galactic Confusion Foreground for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin Network and Its Impacts on Resolvable-Source Analysis
2609.16477v2.abstract: The millihertz gravitational-wave sky is expected to be observed by a network of space-based detectors (LISA, Taiji, and TianQin) in the 2030s. A dominant noise in this band is the confusion foreground produced by O(10^7) unresolved Galactic binaries (GBs). Because the same population projects onto the time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels of the different detectors, the foreground is necessarily correlated across the network. We construct the full foreground noise covariance matrix for the LISA-Taiji-TianQin network from a catalogue of ~3 x 10^7 GBs through numerical simulation, and we derive an analytic model of the cross-detector foreground coherence that provides a cross-check and physical interpretation of the numerical results. We derive the overall sensitivity of the detector network based on this covariance matrix, and further characterize the frequency- and time-dependent cross-detector foreground correlations. Taking massive black hole binaries (MBHBs) and GBs as representative transient and continuous sources, we further compare the block-diagonal (i.e., neglecting the cross-detector foreground correlation) and full-covariance noise models in terms of their impacts on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), parameter uncertainties, and Bayesian posteriors. The impact is confined to specific signal regimes, affecting primarily high-mass (M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun) MBHBs and low-frequency (f_0 <~ 2 mHz) GBs, with SNR relative differences of up to ~30% and ~10%, respectively. No statistically significant parameter bias arises under either noise model, as verified by probability-probability tests. Parameter estimations for MBHBs and GBs are performed using the network analysis pipelines implemented in the Triangle-BBH and Triangle-GB codes. Both repositories, together with the simulated foreground data and network sensitivities, are publicly released for diverse scientific investigations.

classification.title_zh: LISA-太极-天琴网络的相关银河混淆前景及其对可分辨源分析的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 毫赫兹引力波天空预计将在2030年代由空间引力波探测器网络（LISA、太极和天琴）观测。该频段的一个主导噪声是由 O(10^7) 个未分辨银河双星（GBs）产生的混淆前景。由于同一星族投影到不同探测器的时间延迟干涉（TDI）通道上，该前景在网络中必然是相关的。我们通过数值模拟，从约 3 x 10^7 个 GBs 的目录构建了 LISA-太极-天琴 网络的完整前景噪声协方差矩阵，并推导了跨探测器前景相干性的解析模型，用于对数值结果进行交叉检验和物理解释。基于该协方差矩阵，我们推导了探测器网络的整体灵敏度，并进一步刻画了频率和时间依赖的跨探测器前景相关性。以超大质量黑洞双星（MBHBs）和 GBs 作为代表性的暂现源和连续源，我们进一步比较了块对角（即忽略跨探测器前景相关性）噪声模型与完整协方差噪声模型在信噪比（SNR）、参数不确定度和贝叶斯后验上的影响。该影响局限于特定信号区域，主要影响高质量（M_c ~ 10^7 M_sun）MBHBs 和低频（f_0 <~ 2 mHz）GBs，SNR 相对差异分别可达约 30% 和约 10%。在两种噪声模型下均未出现统计显著参数偏差，这通过概率-概率检验得到验证。MBHBs 和 GBs 的参数估计使用 Triangle-BBH 和 Triangle-GB 代码中实现的网络分析流程完成。两个代码库连同模拟前景数据和网络灵敏度均已公开发布，供多样化的科学研究使用。
classification.one_liner: 构建 LISA-太极-天琴 网络的相关银河双星混淆前景协方差，并评估其对可分辨源参数估计的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于空间引力波探测器网络的数据分析与前景噪声建模，匹配经典引力/引力波方向，但不涉及全息、量子引力或理论物理核心问题。

2609.18202v1.title: Gravitational lensing of neutrinos through the lens of decoherence
2609.18202v1.abstract: We propose a new source of neutrino decoherence arising from stochastic gravitational lensing by unresolved mass substructure. Unlike traditional models that treat the lensing potential as smooth and deterministic, we decompose the lensing potential into a smooth component and a stochastic population of compact clumps. The substructure induced fluctuations of the lensing potential generate stochastic corrections to the neutrino time delay, thereby producing random relative phases between different neutrino mass eigenstates. Averaging over the clump ensemble converts these phase fluctuations into an effective dampening of flavour coherence. This framework connects stochastic gravitational lensing with neutrino phenomenology and offers a novel route to probe dark matter substructure through astrophysical neutrino flavour transitions.

classification.title_zh: 从退相干视角看中微子的引力透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的中微子退相干来源，它来自未被分辨的质量子结构引起的随机引力透镜效应。不同于将透镜势视为光滑且确定性的传统模型，我们把透镜势分解为光滑分量和随机分布的致密团块。子结构导致的透镜势涨落会对中微子时间延迟产生随机修正，从而在不同中微子质量本征态之间产生随机相对相位。对团块系综取平均后，这些相位涨落转化为对味道相干性的有效阻尼。该框架将随机引力透镜与中微子现象学联系起来，并为通过天体物理中微子味道转换探测暗物质子结构提供了新途径。
classification.one_liner: 把未分辨暗物质团块造成的随机引力透镜视为中微子退相干来源，并提出用中微子味道转换探测暗物质子结构。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息研究；主要涉及经典引力透镜与中微子退相干/暗物质子结构，仅与‘经典引力/广义相对论’重点标签有间接关联。

2606.27465v2.title: Modelling Dissipative Dynamics of r-mode Instability in Hybrid Stars
2606.27465v2.abstract: Compact star cores reach extreme densities and may contain exotic dense-matter phases. Information about the exotic interiors of rapidly rotating pulsars can be inferred from r-mode oscillations, whose stability is governed by viscous dissipation. In this work, we model a compact star containing a possible mixed phase of hadronic and quark matter and employ a hybrid statistical framework based on Bayesian inference to infer the dissipation time scales associated with the hybrid phase. Using low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXB) timing observations together with mass-radius constraints from the Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) mission, we estimate the shear and bulk viscosity contributions to r-mode damping for a hybrid star of two layers. Our inference yields shear and bulk viscous dissipation time scales of $\tau_s=(4.99^{+0.49}_{-0.52}) \times 10^8 T^{\frac{5}{3}}$s and $\tau_B=(2.150^{+1.23}_{-0.60}) \times 10^{19} (T^4 10^{-12}+T^2 10^{-6})^{-1}\Omega^{-2}$s respectively. The timescales thus obtained can be implemented to obtain the minima of the star's rotation frequency at $\Omega=451.87$ Hz at temperature $T=0.259$ MeV for a hybrid star of mass $1.5$ $M_{\odot}$ and $\Omega=517.47$ Hz at $T=0.234$ MeV for $M=1.75 M_{\odot}$. We find that the instability window obtained through the inference framework effectively explains the observed stability of millisecond pulsars in both the radio and LMXB populations, particularly for XTE J0929-314 and XTE J1807-294, J0437-4715, J2124-3358, respectively. These results demonstrate that Bayesian inference combined with r-mode phenomenology provides a powerful and observationally consistent framework for constraining the transport properties of dense hybrid matter.

classification.title_zh: 混合星中 r 模不稳定性的耗散动力学建模
classification.abstract_zh: 致密星核心可达到极端密度，并可能包含奇异致密物质相。快速旋转脉冲星奇异内部的信息可由 r 模振荡推断，而其稳定性由黏性耗散决定。在本工作中，我们建模一颗包含可能的强子与夸克物质混合相的致密星，并采用基于贝叶斯推断的混合统计框架来推断与混合相相关的耗散时间尺度。利用低质量 X 射线双星（LMXB）计时观测以及中子星内部组成探测探索者（NICER）任务给出的质量-半径限制，我们估计了双层混合星的剪切黏性和体黏性对 r 模阻尼的贡献。我们的推断给出剪切和体黏性耗散时间尺度分别为 τ_s=(4.99^{+0.49}_{-0.52}) × 10^8 T^{5/3} s 和 τ_B=(2.150^{+1.23}_{-0.60}) × 10^{19} (T^4 10^{-12}+T^2 10^{-6})^{-1} Ω^{-2} s。由此得到的时间尺度可用于获得恒星转动频率的极小值：对于质量为 1.5 M⊙ 的混合星，在温度 T=0.259 MeV 时 Ω=451.87 Hz；对于 M=1.75 M⊙，在 T=0.234 MeV 时 Ω=517.47 Hz。我们发现，通过推断框架得到的不稳定性窗口能有效解释射电和 LMXB 族群中毫秒脉冲星观测到的稳定性，特别是 XTE J0929-314 和 XTE J1807-294、J0437-4715、J2124-3358。这些结果表明，贝叶斯推断结合 r 模现象学为约束致密混合物质的输运性质提供了一个强大且与观测一致的框架。
classification.one_liner: 用贝叶斯推断从 LMXB/NICER 观测约束混合星 r 模黏性耗散时间尺度，并解释毫秒脉冲星的观测稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/致密星与输运研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、AdS/CFT 或量子引力。

2606.11825v2.title: A singularity theorem in terms of asymptotic expansion
2606.11825v2.abstract: We prove a sharp singularity theorem in which the classical focusing hypothesis of Hawking--Penrose theory is replaced by a condition on the asymptotic volume growth of timelike geodesics. More precisely, let $(M,g)$ be a smooth, globally hyperbolic Lorentzian manifold satisfying the strong energy condition, and let $V\subset M$ be a smooth, compact Cauchy hypersurface. We associate to the future-directed timelike geodesics orthogonal to $V$ asymptotic volume-expansion invariants $\theta_\alpha$, and show that a uniform lower bound $\theta_\alpha\ge c>0$ forces a sharp upper bound on the time separation between $V$ and its chronological past. In particular, $(M,g)$ is past timelike geodesically incomplete. The estimate is sharp and equality is attained by Lorentzian cones. Moreover, in the smooth setting we prove a rigidity theorem showing that equality characterizes these cone models. The argument extends to globally hyperbolic Lorentzian length spaces satisfying the synthetic strong energy condition in the form of the Timelike Measure Contraction Property, TMCP(0,N). In this non-smooth setting we also obtain corresponding raywise and measure-rigidity statements.

classification.title_zh: 基于渐近展开的奇点定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们证明了一个尖锐的奇点定理，用类时测地线的渐近体积增长条件取代了 Hawking--Penrose 理论中的经典聚焦假设。具体地，设 (M,g) 为满足强能量条件的光滑全局双曲洛伦兹流形，V⊂M 为光滑紧致 Cauchy 超曲面。我们对与 V 正交的未来指向类时测地线定义渐近体积膨胀不变量 θ_α，并证明一致下界 θ_α ≥ c > 0 会迫使 V 与其时序过去之间的时间间隔具有尖锐上界。特别地，(M,g) 是过去类时测地不完备的。该估计是尖锐的，并且等号由洛伦兹锥实现。在光滑情形下，我们还证明了刚性定理，刻画了等号情形对应于锥模型。论证可推广到满足合成强能量条件（以类时测度收缩性质 TMCP(0,N) 表述）的全局双曲洛伦兹长度空间。在非光滑情形下，我们也得到相应的逐射线和测度刚性陈述。
classification.one_liner: 用类时测地线渐近体积膨胀代替经典聚焦条件，证明尖锐奇点定理与锥模型刚性，并推广到满足 TMCP 的洛伦兹长度空间。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论/洛伦兹几何中的奇点定理研究，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，且不涉及全息或量子引力。
